Mia, a Scottish doctor, in trouble at home, arrives in New Zealand to take refuge with her sister only to find her sister has died. Shock turns to mounting horror as she's drawn into a small town's web of lies and secrets.
Bloom finds her secret life in the world of Magix, she and her new friends must unlock new powers to defeat threats and find the truth about Bloom's birth parents.

movies.originalTitle: Kiru ra kiru: KILL la KILL
movies.plot: A young girl arrives at a school of superhumans to find out the truth behind her father's murder.
Long-running news-magazine/investigation series.
A coming-of-age story about a group of college athletes who are fighting for their dreams, experiencing and finding love in the process, and growing every step of the way.
Two skilled confidence tricksters separated by a 10-year prison sentence.

Freshman Rusty Cartwright arrives at college and decides he no longer wants to be the boring geek from high school. He decides to pledge a fraternity. He is offered 2 bids; one from his sister's boyfriend Evan's fraternity and one from Cappie, his sister's ex-boyfriend's fraternity. Rusty must learn to handle his new life, and his new relationship with his sister. His sister must decide if she loves Evan who is stable or Cappie who really loves her.
Genre anthology series based on the graphic novels by R.L. Stine.
Kagami meets Kuroko, the 6th member of the Miracle Generation, and they make a pact to defeat the other members of the team. A battle of light (Kagami) and shadow (Kuroko) begins.
A jaded film critic reunites with an aspiring director after years apart due to a mysterious event. Their reunion triggers buried memories and emotions, leading them to confront their shared past.
The intoxicating charm of a flirtatious art school classmate pulls a reluctant love cynic into a friends-with-benefits relationship.
A pink-haired girl named Stephanie moves to LazyTown with her uncle, the town's mayor, and tries to teach the extremely-lazy residents that physical activity is beneficial.

The drama is about a woman, Nam Hong Joo, who can see accidents that take place in the future through her dreams. And a prosecutor, Jung Jae Chan, who struggles to stop the woman's dreams from coming true.
Follows the story of Ok Chan-mi as she seeks revenge for the death of her twin brother.
Follows the world of an elite ballet academy, and charts the rise and fall of young adults who live far from their homes, each standing on the verge of greatness or ruin.

When their convenience-store-magnate father dies, a pair of pampered Pakistani-American brothers lose everything and are forced to reckon with their Baba's secret life of crime as they attempt to take up his mantle in the underworld.
On their way from Egypt to the promised land, Moses and his family struggle to manage the hardest part of their nation's journey: the people.

Ordinary Anne Boonchuy, 13, finds a music box that sends her to Amphibia, a world full of frogs, toads, and giant insects. With help from Sprig, she must adjust to life in Amphibia and discover the first true friendship in her life.

Cleaver Greene is a drug addict who has a massive gambling debt with some very shady characters and is in love with a prostitute. He's also a very good criminal lawyer, capable of winning unwinnable cases.

Kelly Quinn and her two best friends, Darbie and Hannah, find Kelly's grandmother's cookbook in the attic and discover some strange recipes. They soon begin to realize they have a book full of magic recipes.
A couple on a backpacking trip discovers a magical town in which everyone acts like they're in a classic musical.
The misadventures of a poor, homeless, fumbling boy and his friends in their humble neighborhood.
The misadventures of two single women in the 1950s and '60s.
Teen pregnancy halts Maria's teaching aspirations, but her determination drives her to fight for women's rights and a brighter tomorrow.
Cases of hard-working Parisian detective Chief Inspector Jules Maigret.
When an unlikely group of misfits discovers a common enemy in the same ruthless yet superstitious politician, they plot a heist to exact revenge.
Follows Baylen Dupree, a vibrant young woman with Tourette's Syndrome and her journey towards independence.
A fugitive scientist has the curse of becoming a powerful green monster under extreme emotional stress.
The everyday life of Arnold, a fourth-grader in the city of Hillwood, Washington, who lives in a multi-racial boarding house with his grandparents and a motley assortment of friends and neighbors.
A microbrewery owner and a student doctor are brought together by a car accident that injures a stray dog they agree to adopt, forcing them to navigate each other's vulnerabilities.

Homicide detective William Wisting struggles with the two toughest cases of his career. His serial killer investigation crosses paths with his journalist daughter's news story, putting her in grave danger.
Romance is sweet and bitter - and life riddled with ups and downs - in multiple stories about people who live and work on bustling Jeju Island.

Baek Sa Eon, a former presidential spokesman, marries Hong Hui Ju, a mute newspaper heiress, in an arranged union. When Hui Ju is kidnapped, their distant relationship is challenged as they navigate the crisis.

movies.originalTitle: Gakuen mokushiroku: HIGHSCHOOL OF THE DEAD
movies.plot: High school students are overwhelmed with the start of the zombie apocalypse.

Ex-cop Jim Bergerac is forced to confront a troubling past case when a wealthy woman is murdered, pushing him to overcome personal demons and reignite his investigative prowess to navigate family tensions and law enforcement scrutiny.

Explores the lives and sacrifices of historical saints like Joan of Arc, Francis of Assisi, John the Baptist, Thomas Becket, Mary Magdalene, Moses the Black, Sebastian, and Maximillian Kolbe, highlighting their acts.
When an Edinburgh schoolgirl is abducted, DI Ray Lennox investigates her disappearance whilst confronting his own past trauma.

Amanda, a divorced mother, relocates with her teenagers to South Harlesden. She faces modern parenting issues like teenage rebellion and environmental concerns, while her mother's loneliness adds chaos.
An anthology series that follows the work of homicide detectives in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
When seven college students find themselves trapped in a deadly game, two detectives compete to find the killer - even as their attraction grows.
An American guy falls in love with his Nigerian nurse.
Triplets Huey, Dewey, and Louie accompany their wealthy uncle Scrooge McDuck on globe-trotting adventures and treasure hunts, while uncovering family secrets and facing dangerous enemies.
A veteran cop with more than twenty years of experience is teamed with a young Inspector to solve crimes in San Francisco, California.
The misadventures of a futuristic family.
True crime drama following Detective Chief Inspector Colin Sutton as he tracks down notorious serial killers.
A musical comedy adventure featuring a knight on a quest for love who helps a childish king to see the error of his ways.

Follows 38 yr old Julian Kaye after his wrongful conviction release following 15 years in prison as he struggles to find his footing in the modern-day Los Angeles sex industry and navigates his complicated relationships.
A comedic look at a couple facing various challenges in their daily lives while trying to cope with their changes from twenties to thirties.
Set in the vineyards of California, this prime-time soap opera presented the conflict in the powerful Gioberti family, owners of the vast Falcon Crest Winery.
Ten young Canadians from across the country come together to share an unfiltered and unforgettable summer.

movies.primaryTitle: Suspect: The Shooting of Jean Charles de Menezes
movies.originalTitle: Suspect: The Shooting of Jean Charles de Menezes
movies.plot: Police pursue suspects in failed bombing attempts. Innocent Brazilian man is misidentified as a suspect and shot dead by police. Police are found guilty in his death. Police Commissioner resigns.
Uxía has a pet store and employs her uncle Antón, a rural veterinarian.

Payton Hobart, a student from Santa Barbara, has known since age seven that he's going to be President of the United States. But first he'll have to navigate the most treacherous political landscape of all: Saint Sebastian High School .
Bill and Judy are not your average parents; the kids are the responsible ones.
The battle between man and sea takes a vicious turn.
Follows a team of skilled police interrogators as they interview suspects to get to the bottom of heinous crimes.
A female private investigator whose career specialty is exposing fraud for a living is drawn to a man whose career appears to be committing fraud for a living.
An outspoken and confident technology wiz and skilled black belt discovers that both her parents are spies and expect her to follow in their footsteps.

College freshman Steve Karp, his girlfriend and their fellow dormmates embark on one of the greatest experiences of their lives. Unfortunately for Steve, his lonely and recently divorced father is tagging along for the ride.
A youth romance about two men and woman who aren't blood related but treated each other as family during their teens and how they meet again after 10 years.

Hachimitsu Academy, once an all-girls school, has become co-ed, and teen Kiyoshi is one of five boys to enroll. When he is caught peeping, Kiyoshi is sent to the schools prison, where his punishment is carried out.
A sci-fi anthology series with stand-alone episodes based on the works of Philip K. Dick.

Ha-jin travels 1000 years back in time and lands in the era of Goryeo Dynasty as a young girl named Hae-soo. She, now trapped in another person's body, becomes involved in a power struggle against various vicious contenders to the throne.

movies.primaryTitle: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
movies.originalTitle: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
movies.plot: The Ninja Turtles, as teenagers, deal with their new life as heroes while also dealing with the pressures of going to high school in New York City.
An ex-secret agent is taken to a bizarre prison disguised as an idyllic village, from which he attempts to escape while trying not to divulge the information his captors seek to obtain.

movies.originalTitle: Tensei Shitara Dragon no Tamago Datta: Saikyo Igai Mezasanee
movies.plot: A person reincarnates as a dragon egg in a dangerous forest. Without limbs or powers, it must survive and grow from this vulnerable state, determined to become the mightiest dragon possible.

Eight contestants in financial hardship take part in Money Game, a reality competition with 44.8 billion won up for grabs. To win they must endure 100 days in a sparse studio as all purchases carry a 1000x markup, subtracted from the prize
Guts is haunted by demons who are attracted to him because of a demonic mark on his neck.

Veteran detective Danny Frater is called to a hospital mortuary to identify a corpse only to find it is his estranged daughter. Traumatized by the news she took her own life, Frater sets out to discover the truth about her death.
A historical fiction drama and thriller set in the turbulent period of the late 1920s in the Balkans as a place where high politics, local interests, capital and crime all merge together.

Let yourself be enchanted by the social scene, linked to tradition and splendor like no other culture in America, by a group of the city's most charismatic gentlemen and their equally charming Southern belles.
In a city of coaching centers known to train India’s finest collegiate minds, an earnest but unexceptional student and his friends navigate campus life.
Chaos ensues when a modern-day chef gets trapped in the body of a Joseon-era Queen.

After Crystallized, the 16 realms have abruptly fused into a cosmic unstable dystopia. A Spinjitzu Ninja Master trains a new generation of heroes to find Elemental Dragons before the forces of evil exploit that energy to destroy the world.
A smart alecky San Francisco, California cop and his get rich quick scheme of a partner keep tabs on crime and take down the bad guys in the Bay Area.
It follows the tale of when Julio Torres lost a golden oyster.
Behind the scenes with WWE Superstars and staff from RAW to WrestleMania as they create wrestling's grandest events.
When he's invited to manage a hotel for dead souls, an elite hotelier gets to know the establishment's ancient owner and her strange world.
A retired Intelligence Agent turned private detective helps various threatened clients to equalize the odds.
What will happen, when, as a result of a Biological War, almost the entire human population dies? Women will cry and then create a new and better world.
Ecological thriller about the delicate interconnectedness between mankind and Earth.
A clan of heroic night creatures pledge to protect modern New York City as they did in Scotland one thousand years earlier.
A rookie FBI agent is sent to a house for undercover agents in Southern California, where he is trained by a former legend FBI agent.
An aging sheriff tries to keep the peace in Rome, Wisconsin, a small town plagued by violent--and bizarre--crimes.

You'll fall for the Ouran Host Club: Tamaki's truly romantic. Kaoru and Hikaru display brotherly love, Kyoya's brainy, Honey's innocent, and Mori's manly. Oh, and don't forget Haruhi. He knows what girls want, because he's a girl too.
History Professor Sydney Fox and her linguistic assistant Nigel recover ancient artifacts from around the world, while battling rival hunters.
A talented P.I. agrees to work as the in-house investigator for his mother, who is reeling from the recent dissolution of her marriage.
As part of a deal with an intelligence agency to look for his missing brother, a renegade pilot goes on missions with an advanced battle helicopter named Airwolf.
A modern-day Korean emperor passes through a mysterious portal and into a parallel world, where he encounters a feisty police detective.

movies.primaryTitle: Two Guys, a Girl and a Pizza Place
movies.originalTitle: Two Guys, a Girl and a Pizza Place
movies.plot: Three twenty-somethings share a Boston apartment and hang around (and work) at a pizza place.
A parody of reality shows cast with spoofs of several famous types of animated characters.
French serial about the lives and jobs of people working at a talent agency in Paris.
A politically sensitive murder forces two disparate detectives into a battle with the Berlin underworld and a confrontation with their own corruption.
Identical twin sisters with opposite lives - one a former athlete living freely, the other a corporate perfectionist switch places with each other, despite their contrasting personalities.
Unpleasant events disturb the life of an aspiring crime fiction writer when he becomes a resident of an apartment building teeming with shady neighbors.
A story about Ji-won who after being killed by her husband who had an affair with her best friend, goes back 10 years in the past and has a chance to change her fate.
Archie MacDonald, a young restaurateur is called back to his childhood home of Glenbogle where he is told he is the new Laird of Glenbogle.
A man and a woman make separate journeys to a mysterious island off the British coast.

A series of murders alarm the police authorities, as strange symbolisms are traced to every crime scene. The eccentric professor of criminology Dimitris Lainis is asked to shed some light on the mystery.
Follows a woman who embarks on a journey of self-discovery and personal growth, navigating the complexities of life and relationships while pursuing her dreams.
Max Liebermann, a medical student and protegé of Sigmund Freud, helps Detective Reinhardt in the investigation of a series of disturbing murders around 1900s Vienna.
Inés is a 42-year-old woman who, at a difficult moment in her life, plunges into the sea to end her life. Her savior is Hugo, a teenager with whom she falls obsessively in love.
Chronicles some of the most famous leaders of the Roman Civilization.

movies.primaryTitle: The Misfit of Demon King Academy
movies.originalTitle: Maô Gakuin no Futekigôsha ~Shijô Saikyô no Maô no Shiso, Tensei Shite Shison-tachi no Gakkô e Kayô~
movies.plot: Tired of endless war, Demon King Anos decides to be reincarnated into a peaceful future. Enrolling in school, he doesn't get the welcome he hoped for.
It follows the life of the legendary Hunkpapa Lakota chief, detailing seminal moments and key figures in Native American history.
A true-crime satire that explores the aftermath of a costly high school prank that left twenty-seven faculty cars vandalized with phallic images.

Murphy is a hard-living, hard-drinking, disaffected twenty-something. She's also blind. Her life comes crashing down when she stumbles upon what she's sure is the lifeless body of her closest friend in the alley outside her apartment.

movies.primaryTitle: Don't Trust the B---- in Apartment 23
movies.originalTitle: Don't Trust the B---- in Apartment 23
movies.plot: A naive young woman finds herself with a wild roommate when she moves to New York.
The adventures of a mobster-turned-movie producer in Hollywood. TV show based on Elmore Leonard's novel and subsequent film.
U.S. Marshal Mary Shannon must hunt down witnesses for federal cases in the witness protection program while also managing a rather dysfunctional family and her own personal life.
The misadventures of a divorced mother, her family and their building superintendent in Indianapolis.
Teenage versions of DC Comics superheroines both attend high school and fight crime to protect the citizens of Metropolis.

A bride-to-be wins a newlywed house, but after breaking up with her fiance and faced with debt, she finds a fake husband to move in with. They have to fool the house inspector for 90 days, then the dream home is officially hers.

Sam Loudermilk is a recovering alcoholic and substance-abuse counselor with a bad attitude. Although he has his drinking under control, Loudermilk discovers that when your life is a mess, getting clean is the easy part.
Unlock the secrets of the Dragon Eye and come face to face with more dragons than anyone has ever imagined as Hiccup, Toothless and the Dragon Riders soar to the edge of adventure.
Resistance fighters battle the aliens who control Earth.
The adventurous life of Cricket Green, a country boy who moves with his family from their rural farm to a modern metropolis.

A Japanese-American athlete transfers to an all-boys school in Japan to be near her sports idol. Disguised as a boy, she becomes his roommate and must keep her identity secret while dealing with unexpected feelings and confusion.

Aisha Tyler hosts this skit comedy show where the actors on the show, usually Wayne Brady, Colin Mochrie, Ryan Stiles and another guest star or two do different comedy skits. It's all improv and made up on the spot.
Jana returns to her hometown to help her alcoholic twin. She falls for a man accused of killing Maria, her brother's lost love. Investigating Maria's death, Jana confronts her own repressed past.
The adventures of Shaolin monk Kwai Chang Caine as he wanders through the American West, armed only with his spiritual training and his skill in Kung Fu.

Michiko is a free-willed "sexy diva" who escaped from prison, while Hatchin is a run away girl fleeing from her strict catholic foster family. The two join forces and set off on an unpredictable road trip seeking their own freedom.

movies.originalTitle: Gate: Jieitai Kanochi nite, Kaku Tatakaeri
movies.plot: A gate appears in modern-day Tokyo which allows access to a fantasy world. A Japanese military squad is formed to establish ties between both worlds.
A romantic comedy set in 1880s Madrid, coinciding with the Alphonsine era and the Restoration period, depicting the social and cultural landscape of the time.
An unhappy young woman from an abusive family is married off to a fearsome and chilly army commander. But the two learn more about each other, love may have a chance.
A woman struggling in her life as a quietly tortured housewife finds an unconventional path to power through an unlikely source: the world of aerobics.
British comedy sketch show by 6 well known comedy actors/actresses

In the mid-nineteenth century in the village of Kengis, northern Sweden, the body of a shepherd's girl is found in a bog. Soon the villagers set out in search of the killer bear they think is on the rampage.
A teenager with no hands is suspected of knowing who killed her cult's leader and lands in juvenile detention.
Haruka Sakura has no interest in weaklings, only the strongest fighters. Starting at Furin High, a school known for student brawlers who protect their town, Haruka seeks to battle his way to the top.
In the computer world of the Grid, a young program joins Tron's fight against their world's tyranny.

Explores the emotional struggles and sexual politics of a group of doctors charged with healthy libidos. Their dedication to their personal lives is relentless, interrupted only by the occasional need to treat sick children.
Set in an alternate New York City, a father and husband searches through a magical world for his abducted son and missing wife.
16 year old Cassie Blake moves to Chance Harbor, Washington to live with her grandmother after her mother mysteriously dies. She discovers she's a witch along with 5 other teens.
Two opposing factions of transforming alien robots engage in a battle that has the fate of Earth in the balance.
Discovering his ties to a secret ancient order, a young man living in modern Istanbul embarks on a quest to save the city from an immortal enemy.

movies.primaryTitle: Shiboyugi: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table
movies.originalTitle: Shibô Yûgi de Meshi wo Kû.
movies.plot: About a badass girl who is participating in death games in a professional way because she lives off the prize money. And she makes sure to win, no matter who's her competition.
Hybrid warrior Clare and her comrades fight to protect their land from shape-shifting demons.
A comedy that follows three Chicago EMTs who despite their narcissistic and self-destructive personalities are uniquely qualified to save lives.
A story of struggle for power set in the rugged and mysterious hills of Appalachia.

Ace NIS agent Jung Hae-seong is demoted after a mission failure. He goes undercover at a high school to locate King Gojong's missing gold, meeting his teacher Oh Soo-ah, who sees him as her lost first love, stirring old heartbreak.
The misadventures of a group of urban teens as they go about their lives.
The untold story of Superman's grandfather as he fights for justice on his home planet.
Two divorced mothers and their children share an apartment.
The story blends elements of science, fate, and obsession. It follows Wu Nong Yu, a graduate student in genetic engineering, and Xie Xin Xu, a brilliant but emotionally detached man.

Julie is a teenage girl who finds her passion for music and life with the help of a high-concept band of teen boys "The Phantoms" who have been dead for 25 years. Julie, in turn, helps them become the band they were never able to be.
Michelle, a Las Vegas showgirl marries a man on a whim and moves to his sleepy coastal town where she winds up working alongside her new mother-in-law at her dance school.
Dark comedy about the eccentric members of the Flowers family. Maurice and Deborah are barely together but yet to divorce. They live with Maurice's batty mother and their maladjusted twin children.
Sofia is a little girl with a commoner's background until her mom marries the king and suddenly she is royalty.
A hotel owner reads a letter from a former guest talking about his affair at the hotel. It becomes a flashback of the guest arriving at the hotel and falling in love with someone.
The heroic story of Ertugrul Ghazi, the father of Osman (Uthman) who founded the Ottoman Empire.
After being betrayed and murdered by his employer, a government assassin is resurrected as a Hellspawn and is forced to act as the reluctant leader of Hell's army.
When a single career woman reunites with her best friend's younger brother after he returns from three years of working abroad, their efforts to reconnect grow into romance.
Single men and women bare all on a tropical island in the hopes of finding love without modern world complications getting in the way.

From behind the bars to life on the outside Wentworth's spin off series delves into a new world of redemption and survival following life on parole and its challenges in a world that has changed before them.
In the Quad, a planetary system on the brink of a bloody interplanetary class war, a fun loving trio of bounty hunters attempt to remain impartial as they chase deadly warrants.
After a family scandal leaves Mel, a local politician, in charge of her niece and nephew, she hires a man named Joe to become the family's male nanny, or "manny."
A crazy fantasy caper involving alchemists, immortals, gangsters, outlaws and an elixir of immortality, spread over several decades.
A minor god seeking to gain widespread worship teams up with a human girl he saved to gain fame, recognition and at least one shrine dedicated to him.
In the Tudor court of Elizabeth I, Lord Edmund Blackadder strives to win Her Majesty's favour while attempting to avoid a grisly fate should he offend her.
In a surreal world, a large maximum-security prison that houses thousands of dangerous inmates is run by an eccentric warden and his equally-odd staff.
Comedy parody about TV.

When the constant comments on her single status and society's expectations of the perfect family Christmas finally get to 30-year-old Johanne, she starts a 24-day hunt for a partner to bring home for Christmas.
Follows Matty Matheson as he cooks up a storm with no kitchen and no plan while hitting the road.
A former philosophy professor who takes a job teaching advanced placement biology uses his students to get back at the people in his life who have wronged him.

movies.primaryTitle: The Testament of Sister New Devil
movies.plot: First-year high school student, Toujo Basara, was suddenly have two beautiful step-sisters adopted by his father. But Mio and Maria's true forms are actually the newbie Demon Lord and a succubus!?
Gentleman adventurer Phileas Fogg sets out on a quest to travel around the world and back home in a period of 80 days.
The series follows doting mothers and their childrens' early steps on the road to stardom, all under the discerning eye of a notoriously demanding and passionate dance instructor.
A series of scary anthology stories based on the children's books by R.L. Stine.
A worldwide financial conspiracy is discovered by a group of traders of a large investment bank.

Rose Thippapha returns from America after her stepfather's accident. Vineyard owner Wasu threatens her inherited land for his illegal operations. Childhood friend Din Kasama Wathinwanit protects her through a marriage arrangement.
Funky hospital-based sketch-comedy-drama type show.
Nanami is left homeless after her father runs away due to debts. When she saves a man named Mikage from dogs, he gives her his house which turns out to be a shrine and she becomes the new deity.
Four women and one man share the common bond of loving someone in the U.S. Army.

Follows John Creasy, a wounded former mercenary on a quest to get revenge for the loss of his only companion while defending the daughter of his dead colleague from the forces that tore her family apart.
During a perilous 24-hour mission on the moon, space explorers try to retrieve samples from an abandoned research facility steeped in classified secrets.

When the Embassy in London is attacked, a U.S. diplomat faces an impossible choice: protect the Ambassador or follow orders to extract a high-value asset. As a deeper conspiracy unfolds, she must team up with her ex, a British SAS soldier.

movies.primaryTitle: I Know What You Did Last Summer
movies.originalTitle: I Know What You Did Last Summer
movies.plot: In a town full of secrets, a group of teenagers are stalked by a mysterious killer a year after a fatal accident on their graduation night.
A powerful aristocratic family breeds thoroughbred horses at their grand estate, where hidden secrets, power struggles, and family conflicts threaten their legacy.
The Jessops navigate everyday family (mis)fortunes - from new jobs to kidnapping dogs. Acclaimed comedy with Tom Basden, Jim Howick, Alison Steadman and Katherine Parkinson.

movies.primaryTitle: Behzat Ç: An Ankara Detective Story
movies.plot: An inharmonious police team in Ankara Police Force and its discredited police chief fight crime.

Daimon and Ana Helstrom are the son and daughter of a mysterious and powerful serial killer. The siblings have a complicated dynamic as they track down the terrorizing worst of humanity - each with their attitude and skills.
Newly-elected U.S. President Hunter Franklin and his family move into the White House.
TV show based on the action-comedy 'Rush Hour' films about an L.A. cop who teams up with a detective from Hong Kong.
Hospital Playlist tells the story of five doctors who have been friends since they entered medical school in 1999.

movies.primaryTitle: Soul Power: The Legend of the American Basketball Association
movies.originalTitle: Soul Power: The Legend of the American Basketball Association
movies.plot: The American Basketball Association's nine-year rivalry with the NBA transformed basketball forever. The ABA introduced the 3-point shot and Slam Dunk Contest, now game staples.

movies.originalTitle: Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu
movies.plot: Fascinated by the macabre, Kyotaro fantasizes about acting on his twisted thoughts to the detriment of his classmates. His heart was dark until an encounter with Anna lit a spark within it in a classic tale of boy meets girl.

A comedy series about a bachelor brother and his newly divorced sister living under one roof again. Together, they coach each other through the crazy world of dating while raising her teenage daughter.
The off-the-wall, day-to-day life of three friends who have exactly the same name.
In 1952, four women who worked at the wartime code-breaking centre, Bletchley Park, reunite to track down a serial killer.

movies.primaryTitle: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You
movies.plot: Sawako wishes to make friends but her weird vibe and lack of communication skills are getting in her way. Fortunately, it's no longer the case since she met Kazehaya, an extroverted guy who she couldn't help but to fall in love with.
An unlucky girl meets an undead guy. The two work together well with their super abilities, but discover a conspiracy involving superhumans.

Jo I-na finds her uncle murdered beside a puzzle piece but can't explain her presence. Ten years later, as a criminal profiler, she investigates murders where victims are found with similar puzzle pieces.
Villains from some of television's most popular reality shows will be put in competition, where each week one will be eliminated until only one winner remains.
A famed magician uses his skills of deception to assist the FBI in solving high-profile cases.
In the Regency era, Mr E. Blackadder serves as butler to the foppish numskull Prince George amidst the fads and crazes of the time.
A forensic neuro-psychiatrist reluctantly enters a dangerous and violent world of mistaken identity, police corruption and mental illness.
Follows the lives of several single male and female roommates and friends in 1990s Brooklyn, New York.
A contemporary father takes his family on a road trip across America, but a set of crazy, unforeseen circumstances causes them to end up on the run from the FBI.

A family-owned hotel in the fictional coastal Spanish town of Cantaloa in 1905: love, blackmail, jealousies, crime, comedy, and plots and counter-plots all involving the hotel's owners, guests, detectives, and residential employees.
When a mysterious illness descends upon the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, a desperate fight for survival collides with a race to find a cure.
The wild misadventures of Edina "Eddy" Monsoon and her best friend Patsy Stone, who live in a nearly constant haze of drugged, drunken selfishness.
A single murder case is dissected from the committing of the crime through to the investigation, arrest and trial.

A team trapped inside the dysfunctional hell of creating franchise superhero movies. At the end of the day the question they face: is this Hollywood's new dawn or cinema's last stand? Is this a dream factory or a chemical plant?
Two brothers with opposite personalities investigate crime.
Set in the 1920s, this is the story of four women from different backgrounds newly hired as operators for a phone company.
"Arthdal Chronicles" depicts the birth of civilization and nations in ancient times. It is a story of mythical heroes--their struggle, unity, and love of people living in a virtual land called Arth.

A teenage boy and girl get their lives changed forever when a California wildfire awakens a terrifying supernatural creature. As the full moon rises, all teens come together to unravel the secret that connects them.

The friendship between Riley, a Marine combat veteran struggling to readjust to civilian life in Ohio, and Awalmir, the Afghan interpreter who served with his unit and has just arrived to start a new life in America.
Tenacious and stubborn DCI Alan Banks unravels disturbing murder mysteries aided by his young assistants, DS Annie Cabbot and DI Helen Morton.

Martin Tupper's a recently divorced book editor in Manhattan. Martin's life is filled with fantasies and sexual thoughts, many times coming in the form of black-and-white shots from old TV shows and films.
The series followed Halil Ibrahim as he seeks revenge for the death of the love of his life. His plans are derailed when he meets Zeynep from the Leto family.
Follows three generations of the same Cuban-American family living in the same house: a newly divorced former military mother, her teenage daughter and tween son, and her old-school mother.
A behind-the-scenes look at a fictional sketch-comedy television show.
A tragic accident leaves an ambitious prosecutor with the mind of a child, forcing him and his mother to embark on a journey to heal their relationship.

1915, WWI. French Private Gabriel is presumed dead. Selected for a top-secret program, he's given a serum that makes him stronger and faster. To see his family again, he must join the Sentinels, elite soldiers on a mission to end the war.
A female celebrity has her whole life upended when her phone is hacked and a photo of her in an extremely compromising position emerges.
Hotshot lawyer Nick Fallin must perform community service at a child advocacy office or risk being disbarred.

movies.primaryTitle: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest
movies.plot: Hajime Nagumo and his high-school classmates are suddenly summoned to a fantastical land as heroes.
Various historical fighters are summoned from across time to wage war on each other, with the fate of the world in the balance.
Noodle shop employees by day and demon hunters by night, the Counters use special abilities to chase down malevolent spirits that prey on humans.
Cranky nurses, anxious doctors, and administrators wrestle with the darkly comic, honest, and compassionate realities of caring for the elderly in a rundown hospital.

movies.primaryTitle: Wyatt Earp and the Cowboy War
movies.originalTitle: Wyatt Earp and the Cowboy War
movies.plot: The legendary feud between Wyatt Earp and Ike Clanton unfolds through vivid reenactments in this gritty docudrama about the gunfight that defined an era.
War veteran and former hunter soldier Niels Oxen, Denmark's most decorated soldier ever. Sent home with war trauma, he tries to create meaning in life and to make everyday life fit together.
A British and German detective clashing over how to police the Spanish island of Mallorca.

A family moves to a small town into a house in which terrible atrocities have taken place. But nobody seems to notice except for Pat, who's convinced she's either depressed or possessed--turns out, the symptoms are exactly the same.

Follows Suzie, an American woman living in Japan, and Sunny, a domestic robot made by her husband's company, as they uncover the dark truth of what really happened to Suzie's husband and son, who disappeared in a mysterious plane crash.
A slacker must find and return escaped souls to hell.
A young man competes with people around the world for a chance to become the succesor of God, with a diary that is able to tell the future.
A dedicated investigator, she is being forced into early retirement and takes on a final cold case centered on a young Russian asylum seeker who died mysteriously one year prior.
David Tennant and Michael Sheen's West End play has been put on hold due to Covid-19, but their director has persuaded them to carry on rehearsing online.

Abby Walker's husband is murdered before her eyes. On her quest for revenge, Abby crosses paths with Hoyt Rawlins. Abby and Hoyt's journey takes them to Independence, Texas, where they encounter residents running from their own pasts.
The lives and work of the staff of a major Los Angeles law firm.

A former FBI profiler with the ability to look inside the mind of a killer begins working for the mysterious Millennium Group which investigates serial killers, conspiracies, the occult, and those obsessed with the end of the millennium.

Third-year student Taiki joins badminton club. Despite being an early riser, star player Chinatsu, his crush, arrives first. Living together unexpectedly, Taiki strives to reach Nationals to impress Chinatsu.
Based on the book series of the same name focusing on a group of young girls who start their own babysitting service.
A self-destructive woman who has a spiritual awakening becomes determined to live an enlightened life, creating havoc at home and work.
A widowed mom discovers that her son has super powers and tries to figure out how to raise him safely and responsibly.
A determined FBI agent delves into a female killer's history while partnering with a seasoned investigator to track her down.
After losing their parents at sea, two siblings enter an exclusive boarding school. The students soon realize that the school is full of mysteries and secrets.
Victor Meldrew is a retiree who attracts bad luck. If he's not driving his long suffering wife Margaret crazy with his constant moaning, he's fighting with neighbours.
A Mennonite family secretly built a drug empire from rural Canada, connecting their religious community to cartel networks across North America.
The Mayor of Chicago guides his city with a Machiavellian style.
The story of a young delivery boy who becomes a drift-racing legend.
The young Swedish couple David and Siri, together since high school, share a love that is self-evident and strong, but soon face challenges that test their relationship and their future.

A warrior from the 16th Century, the first female university student from the 19th Century, and a paramedic from the 21st Century join a secret agency to prevent people from changing Spanish history using time-traveling doors.

The play is adapted from Qingshan Quzui's novel "Losing Money to Become the Richest Man Starting from Games". When Qian Pei, a worker in a large factory, was fired, he unexpectedly received a million-dollar startup fund and turned from a social animal to a boss. However, the investor stipulated that he would only receive a monthly salary of 5,000 yuan if the company made a profit, and he would only receive a bonus if the company lost money. In order to lose money, Qian Pei started from the high-risk and fast-burning game industry and founded Tengda Information Technology Co., Ltd., which means "flying yellow and rising", hoping that the company could go bankrupt quickly. However, he gathered all kinds of unreliable shrimp soldiers and crab generals, deliberately made a series of alternative games that violated the laws of the market, but became popular again and again. Frustrated, Qian Pei turned to other fields. However, whether it was physical industries such as internet cafes, restaurants, and apartments, or cultural industries such as Chinese websites, film and television companies, and live broadcast platforms, Qian Pei made money repeatedly and made a lot of money. He could only rack his brains to give benefits to employees, becoming a conscientious boss in the eyes of employees and a business wizard in the hearts of his peers. But only Qian Pei himself knew that this was not what he wanted. He really just wanted to lose money.
Police investigate when the body of a girl is found in a lake.

movies.primaryTitle: The Last Days of Ptolemy Grey
movies.originalTitle: The Last Days of Ptolemy Grey
movies.plot: Suddenly left without his trusted caretaker, Ptolemy Grey is assigned to the care of orphaned teenager, Robyn. When they learn about a treatment that will restore Ptolemy's memories, it begins a journey towards shocking truths.

Quarry, a disillusioned Vietnam War vet, returns home to Memphis in 1972 only to find rejection and scrutiny at every step. A mysterious man known only as The Broker gives him an offer he can't refuse - to work for him as a hitman.
World renowned chef Gordon Ramsay puts aspiring young chefs through rigorous cooking challenges and dinner services at his restaurant, "Hell's Kitchen".

In a quaint mysterious town of Charandaspur, where fate, myth, and murder entwine, detectives Rea Thomas and Vikram Singh unravel a chilling conspiracy of ritualistic killings tied to a centuries-old secret society.

movies.primaryTitle: Shimoneta: A Boring World Where the Concept of Dirty Jokes Doesn't Exist
movies.originalTitle: Shimoneta to Iu gainen ga sonzai shinai taikutsu na sekai
movies.plot: Tanukichi Okuma is roped into joining an obscene terrorist organization bent on the destruction of everything that his new school stands for, the most prestigious public morals school.
The history of Gon Freecss, a boy who left home alone to become a Hunter. In the hard test, Gon meets Leorio, Kurapika and Killua.
Game show contestants compete to prove they're the most average American through challenges about typical US life and thinking. Winner gets crowned and can win $67,920 - the average US salary.
The exploits of a group of men and women who serve New York City as police officers, firefighters, and paramedics in the fictional 55th Precinct.
After being dumped by his girlfriend, a college student enlists a dating service to "rent" a girlfriend who, unbeknownst to him, happens to be both a fellow student and his neighbor.
A nouveau-riche hillbilly family moves to Beverly Hills and shakes up the privileged society with their hayseed ways.

movies.primaryTitle: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten
movies.originalTitle: Otonari no tenshi-sama ni itsu no ma ni ka dame-ningen ni sareteita ken
movies.plot: Mahiru is so beautiful that they call her "angel", Amane is an average boy who has never thought much about beauty, but everything changes when he sees Mahiru during a storm, and an incredible and unlikely relationship begins.
From elves to succubi to fairies and more, Our heroes: Stunk, a human, Zel, an elf and a hermaphrodite angel named Crimvael are here to rate the red-light delights of all manner of monster girls.

Ex communicated RAW agent Kabir Anand, a courageous analyst and a sleeper agent take on a covert mission in Balochistan when four Indian spies are captured; the mission soon turns south and Kabir must face his demons from the past.

It is an adult animated series centered on five house cats who mysteriously become sentient. With their "higher" consciousness, they create an absolute catastrophe, forcing them to repeatedly save their beloved owner, Ms. Stoner.
A group of disparate fugitives from an interplanetary tyranny find themselves in control of a massively powerful starship.
Scientists from the Centers for Disease Control travel to a research facility in the Arctic.

Sex, drugs and a gruesome murder. An edgy one night stand turns into a nightmare for Aditya, when he wakes up with blood on his hands. The evidence is stacked against him, but he doesn't remember the grisly crime. Is he guilty or not ?

movies.primaryTitle: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
movies.originalTitle: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
movies.plot: On the planet Eternia, a young prince gains the ability to become a powerful warrior to defend Castle Grayskull against the dark lord Skeletor.

A former elite police officer, forced to resign after a panic attack, takes a job as a security guard at a clothing complex, where he uncovers an opportunity to resolve his late father's crippling gambling debts.

Follows millionaire Phillip Drummond, his daughter Kimberly, their current housekeeper Edna and Arnold and Willis, the two pre-teenage sons of their late African American housekeeper from Harlem, whom he adopted and raised as his own.

Four years after the Rising, the government starts to rehabilitate the Undead for reentry into society, including teenager Kieren Walker, who returns to his small Lancashire village to face a hostile reception, as well as his own demons.
A mysterious, clever girl named Nanno transfers to different schools, exposing the lies and misdeeds of the students and faculty at every turn.

In the 1840s, Cranford is ruled by the ladies. They adore good gossip, and romance and change is in the air, as the unwelcome grasp of the Industrial Revolution rapidly approaches their beloved rural market-town.

The entrepreneurial jet set and the criminal world are more brutal, chaotic, and ruthless than ever. When these two worlds collide, loyalty, friendships, and business partners will be tested in the never-ending quest for easy money.
Comedian and political satirist Bill Maher discusses topical events with guests from various backgrounds.

Ayuzawa Misaki serves as the student council president at Seika High. However, unbeknownst to her classmates, she works part-time as an employee at a Maid Cafe. Usui Takumi, a boy from her school, discovers this secret.

Nelly hasn't rested trying to find his missing daughter Jody, he won't give up, and he will do anything to find out what happened. Discovering things about him and those around him, things he never imagined.

Ralph Lamb, a former MP for the US Army, becomes sheriff. His brother, Jack, and his son, Dixon, are deputized. Meanwhile, Vincent Savino comes from Chicago to Vegas to run The Savoy hotel and casino.
Showcases how love plays out between two very different people over the course of 15 years. Are the bonds between us stronger than the forces that would tear us apart?
A gripping teen mystery thriller that centers on the intense bond between teenage girls as they navigate a brutal survival competition even more challenging than the entrance exam.
During the dawn of the magical era, Lü Shu, a metahuman, experiences the changes in himself, his country and the world.
A man claims he's blind from an accident, but his daughter-in-law doubts him. They plan tests to verify his blindness.

Black, plus-size, and newly single, Mavis unexpectedly finds herself rebuilding her life after putting all her eggs in one man's basket, but she's determined to not only survive but thrive with support from her chosen family.
Former professional hockey player Matt Shade partners with private eye Angie Everett to solve crimes around Toronto.
A group of best friends creating a webcast while grappling with everyday problems and adventures.

Follows the dedicated, heroic and adrenaline-seeking lifeguards of the North Shore of O'ahu, as they save people's lives in the difficult and often life-threatening conditions of Hawaii's Seven Mile Miracle.

Set a decade after the U.S.S Voyager's return to Earth, a rag-tag crew of renegades and outcasts must covertly work with Admiral Chekov and Tuvok to stop forces threatening the Federation from outside, and within.

A bored linguistics professor discovers after 17 years that her tech salesman husband is secretly a top international spy. Now she has a use for her martial arts workouts and endless supply of languages.
In a city which should be familiar, there is the feeling of something a little different.
The thrilling love story of Shin Woo Yeo, a 999-years-old gumiho who wants to become human, and Lee Dam, who accidentally swallowed his fox bead.
Bertram Wooster, a well-intentioned, wealthy layabout, has a habit of getting himself into trouble and it's up to his brilliant valet, Jeeves, to get him out.

The story is set during the Joseon Dynasty when twins were considered an ominous sign. When the Crown Princess Consort gives birth to twins, an order is sent to kill the daughter. To save her, she is secretly sent out of the palace.
A food company heir running Seoul's top restaurant meets a passionate rural chef. Despite his indifference to taste, they develop feelings while operating a small eatery together in Jeonju.
A group of never-do-well forest rangers are facing the shutdown of their National Park when a new ranger arrives to help transform them and save the park.
The misadventures of a milkshake, an order of fries, a meatball, and their retired next door neighbor in the suburbs of New Jersey.
Richie Finestra, a shrewd record executive from New York, tries to promote American Century, his music label, amidst the changing music scene in the 1970s.

Hockey is the last beacon of hope in Beartown and being responsible for it is a heavy burden. The day of the semi-final match is also the catalyst for a violent act that will leave a young girl traumatized and a town in turmoil.
World War II-era drama centered on the lives of ordinary people affected by the war.
Two obsessive dreamers collide with the resistance of expectations, morality and each other.
Along the stormy Black Sea coast, a resilient woman's path crosses with a troubled man whose inner struggles mirror the wild waters that surround them.
The origin story of Velma Dinkley, the underappreciated mastermind behind the Scooby-Doo gang.

A retired police officer is on a fresh career path as he rises to the challenge of being a newly single dad. His kids are grateful to him for making sure they're okay, but decide it's time for him to get out of the house, so they turn to Vanessa (Leah Remini), his former police partner, for help.
A separated, fired NYC lawyer returns to his hometown in Ohio, meets old high school friends and cute crush, buys a bowling alley and opens a law office in it.
Toradora tells the tale of Ryuji (dragon) and Taiga (tiger) helping each other confess to their crushes.

Follows a 12-year-old girl who lives a closed-in life after turning into a vampire, only able to go out at night. Her father does his best to provide her with the minimal amount of human blood she needs to stay alive.
When British and Australian detectives team up to solve a murder mystery, they uncover a conspiracy with international political consequences as well as a clash of cultures.
The adventures of the archaeological treasure hunter in his youth as related by an elderly Indiana Jones.
Derek is a loyal nursing home care assistant who sees only the good in his quirky co-workers as they struggle against prejudice and shrinking budgets to care for their elderly residents.
The adventures of a gentlemanly gunfighter-for-hire.
The adventures of an impossibly upright Royal Canadian Mounted Police constable and his American colleagues in the city of Chicago.

High school outcast Josh is searching for his missing girlfriend in post apocalyptic Glendale. He's joined by a group of misfits Angelica and his former bully Wesley. On the way they'll face many weird things.
Jimmy Kimmel interviews celebrities.

You'd think boys would be glad to see girls attend their high school? Not at all. When Voltaire High becomes coed in 1963 France and for the first time a handful of girls take classes alongside boys, a whole world is knocked off balance.
The iconic Canadian sketch comedy troupe The Kids in the Hall return from the dead with a reboot of their ground-breaking sketch series.
An urban dark fantasy drama about a gumiho who settles into the city and a producer who is after it.
Claire embarks on a life-or-death mission that includes blackmail, nuclear sabotage, and deceiving the people she loves the most.
The series follows recovering addict and comedian Mae, who is trying to control the addictive behaviors and intense romanticism that permeate every facet of their life.

Baek Su Jeong leads a planning team at a renowned department store. She meets her new boss, Ban Ju Yeon, her first love from an online game 16 years ago, stirring up memories of when he confessed his feelings but she rejected him.

Rick Hunter is a renegade cop who bends the rules and takes justice into his own hands. Partnered with the equally stunning and rebellious Sgt. McCall, he sets out to crack down on L.A.'s slimiest criminals.
Casey McCall and Dan Rydell are sports anchors and best friends on "Sports Night", a nightly cable program.

A drama showing what it is like for a scared high school girl, Song Woo-yeon, who is unable to express her intention in consideration of others, to find her heart beating, and how the world changes if she speaks out and loves herself.

2074. In the wake of a mysterious global disaster, war rages between the Tribes that have emerged from the wreckage of Europe. Three siblings from the peaceful Origine tribe are separated and forced to forge their own paths.

movies.primaryTitle: My Love Story with Yamada-kun at Lv999
movies.originalTitle: Yamada-kun to Lv999 no Koi wo Suru
movies.plot: After her boyfriend breaks up with her for another girl, Akane Kinoshita decides she is going to make him regret his decision. Unexpectedly, however, she meets a socially awkward gamer who might just solve all of her problems.

Bok Gwi Joo's family has supernatural abilities. He can revisit happy past moments. Depression causes him to lose this power. His family also loses abilities due to modern issues. Do Da He joins their household, instigating change.
An ER doctor, who fled his native Syria to come to Canada, must overcome numerous obstacles to resume a career in the high stakes world of emergency medicine.

Minato fails college exams twice leaving him feeling worthless. A woman Musubi falls from the sky and bonds with Minato via a kiss awakening his powers. This draws Minato into a dangerous competition against others with special abilities.
Follows the mischievous adventures of a Monkey by the name of George.
After tragically losing his wife to suicide, child psychiatrist Eli Adler encounters a troubled young boy who seems to have a haunting connection to Eli's past.
A deep-cover operative, Martin Odum, has an uncanny ability to transform himself for each job. His own identity is questioned when a stranger suggests he's not who he believes.
Máxima Zorreguieta finds herself in the spotlight when she appears at the Dutch crown prince's side, but by the moment Willem-Alexander asks her to marry him, the past catches up with her.
A happily married man's life is turned upside down when his wife is killed in a mysterious hit and run accident in Tel Aviv.

movies.primaryTitle: The Moon Flows Through the River
movies.plot: It tells the story of the soul exchange between a prince who has lost his smile and a saddle-carrying merchant who has lost her memory.
Follows investigative journalist Martin Scarsden as he has to uncover the truth of the case of killing of five parishioners by a charismatic and dedicated young priest.
Twenty years ago, a series of tragic events almost ripped Millwood apart. Now, in the present day, a brand-new set of Little Liars finds themselves tormented by an unknown assailant.
A young japanese man finds himself in a strange game to recover from his debts.
A couple meets at an Overeaters' Anonymous meeting.
A comedy about two young couples and their outrageously contrasting views on parenting.
A young doctor uncovers lead poisoning in children near a steelworks. Despite state opposition, she strives to treat the sick kids.
Single hopefuls looking for love complete tasks, couple off and get voted out week by week. Packed full of drama.
A comedy centered on a loud-mouthed Irish matriarch whose favorite pastime is meddling in the lives of her six children.

The Right Honorable James Hacker has landed the plum job of Cabinet Minister to the Department of Administration. At last he is in a position of power and can carry out some long-needed reforms, or so he thinks.
Single mother Pørni is responsible for three children, her elderly father, and all the children she meets in her job at the child welfare service.

Talented chef Jónas tries to regain his family's trust after imprisonment. Shunned by society, he accepts illicit funds to open a restaurant, leading him to money laundering. This jeopardizes his parole, life, and loved ones.
The show charts the journey of a retired police constable who pushes the boundaries to save his family from the consequences of an unfortunate incident.
Unfolds as Rapunzel acquaints herself with her parents, her kingdom and the people of Corona.
The body of a young woman is discovered in the icy river. The investigation is led by Zawieja for whom solving the case will be a fight for herself.
Aspiring chefs are judged by a panel of food and wine experts while competing against one another for a shot at culinary stardom.
A protection officer and an MI6 operative team up after a terrorist attack. They suspect a mole as they race to thwart a larger conspiracy threatening Paris.
Determined to provide a ray of light for those under her care, a young nurse navigates the world of mental health and the diverse stories surrounding it.
Mandy is a hapless, jobless heroine whose daft adventures mostly end in disaster. She's got Big Dreams, but can she actually be bothered?
Two monks confront perimenopause -- and uncover the global health crisis every woman needs to know about.
When Scottish backpacker Robbie finds himself in Sydney, he is determined to become a live-in caretaker for a notorious rock'n'roll legend, Mike, who has been diagnosed with multiple sclerosis.
Keddie plays a writer who meets rancher Wenham on a dating app. Thinking he's ideal, she commits to him, only to find he's misrepresented himself. She uncovers his lies.
The Earth is embroiled in a desperate war against alien invaders, and this series focuses on one squadron of Marine pilots involved in it.
The further adventures of Hiccup and his friends on the Island of Berk.

movies.primaryTitle: The Bastard Son & The Devil Himself
movies.originalTitle: The Bastard Son & the Devil Himself
movies.plot: Caught between two warring clans, the son of a notorious witch responsible for a deadly massacre tries to find his place in the world — and his powers.
Follows the early years of Ghost and Tommy.
The misadventures of a dumb blond egomaniac who severely overestimates his own manliness and his supposed "success" with women.

The show is about two slow-witted teenagers Beavis and Butt-Head and their everyday exploits, including trying to get laid (or "score," as they like to call it), breaking things, pulling pranks, skipping school and watching TV.
The story of a young woman who works in a department store and gets caught up in the charms of the modern world.
In liberal San Francisco a conservative cartoonist tries to keep his two daughters, who rent an apartment below him, safe.

In a small French mountain town where everyone knows each other, the dead begin to inexplicably return as if their death never happened. Forcing the townsfolk to confront their difficult past as they seek to understand this phenomenon.
Bell has landed herself into prison struggling to survive. Claire, a mysterious female inmate chooses to help her.
Elite five-member squad uses elaborate schemes to get confessions from major crime suspects. Based on real methods, they plan complex operations.
A spinoff of ABC's "Black-ish," Zoey Johnson is off to college and must live outside the nest, dealing with drugs, sex, and relationships along the way.
Two directionless siblings are blackmailed into the world of organized crime.
Teachers show their hilariously warped perspective as six elementary school educators try to mold young minds although their own lives aren't really together.
A sketch comedy show involving five friends.
After losing her memory in a bizarre accident that kills most of her classmates, Alma tries to unravel what happened that day and regain her identity.

Using a unique 90 Day Fiance visa, overseas fiances will travel to the US to live with their partners for the first time. Each couple will have just 90 days to decide to get married or send their international mate home.
Contestants compete for a job as an apprentice to billionaire American Donald Trump.
Editor Susan Ryeland gets drawn into a web of intrigue and murder when she receives Alan Conway's unfinished manuscript of an Atticus Pünd mystery.

movies.primaryTitle: Rainbow: The Seven from Compound Two, Cell Six
movies.plot: Set in 1955, the anime follows the story of seven teenagers locked in a reformatory, waiting for a ray of light in a daily hell of suffering and humiliation, focusing especially on how they faced the life once regained freedom.
San Francisco lawyer Eli Stone begins to see things, which leads him to discover a brain aneurysm. But his visions lead him to accept cases with little monetary gain but a lot of moral goodness.
It tells the story of Lisa who witnesses a cataclysmic event on platform 7 of a railway station and in her memory finds a connection between her own life and the event she just witnessed.
Science and mythology - and how they are the same thing.
A man living in the 23rd Century works at a remote "lighthouse" in space that serves as a beacon to help passing ships.
A New York City attorney and his wife attempt to live as genteel farmers in the bizarre community of Hooterville.
The Cotswolds-based PR guru turned amateur sleuth returns for a series of comedic murder-mysteries based on the books by M.C. Beaton.

Follows Luke Fitzwilliam, as he finds himself on the trail of a serial killer after meeting Miss Pinkerton on a train to London. Now Fitzwilliam has to find the killer before any more blood will be shed.

movies.primaryTitle: Noble Reincarnation: Born Blessed, So I'll Obtain Ultimate Power
movies.originalTitle: Kizoku Tensei: Megumareta Umare kara Saikyo no Chikara o Eru
movies.plot: Reborn as an emperor's 13th child, six-year-old Noah retains his incredible strength and gains powers that multiply with each follower. But royal life brings dangerous political intrigue beneath its luxurious surface.
A United States astronaut finds his life vastly complicated when he stumbles on to a bottle containing a female genie.

William James Moriarty lives as a regular noble while also being a consultant for the common folk to solve their problems. However, deep inside him lies a desire to destroy the current structure that dominates British society.
ID channel show featuring a true murder story in the heartland (midwest USA). Includes interviews with the victim's family, friends, and investigators, as well as reenactments.
Follow the lives of the residents of a relatively luxurious block, the problems of sharing housing, the housing bubble, and young people's difficulties finding apartments.
Ten top UK comedians face off in Jimmy Carr's challenge: make others laugh while keeping a straight face. They'll try everything to crack their opponents, but must never break themselves.
A young man is magically turned a merman, and discovers his underwater origins, after he comes in contact with the magic waters at the mysterious Mako Island guarded by a trio of mermaids.

movies.primaryTitle: My Status as an Assassin Obviously Exceeds the Hero's
movies.originalTitle: Ansatsusha de Aru Ore no Status ga Yuusha yori mo Akiraka ni Tsuyoi no da ga
movies.plot: Oda Akira, a teen with the power to go unnoticed gets transported to a fantasy world with his class. Asked to fight a demon, he grows suspicious of the royal family and sneaks around for answers while weighing his loyalty to his peers.
Baloo the Bear from The Jungle Book (1967) is cast as a 1930s Pacific Islands bush pilot.

movies.originalTitle: Shangri-La Frontier: Kusoge Hunter, Kamige ni Idoman to su
movies.plot: High schooler Rakuro loves beating bad games. But can he discover all the secrets hidden in a best-selling VR game?
Penny loses everything when she accuses her husband of a sex crime against her daughter's teenage friend and no-one believes her.
The Mantle twins, identical from head to toe, are on a mission to change the way women give birth.
Each week D.I. Sleet is partnered by a celebrity guest as they investigate a murder in the titular town, which is in turn seemingly peopled entirely by 'celebrities'.
The saga of a Chicago police detective's efforts to stop a young hood's ruthless rise in the ranks of organized crime.
The movie will be a romantic film featuring two people who are not right for each other. The story is about Prajakta's character who is a tech wizard and the guy who is interested in her.

A straight-A student runs a secret essay service until a jock discovers her identity and asks for love letters to win his crush. While helping him, she falls for him herself and must choose between staying hidden or living openly.
A man builds a new identity far from his troubled roots, until buried family secrets resurface and pull him back into the shadows he left behind.
The lives and trials of a young single woman and her friends, both at work and at home.
Far from home, Jason washes up on the shores of the ancient and mysterious city of Atlantis.

Revolves around Futaba, a girl who was in love with a boy named Ko Tanaka in middle school. However, it did not work because he transferred but in high school, her world is turned around once again when she meets him again.
A psychotherapist questions his abilities and gets help by reuniting with his old therapist, whom he has not seen for ten years.

Members of your crew have been replaced by an alien shapeshifter intent on causing confusion, sabotaging the ship, and killing everyone. Root out the 'Impostor' or fall victim to its murderous designs.
Follows Django, a gunslinger in the Wild West who is searching for his daughter who he believes escaped the murder of his family eight years ago.
A detective transferred to Victorian High Country investigates 5 missing persons. She uncovers a complex web of murder, deceit and revenge.

The series recounts Leonardo da Vinci's extraordinary life through the works that made him famous, through the stories hidden within those works, revealing little by little the inner torment of a man obsessed with attaining perfection.
A post-apocalyptic thriller set in near-future Brazil, where a select few are allowed to join a privileged society after undergoing an intense and competitive process.
Psychiatrist Suzanne Oreste, 38, returns after 2 years to treat severe cases at Mont-Royal Institute. Her mysterious illness proves no setback as she finds light in life's darkest corners.
An eternal conflict reaches epic proportions when both God and the Devil are sent to Earth in the bodies of chunky house cats.
Follows two priests dealing with cases of a demonic presence targeting a family and a foster home.
Two teams led by their team leader (either Lee Mack or David Mitchell), must try to make the other team believe their crazy stories.
A teenage girl periodically receives brief psychic visions of the near future. Trying to make these visions come true results in trouble, and hilarious situations, for the girl and her friends.

Kaya-chan, a troublemaker in kindergarten, hides a secret: she can see evil spirits and defeat them with a punch. Now with Ms. Chie by her side, this five-year-old fights the supernatural while just trying to stay out of trouble.
Sergeant Maaka, and Officers Minogue and O'Leary, are members of the Wellington, New Zealand, police. Their job is to investigate paranormal phenomena.
A Netflix Original Series documenting various stories about exposing the greed, corruption, and crime spreading through the global economy.
The original rapid fire sketch comedy show.
The lives of men and women who are part of a commando group deployed in Iraq to fight ISIS.
A story of trials and tribulations of four young entrepreneurs who quit their day jobs in order to pursue their start up venture.
"Documentary Now!" parodies the current obsession with documentaries. Season one features six different stories and stylistic approaches paying tribute to the doc format.
An anthology series which centers on different characters being targeted by crazed serial killer Mick Taylor in the Australian outback.
Anthony Bourdain, chef, writer, traveler, visits places all around the world sampling various foods.

Serial killer Felix Garay's prison release disrupts his daughter Sara's perfect life with her family. As new copycat murders emerge, she questions if someone close to her is responsible while confronting buried secrets.
Follows criminal investigations in Paris from all the different points of view of those involved.

A gripping twist on a classic cat-and-mouse story, this British drama series explores the intoxication of sexual attraction and the dangerous power of emotional manipulation as two conflicted detectives track down a pair of deadly killers.

Carl Kolchak is a reporter for a Chicago newspaper. Through more accident than design he ends up investigating homicides, many of which involve supernatural forces. Ultimately, rather than reporting on the crimes, he solves them.
Follows an early 2000s family sitcom that Hulu has rebooted and their dysfunctional cast that must deal with their unresolved issues in today's fast-changing world.

movies.primaryTitle: Chuhai Lips: Canned Flavor of Married Women
movies.originalTitle: Hitozuma no Kuchibiru wa Kan Chuhai no Aji ga Shite
movies.plot: A college student and a married woman bond over a love of alcohol. But it's not long before their drinking leads them into romantic sex complications.
With his family deep in debt, Futaro Uesugi accepts a lucrative job tutoring underachieving quintuplet classmates to help them graduate high school.

Daily bus flirtations between Emily and Ryan end with COVID. Two years later, they reunite and embark on eight dates to test marriage compatibility, facing personal challenges and differing views while finding true connection.

Clark Kent builds his secret Superman identity and embraces his role as the hero of Metropolis, while sharing adventures and falling in love with Lois Lane, a star investigative journalist, who also takes Jimmy Olsen under her wing.
Singer Kelly Clarkson brings her gift of connection to a fun and funny hour each weekday, offering heartwarming stories, live musical performances, games and surprises.
James Hacker was propelled along the corridors of power to the very pinnacle of politics - Number 10.
Four hockey-playing teens from Minnesota try their luck at becoming a band. Hilarity ensues as they navigate the pressures of school, relationships, and fame in Los Angeles.

Gary is an emotional wreck and struggles to provide for his daughter since the death of his wife. Mary has a secret she can't bring herself to share with anyone. The universe brought these two together for a reason.
Teenager Harley Diaz maneuvers her way through the bustle of being a middle child in a family with six other siblings.
During the occupation of Izmir by Greeks, a Turkish soldier starts to work for the enemy. But he is not really on the side of the enemy. He must keep this secret at the cost of losing his family.
A coming-of-age comedy set in the "go-go" 80s about a college student enjoying a last hurrah before summer comes to an end--and the future begins.
A young artist finds herself obligated to sacrifice her love story for hiding a family secret.

Christmas store owner Emily Lane's sleuthing skills are put to the test as she investigates local murders. Despite Detective Sam Wilner's growing affection for her, Emily's enigmatic past raises suspicions about her true motives.
In a future where humans are infected by untested, microscopic robots, a young man with the ability to control the bots helps a government agency control the tech's vicious creations.
An office worker who is insecure about her looks becomes a masked internet personality by night until a chain of ill-fated events overtakes her life.
Horse trainers compete in the high-stakes world of professional reining.
Four friends whose lives changed forever with the arrival of a ton of cocaine.

Umbre follows Relu, an enforcer for a small-time mob boss, as he struggles to keep his family in the dark about his job. The secrets Relu keeps become increasingly oppressive and the lies begin to surface.
It revolves around Bhuvan and his family's everyday lives, when an unexpected purchase leads to a series of events and depicts every common man's larger than life dreams.
Follows a group of adult siblings and their father as they deal with grief, love and their lives in Los Angeles.
Hayden Fox is the head coach of a university football team, and eats, sleeps and lives football.
The medieval era cases of a Crusader-turned-Monk who investigates mysteries in the Norman English town of Shrewsbury.

Humanity faces extinction in a distant future. Age, a powerful boy and the last of the Heroic Tribe, is called to protect humanity in a cosmic war. The series delves into themes of destiny, loyalty, and survival.
Kermit the Frog, Clifford and friends struggle to put on a weekly TV variety show.

A group of young teens is unexpectedly sent to the mysterious Digital World and paired up with their own powerful, morphing monster called the Digimon. Together the entire group set out on an adventure to fight evil and save the world.

movies.originalTitle: Dragon Ball Kai: Doragon bôru kai
movies.plot: Goku is settled with his family and is living in peace. Unfortunately, his peaceful time is momentary as a visitor crashes into the planet claiming to be his brother.
It will follow the trio as they "take on the next stage of life in the Valley."
Criminal network of wealthy investors, bankers and lawyers orchestrated EUR146B tax fraud scheme across Europe, becoming continent's largest financial heist from taxpayers.

movies.primaryTitle: A Bit of Fry and Laurie
movies.plot: Comedians Stephen Fry and Hugh Laurie perform a variety of comedy skits and the occasional musical number.

In 1943 Los Alamos, New Mexico, a team of government scientists is working on the top-secret Manhattan Project in a race to produce an atomic bomb before the Nazis. Meanwhile, their families adjust to life on the military base.
In this satirical comedy, a zany nobleman navigates through family feuds and clashes with peasants in his quest to become Poland's most famous figure.

A group of unique characters from dramatically different socio-cultural backgrounds meeting in startling circumstances in the vibrant and colorful city of Istanbul, - some by chance and some by force of will.

movies.originalTitle: Mao no Musume wa Yasashi Sugiru!!
movies.plot: Former Demon King Ahriman's world conquest plans are thwarted by his own daughter Dou's gentle nature. As she charms all beings with kindness, demon aide Jahi attempts to train her in proper demon ways.

The daily life of high-school student Natsuo is heavily complicated after his single father marries the mother of his teacher crush Hina Tachibana and her sister Rui - who he had shared his first experience with with at a preceding mixer.
Kion, the son of Simba, leads his friends known as the Lion Guard to protect the Pride Lands.
A tiffin service provider finds a mentor in a failed UPSC aspirant who inspires her to become an IFS.
A group of women known as the "ladies in black" are introduced to shy sixteen-year-old Lisa when she starts a summer vacation work in a large Sydney department store at the beginning of 1959.

No one knows who invented Panic or when it first began. But in the forgotten rural town of Carp, Texas, the game is the only way out. Every summer the graduating seniors risk their lives competing in a series of challenges that force them to confront their deepest fears for the chance to win life-changing money. Anyone can play. Only one will win. Let the games begin.
The Smurfs are tiny blue creatures that live in mushroom houses in a peaceful forest. They repeatedly try to outwit Gargamel, an evil sorcerer, his apprentice, Scruple, and his mangy cat, Azrael.
A SWAT team veteran is pulled out of retirement to lead a last-chance experimental unit comprised of untested and unpredictable recruits.
Two friends linked by warmth and tension grow apart - until one is asked to accompany the other through her final days.

A mother and daughter flee to escape from a forced marriage in a restrictive sect. The mother works for a progressive psychiatrist whose daughter's identity causes turmoil, despite their growing bond.
Follows Special agent Avery Ryan as she works to solve internet related crimes as a cyberpsychologist for the Cyber crimes division of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI).

Sakurai Shinichi's one wish is for a little peace and quiet. But Uzaki Hana his boisterous, well-endowed underclassman has other plans. All she wants is to hang out and poke fun at him, this might be the start of a beautiful relationship.

Usagi is a clumsy but kindhearted girl who transforms into the powerful guardian of love and justice, Sailor Moon. Meeting allies along the way, Usagi and her team of Sailor Guardians fight to protect the universe from forces of evil.
The Wild West adventures of the Barkley family in California's San Joaquin Valley.

Tsukasa, whose dreams were crushed. Inori, left to fend for herself. These two share a dream...and their tenacity may be the only thing that sees them through. Their destination? The ice...on the world's stage.
Based on the books by Marc Brown, these are the adventures of Arthur, an 8-year-old aardvark, and his family and friends as they grow up and learn how to be good neighbors to one another.
In 1963, all the prisoners and guards mysteriously disappear from Alcatraz. In the present day, they resurface and a secret agency is tasked with re-capturing them.
Set in an Auckland City hospital that follows the complicated personal and professional lives of its staff and their families and friends.
A follow-up to the blockbuster movie of the same name, following rich teenager Cher and her friends as they attend high school in Beverly Hills. Many of the actors from the film appear.
Best friends Maggie and Eddie have lived in each other's pockets for ten years. But with the future looming, can their relationship survive?

A group of Brits leave post-war Britain in 1956 to embark on an adventure. The Roberts family tries to make the best of their situation, but life at the shelter tests them, but they're not the only ones avoiding the truth.
The adventures of Ryo Saeba, a gun-for-hire living in the Tokyo metropolis, who will take on any dangerous job as long as it involves beautiful women.
