The everyday lives of the doctors, nurses, and patients who find themselves, for various reasons, in the wards of the frenetic cardiac unit of the fictional Holby City General Hospital.
The comical seafaring adventures of a young, enthusiastic boy, his pirate captain mentor, and the talking whale that raised him from birth.
A young woman puts her life back together after suffering from a nervous breakdown.
Northern Irish police officer DCI Tom Brannick investigates crimes while trying to hide a dark secret from his past.
Following the lives of confident aspiring musician Austin, quiet talented songwriter Ally, and their two friends.

A young woman, on the run after 10 years in a suffocating marriage to a tech billionaire, suddenly realizes that her husband has implanted a revolutionary monitoring device in her brain that allows him to track her every move.

A widower is eager to move on from the most difficult year of his life, only to realize he's utterly unprepared to raise his two daughters on his own and equally unprepared for the dating world where he's suddenly a hot commodity.
Jay Sherman is a New York film critic who has to review films he doesn't like for a living.
There is a rumor about this beautiful village: people get eaten here. Police officer Agawa Daigo uncovers a horrifying truth lurking in everyday life.

A tragic accident radically changes the lives of three families, triggering a terrible spiral of guilt, resentment, and violence, that will lead them to explore the outermost edges of pain, endurance, and mercy.
A blue-collar baker strikes up a relationship with an international superstar in this U.S. version of the Israeli romantic comedy series 'The Baker and the Beauty.'
Details of how a woman came to learn that her husband, high school teacher Spencer Herron, was engaging in inappropriate behavior with his teenage students as well as committing sexual assaults.
Girl with psychic powers transported to magical Gaea. She and friends face attack by evil Zaibach empire. Guymelf Escaflowne holds the key.
Two men, a neat freak and a slob separated from their wives, have to live together despite their differences.

Crime boss Felix Carmichael lands in prison after 20 years ruling 'The Capital' syndicate. Upon discovering internal betrayal while locked up, he plots his breakout to seek vengeance and restore his criminal empire.
Animated series about bad cops. Not bad as in corrupt, bad as in under-performing. They aren't first responders, they are the worst responders.
Ambitious 8-year-old filmmaker Brendon Small shoots movies with his two best friends while coming to terms with adolescence, life, and relationships.
A series showcasing documentaries on American history.
Due to unforeseen reasons, photographer Vicky's life turns upside down. When he tries to solve his problems, he lands himself further in trouble.
Lovejoy is an irresistible rogue with a keen eye for antiques. The part-time detective scours the murky salerooms, auction halls and stately homes of Britain, always on the lookout for a find.
Nemo Bandeira, a dealer with a clean businessman facade, is diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease and tries to keep it from his family while he starts to think about who might be his successor.
A tough US Air Force officer and a skeptical scientist investigate UFO and alien conspiracies as Cold War paranoia spreads.

Commissioner Montalbano works in Vigata, Montelusa province with Deputy Commissioner Augello and Inspector Fazio, in each episode Montalbano solves complicated cases with his characteristic cunning in a rural Sicily ruled by the mafia.
It follows people on the autism spectrum as they navigate the world of dating and relationships.
Mixed with emotions like Sexual Desire, Betrayal, Love and many more, this series consists of multiple episodes. Each episode has a different plot and cast.
In an amoral science-based company, a manager tries to keep control of his scientists while being pressured by his shrewd boss.
Talented performers showcase their skills in music, dance, comedy, and youth categories while viewers vote to decide who advances to the next round.
Long after a devastating war almost destroyed the entire world, a boy with superhuman strength fights to save his friends from those who seek to conquer what is left of civilization.

movies.originalTitle: Omae Gotoki ga Maou ni Kateru to Omouna to Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou sareta node, Outo de Kimama ni Kurashitai
movies.plot: A zero-stat girl sold into slavery by her party's sage survives a monster pit by grabbing a cursed weapon, awakening hidden power.

The coming-of-age joyride of Cootie, a 13-foot-tall man who escapes to experience the beauty and contradictions of the real world. He forms friendships, finds love, navigates awkward situations, and encounters his idol, The Hero.
At a historic Istanbul hotel, a journalist is thrust into the past and must stop a plot that could change the fate of modern Turkey.
The adventures of the greatest of the female superheroes.

Follow the adventures of three ordinary girls as they learn their most important lessons the hard way. Meanwhile, a pocket-sized professor makes life difficult for a robot who just wants to be normal.
A young amateur magician unknowingly enters a tournament that is fought to the death.
Sitcom following estranged foster-brothers Stephen and Andrew as they vow to take over the family business following their father's death.

Rose returns from America when her stepfather's accident puts her in danger from Wasu, who wants her land. Her friend Din offers protection through marriage. Their fake union slowly stirs genuine emotions.

When Ji Sung-Joon was young, he was ugly. As he grew up, he began to have an attractive appearance. When Kim Hye-Jin was young, she was pretty. As she grew up, she became ugly. Ji Sung-Joon tries to find his first love.
A family is trapped in a dinosaur dominated alternative world and must struggle to survive it.
Tatra Mountains will become an arena of brutal murder. The investigation is carried out by a cynical but effective policeman, Wiktor Forst.
Inspired by Julia Child's extraordinary life and her show The French Chef, which essentially invented food television.
Twenty years after graduation, a tight-knit group of college friends reconnects and discovers that love hasn't gotten easier with age.

Set in the late 1980s, Hap and Leonard is a darkly comic swamp noir of two best friends, one femme fatale, a crew of washed up revolutionaries, a pair of murderous psycho killers, some lost loot, and the fuzz.

Yuuichi Katagiri knows the hardships of not having enough funds. He works hard to save up in order to go on the high school trip. However, after the class' money is all collected; it's stolen. Suspicion falls on two of Yuuichi's friends.
In this game show, the game changes every show. Players begin each round without knowing the rules and must figure them out while competing to win.
Six teenagers with different lives and personalities attend a prominent private school with only one thing in common: their vocation and passion for music.

movies.primaryTitle: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War - Stairway to Adulthood
movies.originalTitle: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Otona e no Kaidan
movies.plot: Kaguya sat alone in her room, looking through an album. Inside were photos capturing memories spent with Shirogane and her friends at Shuchiin Academy. As she turned the pages, lost in nostalgia, Kaguya's memories came flooding back.
When an alien from the planet Deviluke runs away and goes into hiding on earth,she meets a human named Yuuki Rito. Watch as she wants to get married to him while he wants no part of it
Explores through multi-layered portrait of American frontier from literal trailblazers to the law enforcers and battles for both land and freedom.
A group of women maneuver through the complex social dynamics and hidden power structures of elite American society, where old money, status, and political influence reign supreme.
A police officer's relentless two-decade hunt for a serial killer who murdered four young women in southern France.
A former Army Ranger, an FBI agent and a young woman search for the culprits who want the crime-fighting car KITT.
Tells the story of Roman Compte, Cuban exile, CIA operative, and general manager of the Hotel Mutiny, the glamorous epicenter of the late '70s and early '80s Miami cocaine scene.

After a wealthy ex-girlfriend humiliates him, a poor man plots revenge by pursuing her new boyfriend - a rich heir. His seduction scheme backfires when real feelings develop, leading to complicated emotions and unexpected romance.

Two handymen take on jobs for both the mob and the police that no one else can handle. Worick and Nicolas work in a town which is full of mafia, hoodlums and prostitutes. They face a challenge after taking on a job of crushing a gang

In 2071, toxic air pollution has devastated the world, leaving society reliant on drivers known as Knights for necessities. When a revered Knight meets a young refugee determined to join the ranks, he agrees to help him achieve his dream.
Zak Bagans, Aaron Goodwin, Billy Tolley and Jay Wasley investigate the scariest, most notorious, haunted places in the world.
The misadventures of the staff and guests of the St. Gregory Hotel.
On a post-apocalyptic exoplanet, worker drones struggle to survive by hiding from rogue robots called Murder Drones.
24-year-old loner B.A. Jaye lives in a trailer park and sells souvenirs in Niagara Falls. Animal figurines and dolls speak to her and force her to interact with people and try to help them.
Multiple teams race around the globe for $1,000,000 to 'amazing' locations.
Thirty-something Irish Catholic couple Sean and Claudia deal with their three children as well as Sean's judgmental father and weasel brother.
A businessman checks into a modest boutique hotel under an alias, captivating the owner's daughters - one sees him as a soulmate, the other as destiny.
With help from her dad and grandmother, Nora Lum navigates young adulthood in Flushing, New York with her cousin.
Five years after the end of their hit series "Eternal," Seth and Jeremy lean on each other as they struggle to regain their former level of success and relevance.
A chance meeting leads photographer Peach to mentor wealthy businessman Thee, whose obsession with TV dramas and disconnect from real-world values needs a serious reality check.
A former detective now living on the streets searches for the truth after a new death raises unnerving doubts about a supposedly settled murder case.

movies.primaryTitle: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
movies.originalTitle: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
movies.plot: A peek inside the unconventional lives of six successful women navigating an exclusive social circle in a city where religion, status and perfection are praised to the highest degree.

High school student Junichi Tachibana attempts to find love once again after having his heart broken last Christmas. This series follows his romantic endeavors in a sequence of six separate arcs, each involving a different heroine.
Though Raven Baxter is psychic, she never guessed that she would be a single mother living in an apartment with her twins, Nia and Booker Baxter, and her best friend Chelsea and her son Levi.
Follows Laura Simmonds and her Barcelona Consul colleague and friend, Alba Ortiz, as they fight to protect British nationals who find themselves in trouble in Catalan city.
Attorney Jessica Pearson enters the complex and seedy world of Chicago politics.

Ferit, a rich and powerful man who has lost all faith in love, unknowingly hires Nazli, a girl who is bright and full of life, as domestic help. Their lives get complicated as she helps him fight for the custody of his orphaned nephew.
A widower struggling to raise his emotionally challenged son discovers that he can predict events before they happen.
A comedic look at current events.
Drama following the extraordinary adventures of female medics in the British Army.
A classy, resourceful panther has plenty of hilarious misadventures, outwitting those who annoy him with his clever tricks.

K-ON is about 5 high school girls who become friends through the Light Music Club. Yui the lead guitarist, Tsumugi the keyboardist, Mio the bassist, Azusa the rhythm guitarist, and Ritsu the drummer. K-ON is the story of 5 aspiring musicians and their journey through high school together.
The tragic story of Catalina Santana whose ambition is so strong that she will risk her life, due to her obsession to have bigger breasts to attract drug lords and have all the luxuries in the world.
The war for Eternia begins again in what may be the final battle between He-Man and Skeletor. A new animated series from writer-director Kevin Smith.
Flawed but gifted DI Harry Clayton receives a bracelet from a mysterious woman. Realising that the bracelet can control luck, he decides to use it to his advantage.
A television series centered around characters who are tied to the same horse-racing track.
The lives of the people of Arcadia, Missouri are forever changed when their deceased loved ones return.
Follow recently graduated police officer Kurt Wallander as he investigates his first case.
A workplace comedy set in the world of the monsters from Big Mouth.

Workaholic hotel manager Shen Xi Fan meets gentle doctor He Su Ye while seeking treatment. Though initially doctor-patient, they unexpectedly live nearby, allowing love to bloom despite both nursing heartbreaks.
An unpopular 15-year-old gains immediate, yet unwanted, popularity at her high school when the student body mistakes an accident she has for a suicide attempt.

Awkward, neurodivergent teenager Harriet Manners whose life is turned upside down when she is spotted to be a model and embarks on a life-affirming journey of self-discovery as she balances high school and high fashion.
Adapted from a webtoon. A drama about voluntary unemployed Lee Yeo-reum and librarian Ahn Dae-beom, who declared a life strike, leaving a complex city and looking for themselves in a strange place.
After the death of her husband, a woman attempts to rebuild her life while surrounded by her sometimes problematic family and friends.

Peggy, a former addict, who decides to make a new start after the death of her beloved mother with whom she lived in the small desert town of Yucca Valley, California, makes a life-changing decision to become a private investigator.

A 37-year-old man on the verge of being divorced from his wife suddenly finds himself inside his 18-year-old body. He starts living a new life under a new name to get closer to his children and protect them.

It tells the story of Janet, a supermarket worker who doesn't care about anything, including her life, and Seamus, a self-centered, political broadcaster. They find themselves inextricably drawn to each other.
Follows two friends who love having fun and booze, until everything unravels.
Two detectives fall in love while investigating a murder, until one becomes a suspect.
Simon Templar acts as a modern-day Robin Hood.
Akane Tendo meets her new fiancé, Ranma Saotome, a martial arts prodigy with a twist: he magically transforms into a girl upon touching cold water.

Sue Thomas is a deaf woman who works for the FBI in Washington, DC. Using her ability to read lips and assisted by her dog Levi, she solves tough crimes that her hearing colleagues and listening devices can't crack.

A retired intelligence operative haunted by her son's premature death returns to spycraft and allies to unravel the mystery. While navigating old ghosts and dangers, she must balance justice for her son with learning who he really was.
A government employee discovers that the cause of the tensions between the two political parties is a race of extraterrestrial insects eating the brains of the politicians.

Four sisters face turbulence when their father's affair is exposed. Embodying the tumultuous "asura" demigods, they clash over differing outlooks on love yet find moments of connection amid conflict and growth.

When the managing director of a packaging company receives word from headquarters that her office will be closing and everyone will be working remotely, she switches to survival mode to keep everyone together.

The team of Det. Supt. Michael Walker, DI North, and DCI Connor follows each case from crime committed, through the pursuit of justice, to the law courts where the efforts of the force will be tested--sometimes to the breaking point.
Craig of the Creek follows a young boy, Craig, and his two friends, Kelsey and JP, as they go on adventures within a world of untamed, kid-dominated wilderness in the creek.
Two Angels, Panty and Stocking, are kicked out of Heaven for bad behaviour and sent Ghost hunting by Garterbelt, a Priest of Daten City.
Two detectives with different views on the world team up and using cynicism, guile and deception, they clean up the streets of Battle Creek.
Twenty players attempt to win a prize of up to $250,000 in the ultimate murder mystery game.
A prequel series set in the 1950s that follows Soldier Boy and Clara Vought (known to some as Stormfront) on a murder mystery during the early days of Vought.
Cha Woo-sol, a victim of school bullying for three years, is released from prison and becomes a criminal and a world mixed martial arts champion.
A New Mexico deputy marshal gets assigned to Manhattan's 27th Precinct.
The greatest of the DC Comics superheroes work together to uphold the good with the help of some young proteges.

Tim and Yu, two con artists devise a plan to scam two wealthy cousins, Pai and North, by luring them into deceptive marriages. However, complications arise when the scammers start to fall genuinely in love with their targets.
Kitty enthusiast Gabby and her sidekick Pandy Paws team up for a series of animated adventures.

Meet the renegade philosophy teacher who's not afraid to speak his mind and break the rules to revolutionize his students' lives, including the son he barely knows and a student with a severe social phobia.

Two women discover they dated the same deceptive man they met online. After launching a podcast about their experiences with Brandon, more victims emerge, revealing a pattern of manipulation and dark secrets.
Im Hwa Ryeong, a prickly, sensitive and hot-tempered queen, tries to turn her trouble making princes into proper crown princes.

A gritty 1960s cop drama about LAPD detective Sam Hodiak and his trainee, who must deal with gangs, brutal crimes, changing times, family crises and unhinged manipulative small-time crook Charles Manson, who's slowly building his cult.
This show took place in the fictional Midwestern town of Springfield and centered on the middle class Bauer family.

Five teenagers from across the globe unite to fight pollution and protect the planet. With their elemental powers combined, they summon the Eco-hero Captain Planet to battle environmental disasters and villains threatening Earth's future.
A special crime unit investigates serialized crimes that cross over European borders, to hunt down criminals and bring them to justice.
A young boy is wanted for a crime he has no recollection of committing and must go on the run, hunted by two kings and their forces.

Condemned to death for a vicious crime she didn't commit, Nikita reluctantly chooses to live as a secret government assassin whose life is controlled by a clandestine anti-terrorist organization Section One.
A struggling middle-aged actress attempts to make a career for herself while surrounded by her hard-drinking best friend Maryann, her two former husbands, and her two daughters.
It follows twelve players as they work together in challenges to add money to a pot that only one of them will win.
Set in a high-class brothel, this new series creates a hyper-reality in which the viewer is privy to the private lives and emotions of five beautiful young women.
Talented teen figure skater Kayla is forced to leave everything behind when her family follows her twin brother Mac to a prestigious hockey academy.
A mysterious woman rises to fame and becomes a powerful influencer after accurately foretelling the murders of several social-media influencers.
The adventures of the creatures of the most incredible metropolis: Zootopia.
In a post-apocalyptic future where humans live in domed cities surrounded by wasteland, wolves are assumed to be two hundred years extinct.
The series follows an epidemic that breaks out in Atlanta, leaving the large city quarantined and those stuck on the inside fighting for their lives.
A unique bodyguard protects his clients by secretly infiltrating their lives in order to draw out and eliminate threats.

A secret death witnessed by two boys in a small Oaxacan village forges an unbreakable bond. Twenty years later the childhood friends reunite as different people, facing their shared past and new trials that test the power of friendship.
Skilled cake artists create mouthwatering replicas of everyday objects, in a mind-bending baking contest inspired by a popular meme.
University lecturer Robert Bridge becomes involved in a series of supernatural events surrounding medium Alison Mundy in this chilling TV series.
A dramatization of the life and death of Montreal mob boss Vito Rizzuto.
When Pastor James returns to Crossroad Springs, the Hamiltons rediscover the ties that bind through changing seasons, quiet reckonings, and the grace of starting over.
After his brothers are brutally murdered the turkey seeks revenge.
FBI agent Will Keaton enlists the most notorious traitor in American history to help catch a spy.
Young Czech-Austrian psychoanalyst, Sigmund Freud, investigates a murder conspiracy in 1880's Vienna.

"Pretty Hard Cases" follows Guns and Gangs detective Sam and Drug Squad detective Kelly. By day, they are heroes in their particular way: skilled, tough, determined, and entertaining, fighting to do good in a broken system.

movies.primaryTitle: A Young Doctor's Notebook & Other Stories
movies.originalTitle: A Young Doctor's Notebook & Other Stories
movies.plot: In the early 20th century, a young doctor arrives in a small Russian village around the time of the Russian Revolution to work in the local hospital.
Middle-class man seeks secret escort services during financial woes. Entangled in lies, murder and gang, he becomes what he once despised - corrupt.
Shocking tragedies shatter a tight-knit South Carolina community and expose the horrifying secrets of its most powerful family.
A small community of survivors of an apocalypse that has overrun the rest of the world and plunged it into chaos is holed up on Germany's only offshore island.
Simón's wife was killed to extract her heart and transplant it to Camila, the wife of a rich man. In search of revenge, he dives into the dangerous world of organ trafficking.
In a Texas town, a woman becomes obsessed with one of her husband's companions and creates an art project inspired by him, a series of letters beginning "Dear Dick:"
A group of young adults attend a party on a remote island, but the tempting paradise they find waiting for them holds dangerous secrets and entrapments.
Follow Survivor and protagonist Helena Walker after her initial awakening on The Island.
When Haruka's class got sent to another world. Haruka takes the opportunity to live his ideal life of solitude. But he keeps getting into adventures with his friends.
While on quests to pursue love, sex, and fame with his friends in Los Angeles, Ulysses' premonitory dreams make him question the possible presence of a dark and monstrous conspiracy.
One Life to Live centres takes place in the fictional town of Llanview, PA.around the wealthy Lord family, and the middle-class Woleks and Rileys.
A father and daughter fight to save humankind.
Drama series following the detectives of an elite murder investigation squad in London.

A year after a devastating flood has killed five locals in an idyllic country town, a mysterious new plant appears. The plant's phenomenal ability to restore youth is so formidable that attempting to harness it means re-evaluating values.
A female archer loses her memory after shooting a prince in battle. When they reunite, they must rely on each other despite being former enemies, as romance blooms amid conspiracy and danger.
Dr. Sam Waters is a detective with the Violent Crimes Task Force, a federal agency which often works with the FBI, ATF, and other crime-solving agencies.
A teen drama anthology that often touched on social issues of the day.
Elite athletes from eight countries battle for national pride. After grueling tests of raw strength and endurance, only one flag can claim victory.

Jackie Chan teams up with his 11-year-old niece, Jade, traveling the globe to locate a dozen magical talismans before the sinister Dark Hand does. Helping Jackie and Jade is Uncle, a cantankerous but wise antiquities expert.
A young man searches for answers as to why he's been suffering from supernatural possessions his entire life.
A smart and cynical girl goes through teenage life as a proud outsider in a world of mainly idiotic adolescents and condescending adults.

movies.primaryTitle: Cocaine Quarterback: Signal-Caller for the Cartel
movies.originalTitle: Cocaine Quarterback: Signal-Caller for the Cartel
movies.plot: Follows the FBI's capture of Owen Hanson, a former USC football player who became drug kingpin.
A woman arrives in her late husband's homeland with her son, but his powerful family prevents her from leaving, leading to a battle as dark secrets emerge.

Oh Han Byul leads an entertainment agency's PR team. One of her top clients is star Gong Tae Sung who does no wrong. They went to the same university, where he became her sworn enemy. They bicker but soon develop feelings for one another.
It follows the birth of the nightclub scene in London's Soho

Working class wild child Alma Nuthall comes from an eccentric family of unruly women. Both Brilliantly life affirming and gloriously funny, 'Alma's not Normal' is an uplifting story of one woman's desire to take control of her own destiny.

Three brothers set out for vengeance when their younger sister commits suicide after love goes wrong. The three handsome brothers' evil intentions are dispelled when their hatred turns to unexpected love.
In the city of Dakota, a teenage boy with electricity based powers, with the help of his inventive friend, fights crime as a superhero.
Inspired by Kevin Durant's youth basketball playing experience on the AAU circuit.
Two sisters discover disturbing family secrets after a string of mysterious deaths occur on a luxury ship traveling from Spain to Brazil in the 1940s.

A mother and daughter in São Paulo faces corruption that affects her community and family. As evil forces threaten countless sick people for profit, she struggles with moral choices while fighting for survival.
A high school student discovers he is an Ajin, a demi-human being. He ends up a fugitive on the run because of his powers.

While attending an online forensic course, young lab assistant discovers that the fictitious case study has a link to her past. With the help of two female professors she works on bringing a killer to justice.
Deniz, a rising financier, loses his secret love Vicdan in a crash-only he remembers she ever lived. Torn between ambition and obsession, he hunts for the truth behind her disappearance.
A British civil servant agrees to spy on her own government for the Americans in the aftermath of WWII.

movies.primaryTitle: Todd and the Book of Pure Evil
movies.originalTitle: Todd and the Book of Pure Evil
movies.plot: A stoner metalhead named Todd Smith, his crushee Jenny, his best friend Curtis, and the geeky Hannah, search their high school for a mayhem-causing Satanic spell book, while being opposed by Atticus, the evil guidance counselor.
An American astronaut struggles with leaving her husband and daughter behind to embark on a dangerous mission with an international space crew.

Ippo continues to defend his title and training to reach his goal, Ichiro Miyata. While Takamura goes for the world, and faces the world champion, Brian Hawk. In what is to become his toughest fight so far.
A young girl named Rin seeks to avenge her parents, who were ruthlessly killed by a group of master swordsmen, with the help of cursed samurai Manji, who is seemingly immortal.

movies.primaryTitle: Those Who Read the Hearts of Evil
movies.plot: A crime thriller drama based on a web novel of the same name that contains the field experience of Kwon Il Yong, Korea's No. 1 profiler.
TV version of the 1988 black comedy "Heathers," in which an outcast student plots to kill the cool kids.
The series focuses on the life of Osman Bey, the son of Ertugrul Gazi and the founder of the Ottoman Empire.
The misadventures of an Anglican vicar, his wife, and a small but odd group of parishioners in London.

While on a midnight stroll, a girl named Ai picks up an egg. A voice coaxes her: "If you want to change the future, you only need to choose now. Now, believe in yourself and break the egg." What awaits Ai after the breaking of the egg?

movies.originalTitle: Sairento Wicchi Chinmoku no Majo no Kakushigoto
movies.plot: A powerful witch can cast spells without speaking; in reality she is just shy and distant from people. But now she is assigned to guard a prince.

movies.primaryTitle: John Wick: Under the High Table
movies.originalTitle: John Wick: Under the High Table

movies.plot: After a car accident takes the life of a family member, a police detective lives two alternating parallel lives, one with his wife and one with his son. Is one of his "realities" merely a dream?

movies.primaryTitle: Grease: Rise of the Pink Ladies
movies.originalTitle: Grease: Rise of the Pink Ladies
movies.plot: A brainy misfit sees her reputation decline and her popularity rise when she runs for student council president.
A comedy centered around the incompetent boss of a German insurance office.
A terrible plague strikes and a group decides to risk their lives. Humanity struggles to survive as they face the end of their civilization.
Superstars of World Wrestling Entertainment do battle in elaborate, long running rivalries in a weekly two-hour showdown.
Set inside the offices of the "Nation Building Authority", a newly created government organization responsible for overseeing major infrastructure projects.
Retells the story of the 10 year siege of Troy, which occurred in the 12 or 13th century BC.
The last son of the planet Krypton protects his adoptive home of Earth as the greatest of the superheroes.
When Ottoman Sultan, Fatih Sultan Mehmet, ascends the throne, he must defeat many enemies inside and outside the palace in order to conquer Istanbul, his biggest dream.
Senior Prosecutor Janet King returns from maternity leave to confront a high-profile murder, and a conspiracy which will have shocking ramifications throughout the judicial system.
The story of Romulus and his twin brother Remus, in eighth century B.C. as seen through the eyes of three people marked by death, loneliness and violence.

Four young friends' paper routes are disrupted on Hell Day 1988, when they unknowingly time travel to 2019. While searching for a way home, they come face-to-face with their adult selves and learn how to work together to save the world.

A county magistrate's daughter loses everything but regains her life by masquerading as a minister's daughter, overcoming injustice with help from Duke Su Xiao Heng, rescuing her imprisoned father, and upholding justice.
The Casillas Dynasty saga continues as the family faces a ruthless game of power and betrayal following patriarch Aurelio's disappearance.
A pair of teenage royals and their bodyguard escape from their home planet and try to blend in on Earth.
A woman's life working in the adult film industry spans from its seedy beginnings to a highly successful enterprise.
Set in 19th-century Korea, a female historian faces gender discrimination but perseveres. She gets entangled with Prince Lee Rim, blurring lines between duty and personal involvement.
Mi-kyung's potato-focused world changes when she meets the practical Baek-ho, sparking a spiraling romantic comedy about healing and growth.
A model high school student who's steeped in a world of serious crime finds his double life upended when a classmate takes an interest in his secret.
Demet seeks a better life by convincing her daughter Zeynep to leave their village. Zeynep enrolls in a private college, leading to a love triangle and uncovering past secrets.
One day, Tsubasa Hanekawa encounters a giant white tiger apparition at an intersection that talks to her. Her house burns down the next day, leaving her homeless.

Three travelers lives unexpectedly intertwine. Chander and Sudha share an instant spark. With Preeti, Chander finds steady companionship built on quiet understanding and ease. Which love endures through time, and life's journey?
A foot soldier sets out to infiltrate and take down a group of warriors known as the Dragon Keepers. He encounters obstacles and challenges as he attempts to complete his mission against the group.
A glamorous period drama about an English hotel in 1920s Italy, when Benito Mussolini's brand of fascism was on the rise.

Six-months-sober Bridget is key witness to a murder but flees, visiting her identical twin, who "suicides". Bridget takes over her rich, glamorous, married life in New York City. Out of the ashes and into the fire?
Ambitious entrepreneurs present their breakthrough business concepts.
The TV series of the Canadian sketch comedy troupe that, more often than not, puts bizarre, unique, and insane twists in their skits.

A look at the highs and lows of the band members that make up a Muslim female punk band, Lady Parts, as seen through the eyes of Amina Hussein, a geeky PhD student who is recruited to be their unlikely lead guitarist.

Based on a novel of the same name, it tells the record of a royal court romance between the King of Joseon who places his duty to his country first above love, and a court lady who wants to protect the life she has chosen.
A series of supernatural events begins in a small coastal New Jersey town after the arrival of a mysterious teenage girl, who apparently has the ability to influence the people and events around her.
Five years after his daughter's disappearance, Danish police officer Rolf discovers a fatal flaw in the DNA database and might finally be able to find her.
Filmed and televised versions of theater productions, such as plays, musicals, operas, ballets, and concerts from around the world.
A young man joins the crew of a cruise ship in order to investigate the disappearance of his sister.
Against 1990s Shanghai's economic boom, opportunist A Bao journeys from troubled past to self-made millionaire.

A narco kingpin escapes from a high-security Mexican prison with his son and finds refuge at a remote drug rehab facility located on the U.S. side of the border where they encounter deadly mutant zombies.
After graduating from university, twenty something year-olds Meg, her cousin Bunny and their friend Laura share a flat and face the ups and downs of love and life.
Shiv Sheridan returns to Dublin after years of partying in London and tries to navigate a new phase of her life, but being back with her family and trying to stay sober won't be easy.

COUPLES THERAPY unlocks a hidden world: other people's relationships. Far from reality-show caricatures, this is true documentary filmmaking that brings viewers into authentic and visceral experience of weekly therapy with four couples.
Refugees from a war-torn country 180 years in the future start showing up in the present to seek asylum in an American town.
After her father's sudden death, Aida returns to her childhood neighborhood and tries to help her children get ahead in life.

A young girl is sent to live with her late mother's relatives in Prince Edward Island. Set in the early 1900's, the series follows her adventures, as well as that of her family and the town's people as she grows up in Avonlea.
Twenty something Josh is going through a number of big changes as he navigates his first decade of adulthood. After being dumped by his girlfriend, he comes to the realization that he is gay.
A talented young TV producer arrives in Miami to revamp the lowest-rated morning show in the country.
Puffin Rock follows the adventures of Oona, her little brother Baba, and their family and friends on a gorgeous and wild Irish island.
Americans move to a foreign country all in the name of love. Will uprooting their lives in the United States pay off, or will they be packing up and moving back to America brokenhearted?
Anthology series that explores the experiences of women in personal and emotional moments.
A young man, failing at life, is offered a new start as a 10 years younger high-school student.

movies.primaryTitle: My Life as a Teenage Robot
movies.originalTitle: My Life as a Teenage Robot
movies.plot: The escapades of a super-powered robot who happens to resemble a teenage girl that tries to balance high school and teen problems while trying to save the world from danger.

Marvin Flute, who might be the greatest detective ever, has one mystery he still can't crack: his family. He will follow every lead he's got to redeem himself with the ex-wife he never stopped loving.

A comedy panel game in which being Quite Interesting is more important than being right. Sandi Toksvig is joined each week by four comedians to share anecdotes and trivia, and maybe answer some questions as well.
A New York City homicide detective cracks case after case while raising wild twin boys and locking horns with her less-than-helpful Police Detective ex-husband.
When one of their number disappears on the same day that an American girl joins their ranks, a group of English boarding school students embarks on solving a mystery.
Detectives Janet Scott & Rachel Bailey investigate murders with Manchester Police's Major Incident Team.

When the Hardy boys, Frank and Joe and their father, Fenton arrive in Bridgeport they set out to uncover the truth behind the recent tragedy that has changed their lives, and in doing so, uncover something much more sinister.
Cassidy Collins, an ex-soldier turned corrections officer, works to prove herself in a dangerous prison to save someone she loves.
With the country on the brink of Civil War, the struggle for freedom is more dangerous than ever. Underground follows the story of American heroes and their moving journey to freedom.
After their deaths, two teens are transported to an apartment with an ominous black sphere and must participate in a gory alien-hunting "game."
The misadventures of the family staff of The Shady Rest Hotel and their neighbors of Hooterville.
DI Jack Frost is an unconventional policeman with sympathy for the underdog and an instinct for moral justice. Sloppy, disorganized, and disrespectful, he attracts trouble like a magnet.
Stockholm, the day of peace in Europe 1945. A spontaneous kiss between two strangers, during the celebration at Kungsgatan, will have major consequences.
A deep cut into the days and nights of a public schoolteacher in the San Fernando Valley.
A Japanese conman crosses paths with a French rival, and gets entangled in conspiracies and scams beyond his wildest dreams.
Follows a group of police officers on the front line wondering what they did to end up where they are now, on the ugly side of Manchester.
A 39-year-old woman decides to use the money her parents had been saving for her wedding to open a cat-themed cafe.
Story about a son's search for his family's lost honor.

Lobo Rosales, a former detective, becomes a guardian to the daughter of a woman he once loved. He must flee with young Renata when he discovers that she holds the key to a hidden fortune that many criminals are willing to kill to find.
Emily Bronte's classic story of destructive passion and immortal love.
An eccentric teacher takes her class on wondrous educational field trips with the help of a magic school bus.

A 12-year-old boy becomes the lone survivor of a plane crash. As he and others affected by the tragedy try to make sense of what happened, unexpected friendships, romances, and communities are formed.
The series tells the story of Deniz and Nil's entertaining relationship by explaining the relationship between men and women in a humorous as well as realistic language.

Serhat, a successful surgeon, leaves his homeland to build a new life in Istanbul. He falls in love with Melek and secretly marries her, but destiny leads him back to Urfa, where he confronts his past under the shadow of two rival families

movies.primaryTitle: Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?!
movies.originalTitle: 30-sai made Doutei dato Mahoutsukai ni Nareru Rashii
movies.plot: Adachi, a quiet office worker mid-30s, has the power to read minds. One day he discovers that his popular workmate Yuichi has a crush on him.
A secret government agency solves crimes by entering the minds of recently deceased individuals.
TV series featuring the classic Looney Tunes animated shorts.

movies.primaryTitle: E! Dirty Rotten Scandals: America's Next Top Model
movies.originalTitle: E! Dirty Rotten Scandals: America's Next Top Model
movies.plot: Former contestants expose the TV show's dark side, revealing how a modeling competition dream turned into exploitation and trauma behind the glamorous facade.

Two gentle friends, Leonard and Hungry Paul, navigate life's challenges as overlooked nice guys, their journeys unfolding through humorous and poignant moments exploring themes of inciting change versus acceptance.
The life stories of various historical figures and celebrities are told.
The story revolves around office colleagues. Amidst work stress they fight and fall in love. Could this change their lives forever?

Hampton Chambers a newly released ex-convict striving to leave his criminal history behind and reunite with his family. Amidst this struggle, he grapples with frequent inexplicable moments of divine intervention.
Follows a talented gallery curator named Sung Duk Mi, who is an idol fan-girl underneath her professional veneer. Meanwhile, her boss Ryan becomes a passionate fan-boy of her.

Anthology series set in room 104 of a seemingly average American motel, each time telling a different story of the assorted guests who pass through, which can range from funny and fantastical to dramatic and horrifying.
High schooler Utage works as a housekeeper and idolizes Tamon from F/ACE. When assigned to clean his home, she finds he's actually shy and gloomy offstage - yet she falls for his true self.

movies.primaryTitle: Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
movies.originalTitle: Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
movies.plot: The submarine Seaview is commissioned to investigate the mysteries of the seas. Usually it finds more problems than answers.
Set in early-18th-century Madrid, the plot follows the love story between an agoraphobic cook and a widowed nobleman.

A newly transferred girl to Akira's school happens to drool on the desk. The otherwise normal Akira decides to taste it and it is now that things start to change as he will start going out with the girl, Mikoto, whom he seems destined for.
A group of convicts and outcasts fight a guerrilla war against the totalitarian Terran Federation from a highly advanced alien spaceship.
The Maryhill CID investigates gruesome murders against the bleak backdrop of the city of Glasgow.
A young paramedic discovers he has telepathic powers.

Rebellious Brooklyn teen Summer Torres is sent to live with family friends in the tiny town of Shorehaven on the Great Ocean Road, Victoria, AUS. Despite her best efforts, Summer falls in love with the town, the people and the surf.
A fast-paced thriller following medical student Mia Akerlund who discovers the use of highly advanced biohacking technology in her university town.
The story follows a band of Blood Angels Space Marines as they face a dangerous and insidious foe.
The wacky misadventures of an Australian wallaby and his friends as he finishes his transition to American life.
A remarkable young English nanny takes over the household of a widowed professor and his three children.
A rich man named Adnan marries Bihter, who is younger than him. A poisonous forbidden love begins between Adnan's nephew Behlül and Bihter who lives in the same mansion.
After meeting under near-fatal circumstances, a policewoman and a betrothed lawyer embark on a scandalous, sexually-charged courtship.

A model student, once focused solely on grades, faces domestic abuse and school bullying. Joining forces with classmates, he forms "High School Heroes," a group that fights back against bullies on behalf of the victims.
The story of Han Yi-joo, who chose a contract marriage to avenge her husband and family, and Seo Do-gook who postpones a contract marriage to welcome her as his wife.
Simon's 40th birthday turns into another lovely family weekend back at home when well-meaning relatives get more and more annoying with every passing hour.
Young, free and madly in love. As teenagers, the world was their oyster but as adults, their lives seem dimmer, like a very important piece is missing.
Quirky police detective, in Finland, delves into his memory palace to solve despicable crimes all the while trying to keep his family together.
When a plane crashes on a deserted island on the way to Thailand, the crash survivors struggle to get along, and heads clash as they have differing views on how to stay alive and get off the island.
The top 0.01% of students control law and order at Jusin High School, but a secretive transfer student chips a crack in their indomitable world.
Follows the professional and personal life of Municipal Court Judge Olivia Lockhart and the surrounding townsfolk of Cedar Cove.
A love story between a psychiatrist named Ji Hae Soo and an author who had schizophrenia named Jang Jae Yeol.
Cam Calloway and Reggie Vaughn gained fame and fortune that no one could have imagined growing up in one of Boston's most infamous neighborhoods.

From pretending to be a pilot on a make-believe airplane to pretending to be a pirate in search of buried treasure, Barney's friends discover that creativity lets them soar in the wings of imagination!

Indian classical singer Radhe and pop star Tamanna. Despite their contrasting personalities, the two "set out together on a journey of self-discovery to see if opposites, though they might attract, can also adapt and go the long haul.
A painter in Istanbul embarks on a personal journey as she unearths universal secrets about an Anatolian archaeological site and its link to her past.
Follows the crew of Moonbase Alpha who struggle to survive when a massive explosion throws the Moon from Earths orbit and out into deep space.

Hetty wakes on her 60th birthday and decides to become a private investigator. With assistance from a teenager called Geoffrey and her husband Robert, combined with her own common sense, Hetty is confident she can solve any case.
An antiquities expert teams up with an art thief to catch a terrorist who funds his attacks using stolen artifacts.

A female general with a gentle appearance but a strong inner spirit, and a male general with a cold exterior and internal but with stronger martial prowess. They join forces to combat deceit, help the weak, and eliminate external threats.
Documentary series focusing on great American artists and personalities.
With big dreams of financing their own film project, three struggling young men join forces in a guesthouse venture that is anything but profitable.

Longtime friends gather off-the-clock to solve cases, despite personal issues. DA Jill has troubled past, ME Claire is dealing with a husband newly in a wheelchair, and tough Detective Lindsay finds herself working under her ex-husband.
An FBI agent and his new partner, a CIA operative, embark on missions to save the world, but have to put up with each other first.

Four aspects (intellect, sensitivity, fear, and lust) of Waterton Publishing Company fact-checker Herman Brooks' personality help him get through different situations in both his private and professional life.
Comic tales of a group of good friends, four boys and two girls, during breaks in primary school, as they grow up, relate to each other, and have brushes with authority.
Rebellious teens fight in armed combat against one dispassionate girl's supernatural powers in an afterlife high school.
A look at the personal and professional lives of employees at an American news magazine in the late 1960s.
A dramatization of the life of lesbian trailblazer, voracious learner, and cryptic diarist Anne Lister.
The adventures of two young drifters across America.

movies.primaryTitle: Mr. Show with Bob and David
movies.originalTitle: Mr. Show with Bob and David
movies.plot: This is a sketch-comedy show. The twist here is that all of the sketches (even the monologue) are connected in some strange way.
A raunchy spoof edition of Countdown (1982) with the stars of 8 Out of 10 Cats (2005).
A one-hit-wonder band from the '90s gets a second shot at fame when a young rapper samples their song.
"Therapist" Dr. Tom - who is constantly spouting famous and not so famous historical quotes - is Erica Strange's savior and worst enemy.

Pinky and the Brain are genetically enhanced laboratory mice who live in Acme Labs. The Brain is self-centered and scheming; Pinky is good-natured but feeble-minded. In each episode, the Brain devises a new plan to take over the world.
In a global sky-park, two dreamers pin their hopes on a damaged Princess Android - their possible salvation or doom. A psychological thriller between the clouds and lurking shadows below.
For a cool high-school kid and his friends, thwarting authority figures and other enemies is never a problem.
Ko Dong Man, a former taekwondo champion, and Choi Ae Ra, a receptionist, struggle to follow their dreams as life throws obstacles in their path.

After 13-year-old super-genius Lunella accidentally brings ten-ton T-Rex Devil Dinosaur into present-day New York City via a time vortex, the duo works together to protect the city's Lower East Side from danger.
Following Michelin Guide inspectors who dine undercover with fake IDs and numbers to award stars, traveling from LA to London.
When a young couple inherit a farm, they are determined to turn it into a success, but strange supernatural forces soon intervene, threatening their marriage and their lives.
Six best friends talk about all aspects of sex and relationships on their never-ending quest to find true love.
Drama series following eight women's struggle to lose weight at a weekly slimming club.
A teen without magical powers enrolls in a magic academy. He can't use a wand, but his skill with a sword fuels his drive to keep a promise to a friend.
For an attorney who despises losing to men and an A-list actor who distrusts women, love means nothing - until they're forced to date each other.
The further adventures of Captain James T. Kirk and the crew of the USS Enterprise, as they explore the galaxy and defend the United Federation of Planets.
Based on the relationship between Leonard Cohen and Marianne Ihlen, follows two lonely people falling in love while they are still trying to discover who they are.
Sacha Baron Cohen offers his take on America's patriotism.

Whether it's lovelorn rats, gender-questioning pigeons or aging bedbugs in the midst of a midlife crisis, the awkward small talk, moral ambiguity and existential woes of non-human urbanites prove startlingly similar to our own.
The trials and misadventures of the staff of a country veterinary office in Yorkshire from the 1930s to the 1950s.
The further and darker adventures of Batman with a new Robin, a closer association with Batgirl and the previous Robin now as Nightwing.

An ordinary girl is admitted to the most prestigious school in the country where she encounters F4, an exclusive group comprised of the four wealthiest and handsomest boys in the school - Dao Ming Si, Hua Ze Lei, Xi Men and Mei Zuo.

The biggest names in American football join coach Chuck "Chico" Kyle as he embarks on a 40th and final season helming one of the greatest high school sports dynasties in U.S. history, and defines for all of us THE OBJECT OF THE GAME.
A warrior chosen as the latest and last Wu Assassin must search for the powers of an ancient triad and restore balance in San Francisco's Chinatown.
Having created super-spy Jason Bourne, the Treadstone project turns its attention on a new protocol to develop unstoppable superhuman assassins.
Ban Ji-eun can remember all her past lives. When her previous life is cut short by a tragic accident, she sets out to reunite with a man named Moon Seo-ha whom she met in her 18th life.

movies.primaryTitle: Lady Oscar: The Rose of Versailles
movies.plot: The story of Lady Oscar, a female military commander who served during the time of the French Revolution.
Agent Fatima gets a tip that a terrorist act is planned in Sweden. At the same time, teenager Sulle has opened her eyes to her student assistant who opens the doors to a fascinating new world.

movies.primaryTitle: Army of the Dead: Lost Vegas
movies.originalTitle: Army of the Dead: Lost Vegas
movies.plot: Scott Ward and his rescue crew's efforts to protect all they love during the first phases of the mysterious zombie outbreak in Vegas.
Inspector John Marlott investigates a series of crimes in 19th Century London, which may have been committed by a scientist intent on re-animating the dead.
Animated adaptation of NieR: Automata (2017), where a long-running war on post-apocalyptic Earth between androids and machines soon unveils the truth of the world.

The focus in on the upper class Hughes and Stewart families plus their tribulations in Midwest Oakdale. The Stewarts fade away eventually to be replaced by the rural Snyders and wealthy Lucinda Walsh with her many intrigues.
In 1960s America, a young couple struggles to expose the truth about a hidden alien invasion, while a secret government organization follows its own agenda in dealing with the threat.
Kwabena is an aspiring filmmaker trapped in his recruitment job. When he is given the opportunity he's always dreamed of, is he brave enough to chase it?
Life is just one big adventure for Clarence and his two best friends, Jeff & Sumo.

It follows forensic pathologist David Hunter, who gave up his work to settle down as a doctor in the rural village of Manham. When a woman is found dead, David struggles to stay out of the investigation.
An unexpected pregnancy complicates the lives of two families. The series centers around Oly, an ambitious and high-achieving teenage girl who has a surprise baby.
An elite special missions force fights against the terrorist forces of Cobra.
The lives of 10 faculty members at a high school in Boston weave in and out of dealing with trouble-makers, having a personal life, and keeping sanity.

In the 1960s, at the height of the Cold War, in the small village of Glória do Ribatejo, João Vidal will take on several high-risk espionage missions that could change the course of Portuguese and world history.
A story about a group of people with special abilities who disguise themselves as family members to survive and use unique methods to overcome the vicious criminals who threaten them.
A team of 4 talented men solve their clients' problems by staging "drills" to deceive people.
Saving the world from an evil madman? Not a problem for this kid. Finding his birth parents? That's the real adventure!

Meet Dave and Julie Rafter: just your average Australians with three adult children. On the eve of their 25th wedding anniversary it seems that they're about to have their house to themselves at long last.
The story of a double-glazing showroom in Essex in 1983, led by charismatic salesman Vincent who will happily break the rules if it guarantees a sale.
Out-of-the-box Simon Roberts runs an ad agency with his Type-A daughter Sydney.

movies.primaryTitle: Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector
movies.originalTitle: Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector
movies.plot: A retired forensic criminologist teams up with an ambitious young detective to help capture some of the most dangerous criminals in America.
Series of experimental short films that envision post-apocalyptic worlds and nightmarish scenarios.
The ongoing saga of the Martin family and their beloved collie, Lassie.
After a powerful dragon devours him, an average adventurer transforms into a living skeleton and sets out on a mystical journey to regain human form.
Deputy Bill Hollister, a career lawman who is very comfortable kicking down doors but utterly lost in a staff meeting, becomes acting sheriff of Los Angeles County when the sheriff drops dead.

A team of part-time paranormal investigators use homemade gizmos to track the supernatural, sharing their adventures online. As their haunted stake outs become more terrifying they begin to uncover an unimaginable, apocalyptic conspiracy.
Hell-bent on exacting revenge and proving he was framed for his sister's murder, Álex sets out to unearth much more than the crime's real culprit.
Five mysterious stories are shown in which people meet strange or unexplainable events. The viewer is invited to decide if the stories are fact or fiction.
Rachel, a single mother and cleaner, is offered a better job by a wealthy businessman. She accepts, but grows suspicious of his motives as she becomes more involved in his affairs.
A woman who grows up in a dangerous neighborhood transforms her desire for revenge into a dark legend, turning into both a myth and a curse in the streets that forged her.

Yuuta suffered from "chuunibyou" while he was in middle school. When he graduated, he try to forgot about it but he accidentally got into a contract with Rikka and disrupts his desperately ordinary life.
A group of shipwrecked characters attempt to escape from an island inhabited by horrifying monsters, including the giant primate who rules the island: Kong.
U.S. fighter pilots are recruited to test experimental aircraft and rockets to become first Mercury astronauts. TV adaptation of Tom Wolfe's book, 'The Right Stuff'.
Mama's Family originated with Thelma "Mama" Harper, and her younger sister Fran living together in Mama's house.
The adventures of two California Highway Patrol motorcycle officers.
A parenting diary of assassin buddies?. Two assassin partners Kazuki Kurusu and Rei Suwa who never let their target get away somehow end up taking in a four-year-old girl Miri.
A look at the lives, loves, and losses of four different women: Toni, Maya, Lynn, and Joan.

Mystery Inc. teammates Shaggy, Scooby, Velma, Daphne and Fred have creepy adventures and new mysteries to solve. Always meeting some monster or ghost, the band of teens have gadgets and inventions that help on their detective adventures.
Elizabeth Tudor, an orphaned teenager who becomes embroiled in the political and sexual politics of the English court on her journey to secure the crown.
Dramatized reconstruction of real-life air disasters, along with interviews with aviation experts and eyewitnesses.
Detectives Vanessa and Peter Coleman retire from the Australian police to run a motel in New Zealand, but their plans change when a body is found in Unit 3.
Phil travels around the world sampling food and tradition with friends and a sense of humor.
A group of young supermarket employees faces the daily challenges of the store. Led by store manager Thorsten, the employees try to master all the disasters and dramas.

Ian Mitchell discovers a mysterious box on his doorstep containing a gun and a photo of a stranger he must kill in the next three days. If he doesn't kill him, he'll be endangering the safety of himself and his family.
Princess Adora raises her magic sword and becomes She-Ra, the most powerful woman in the universe, to aid her friends in defeating the Evil Horde so their planet Etheria can be free.
The story of a group of young friends and the mysterious events that occur in the rural village of Hinamizawa.

When the queen-to-be of medieval Korea is badly wounded, Captain Choi Young uses a wormhole to "heaven," which is actually 21st-century South Korea, to bring back the spoiled Dr. Yoo Eun-Soo who becomes a pawn in a game of human chess.
Alumni from reality TV and other forms of entertainment and first time cast members live together and compete against one another in physical and mental challenges for cash prizes.
A look at the personal and professional lives of the judges, lawyers, clerks, bailiffs and cops who work at an L.A. County courthouse.
High school sophomore and hardcore skater Reki introduces transfer student Langa to a secret, no-holds-barred race down an abandoned mine.

Endo Kiyomi, a single mother near Mt. Fuji, works at a business hotel. One day, she meets an alien. Unlike a pure-hearted girl seeking justice, her life experiences lead her to ask the alien to solve minor work or personal issues.
In the future, long after the Batman has driven himself into exile, his legacy lives on in the form of the Birds of Prey--Black Canary, Oracle, and the Huntress.

Ashito Aoi, who lives in Ehime prefecture. Ashito has a strong talent in soccer, but he tries to hide it. Due to his very straightforward personality, he causes a disaster that serves as a huge setback for him
Set in a legendary ancient time China, a man works in ruling government dedicates to civilian lives
A prisoner becomes a lawyer and fights to overturn his life sentence for a crime he didn't commit.
A journalist's life takes a 180 because of the very system that made her who she is. Will she fight or will she concede?
A widowed father and his three teenage sons share heartwarming moments while dealing with loss. Together, they find joy, growth, and their mom's spirit in daily life's ups and downs.
Exposed as an ex-Russian spy, an American single mom must juggle family life and unique shape-shifting skills in a battle against an insidious enemy.
The hit show from the creator of Trigun continues its crime-fighting, otherworldly adventure in the chaotic city of Hellsalem's Lot.
An unexpected friendship forms when three teenage girls meet in Shoplifters Anonymous.
Park Seok Cheol, a gangster family's grandson with a pure heart, falls for aspiring singer Kang Mi Yeong. He navigates life's challenges while protecting his family, career, and love.
Carrie Bradshaw is in her junior year of high school in the early 1980s. She asks her first questions about love, sex, friendship and family while navigating the worlds of high school and Manhattan.
Colonists, crash-landed on an alien planet, begin the long trek to their originally designated landing place, facing alien and human threats.
Three-year-old Saville Kent's brutal murder at Road Hill House shakes a sleepy English village. Inspector Jonathan 'Jack' Whicher investigates on the Home Secretary's orders.
The adventures of the various inhabitants of an underground civilization.

movies.originalTitle: Ore wa Subete wo [Parî] Suru ~Gyaku Kanchigai no Sekai Saikyô wa Bôkensha ni Naritai~
movies.plot: Assassination attempt on the Princess Lynneburg threatens the Kingdom of Clays. As neighboring countries plot the kingdom's downfall, Noor arrives at the royal capital, determined to become an adventurer despite his limited abilities.

Tired of his mundane life, Mikado Ryugamine decides to move to Ikebukuro, a district in Tokyo, when a friend invites him. Ikebukuro is full of connected mysteries where people's pasts intertwine with the present.
A controversial dating series in which people see potential love interests whose naked bodies are gradually revealed to them. Then they must get naked themselves and choose.
In a dystopian alternate 1999, a former cop is forced to take part in a death race in which cars run on human blood as fuel.
The crazy and sometimes surreal comedic adventures of four very different students in Thatcher's Britain.
Derived from the 1947 movie with the same name, a house is haunted by a deceased sea captain who wreaks havoc with the new tenants who were not advised of his existence.

Widower Steve Douglas raises three sons with the help of his father-in-law, and is later aided by the boys' great-uncle. An adopted son, a stepdaughter, wives, and another generation of sons join the loving family in later seasons.

movies.originalTitle: Saikyô no Ôsama, Nidome no Jinsei wa Nani wo Suru?
movies.plot: Reborn as Arthur Leywin after a mysterious demise, a former king retains his wisdom despite entering a new life as a baby on the magical continent of Dicathen. He masters magic, forging his path to rectify past mistakes.
Single mother DCI Janine Lewis struggles with the problems of bringing up four children while leading her team of detectives in solving high-profile murders.
Exploring various global wildlife issues and subjects.

A video game architect and a college girl's life are keep being reset after encountering a bus-bomb explosion. During each reset, they worked together with the police to find the truth and try to save the innocent people.

Wealthy Mrs. Li moves her family from Luoyang to Bianjing to find husbands for her five daughters. Despite initial struggles, the family works together to establish a business and search for suitable matches.
Zorro is set in 1834 and follows Diego de la Vega. Determined to find out who killed his father, he will discover family secrets that will change his destiny forever.
A family of crooks assume the identity of an upper-middle-class suburban clan in the Deep South.

movies.primaryTitle: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
movies.plot: A suicidal girl agrees to be eaten by a mermaid, so the mermaid herself agrees to care for her and protect her till it's time to eat.
Through the adventures of four friends 'Hostel Daze' captures what goes inside an engineering hostel in India.
Follows contestants as they compete in challenges based on the Korean children's games featured on the Squid Game to win a $4.56 million cash prize.
An 18-year-old actress in a popular children's show navigates her complex relationship with her narcissistic mother, who thrives on being "a starlet's mom."
Surreal British comedy in which Vince Noir and Howard Moon have adventures filled with oddball characters while working as zookeepers, then pursuing a musical career, then running a second-hand shop.
In a biological research company, a son with social problems is forced to work for the company of his father, an extremely eccentric and exotic man to save him from disaster.
Set in Edinburgh, the mercurial Detective Inspector John Rebus's investigations lead him through the city's ancient beauty and into its more sinister quarters.
Four female journalists find friendship, love, and scandal as they follow a parade of flawed candidates in an unpredictable presidential campaign.
When her husband is attacked, a woman becomes entangled in a police operation to topple a notorious crime lord.
A jealous, envious man seeks inner peace while feeling isolated in a world where others seem to succeed.
The story of 18-year old students who have to battle the discrimination at their school in order to have a future.

Ginko is a 'Mushi-shi' or Mushi master, who can interact with 'Mushi': tiny magical beings at the basis of all life, that glow brighter as a warning sign. He travels around trying to resolve 'Mushi'-related occurrences.

Vincent Terranova is an agent with the Organized Crime Bureau infiltrating dangerous criminal organizations, struggling to remain true to himself while becoming close to the criminal leaders he is sworn to bring down.
Follows the lives and loves of four close, but very different, sisters of the Reed family living in Winnetka, Illinois.
Told through a series of interconnected phone conversations, it chronicles the mysterious story of a group of strangers whose lives are thrown into disarray in the lead-up to an apocalyptic event.
Men who dated the same woman are dying in unusual ways and she must come to terms with her complicated past.
Inspired by true events - 'Ek Thi Begum', is the untold revenge story of Ashraf a.k.a Sapna.
"Graveyard" is a dark basement, where a special unit works to solve unsolved murders of women. Commissioner Önem, will have to fight masculine prejudices that support male violence.
Follows the life of three siblings, one of whom moves from Los Angeles to Louisiana to claim a shared inheritance from their recently departed father: an 800-acre sugarcane farm.
After an eerie mist rolls into a small town, the residents must battle the mysterious mist and its threats, fighting to maintain their morality and sanity.
In a seemingly picturesque retirement community, a group of unlikely heroes must band together to stop an otherworldly threat from stealing the one thing they don't have - time.
A peek inside the exploits and privileged private lives of the blended Kardashian-Jenner family, including sisters Kim, Kourtney, Khloé, Kendall and Kylie.

Satirical sitcom about how friends, family, historical circumstances, and his arch-rival Robert Greene, who first coined the derogatory term "upstart crow", influenced William Shakespeare to write his famous plays.
Eight singles, chosen by clinical physiologist John Aiken, neuropsychotherapist Dr. Trisha Stratford and psychologist Sabina Read, come to find themselves looking for love on a TV show.
A wealthy matriarch tries to maintain her family's facade of perfection after her husband's mistress exposes their dirty secrets.
Middle-aged Mary Ann returns to San Francisco and reunites with the eccentric friends she left behind.
Office worker Kobayashi's boring life changes after she drunkenly saves a dragon. To pay her back, Tohru takes human form and becomes her maid.

These are the new voyages of the starship Enterprise. Picking up from where the original 5-year mission left-off, a new cast continues the adventures of this legendary crew: to boldly go where no human has ever gone before & to search for new life forms.
Surreal comedy that follows Jamma's quest for attention as he navigates chaotic family dynamics and literally stumbles through love.

movies.originalTitle: Yasei no Rasu Bosu ga Arawareta!
movies.plot: The last boss of a great battle with heroes returns 200 years after her defeat to explore the world and its changes since her time.
Ellen Morgan is a neurotic bookstore owner who deals with life through comedy and extensive rambling.
Ren, a psychotic Chihuahua, and Stimpson J. Cat, a dimwitted Manx cat who goes by the nickname Stimpy, have a host of unusual adventures.
Hannibal Heyes and Kid Curry, two of the most wanted outlaws in the history of the West, are popular "with everyone except the railroads and the banks".
Revolves around an elite group of male warrior youth called Hwarang who grow through passion and love in Seorabeol, the capital of the ancient kingdom of Silla.
Raucous one-hour dramedy that tells the story of the Finley-Cullens, a dysfunctional family of adult half-siblings battling to take control of the family business.
Ned Bigby shares his advice on how to survive middle school.

movies.primaryTitle: Why the Hell are You Here, Teacher!?
movies.plot: A comedy about female teachers who can't help developing romantic interests in their male students.
Two men face off in a savage, deserted world.
A non-fiction crime drama uniquely telling stories with a combination of Dramatisation, home video and documentary style material.
Tasha has the perfect house, a loving husband and a beautiful little girl. Her life could be perfect if it wasn't for Jen, her husband's ex-wife who just won't leave them alone.
When their owner passes away, three cats, who are brothers that don't resemble each other, inherit a large amount of fortune along with a giant mansion and a very sarcastic butler named Hovis.
Partridge's life after returning to Norfolk from Saudi Arabia where he spent a year. His struggles to readjust to his hometown and reintegrate into society.
A debt-ridden mechanic, Timur, finds himself drawn into the secrets of the Karsli family and unexpectedly takes on the role of heir Zafer Karsli, changing everyone's lives forever.
Falling in love is tricky for teens Juliette and Calliope: One's a vampire, the other's a vampire hunter and both are ready to make their first kill.
The adventures of the riders of the Pony Express.
After a heist, the crew have gone their separate ways, but now, they are being targeted by a killer one-by-one.
Five strangers are connected by the curse that has plagued Ravenswood for generations.
11-year-old Nicky, Ricky, Dicky, and Dawn Harper's sibling rivalry are heightened by the fact that they are quadruplets.
Makoto Misumi, an ordinary teenager, is summoned to a fantasy world to be its hero. However, the goddess judges him unattractive and dismisses him from his duties.
A major accident takes the lives of 48 people. The lives of the survivors, those who lost loved ones and those connected to the parties blamed for the tragic event are also marked forever.

movies.primaryTitle: Between Two Ferns with Zach Galifianakis
movies.originalTitle: Between Two Ferns with Zach Galifianakis
movies.plot: Zach Galifinakas comically interviews various celebrites between two ferns.
A family grieves the death of their daughter in a suicide bombing. Meanwhile, her brother suspects she is still alive after glimpsing her in a news report and sets off to find her in the Middle East.
The joys and heartaches of the Lawrence family of Pasadena, California.
Retta tours properties that were nominated based on gaudy designs and botched renovations.
A follow-up to the novel and film of the same name, focusing on a group of troubled teens in 1960s Oklahoma.
A rivalry between big cat eccentrics takes a dark turn when Joe Exotic, a controversial animal park boss, is caught in a murder-for-hire plot.

A shocking new series that points to Arthur Leigh Allen as the Zodiac killer. At the heart of the revelations is an unlikely family whose increasingly chilling relationship with Allen promises to connect him to the infamous Zodiac murders.

movies.primaryTitle: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms
movies.originalTitle: Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaî ga Tsûjinai
movies.plot: Mona Kawai is used to winning hearts, but Medaka Kuroiwa refuses to fall for her in this new rom-com!.
Rhoda Morgenstern leaves best pal Mary Richards and her other friends in Minneapolis, Minn., to try her luck in Manhattan.

movies.originalTitle: American Idol: The Search for a Superstar
movies.plot: Twelve American finalists (six men and six women) compete in a singing contest.
A teacher is asked to be a superhero using a special alien suit with powers he can barely understand or control.
The life of a therapist and single mom is upended when her dad gets out of prison and moves in with her and her teenage son.

When young friends Connor, Amaya, and Greg put on their pajamas and activate their animal amulets, they turn into their alter egos: Catboy, Owlette, and Gekko as they embark on adventures that are filled with action.

Spinoff of the hit Disney Channel series "The Suite Life of Zack & Cody," in which twin brothers Zack and Cody Martin and hotel heiress London Tipton enroll in a semester-at-sea program aboard a ship called the S.S. Tipton.

Five attorneys at a law firm navigate cases and build friendships. They include An Ju Hyeong, a competent but detached senior lawyer, and Kang Hui Ji, a passionate junior associate who believes in changing lives.
Newly promoted DI Rachita Ray takes on a case that forces her to face a lifelong personal conflict.

In the early 21st century, mankind has colonized the oceans. The United Earth Oceans Organization enlists Captain Nathan Bridger and the submarine seaQuest DSV to keep the peace and explore the last frontier on Earth.
A city veterinarian moves to the countryside where he meets a policewoman, a town insider with a friendly secret.
Follow Zac and Fatima as they navigate the ups and downs of their relationship.
Decades after Bride Covey disappears in the ocean under mysterious circumstances, a flash drive will change Eleanor Bennett's life forever.

A disillusioned reporter, James "Jim" Bronson, quits his job and starts wandering the road on his Harley-Davidson motorcycle as a form of soul-searching. He meets various characters. Some he helps, others he educates.

movies.primaryTitle: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
movies.originalTitle: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
movies.plot: Eternia's Prince Adam discovers the power of Grayskull and transforms into He-Man, Master of the Universe. A reimagining of the classic animated series.
One hundred contestants in top physical shape compete in a series of grueling challenges to claim the honor - and cash reward - as the last one standing.
The violent attack on a teenage girl in a tidal islet in which group of teenagers from disparate backgrounds, each of whom could have committed the crime, along with their parents.

Jack Regan and George Carter are hard-edged detectives in the Flying Squad of London's Metropolitan Police. They pursue villains by methods which are underhanded and often illegal, frequently violent and--more often than not--successful.
Camera crews follow police officers while they work.
This series just asks one question - how far will you go to protect the one you love. Two desperate and driven men must engage in the ultimate cat and mouse game to save the one they love.
Focuses on humans dealing with the incoming invasion of a highly-advanced alien civilization called Three-Body.
A gifted teen leaves home to attend a prestigious football academy where he discovers truths about his family's history and leads his team to beat fierce rivals.
Steve is asked to review restaurants for the UK's Observer who is joined on a working road trip by his friend Rob who fills in at the last minute when Coogan's romantic relationship falls apart.
Follows a genius actuary and his team as they bond while tackling divorce complexities to develop a new divorce insurance policy.

Princess Elena has saved her magical kingdom, Avalor, from an evil sorceress and must learn to rule as its crown princess. Elena's adventures will lead her to understand that her new role requires thoughtfulness, resilience and compassion.
Junk Dog, an underground fighter with the alias of "Gearless Joe" sets out to join the worlds most prestigious mecha boxing championship, Megalonia.

A shipping magnate's death reveals Emma is his unknown daughter and heir. Along with inheriting part of his empire, she discovers four siblings she never knew about. Wealth changes everything minds and hearts alike.
A feisty Vancouver homicide detective tracks down the most cunning of killers by trying to figure out the often-unexpected motive to the crime.
A mockumentary-style period piece comedy that follows members of the wealthy Bellacourt family and their servants in early 20th-century Newport, Rhode Island.
A gripping love triangle unfolds amid glittering ballrooms and private chambers, as three young souls grapple with passion, obligation, and the eternal conflict between reason and desire.

In the near future, Norway is occupied by Russia on behalf of the European Union because the newly-elected environmentally-friendly Norwegian government has stopped the all important oil- and gas-production in the North Sea.
