Eliza Thornberry is not your ordinary kid. It's not just because she travels the world in an RV with her parents: famous nature show hosts. Eliza also happened to be granted the magical ability to talk with and understand animals.
'Femme Fatales' was an anthology series which was hosted by the enigmatic Lilith. Each story was a lovely, contemporary crime thriller in the tradition of classic films and beloved TV shows.
Eccentric detective Terry Seattle teams up with clueless celebrity guest stars to investigate a series of murders in this improvisational crime comedy.
The bond that develops between former con man Harry King and idealistic policewoman Camille Delmasse.
British comedy duo Ricky Gervais and Stephen Merchant send their simple and closed-minded friend Karl Pilkington on a trip around the world to experience a variety of people and cultures.
An ordinary high school student, Lu Mingfei, one day received an admission letter from Cassel College, a foreign private university. After hesitating and hesitating, Lu Mingfei decided to find out.
Sonja lives a carefree life with her family near Stockholm and works as an accountant in the family business at the marina. One day Sonja is drawn into the criminal underworld to save her family.
Former footballer Vinnie Jones tackles farmland projects in West Sussex. His team undertakes ambitious builds amid banter and conflict, showcasing an unseen side of Jones over a hectic summer.
An unassuming young rideshare driver is thrown into her worst nightmare when a mysterious Hollywood Hills passenger enters her car.

In a post-apocalyptic world set a thousand years after our era, the remaining humans, now with telekinesis, live in a seemingly peaceful society, but dark secrets of the past will soon be discovered by a small group of friends.

A story about twins who struggle to find their own identities, and their journeys of self-discovery so closely mimics each other's. During a time 90s grunge and rave culture, the twin sisters grow up down the hall from one another.

movies.primaryTitle: The Late Show with Stephen Colbert
movies.originalTitle: The Late Show with Stephen Colbert
movies.plot: Stephen Colbert took over as host, executive producer and writer of THE LATE SHOW on Tuesday, Sept. 8, 2015. The comedy-variety-talk show is broadcast four nights a week from the Ed Sullivan theatre in New York.
Marcus, a disillusioned teen, is recruited into a storied high school for assassins. He is forced to maintain his moral code while navigating a ruthless curriculum and vicious social cliques.
Defense Attorney Mitch McDeere is targeted for execution by the Chicago Mob in retaliation for bringing down a profitable Mob-operated Memphis law firm ten years earlier.
A homicide squad detective, suspected of serial murder, searches for the real culprit.

A young Indian spy's covert mission interweaves with a veteran spymaster's past, revealing national secrets and hidden truths. Through intelligence and determination, they protect India's security amid sacrifice and generational burdens.
A family adopts a dog named Stan in the hope that two feuding step-siblings will bond over the pet. It works when the siblings soon find out that the dog can talk and write.
The misadventures of a struggling rock group.
The misadventures of a bumbling U.S. Marine named Gomer Pyle.
A veteran cop gets mired in a high profile murder case when a girl is found dead in a politician's car.
A drama about English settlers in America in 1617.
A fictional crime series about the three best friends, Romano, Pencil and The Pope, who together transition from petty crime to serious crime.
A man who converts to a controversial following suffers from a crisis of faith.
The Z-Fighters set out to rescue Trunks from a prison planet.
The further adventures of the Marvel Universe's mightiest general membership superhero team.
The Macahans, a family from Virginia, headed by Zeb Macahan, travel across the country to pioneer a new land and a new home in the American West.

Idealist Public Prosecutor Selim receives an offer he cannot refuse from organized crime leader Selcuk Taskin, whom he sent to prison. Selcuk will testify in the prosecutor's case, but in return, he asks the prosecutor to protect his son.
A trucker and his pet chimpanzee travel the highways of America, getting into various adventures and misadventures along the way.

Based on the novel of the same name winner of the Primavera award 2016. Raquel, a young literature teacher, gives her marriage a second chance and moves to her husband's birth town, which hides a dark secret she will try to unravel.
Orphaned at the age of 6, Shirley Hamilton is taken in by the Shamaness Kali and taught how to morph into almost any animal. She shall become Sheena, Queen of the Jungle.
A group of kids are thrown into a fantasy world where they must search for a way home, armed with magic weapons that an evil tyrant wants.
An aging police sheriff begrudgingly joins an alliance with a new sheriff, Evie Barret, to battle angry demons haunting their small New Hampshire town.
When maple-syrup farmer Ruth Landry finds her livelihood under attack by greedy competitors who were once her friends, she concocts a scheme to exact revenge and shake up the industry.
An epic saga about the secret history of the 1930s American heartland, centering on the mythic conflict and bloody struggle between big money and the downtrodden.

The true story of a visionary screenwriter who defied her privileged upbringing to chase her passion in a male-dominated film industry. Rising to become one of the defining voices of Turkish cinema's golden era.
Follows the story of Toru Muranishi's unusual and dramatic life filled with big ambitions as well as spectacular setbacks in his attempt to turn Japan's porn industry on its head.

Encounters with Gothic beasts, including fallen angels and werewolves, broken people are driven to desperate acts in an attempt to repair their lives, ultimately showing there is a thin line between man and beast.
Animated sequel series which follows Everybody Hates Chris (2005), focusing on Chris Rock's life as a kid in 1980s Brooklyn, New York.

movies.primaryTitle: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon
movies.originalTitle: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon
movies.plot: Jimmy Fallon hosts the Tonight Show and interviews celebrities, plays games with them and has a musical or comedic guest perform.

movies.primaryTitle: How NOT to Hire a Hitman
movies.originalTitle: How NOT to Hire a Hitman
movies.plot: Hiring hitmen may seem foolproof but leads to disaster. Failed plots and successful hits end in tragedy. Every mastermind faces justice in these true crime cases of murder-for-hire gone wrong.
A teenager struggles to come to terms with everything life throws at her.
Aadhav and Deeksha, a vibrant young couple are about to be separated as passion pulls them apart. Can love win them back together?

Follows "The Walking Dead" star and motorcycle enthusiast Norman Reedus as he hits the open road to explore local biker culture and celebrate the best and brightest collectors, mechanics and craftsmen around the World. .
Once rivals in school, two brilliant doctors reunite by chance - each facing life's worst slump and unexpectedly finding solace in each other.

A coming of age journey of Shantanu Bansal aka Shanky from Laxmi Nagar, East Delhi, from disowning his Jamnapaar identity to finally embracing his roots and being proud in the highly competitive backdrop of chartered accountancy life.

Shaun The Sheep is a cheeky and mischievous sheep at Mossy Bottom farm who's the leader of the flock and always plays slapstick jokes, pranks and causes trouble especially on Farmer X and his grumpy guide dog, Bitzer.

movies.primaryTitle: Tim and Eric Awesome Show, Great Job!
movies.originalTitle: Tim and Eric Awesome Show, Great Job!
movies.plot: Two comedians, average nobodies, and celebrity guest stars perform bizarre low-budget comedy sketches.
Three close friends set off on a journey to Ayvalik and then to their reshaped future.

In the heart of Cornwall, Darrell Rivers and later her sister Felicity and their friends, attend boarding school, Malory Towers in the late 1940's. Navigating drama, historical mysteries, ghosts, pranks, and challenge formidable foes.

Bella Sway, a lunar cargo pilot and smuggler 100 years in the future, finds herself accused of a crime and marooned on Moonhaven, a utopian community built on the Moon to find solutions to the problems that will soon end civilisation.

movies.originalTitle: Halva Malmö består av killar som dumpat mig
movies.plot: Amanda, 31, navigates the complexities of modern dating through apps and bars, meeting diverse men. She and her friends struggle to move beyond first dates as they explore the dynamics of finding love.
Four close-knit friends in their 40s do their best to face a new world of modern masculinity but even their best tends to make things worse.
Celebrities partner up with professional dancers and compete against each other in weekly elimination rounds to determine a winner.

In this spin-off series of The Golden Girls, Dorothy Zbornak remarries and moves away, so her mother Sophia and their roommates Blanche Devereaux and Rose Nyland open a hotel called The Golden Palace.
Based on the popular feature film "Ferris Bueller's Day Off," this half-hour situation comedy followed the high-school adventures of Ferris Bueller and his friends.
Five teenage girls learn that they have been chosen to guard the walls between parallel universes. For this purpose, they have been given the powers of the elements.
A detective follows the trail of a serial killer 30 years into the future and teams up with detectives in that time period to find the culprit.
Tween vampire attends performing arts school, hiding her identity. Overprotective father assigns ghostly guardian to watch over her as she pursues music passion.

An English department chairman at an underfunded college, Professor Hank Devereaux toes the line between midlife crisis and full-blown meltdown, navigating the offbeat chaos in his personal and professional life.
Newlyweds move in next door to a veteran married couple of 25 years.

In the war between the Earth Federation and Zeon, a young and inexperienced crew find themselves on a new spaceship. Their best hope of making it through the conflict is the Gundam, a giant humanoid robot, and its gifted teenage pilot.
Two couples living under the same roof struggle to keep their relationships alive while pursuing their individual dreams.

movies.primaryTitle: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
movies.originalTitle: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
movies.plot: With a little help from his brother and accomplice, Tim, Boss Baby tries to balance family life with his job at Baby Corp headquarters.
Five women face extreme situations like extortion, oppression and manipulation. Their conflicts intertwine, triggering a butterfly effect, ultimately leading to a shared catharsis.
A British sitcom about the everyday life of a working-class family in Northwest England: watching telly, smoking, drinking, and bickering.
A once-in-a-generation young karate fighter named Jack joins the Wasabi warriors.
Retrospective look at ten seasons of Gallagher trials and tribulations.
The missions of a major city's police department's Special Weapons and Tactics unit.
The story will begin in Istanbul in the 1800s and stretch daily. Mia will work with young rebels to destroy Dmitry, which will cross the road at a luxurious nightclub in Istanbul.
Reborn as a sentient sword, our protagonist joins a young girl on a journey to exact justice on those who prey upon the weak.
Retired Detective Alex Ridley is lured back into service as a consultant detective when his former protégée, Carol Farman, needs help cracking a complex murder case.
The Quinn sisters, Samantha and Charlotte, have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence.

movies.primaryTitle: The Broadway Show with Tamsen Fadal
movies.originalTitle: The Broadway Show with Tamsen Fadal
movies.plot: Every week, the stars of the stage are highlighted in this nationally-syndicated entertainment show.
The interesting story of Mahsun who tried to become a gigolo while working as a courier.
When a man goes looking for his missing girlfriend, he stumbles upon a government conspiracy that is bigger than the President himself.

Recovering alcoholic and divorced father of a young daughter, DS Jim Bergerac is a true maverick who prefers doing things his own way, and consequently doesn't always carry out his investigations the way his boss would like.

Vicky issues an ultimatum to her longtime boyfriend: marry her or she leaves. When things don't go as planned, she pursues her dream of marriage with a new partner, leading to an unexpected journey of self-discovery.
Set in the 1960s, the series, packed with mystery and suspense, depicts the adventures of Doctor Refaat Ismail, a single hematologist who finds himself faced with a series of supernatural events.
The lives, loves, and losses of a group of teenagers and their families as they go through high school, college, and into the world of work in the fictional village of Hollyoaks in Chester, England.
A young heroine, Miu, who travels through Copenhagen's criminal netherworld.

When the crown prince, Chagum, is born with an ancient water spirit inside him, the emperor sends assassins to dispatch the child - but Balsa, a warrior hired by the empress to protect her son, won't let them murder Chagum without a fight.
After an arrest, businessman Simon Williams (Chris Townsend) gets turned into a superhuman by a terrorist Baron Zemo (Anthony Vasquez).
A spin-off of the Oscar-winning film about racial tensions in Los Angeles.
Eric Andre tries to host a talk show in a bizarre environment, where he is sometimes the player of pranks and sometimes the victim.
Indian Air Force pilots take on a risky mission that tests their capabilities to the extreme.

Baseball pitcher Kim Je-hyeok becomes a convict overnight after being sent to prison for defending his sister from a sexual assault, days before he was due to fly to the US to join the Boston Red Sox.
Jason Oppenheim, owner of the Oppenheim Group, expands the company opening a second office in Newport Beach.
A 32-year-old misanthropic musician named Frank lives in Dublin with his mother.

A young woman born in Eight Banners' family marries the Emperor of the Qing Dynasty. After surviving through many murderous scandals and betrayals, she prevails as the most powerful woman in the Emperor's harem, the Empress dowager.

Reborn in magical Phi, Ryo hopes for a peaceful life with water magic. Instead, he faces deadly monsters. With eternal youth and optimism, he masters magic over 20 years until fate makes him legendary-at his own relaxed pace.
A mysterious man bestows unique powers to three women.
Follows members of the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit as they undergo rigorous training and navigate emotional challenges while forging bonds and grappling with the complexities of life at sea.
A woman's search to uncover the mysterious disappearance of her husband leads her to the Congo, where she's forced to seek the truth about what happened to the man she loved.
A chance encounter between two pregnant women in a supermarket just outside of Sydney.
Following the daily life of a band of high school students with their worries and scandals, but also the construction of their identity, their choices and their journey towards adulthood.
Follows the true events involving Vietnam War veteran Campo Elías Delgado, who committed a mass shooting in Bogotá.
Deception, lies and betrayal are the name of the game as four Traitors infiltrate a group of 24 players and use their skills to eradicate 'loyal' contestants trying to win $250,000 in silver bars.

Follows the State's Attorney's dedicated team of prosecutors and investigators as they navigate heated city politics and controversies head-on, while fearlessly pursuing justice in the city of Chicago, Illinois.
A woman, who quit being an attorney at her father's law firm to become a mediator, copes after her father's death.
A dark realistic cop series follows a squad of Paris cops who exist in the blurred boundaries at the very edge of the law, often using violence and intimidation to get the job done.
Mercurial retired police detective, Julien Baptiste, specializes in missing-persons cases.

The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city.

movies.originalTitle: Danganronpa: Kibô no gakuen to zetsubô no kôkôsei - The animation
movies.plot: A group of teenagers enroll in a prestigious high school, which turns out to be a devious trap designed to tempt the pupils to murder one another in order to graduate.

Set in the Southern District of New York Federal Court, brand-new lawyers work for both the defense and the prosecution as they handle the most high-profile and high-stakes cases in the country--all as their personal lives intersect.
A woman who grew up as an only child discovers that her dad fathered many other children as a sperm donor.
When Iruma's parents sell him to a powerful demon, the kindhearted 14-year-old doesn't expect to be adopted and sent to a demon high school.

When a dynastic struggle between the collateral branches of the Kuru clan, the Kauravas and Pandavas lead them to the threshold of war, Lord Krishna decides to step in and take control of the situation.
A cat-and-mouse brawl chasing each other.
A dark, edgy look at life as a Junior-Executive-in-Training at your average, soulless multi-national corporation.
The show centers on Warwick Davis in his day-to-day life, complete with the frustrations he faces.
With freshmen law students Banri and Mitsuo, it's friendship at first sight. But trouble gets stirred up with talk of a fiancé.
Captain Matt Holbrook leads detectives tracking lawbreakers instead of having personal lives. His squad of three rarely worked cases together.
A "maverick" French attorney who frequently uses somewhat unconventional methods to assist clients. Her genuine concern for her clients adds complexity to the problems she takes on.
Geneticist David Sandstrom is the chief scientist at the prestigious virology/micro-biology NORBAC laboratory, a joint enterprise between the USA, Canada and Mexico for countering bio-terrorism.
Maddy Smith and her family are the only wolfbloods in Stoneybridge, which is a well-kept secret. They lead a peaceful life until Rhydian, a wolfblood, arrives and triggers chaos.
When the power-hungry Ravan tore through the world to unleash evil, in his way stood a humble vaanar awoken to his divinity to become an immortal legend.

movies.primaryTitle: In the Eye of the Storm
movies.originalTitle: In the Eye of the Storm
movies.plot: From tornadoes to wildfires, immersive footage captures the epicentre of shocking natural disasters in real-time like never before.
It explores the beautiful and haunting tale about one woman's fight to tell her story.
A former police informant is forced to become an informant again to save the life of his brother, which forces him to come to terms with his dark past.
Jack owns a magazine and is Susan's former brother-in-law. After she is left without her fiancé on her wedding day, Jack agrees to take her back to the magazine.
Will Travers is an analyst at a New York City-based federal intelligence agency who is thrown into a story where nothing is as it appears to be.
A crew of scientists embarks on a mission aboard a ship called the Nightflyer to investigate a mysterious alien signal, but they soon begin to question if something is already on the ship with them.
A dark thriller surrounding Elizabeth Bancroft, a senior detective with explosive secrets.
A pair of scheming ex-lovers attempt to exploit others by using the power of seduction.
When a man goes missing from a tiny outback town, his estranged son is forced to navigate its motley crew of residents to find him.
High school student 'Jeong-woo,' who possesses the ability to detect misfortune, as he becomes a terrorist himself to save people and confront a massive conspiracy.
As Fatma sets out to search for Zafer, she commits an unexpected murder and she has to keep killing in order to survive.
ABC's original hour-long news magazine.

movies.primaryTitle: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince So I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
movies.originalTitle: Tensei Shitara Dainana Ouji Datta Node, Kimama ni Majutsu wo Kiwamemasu
movies.plot: Reborn with the perfect bloodline, this sorcerer is determined to enjoy his new life using his extraordinary magical abilities to master the study of magic that was beyond his reach in his previous life!.
Various supernatural threats use unorthodox methods to take over Mandela County.

Ambitious Jana is confronted with the unscrupulous machinations of the world of finance. Her working life is determined by egotism, the pressure to succeed and machismo. She soon has to decide how far she is prepared to go for her career.
A young woman grows close to a prosecutor as she works with him as a trainee in a murder case. However, things take a turn when she inexplicably becomes a suspect.

Gil Ra-im is a tough stuntwoman with a soft heart. Kim Joo-won is a nit-picky CEO with a long list of complexes. Love-struck, Joo-won barges into Ra-im's life in all the wrong ways, trying to make sense of his illogical feelings.
Adventure Time: Side Quests takes the Adventure Time franchise back to the early days when Finn was just a kid, excited to fight monsters and go on epic quests with his best buddy Jake.
Agent Jim Hardie splits his life between being an agent helping Wells Fargo cope with bad guys, and owning a ranch near San Francisco, California.
In this supernatural thriller, journalist Sagar's life turns upside down when newspapers predict chilling incidents that unfold in his life.
A crass, womanizing duck works as a private eye with his level-headed pig sidekick, all the while raising a family as a single dad.

Three families are torn apart when a stranded female soldier, a disillusioned corporate attorney and a disrespected political activist are pulled into the same shocking international military conspiracy.
Four 17-year-old friends win the lottery in Marseille but are too young to claim it. Their jackpot of 17 million leads to mounting complications - being rich teens isn't as simple as it seems.

Barcelona 1967. Ana Rivera returns from New York to launch her last dream: to make the leap from the exclusive business of haute couture in Madrid to a boutique in Barcelona with aspirations to become a global franchise.
Two misfits, thrown together by chance in the middle of the Australian desert, forge bonds in a quest to transport a precious piano from one side of the country to the other.

movies.primaryTitle: Mitchell and Webb Are Not Helping
movies.originalTitle: Mitchell and Webb Are Not Helping
movies.plot: A sketch comedy series tackles historical moments, news, and awkward social situations with a self-aware approach, poking fun at life's problems without trying to solve them.
Hilarity and fun ensues when Satan ends up in modern day Japan without any magic to return, and starts working part time in a fast food joint.

Pastor, an undercover cop sets on a mission to rescue the kidnapped daughter of a judge by infiltrating the prison where she's suspected to be at. Once inside he will have to learn to live by the prison's and the inmates' rules.
The story kicks off in DC with a reunion of OG Bad Girls and a Ballroom Dinner.

Chloe Saint-Laurent, a profiler with an uncanny ability to empathize with victims and perpetrators, assists the Paris homicide division in cracking its most baffling cases in this tense crime drama series inspired by real events.
Soviet cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers risk everything in an ambitious space program aiming to be the first to reach the moon.

Catherine Black, a famed neuroscientist with a job at the Center for Neurological Research and Treatment, struggles with mental illness. However, this is just one of the many secrets she hides from her fiancé and her family.
A rocket scientist in 1940s Los Angeles is secretly the disciple of occultist Aleister Crowley.
Fate deposits Dud on the doorstep of Lodge 49, a dusty fraternal order that offers cheap beer and strange alchemical philosophies.

A group of students are doing their best to win EWS' Battle of the Bands. Along the way, love and friendship bloom between them while a mysterious secret society casts a shadow over their dreams of becoming the next big music star.
Kimihiro Watanuki, a high-schooler, is troubled by monsters and spirits, but meets Yuko Ichihara, a beautiful witch, who grants his wish to not be able to see them. However, there is a price.
With the powers given by the bite of a radioactive spider, a young man fights crime as a wall-crawling superhero.

The German version of "Love Is Blind (2020)" follows singles who want to be loved for who they are - so they have signed up for a less-conventional approach to modern dating to try to find out if love is truly blind.
Half-siblings Jack and Lily adjust to living together while helping at their family's pet business. They explore culture, identity, and new family dynamics with support from parents and grandmother.
An atheist's life is turned upside down when God adds him as a friend on Facebook.
Detective Tig returns to her coastal hometown and uncovers drink-spiking assaults, pushing her into a dangerous investigation where hidden predators and broken systems threaten the truth.
A modern-day couple who manages to adjust to their parents.
Short dramas each with a twist of some kind; across the first four seasons most of these are from short stories by Roald Dahl.
A girl is involuntarily engaged to a boy who turns female when hit with cold water and male when hit with hot.
A series of horrible sudden deaths keep happening to a group of creatures caused by themselves doing the most stupid things.
A story of two friends and petty thieves trying to make a living, but failing in every possible way.
A series following the lives of Miles, Milly, Warren, Egg and Anna, five young legal professionals.
A road crew helps with a rock band's major multi-city tour.
Working-class Irish-Catholic parents raise their eight sons during the early 1970s.
A woman survives a heart transplant and begins to develop different personality traits.

movies.primaryTitle: The Brilliant Healer's New Life in the Shadows
movies.originalTitle: Isshun de Chiryô Shiteita no ni Yakudatazu to Tsuihô Sareta Tensai Chiyushi, Yami Hîrâ Toshite Tanoshiku Ikiru
movies.plot: A skilled healer opens an underground clinic after being mistreated by his party!.

Capt. Glenn Shephard and his crew set sail in a luxury sailing yacht to explore the crystal-clear blue waters of the Ionian Sea. The sailing yacht brings new challenges to these young, attractive and adventurous yachties.

Morgan Freeman explores humanity's biggest questions: our composition, what preceded existence, if we're alone in the universe, and whether there's a creator - mysteries that have challenged our greatest minds.

Eli Shane aims to become the greatest Slugslinging hero by collecting and dueling with transforming slug creatures to defeat the evil Dr. Blakk, who seeks to turn slugs into mindless weapons in the luminous underground world of Slugterra.

movies.primaryTitle: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
movies.originalTitle: Okiraku Ryoshu no Tanoshii Ryochi Boei: Seisan-kei Majutsu de Na mo Nakimura o Saikyo no Josai Toshi ni
movies.plot: Reborn as a noble's fourth son, Van's prodigy status crashes when he manifests production magic. Banished to a failing rural town, he sees opportunity where others see ruin, armed with past-life memories and his unwanted power.
Ever wonder what's happening inside your head? From dreaming to anxiety disorders, discover how your brain works with this illuminating series.
A parody of past religious-geared animated shows starring Orel, an optimistic God-fearing young boy in a world of cynicism.

movies.primaryTitle: Now and Then, Here and There
movies.plot: A young boy named Shuzo rushes to the defense of a stranger who is being attacked for her magic pendant, only to find himself transported into another world where water is a scarce commodity and he is forced to join an army of children.
The continuing adventures of the staff of the ghost removal service.
A mobile task force is dispatched across Denmark to help local police solve tough cases.

movies.primaryTitle: Hero Without a Class: Who Even Needs Skills?!
movies.originalTitle: Mushoku no Eiyû: Betsu ni Sukiru Nanka Iranakattan da ga
movies.plot: At age 10, kids get Classes that shape their future. Born to legendary parents, Arel is deemed "Classless" but remains determined to succeed through hard work despite lacking skills.
Follows the scandalous lives of a group of four girlfriends, each on her own path to self-discovery as they brave the turbulent journey together.
The magical action-adventures of a teenage girl who learns of her destiny as the legendary warrior Sailor Moon and must band together with the other Sailor Scouts to defend the Earth and Galaxy.

Aspiring fashion designers compete for a chance to break into the industry in this reality competition. Each week, a designer is eliminated from the competition after exhibiting their work in front of a judges' panel.
A young man begins a sexual relationship with his aunt. As the affair intensifies, turmoil arises within the family.
Centers on Sara, an unhappily married photographer who begins a torrid affair with Jack, a lawyer for a powerful family.
Ritsu Onodera and Masamune Takano try to sort their feelings from their past relationship.
A police forensic scientist, Barry Allen, battles crimes as the super-fast superhero "The Flash."

In a sleepy town, a mechanic struggles to emerge from his dead gangster father's shadow in a mission to win over the love of his life. An honest officer ends up being a chaos agent; whilst a reluctant cartel heir has an identity crisis.
A mysterious, justice-seeking entity throws chaos into the life of a cop who's willing to overlook ethics and corruption for a promotion.

Fate Graphite is cursed with the skill "Gluttony". He is starving until the day he kills a thief and devours the man's strength and his soul. The true hunger of Fate's Gluttony has awakened and he will be the master of his own destiny.

Piglets follows a group of six very different recruits at a fictional police training college and the staff charged with training them. The UK broadcaster ITV has commissioned this comedy for its streaming service.

A noble girl from the uniquely honest House Grail is framed by her cheating fiancé's lover. When all abandon her, the ghost of wrongly executed Scarlet Castiel possesses her, offering help for a price: find who framed Scarlet years ago.
This crime drama, set in Rome in the 1970s, tells the story of the Banda della Magia, a prolific Italian crime family responsible for some of the country's most violent crimes.
Patty Greene and Lauren Hutchinson, two awkward teenage girls, are desperate to fit in at Weemawee High School.
Charlie is a scammer with a small chain of fortune-telling storefronts and contracts building tricks for a family that controls the business in the greater chunk of LA.
In this crime thriller, a house cleaner commits a string of murders while searching for her missing husband.

movies.originalTitle: The Reluctant Traveler with Eugene Levy
movies.plot: Follows the adventures of Levy as he visits some of the world's most remarkable hotels, as well as explores the people, places, and cultures.
The story of a world in which archaeologists are massive celebrities and the coolest people on the planet.

The film follows Ghislaine Maxwell growing up in Oxford as the daughter of notorious media tycoon and fraudster Robert Maxwell, her life in London, and then her reinvention in New York, where she meets Jeffrey Epstein.

Anesthesiologist Won loses his partner Fah in a car accident and is wrongly accused of murder. Grief-stricken, he attempts suicide but meets Sepsawat, a Grim Reaper who looks exactly like Fah and helps him prove his innocence.
The bizarre everyday adventures of Heiko "Schotty" Schotte, whose profession is to clean up crime scenes.
Police profiler Arnar is sent back home from Oslo to his native Iceland to investigate the country's first serial killer case. He teams up with the local senior cop Kata.
After career troubles, Ye Meng moves back home seeking peace. She meets the enigmatic Li Jinyu, drawn to his quiet demeanor and expressive eyes. Together, they find healing and romance.
A Disney-produced anthology covering many different genres.

movies.primaryTitle: Mike Judge Presents: Tales from the Tour Bus
movies.originalTitle: Mike Judge Presents: Tales from the Tour Bus
movies.plot: The raucous adventures of musicians such as Johnny Paycheck, Jerry Lee Lewis, George Jones and Tammy Wynette, as told by those who knew them best. Season 2 covers the legends of funk.
When Simon Ferguson (Tim Curry) is fired from a soap opera, he decides to crash with ex-wife Hadley Martin (Annie Potts) at the Manhattan hotel that she runs.

Aile is a story of Aslan who is the son of a large family, runs a nightclub. An extremely shrewd man. He is a dark and mysterious character. Psychologist Devin will enter the life of this difficult man and it becomes intense.
Two friends, one black and one white, recall their friendship in the past when they reunite in the present.

Gus Adler, a divorced professor juggles shared custody of his children while pursuing a passionate romance with an enigmatic woman, leading to mounting tensions between his parental duties and personal desires.
A gawky Englishman comes to Los Angeles to find the woman of his dreams.

When a brutal massacre in a remote village uncovers dark forces, police inspector Petar and his allies are pulled into a deadly battle with them, as the hunt for a powerful relic becomes humanity's last hope for survival.

Dracula travels to London, with dark plans for revenge against those who ruined his life centuries earlier. However, his plan is complicated when he falls in love with a woman who seems to be a reincarnation of his dead wife.
Varieties of celebrities pair up to do battle each week using lip sync as their weapon to out do each other. The audience is the judge, deciding which candidate does the best lip sync performance.
Three rounding almost the 40 year old mark, will juggle life, work and relationships.

movies.primaryTitle: City of God: The Fight Rages On
movies.originalTitle: Cidade de Deus: A Luta Não Para
movies.plot: Twenty years after City of God, Buscapé recounts how conflicts between police, traffickers, and militias impacted the community.
Natsuko Hirose embarks on animation career. Her debut anime becomes a smash hit, sparking social phenomenon and earning her recognition as a brilliant emerging director.

Robyn, an American publicist working for a cutthroat London PR company that represents troubled celebrities, is adept at keeping her clients' lives appearing in perfect order, while her own falls to pieces.
A young woman from Blackpool finds her voice in the male-dominated world of the 1960s comedy and takes London by storm.
In a retro-futuristic world, charismatic salesman Jack Billings leads a team of fellow sales associates determined to revitalize their customers' lives by hawking timeshares on the moon.
Follows Police Detective Sergeant Joe Friday and his partner Officer Bill Gannon as they investigate various different crimes in Los Angeles, California.
Elena Michaels, the only female werewolf in existence, is desperate to escape the paranormal world.
Shinjiro Hayata learns that his father passed on the "Ultraman Factor" to him and fights against evil.
Former ninja Joe Higan is ambushed by assassins who seek bloody revenge on him and his family for their betrayal, after escaping his clan and fleeing into rural America.
Residents of a unique apartment building in Greenwich Village build a bonded family of friends and neighbors.
A young woman framed for murder must become the second wife of the victim's brother.
A Florida Park Ranger and his family deal with strange occurrences in the aftermath of a hurricane.
A soldier returns home from war to find his girlfriend missing, family broken, and neighborhood overrun by crime. Though reluctant, he becomes a hitman to protect loved ones.

movies.primaryTitle: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom
movies.plot: Suddenly summoned to a fantasy world and betrothed to a princess, Kazuya Souma is crowned the new king. Unlike those before him, he won't be using swords and magic to rule; will administrative reform really get this kingdom back on track?
The crazy adventures of the SOS Brigade, led by the insane but charismatic Haruhi.

A dramatic drama depicting the love of a man and a woman whose lives are linked because of a murder since young age. Despite an unfortunate destiny and the stigma and pains, they will try to be happy and heal their wounds.
14-year-old Renton joins the rebel GekkoState ship, co-pilots the TypeZero with the mysterious Eureka, and unknowingly becomes part of a grand scheme.
Four Beybladers and their genius friend travel the world as team 'Bladebreakers' to win a championship, realizing there's much more at stake on the go.

movies.primaryTitle: The Hitch Hiker's Guide to the Galaxy
movies.originalTitle: The Hitch Hiker's Guide to the Galaxy
movies.plot: Arthur Dent and his friend, Ford Prefect, escape the destruction of Earth, only to face incredible trials, tribulations and adventures in space and time.
Kunon is blind but ambitious to see with magic. Word of his genius reaches the royal court, and is invited to study under the kingdom's most powerful magician.

Facing divorce, Selim learns his wife Meyra is terminally ill and fights to win her back. But with past love and secrets resurfacing, their fragile bond is tested between love, loyalty, and second chances.
A tomboyish schoolgirl finds herself forced into repeated duels for another girl who has a role in a world revolution.
A diverse group of young women navigating their lives through the predominantly male oriented world of skateboarding.
A groundbreaking gay adult drama which chronicles the lives of Stuart and Vince, as well as 15-year-old Nathan, who is in love with Stuart.
A couple goes missing near a gorge; an abandoned car sparks a nighttime rescue in the rain. As the search intensifies, past secrets emerge, exposing the hidden struggles behind the disappearance.
Yogi, a smooth, talkative forest bear looks to raid park goers' picnic baskets, while Park Ranger Smith tries to stop him.
Roguish comedy drama following the misadventures of small-time crook Arthur Daley. Can his ex-boxer bodyguard Terry stay level-headed whilst working for the King of Dodgy Deals?

movies.primaryTitle: High School Musical: The Musical: The Series
movies.originalTitle: High School Musical: The Musical - The Series
movies.plot: The students from the school where the High School Musical films were shot stage a musical production based on the franchise.

Mitsumi moves to Tokyo to attend a prestigious school and achieve her dreams of making positive change in the world. But while she's got book smarts, she soon finds herself inexperienced in big city norms, and struggles to make friends.

movies.primaryTitle: KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World
movies.plot: Yukito's parents are the leaders of a cult. After he gets sacrificed, he gets reincarnated into another world where religion doesn't exist and porn books are akin to a child's doodles.
In 1980, the Supreme Headquarters Alien Defence Organization covertly defends Earth against threats from a dying extraterrestrial race that needs to harvest human organs to survive.

movies.originalTitle: Finding Your Roots with Henry Louis Gates, Jr.
movies.plot: Before the popularity of AncestryDNA, journalist and cultural critic Henry Louis Gates, Jr. divulges the family trees of various celebrities, many times with stunning revelations.
In the early 14th century, several oppressed Welsh commoners unite to take revenge on the ruthless nobility.
Fifteen-year-old Tara Webster's dream of dancing comes true when she gets into a top dance academy. She soon realizes dancing is only half the battle.
A small town in the Northeast is turned upside down when local legend and town namesake, Nathan Rutherford (Ed Helms) fights the moving of a historical statue.

Two brothers with contrasting personalities - Güney, a dedicated student and model citizen, and Kuzey, his rebellious younger sibling - navigate life's challenges while their opposing natures create constant tension.
After a nuclear war turns Earth into a lawless wasteland, Kenshiro, a practitioner of the deadly master art "Hokuto Shinken", fights a succession of tyrannical warriors to restore order.

movies.primaryTitle: The Real Housewives of Rhode Island
movies.originalTitle: The Real Housewives of Rhode Island
movies.plot: A tight-knit circle of Rhode Islanders who have deep community roots and families that go back generations.
A couple gets divorced after several years of marriage. After that, the man suddenly gets rich, and life changes again when his ex-wife starts working with him.
Steven Toast is determined to win the recognition he mistakenly believes he deserves.

After a plane carrying three Agents crashes in the Himalayas, they are rescued by an advanced civilisation secretly living in Tibet who grant them enhanced versions of the ordinary five senses, and intellectual and physical abilities.
A couple in their 30s has dated for many years. When they begin to discuss marriage, they begin to look upon their relationship in a different light.
Dan Moody returns home to spend Christmas with his dysfunctional family.

The cases of a private investigations agency run by two Vietnam War veterans and their computer geek friend from high school, armed with toughness, their own helicopter, and the third's technical ability.

movies.primaryTitle: The Adventures of Young Indiana Jones
movies.originalTitle: The Adventures of Young Indiana Jones
movies.plot: The boyhood adventures of the greatest action hero of all time: Indiana Jones. Young Indy travels the world, meeting some of the greatest figures of the early 20th century, and participating in the events that helped shape history.

Doctor William Rush is not your average on-call professional. He's not attached to any hospital, he's highly discreet -- no matter the ailment, his clients must pay a cash-only premium, and the doctor can party with the best of them.
A trio of women form a musical group in Atlanta.
Ms. Rachel, a beloved YouTuber, brings her hit educational content: songs, games, and lessons to help kids learn. The show covers speech, words, phonics, and more, with subtitles in 33 languages.
In the near future, an organized crime group known as "Outfit" becomes a major force in America.
The apartment manager of a residential building takes advantage of his power of surveillance to meddle in the lives of the tenants.

Explores intimate female emotions where desire, fear, and resilience collide. And follows women at emotional crossroads challenging oppression, reclaiming identities, and asserting their right to dignity, love, and self-worth.

Follows the book of Acts. Shows the complete message of Christ and the transformation of Saul to Paul and how the high priest of Judea does not believe in what has taken place after the Crucifixion of Christ.
A young woman tries to cope with life while coming to terms with her abilities as a psychic. She can see everyone's futures, but her present is a mess.

The most powerful drug dealer of his time, Amado Carrillo Fuentes was a man who became the head of the Juarez Cartel. He was nicknamed the lord of the skies for his fleet of planes he used to transport drugs.
Two secret societies clash through history - one seeking to control humanity's fate, the other defending free will. Characters different from the games fight to determine mankind's future.

When Natsume Takashi inherits a book that belonged to his late grandmother he realizes the book is filled with the names of spirits she defeated and bound to her will. He then decides to return their names so they can be free once again.
An insecure yet lovable bearded man relies on his many friends to make face/mouth noises to prevent himself from having to work a desk job and/or move back in with his parents.
A group of outsiders takes on the 1980s old-boys club of Wall Street.

movies.primaryTitle: The Nine Lives of Chloe King
movies.originalTitle: The Nine Lives of Chloe King
movies.plot: A city priest moves to the small village of Castelo Novo, where he mysteriously loses his ability to lie - a situation that leads to unexpected and troublesome consequences.
A comedy series about the challenges of maintaining a relationship after a breakup, when a shared child keeps two exes connected.
Follows a perfect woman whose mask begins to crack when a charismatic stranger arrives on the scene.
Hyouka centers on Oreki Hotarou and his life in the Classic Literature Club. His mundane world is flipped upside down as they begin to solve various mysteries.
50 wanna-be internet celebrities fight each other in various games while their disguised host makes fun of them.
A drama about the race between people who want to get closer to the truth and those who want to cover it up.
An epic based on the myth of Jumong, founder of the ancient Korean kingdom of Goguryeo in 37 B.C.
Drew Barrymore presents human-interest stories, celebrity guests, lifestyle segments and field pieces, all driven by her infectious brand of humor and optimism.
1947, Los Angeles. Cop Joe Teague walks the line between the LAPD, led by William Parker, and the mob, led by Bugsy Siegel.
An ex-cop hosts a late-night talk radio program while getting involved with his listeners' problems in his off-time.

A couple flees their disapproving families and seeks help from Vivek, who leads a group claiming to protect lovers. When his true motives emerge, they must escape through Banaras while evading both their families and new threats.
A medical sales rep excels at selling KydoXin, but upon learning of its harmful effects on patients, he faces a moral crisis and must decide whether to challenge the corporate powers behind it.

movies.originalTitle: Dang wo fei ben xiang ni
movies.plot: Set off by a sweet chance encounter, 16-year-old Su Zaizai finds herself helplessly drawn to Zhang Lurang - her smart, charming yet distant schoolmate.
Based upon a series of children's books, a grizzly cub has many misadventures with his friends.
A forest mystical being appoints two men in succession as the legendary outlaw defender of the oppressed.
A team of detectives investigates stalkers in Los Angeles.
Blanca, a blind profiler, comes back to Genova, her hometown. A difficult case forces her to remain and to face with her mysterious past. Based on books by Patrizia Rinaldi.
Drama series about life at the Bar, the dilemmas and problems that modern day barristers have to face, and what it means to become a silk.
A Harlem widower's empty-nest plans get disrupted when his millennial son and free-spirited daughter move back in, forcing him to navigate new family dynamics and redefine his priorities.

movies.originalTitle: Plae rak chan duai chai thoe
movies.plot: The story of two high school boys who are relearning their deep relationship through complicated and unstable feelings like a storm that blows the boat away from it's path. It is contrary to the peaceful Phuket where they live.
Animated series based on Andrew Peterson's fantasy novels detailing the adventures of the Igiby family and their pursuit by the venomous Fangs of Dang and their evil overlord, Gnag the Nameless.
The story of superhero The Tick, based on the popular comic book.
Former Wall Street mogul Peter Scarbrow becomes headmaster of Mount Horizon, a progressive school for teens at risk, high in the mountains of the Northwestern United States.
The legendary Polat Alemdar uncovers the truth, defeats secret enemies, and serves his country.

10 years after the end of Precrime in Washington DC one of the three PreCogs attempts to lead a normal life while still suffering from visions of the future. Will they be able to hold it together or mentally breakdown and give up?
One newcomer red blood cell just wants to do her job. Between bacteria incursions and meeting a certain white blood cell, she's got a lot to learn.
Sylvia, a disillusioned British spy turned detective starts a new life in the beautiful heart of Italy. She soon finds out trouble follows her wherever she goes.
A man attempts to thwart a giant corporation that seems to have unlimited power.
Ten of the country's most creative and skilled tattoo artists are judged by icons of the tattoo world. They compete for a hundred thousand dollars and the title of "INK MASTER".
Young Catherine Langford embarks on an unexpected adventure to unlock the mystery of what lies beyond the Stargate in order to save the Earth from darkness.
Centers around a three-way romantic relationship involving a loving suburban married couple and another woman.

Urano, a young Japanese soon-to-be librarian, dies in an earthquake. She is reincarnated in another world as a young girl named Mayne, but learns books are scarce and only provided to prestigious elites.
Süreyya, a young and beautiful singer, involves to the life of rooted Boran family of Bursa as a wife of the oldest son Faruk and all the family's secrets begins to uncover.
A detective digs deep into a case while navigating the complex society around her.
A headstrong ex-police officer becomes the unlikely bodyguard for a flamboyant billionaire, leading to unexpected chemistry as threats and luxury collide in their high-stakes world.

Follows a team of super-powered individuals, known as "Alphas", led by noted neurologist and psychiatrist Lee Rosen, as they investigate criminal cases involving other suspected Alpha for the U.S. Department of Defense.
The Cannon family runs the High Chaparral Ranch in the Arizona Territory in 1870s.

Successful writer Erica returns to her hometown, finding her friend Alexandra's dead body. Convinced it wasn't suicide, she launches an investigation entangling past and present, her life upended by meeting Captain Patrick Saab.
A university graduate working in the city morgue is able to repeat the same day over again to prevent murders or other disasters.
Sitcom following the police officers and detectives in the fictional town of Gasforth in England.
Three chipmunk brothers named Alvin, Simon, and Theodore have been adopted by and are living with Dave (human). Each episode finds them getting into trouble and new and unusual situations.
A drama following a group of inspirational women in a rural Cheshire community during World War II.

Discover the secrets behind Europe's engineering marvels. Filmed across six nations, explore record-breaking constructions, innovative machines, ingenious designs, and the hidden engineering driving iconic landmarks today.
Three young alien beings with the ability to form a giant robotic warrior attempt to blend into suburbia, all while battling the tyrannical forces that ravaged their home world.
A noir crime drama set in Aberystwyth, Wales, where troubled DCI Tom Mathias solves murders while searching for redemption.
An adaptation of the ancient epic in which the exiled Prince Rama and his brother Laxman set out to save Rama's wife, Sita, who has been kidnapped by the demon king of Lanka Ravana.
A tabloid editor and her photographer try to make their way in the world of celebrity journalism.

Fallen commander Marc destroyed the Lighthouse. Guided by the mysterious Bai Yuekui, he finds survivors resisting the Manna Ecology with innate power. As the Lighthouse's giant brain awakens, the two factions face an unprecedented crisis.
In 1990s Turkey, a group of teenage outcasts band together to make their beloved teacher fall in love so she'll have a reason to stay in town with them.

movies.primaryTitle: The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr.
movies.originalTitle: The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr.
movies.plot: A bounty hunter rides the Old West, fighting bad guys, many with futuristic-type gadgets.

A boy, hardened by his brother's death, loses faith in their "Age of Electricity" dream. A devout girl hides grief for her mother. Together, they explore the 20th Century Electrical Catalog, confronting their pasts to forge their future.
Aggressively pursued by a politician's daughter who will do anything to marry him, a small-town man takes drastic measures to reclaim his life.
A compromising sexual video featuring a promising politician, it depicts the lives of four women forced to walk the line between public and private life.
Baek Dong-Joo works as a funeral director who has a supernatural power that allows her to see and talk to the dead.
"'Our House"" tells the story of Fi Lawson, who arrives home one day to find a family of strangers moving into her house--and that her husband Bram has disappeared.

A fictional Los Angeles coastal suburb's elite indulge lavish lifestyles while surviving the riptide of organized crime and deep, dark scandal. Hometown hero Pete and the Garretts face off with the global British billionaire Kenway empire.

After suffering a setback following a friend's betrayal Yoo Jin Woo travels to Spain on a business. There, he stays at an old hostel owned by a former classical guitarist Jung Hee Joo. The two get entangled in a mysterious incident.

A cynical woman who lives alone runs into a powerful general who falls in love with her at first sight. She has trust issues; he has secrets that even he doesn't know about. Together, they start to investigate those secrets.
People who walk in with a desire, but end up reborn to themselves through the magical realism of Fantasy Island.

movies.primaryTitle: Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts
movies.originalTitle: Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts
movies.plot: A girl explores the possibilities in a post-apocalyptic world.
A recently-widowed father quits his job as a popular 800-word columnist for a top-selling Sydney newspaper.
A group of misfit lawyers form an unconventional firm.
Dogu is a young man who is not successful in anything. The dream of Dogu, which is not supported by anyone, is to be a comedian. He strives to make his dream come true.

The iconic animated duo are back and dumber than ever. The '90s pop-culture phenomenons return, voiced by creator Mike Judge, to confound common sense, torment each other, and showcase some of the dumbest comedy imaginable.

A group a young warriors known as 'Saints', each in possession of a 'cloth' guarded by a different constellation, must protect the reincarnation of the goddess Athena as she attempts to keep the Earth from being destroyed by evil forces.

A woman at her lowest point reconnects with a rural student she once helped. After bringing him to the city for education, they part ways. Years later, their paths cross again, leading to an unexpected romance born from their shared past.
Fictional series to chronicle the effort to send the first crewed mission to Mars.

movies.primaryTitle: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat
movies.originalTitle: Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha, Isekai Kizoku ni Tensei Suru
movies.plot: When the world's greatest assassin reaches the end of his life, he is sent by a goddess to be reborn in a magical world and use his skills to save that world.
A live-action sitcom about two 12-year-old girls who start a multi-million-dollar gaming company and take on rap superstar Double G as a business partner.
Yuuta Asamura gets a new stepsister after his father remarries, Saki Ayase, who happens to be the number one beauty of the school year.
Spider-Man battles crime in New York City with the help of Iceman and Firestar.

Customs agents go undercover to infiltrate Britain's most dangerous drug gangs, following a thrilling criminal investigation based on extensive research and interviews with those involved in the top-secret operation.
Convinced of her daughter's innocence in a homicide, a devoted mother soon uncovers unsettling truths as the line between victim and perpetrator blurs.

Chocolate shop president Sosuke can't touch others due to trauma. Ha Na, a genius chocolatier, hides her identity at the shop due to scopophobia. After they meet, they overcome relationship issues through the magic of chocolate.

movies.primaryTitle: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class
movies.originalTitle: Kurasu no Daikirai na Joshi to Kekkon Suru Koto ni Natta.
movies.plot: Two high school students hide their arranged marriage as their mutual hatred slowly turns into something softer.
In 1614, two rival ninja clans back opposing sons of Hidetada Tokugawa for the shogunate. They send their finest warriors to battle to the death, with the victor's clan ruling for a millennium.
Sanjay Leela Bhansali brings his majestic signature flair to stories of love and betrayal in the lives of courtesans in pre-independence India.
Die Kantoor is a workplace mockumentary set at Deluxe Processed Meats, a polony distribution company in Klerksdorp, where outdated opinions, low ambition, and misguided leadership collide.
Sam Pinkett and Phil Bourne, Berkshire County administration officials, find their lives altered by a case of mistaken identity.

A story that follows three children who unintentionally film a murder scene. As they become involve with the suspect, it opens up a case that is far more complicated than it looks and entraps several families into an unpredictable outcome.

movies.primaryTitle: Re: ZERO - Starting Life in Another World (Re-Edit)
movies.plot: This is a special version compiling the first season of Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- and containing unseen scenes.
Couple Martyn and Rebecca relocate with kids from London to Glasgow. Neighbour Jan's unsettling remarks hint at a sinister situation unfolding around their new home.
Irish ex-cop Jack Taylor solves crimes as a maverick private investigator. Based on Ken Bruen's crime-drama books.

Fan Xian, born in the ancient empire of Southern Qing, inexplicably possesses memories from the 21st century. Wanting to learn about his mysterious past, he ventures to the capital, only to be entangled in the intrigues of the Emperor.

A frat house notorious for parties is turned into a co-ed residence for four freshmen under the supervision of a graduate student and her occasional boyfriend, a party animal from the closed fraternity.
A miniature propellant cluster bomb of painfully mutinous nightmares, all dripping with the orange sludge of dream logic.
High school student Mirai finds that her schoolmate Akihito is an immortal being and half a spirit. When Akihito learns that Mirai is a spirit world warrior their lives become intertwined.
A grumpy ghost named Scratch is eternally cursed to be in the presence of polar opposite Molly McGee, a cheerful tween.
After 74 villains break out of prison, Marvel's most powerful superheroes team up to capture all of them, and also to defend the Earth from widespread threats.
In a downtown Tokyo café, a group of girls will help sort out any problems to help the local customers.

MrBeast pushes contestants and himself through extreme survival experiments: 100 days in bunkers and circles, freezing expeditions, isolation tests. Each scenario strips life to basics, revealing who has the strength, patience.
Based in Neukölln, Berlin, Toni manages the daily business of dealing with the Arab gangs and ends up wanting to leave his old life behind for his family, but as expected, it's never that simple.
About the hunt for a type of violent criminal who has yet to strike in Denmark, and who is surrounded by fear and mystique - the serial killer.
Estranged sisters Claire and Tess are reunited after 20 years when they inherit their family's cattle station, Drover's Run, in the outback of South Australia, following their father's death.

In 2012, Rani Bharti, Bihar's two-term Chief Minister, rises as a national contender while Delhi's Prime Minister Joshi battles a crumbling coalition, igniting a fierce power struggle of politics, ambition, and betrayal.
The series tells the love story of Han Se Gye, an actress who must spend one week out of each month living in someone else's body, and Seo Do Jae, a man who suffers from Prosopagnosia.
A group of guys travel to Belize to see an old friend, when things take an unexpectedly dark turn.
A mysterious virus turns humans who touch cats into felines, causing a "Nyandemic" worldwide catastrophe where people transform into cats.

movies.primaryTitle: Killer Confessions: Case Files of a Texas Ranger
movies.originalTitle: Killer Confessions: Case Files of a Texas Ranger
movies.plot: Texas Ranger James Holland uses unconventional interrogation methods that earn him the nickname "serial killer whisperer." He solves cold cases by getting killers to confess the disturbing details of their crimes.
The life and times of the rather traditional Sutcuoglu family and their comedic struggles to adapt the high-profile contemporary life of Nisantasi.
Petar Maras, the Belgrade drug lord, is in conflict with Red, the powerful state curator of the Serbian criminal world.
A lawyer is forced to take care of one of New York City's wealthiest families.

movies.primaryTitle: A Body in the Snow: The Trial of Karen Read
movies.originalTitle: A Body in the Snow: The Trial of Karen Read
movies.plot: On a cold January morning in a sleepy suburb outside of the city, a local police officer named John O'Keefe was found dead on a fellow officer's front lawn.

Toprak wakes up from a 5 year coma, Fidan has lost her husband and baby in an accident five yars ago. Together they unravel the mystery of Toprak's past and his uncanny resemblance to Fidan's deceased husband.
Follow the Kardashian family as they celebrate new ventures and navigate through their new normal: motherhood, relationships, and career goals.

Risa and Otani are always being laughed at as the comedy duo. Risa, a girl, is taller than the average girl, and Otani, a boy, is shorter than the average boy. However, Risa has feelings for Otani that shocks him.
Holmes and Dr. Watson solve the mysteries of the Disappearance of Lady Frances Carfax, Thor Bridge, Shoscombe Old Place, The Boscombe Valley Mystery, The Illustrious Client and The Creeping Man.
Red, daughter of the Queen of Hearts, and Chloe, daughter of Cinderella, travel back in time to save their moms from a disastrous event.

An Argentinean intelligence agent infiltrates the Jewish community to gather information that is then allegedly used to perpetrate two of the worst terrorist attacks in Latin American history, leaving over 100 dead.
The first American to interrogate Saddam Hussein slowly starts to realize that the US invasion of Iraq is not as cut and dry, nor its outlook as positive, as Washington believes.
A cartoonist deals with corporate drama that ensues after the revival of a superhero he created.

A romance drama about a semi-human vampire named Seon Woo-hyeol, who failed to become a human by a day out of 100 years, and a woman Joo In-hae, who doesn't have a single human decency, starting to live together and finding true warmth.
Each series, a detective focuses on the prime suspect in a murder case; but everyone has something to hide.
In the extreme Alaskan wild, 16 survivalists compete for a chance to win a massive cash prize but these lone wolves must be part of a team to win.
A beautiful detective falls in love with an ex-soldier who goes into hiding from the secret government organization that turned him into a mechanically charged beast.
Controversial spoof of current affairs television, and the role of celebrity in the UK.

A young girl who lives with her cruel stepmother and sister, accidentally meets 3 young and rich cousins who live a luxury life in a big mansion and is hired by the boys grandpa to look after their bad behavior.

Ates was sent to boarding school after his mother's death and never returned home. He trusts no one. Leyla, on the other hand, has never known her family and earns money by cheating. What will happen when they cross paths?

A work dealing with buying abandoned children by their parents and selling them based on price and rating, as well as the illegal adoption cartel that provides a free refund service if you do not like the child while raising it.

A man comes to Korsbæk, Denmark, in 1929, opens a women's clothing store in competition with an established one - bringing him up against the conservative establishment including the bank manager. We follow the families until after WWII.
A team of experts and scientists undertakes exhaustive research at Skinwalker Ranch, an infamous location for paranormal activity and UFO sightings.

movies.originalTitle: Dian ran wo, wen nuan ni
movies.plot: Zhu Yun's college life has just begun, but is disrupted by the arrival of the bad boy, Li Xun, who turns her world upside down.
An exiled priest tries to escape his demons while living in a remote village in Spain.
After being impregnated by the Devil, a reluctant mother and her Antichrist daughter attempt to live an ordinary life in Delaware.
Ihsan Yildrim's success with his cleaning business makes him want to move his family to the more extravagant Etiler neighborhood.

Tom Good quits the rat race, and with wife Barbara turns the garden of their Surbiton house into a smallholding. Their neighbours, snobbish Margo Leadbetter and her conventional husband Jerry, feel variously amused, offended and impressed.

When Alex Miller let Jed Creek rent her room via Craigslist, she had no idea that he was a notorious serial squatter, and that he would use his knowledge of tenancy laws to slowly kick her out of her own home.
A defamed ex-cop, who is struggling to get back his son, is put on undercover duty within the biggest mafia in Istanbul.

movies.primaryTitle: Snow White with the Red Hair
movies.plot: Although her name means 'white as snow', Shirayuki is a cheerful red-haired girl who lives in the town of Tanbarun and works diligently as an apothecary in her herbal shop.

Audrey is determined not to be defined by motherhood. In theory, this seems fairly easy. In practice, her career-focused husband, self-obsessed mother, and fancy-free best friend make it damn-near impossible.

As Miles, Ashley's partner of 12 years and father of their son, is suddenly incarcerated, she is left to navigate a chaotic and humorous existential crisis when she's forced to move in with Miles' mother and half-sister.
A group of British comedians show the sides of history they don't teach you in school. From the 'Savage Stone Age' to the 'Troublesome 20th Century', you see the full side to history.
Unhappy at work and in her personal life, Anita discovers a way to travel back to age 15. What will she change in her past?
Stand-up comedian Jerrod Carmichael navigates through life with his therapist-in-training girlfriend and his heavily-opinionated family.
A British intelligence officer races against time to uncover a UK politician's potential ties with the Kremlin, risking her reputation and family, as a murder and election loom.
A team of unlikely personalities join forces to help save the Earth from the scheming Mesogog, a dinosaur-like villain who wishes to destroy humankind.
TV adaptation of the 1996 comedy about about three divorced wives who share a common past.
Party girls Sara and Rachel embark on surreal misadventures in the town of Wollongong, Australia.
A group of teenage girls must deal with supernatural fallout stemming from an innocent game of "Light as a Feather, Stiff as a Board" when they start dying off in the exact way predicted.

Set in 1991 Los Angeles, rookie cop Harry Bosch navigates a city plagued by racial tension and gang violence. When drawn into a high-profile heist and criminal corruption, his loyalty to the badge is tested.

Live dramatic shows featuring Hollywood stars, adaptations of motion pictures, and a host accompanying. The host would introduce each act, and would conduct an interview with the stars at the end of the play.

Pinar from a traditional family, tries to build an independent life in Istanbul while working as an assistant brand manager at a food company. Though she seems strong she quietly longs for love, a promotion and to discover her true self.
A middle-school boy is tormented by the suggestive teasing of his older twin step-sisters, both of whom love him.
A scrawny 14-year-old, having discovered his inventor stepdad has three bionic, super-powered teens living cloistered in a secret lab beneath their home, brings them out into the world.
Tsubasa Oozora has loved playing football since he was a child. After moving to Nankatsu, the 11-year-old quickly made friends and joined the local football team at his elementary school.

A college student and aspiring drummer gets unexpectedly ousted from her band. But her luck changes when the talented musician Naoki Fujitani discovers her skill and invites her to join his new ensemble.

Neve Kelly discovers she is dead. She's scared and confused by this new existence. But, when she realizes she has been murdered, she's furious. She's determined to find her killer and get justice, believing that it was someone she knew.
An insight into the everyday lives and struggles of the families living in a tightly-knit close in Mount Pleasant.
A womanizer helps his sister, his bar-owner roomie, and his three friends with much-needed dating advice.
Bob Builder and his machine team are ready to tackle any project. Bob and Can-Do Crew demonstrate power of positive thinking, problem-solving, teamwork,.

movies.originalTitle: Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou sareta Beast Tamer, Saikyoushu no Nekomimi Shoujo to Deau
movies.plot: Rein, an animal tamer, is kicked out of the group of heroes because others think her skills are weak. A kind person, he now lives freely as an adventurer. During his journey, he meets superior species, tames them, and his life changes

Kate inherits a haunted mansion and gains the ability to see ghosts. With her partner Sean, she plans to convert it into a boutique hotel, unaware of the spirits' presence and their potential impact on their lives.
A team of six policemen is on a chase to solve a murder in a suburban lodge room, with just one clue - a fake address, from the park register.
A couple goes through a long, drawn-out divorce.

movies.primaryTitle: Tss... He's Not My Husband, He's My Target
movies.originalTitle: Tss... He's Not My Husband, He's My Target
movies.plot: Two opposite agents pose as honeymooners to spy on an arms dealer. When he falls for the female agent, her partner's jealousy surfaces. Past secrets and new orders complicate their growing attraction.
A nostalgic trip down memory lane, delving into the everyday life of a middle-class family.

Nalan, who seems perfect from the outside, is being severely abused by her mother. Sedat, one of the richest men in Turkey, proposes to her. But her husband and family, who seem perfect from the outside, are not normal either.
Perverted teen Takeru joins a co-ed school where students wield Makens to unleash magical abilities in duels. He must find a compatible Maken while navigating school and girl troubles.
The series follows detectives during the hours immediately following a homicide.

Coming-of-age drama about lovable rogues Conor and Jock as they navigate their awkward teenage years, hatching plans and adventures to help distract from their tough home lives and their inability to stay out of trouble at school.
A village girl's world changes when she meets a soldier from Istanbul doing his mandatory service in her rural community. Their connection challenges social barriers and traditional expectations.
A new adaptation of the classic novel "The Darling Buds of May" by H.E. Bates, following the warm-hearted, wheeler-dealing adventures of the iconic Larkin family in the idyllic Kent countryside.
It is the story of two wedding planners in Delhi, where tradition jostles with modern aspirations against the backdrop of big fat Indian weddings revealing many secrets and lies.

movies.primaryTitle: Field Generals: History of the Black Quarterback
movies.originalTitle: Field Generals: History of the Black Quarterback
movies.plot: Features trailblazing Black quarterbacks who had to deal with bigotry and prejudice as they progressed.
Thomas Veil is a documentary photographer who seemingly has to erase his entire existence in the course of an evening.

This story took place in an apartment building numbered 227. The cast would frequently be sitting outside on a large set of stone stairs, involved in some discussion that would unfold into the weekly plot line.
An American undercover FBI agent is assigned to infiltrate a terrorist sleeper cell that is planning an attack in Los Angeles.
The unlikely love story between a crown prince and his eunuch.

Jessica Tate's sharp-tongued former butler, Benson DuBois, moves up in the world, becoming first the governor's "director of household affairs," then the state's budget director, then lieutenant governor and candidate for the executive mansion.
Teresa is a young woman dominated by her greed. Her parents have made great sacrifices to give her a good, decent life, but Teresa wants more, a lot more.
Three things in life can not be hidden "love, smoke and lack of money". The social society and the events behind the business world are told.
A musical prodigy gets into a gifted program called Advanced Natural Talents at the local high school.
A team of cyborgs protects Limbo from Mon Star and his gang.
Frontier hero Daniel Boone conducts surveys and expeditions around Boonesborough, running into both friendly and hostile Indians, before, during, and even after the Revolutionary War.
The lives of a tween rock band led by real-life singer-songwriting/musician brothers Nat and Alex Wolff.

movies.primaryTitle: Once Upon a Time in Wonderland
movies.originalTitle: Once Upon a Time in Wonderland
movies.plot: In Victorian England, the young and beautiful Alice tells a tale of a strange new land that exists on the other side of a rabbit hole.
A behind-the-scenes drama and espionage thriller in Cold War-era England that centers on a journalist, a producer, and an anchorman for an investigative news programme.
The globe-trotting adventures of big wave surfer Garrett McNamara, his family, and fellow surfers.
Victor Godeanu, Ceausescu's right-hand man, has a secret. He is also a KGB agent and must escape before he is discovered, so he will seize a valuable diplomatic opportunity.

Beneath its surface exists a playground for the murky underworld, pollution hazards, the remnants of huge drug hauls, and a graveyard of bodies from years of suicides, accidents and murders. That's the world of the WATER RATS.
An intersection between reality and unconscious thought, follow three strangers who slowly realize that they are dreaming parts of a bigger, more sinister tragedy.

Kai, Lys and Nubs are apprentices sent by Master Yoda to train at the Jedi temple on the planet Tenoo under the tutelage of Master Zia. Together, they embark on adventures aboard the ship piloted by the skilled Nash and her droid RJ-83.

In the newly announced Kiwi line-up of The Traitors, host Paul Henry will preside over a cast of 19 players, as the "faithfuls" attempt to sniff out "traitors", all while competing in challenges and building up prize money.
After his home kingdom is destroyed by the ancient devil priest Mumm-Ra, the young Thundercat Lord Lion-O leads a team of survivors as they fight evil on Third Earth.
The arrival of DC Leila Hussain sets tongues wagging - what brings this big city girl to a sleepy Northern Irish seaside town?
A dedicated worker and the owner's charismatic son vie for CEO at an underwear firm while unexpected romance complicates their rivalry.

Set in the present day with flashbacks to the 1990s, the comedy revolves around outgoing middle-schooler Sydney Reynolds, who lives with her single dad Max and her progressive grandmother Judy--three generations under one roof.

In 1327, an enlightened friar and his young apprentice investigate a series of mysterious deaths at an abbey risking the wrath of a powerful Inquisitor. Television adaptation of Umberto Eco's novel 'The Name of the Rose'.
Manik and Nandini's fairy tale love faces shadows that threaten their promised world of light. Can their bond prevail or will it crumble under darkness?
A team tracks down fugitive criminals.
Feride, a strong, independent woman, resists the norms of society and life with her sharp humor.
A love story that takes place in Kowloon Walled City.
Adventures of the ghostly con-artist and his 12-year-old pal, Lydia.
This second revival of The Twilight Zone (1959) presents tales of suspense, fantasy, science fiction and horror.

Marc Maron has been a comedian for 25 years. He was an angry, drunk, self-involved mess for most of his adult life, but with the popularity of a podcast he hosts in his garage and a life of sobriety, his life and career are turning around.

A young boy, whose life and family has been destroyed by new media, gets adopted by a family in a rural area after being found lost at sea. He conceals his past for 13 years. But then the girl he loves, a reporter, finds out the truth.
The adventures of the young reporter, his faithful dog and friends as they travel around the world on adventures.
In an early-'80s Polish town, a prostitute and a youth leader are found killed, but the police's handling of the case makes two journalists suspicious.

movies.primaryTitle: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic
movies.plot: Three high school students are transported to a fantasy world. But while two are heroes, one can only be a healer.
Follows the 2023-24 Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders squad: their auditions, training camp, and finally the ending of the Cowboys season, which predictably ended in the NFC Wild Card Round.
Follows a girl band since they met in middle school to present day, learning how their pre-famous lives go on to fuel their future musical chart toppers.

When an Indian village is threatened by former Confederate soldiers, the villagers go in search of help. They recruit seven men, each with unique skills, who return to the village and confront the raiders.

Following the fall of Saddam Hussein, former police inspector Muhsin al-Khafaji has lost virtually everything. He searches for one of the few things remaining in his life, his missing estranged elder daughter.

In 1913 Spain, a woman gets a job at the palace of La Promesa as a reward for saving the marquesses' son - but nobody knows that she has her own plans, which involve avenging her mother's death and finding her missing brother.
