HBO Nordic's first original series from Norway, Beforeigners is about two persons who mysteriously appear in Oslo. They are the first of many from the past to seek refuge in present time. Seven years later the community is transformed.
A mockumentary series about a group of failed MCs from West London and their passion for pirate radio.

In the complicated world of celebrities, Rana Naidu is the go-to problem-solver. When his father is released from prison, Rana grapples with family secrets and personal conflict and realizes that the only problem he can't fix is his own.

A Hidden Camera Show similar to Candid Camera but famous celebrities are the victims. Each week Ashton and his crew of pranksters play a joke on celebrities such as Justin Timberlake and Frankie Muniz.
Follows the reunion of four old sixth form friends. They head to Spain to visit the fifth member of the gang, but things take a dark turn.
Drama series following high profile murder cases through the eyes of the police, the public and the courts.
The day to day of two unwilling patrol officers affected by troubled pasts.
The adventures of average suburban boy Johnny Test, who wittingly plays test subject for his genius twin sisters' various experiments, reluctantly fighting evil villains in the process.

When Defne's brother gets into debt and is held captive, Defne is forced to accept an offer in exchange for the money. She has to make Omer, a wealthy shoe designer who owns a company, fall in love with her and marry her.

movies.primaryTitle: The Life and Movies of Ersan Kuneri
movies.plot: Depiction of the life of Ersan Kuneri. An ex-pornographic actor turned filmmaker in 1980s Turkey.
A Shanghai cop who is a master of martial arts fights crime in the Los Angeles Police Department.
An independent film screener leaks from a talent agency.
The staff of Melonville's TV station put on programming that is unique in its own silly way.
Each person is graded through a popular vote against the backdrop of a girl's high school and if they receive an F grade, they become legitimate victims of school violence.
Follows the lives of 6 women residents of Potomac, Maryland, each in various stages of life and affluence, shaping their community and their lives.

The X-Files' Lone Gunmen, their action-loving man-childish sidekick and patron, Jimmy Bond, and their sexy master thief frienemy, Yves, investigate crimes and conspiracies, often in a silly, comedic and over the top fashion.
Antoine Verlaque, Investigating Judge in Aix-en-Provence with his romantic partner Marine Bonnet, investigates the murders, mysteries and dark underbelly of their idyllic home in the south of France.

movies.primaryTitle: Don't Toy with Me, Miss Nagatoro
movies.plot: Nagatoro, a high school girl, takes pleasure in relentlessly teasing her shy upperclassman after discovering his artistic talents and drawings with her friends.
A mercenary's high-stakes rescue mission in Libya becomes a brutal test of survival as he faces hostile forces and personal demons while trying to save hostages amid a war-torn landscape.
Six friends, all with different lifestyles and mentalities facing a series of unbelievable events.
Stanley Tucci travels across Italy to discover the secrets and delights of the country's regional cuisines.
A weekly YouTube video podcast that explores the strange and weird of this world and beyond.
The story of a French president to be and one of his friends, the mayor of a small city in northern France.
Ben and Erin Napier work with each other to change old homes into dream homes.
Centers on ultra-competitive fraternal twins Lindy and Logan Watson who navigate high school together with their best friends.
The continuing animated adventures of Olive Oyl, Wimpy, Swee'pea and Popeye.
A solicitor returns to the seaside town she left as a teenager to take up the post of coroner, becoming an advocate for the dead as she investigates sudden, violent or unexplained deaths.
A look at the formative years of superstar Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson as he grows up through life.
Ryan Hansen tries to put together a Dick Casablancas-centric television spin-off, calling on his pals to help him get the show off the ground.
A relationship forms between a gifted young girl and a man sprung from prison who has been tasked with protecting her from the evil elements that hunt her power.
Ex-Broadway director Charlie is forced by circumstances to return to his home town of Tauranga, New Zealand where his mum makes him join her amateur theatre society.
A resilient girl with a tragic past and a heart of gold falls in love with a bad boy race car driver.
Mark Gatiss, master of the macabre, presents chilling Christmas stories for a cold winter's night.

Bjørn investigates the killing of his daughter. People around him believe she might have committed suicide, but he doesn't accept that. Both the stakes and the suspense rise relentlessly as Bjørn inches closer to the truth.
A Yale-educated reporter becomes a live-in tutor for two spoiled teenage granddaughters of a Palm Beach cosmetics business magnate.
A working-class couple raises their genius kids in South Jersey.
An old-school Brooklyn native devotes his days to caring for his adorable dog, Bruno, and making sure the neighbors show his pooch the proper respect.
The series follows Frankie Drake, a female private detective operating in Toronto in the 1920s.

A former FBI agent becomes the first Black Sheriff in a rural Bible Belt town, where he confronts both personal demons and a religious zealot targeting African American victims across Southern Virginia.
A woman discovers her family's lifestyle has been funded by blood and seeks to protect herself and her loved ones.
An anthology that examines the diverse sexual relationships involving the different genders, races, sexual orientations, and fetishes of high schoolers, college students, and post-college roommates.

movies.primaryTitle: The Banished Court Magician Aims to Become the Strongest
movies.originalTitle: Mikata ga Yowasugite Hojo Maho ni Tesshteita Kyutei Mahoshi
movies.plot: A court magician who was cast aside by his crown prince is invited to rejoin the team that once made history.
George Smiley pursues Soviet spymaster Karla during the Cold War. The story opens at the Berlin Wall where Alec Leamas witnesses East German guards kill his final agent.
In Iran, Tehran, 1953, Shahrzad and Farhad love each other and intend to get married, but the great mafia Bozorg Agha has decided another fate for them.

A beloved food influencer grapples with loss and hosts four friends from different chapters of her life for a weekend in Nantucket, where hidden truths emerge and relationships evolve amid coastal luxury.
As a single mother and the Chief Nursing Officer at Richmond Trinity Hospital in Richmond, Virginia, Christina Hawthorne makes care-taking her life's work.
Nikki and Kim Parker attend Santa Monica college to earn their college degrees.
About the residents of a small town called Deerfield, who one day discover a magical, destiny-predicting machine in their grocery store.
A teenager seeks out the help of a monster who lives in the woods. Based on the short film 'The Birch'.
Bear Grylls travels the world in search of challenges to his survival skills.

Peter Gunn is a private detective with a knack for finding trouble. His cases often mean he runs into the shadiest characters, most vicious thugs and the most powerful crime bosses. Cool and resourceful, he always gets the guilty party.
Upon losing his memory, a crown prince encounters a commoner's life and experiences unforgettable love as the husband to Joseon's oldest bachelorette.
The lives of the students and teachers at High Water Performing Arts School in Atlanta.
Two men unite against a criminal conspiracy, pursuing a dark past of notebooks, cases, and lies. They face the mafia, money, intrigue, and the terrifying Halka.
The fun adventures of two close friends who are dragged into the inextricable monotony of daily life.
In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles butt heads, forge bonds and live together for 14 days as they go all out to find the one.
Don Diego de la Vega opposes the corrupt tyrants of Spanish California as the masked swordsman, Zorro.
A shy office worker finds herself at an assassination agency and realizes she's good at the job. She deals with workplace drama and tries to impress her attractive but difficult colleague Sakurai.

Highlights the unfailing passion Sunderland residents have for their beloved football club, taking viewers through the highs and lows of SAFC's 2017-18 season in the Championship following its relegation the previous year.
A 14-year-old Persian boy desperately tries to fit in, cope with his mother's dating life, and figure out his cultural identity.
Follows Bow's parents, Paul and Alicia, who are forced to move from a hippie commune to the suburbs to better provide for their family after the dissolution of their cult.
Political ploys, personal agendas and a beastly myth all surface as two mismatched hill station cops navigate a web of suspects after a puzzling murder.

A lawyer and his fiancée visit Tykha Nava in 2018. After she suffers a sexual assault, local police dismiss the case. Facing community suspicion and his relationship's end, Adam investigates the crime himself.
The comfortable life of committed bachelor and efficient yakuza Nitta is interrupted when a strange girl with psychic powers comes to live with him.

Ubaldo receives an inheritance that will change his destiny for good. In the heart of the northeast desert, he'll become the leader of a pack of ruthless bandits, fulfilling the legacy of his biological father - a mythical "Cangaceiro".
After discovering his origins, Damien Thorn must cope with life as the Anti-Christ.
The life of a young Black woman, her work, her family and the popular talk show which she hosts.

It has been 2 years since the GCC raid in Anteiku. Although the environment in Tokyo has changed drastically due to the CCG's increased influence, Ghouls are still a problem, especially the Aogiri Tree organization.
Hikaru Tsutsui is a quiet, unassuming high school student who forsakes the company of his classmates to spend his time reading manga, playing video games, and watching anime.
A half-hour sketch comedy written by and starring Robin Thede.
Gordon Ramsay visits struggling restaurants across America and spends one week trying to help them become successful.

movies.primaryTitle: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
movies.originalTitle: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
movies.plot: Follow Po, who partners up with a no-nonsense English knight named Wandering Blade, to find a collection of four powerful weapons before a mysterious pair of weasels do, and save the world from destruction.

A proud young calligrapher is punished for punching a critic by being sent to a faraway island in the east coast of Japan. But as he meets and lives with the island's friendly people, his attitude begins to improve.
A story about a married couple whose betrayal of one another leads to a whirlwind of revenge.
Alys is a bubbly girl who agrees to seduce the mysterious Drake Palma to help her best friend. But as their pretend relationship starts to feel real, Alys is torn between loyalty and unexpected love.
A family takes in a formerly institutionalized teen savant who is missing standard human behaviors such as anger, joy, and love.
An anthology drama series featuring primarily British productions.
A young pitcher becomes the first woman to play in the Major Leagues.

An unpredictable, brilliant romance that awakens frozen time when a man named 'Chan', who lives every day like an exciting summer vacation, and a woman named 'Ran', who has locked herself in winter, meet as if by fate.
Harlee Santos, New York police officer and single mother, is forced to work in the F.B.I.'s anti-corruption task force while dealing with her own financial problems.
Three real-life siblings star in this series about an older brother who returns to the family business a year after his father dies.
A stripper sets out to prove his innocence for a crime he didn't commit and was unjustly incarcerated for seven years earlier.
A group of divorced friends tries to get back to the single life.
The misadventures of a wisecracking talking horse and his human owner.
When twenty inanimate objects desire change in their lives, a robotic speaker box arrives to give them all new incentive; a competition for an island of luxury known as 'Dream Island'.
Comedians are given makeovers to be transformed into someone completely new, and then have a fully-improvised interview with host Vic Michaelis.

A Dutch detective of Afghan descent, Mardik gets the information stating that his childhood friend Faysal is in the Netherlands. When a terrorist attack occurs the next day, Mardik suspects Faysal and starts to investigate on own behalf.
A quirky hustler recruits a gang of of skilled misfits to find the Snake King's treasure in the Maya Riviera.
A middle-class teen runs away from home and decides to work as a call girl. In little time, she becomes Bruna Surfistinha and gains notoriety after writing her routine on a blog.
A mafia don's arrest during his political campaign sparks a power struggle between his son, uncle, and rival gangs, while a determined police officer watches their every move.
"Entertainment Tonight" is the #1 syndicated entertainment newsmagazine in the world.

This spin-off of Disney's Hercules (1997) follows Hercules' many labors during the years he spent training how to be a hero under the tutelage of satyr Philoctetes. Olympian Gods and Goddesses, as well as Hades and Pegasus, often visit him.
While chaos rules over Rome, established alliances are at risk as tensions rise with emerging criminal clans. The world of "Suburra" takes a new turn.
An aspiring writer befriends her boyfriend's sex doll and the two take on the world together.

movies.primaryTitle: The First Night with the Duke
movies.originalTitle: The First Night with the Duke
movies.plot: College student K enters her favorite historical romance novel as noble's daughter Cha Seon Chaek. After one night with royal-blooded Lee Beon, she tries to pair him with the novel's heroine, but fate has other plans.

movies.primaryTitle: Turning Point: The Bomb and the Cold War
movies.originalTitle: Turning Point: The Bomb and the Cold War
movies.plot: The series chronicles the creation of the atomic bomb and the spread of nuclear arms over the following decades. It continues past the dissolution of the Soviet Union to Vladimir Putin's ascent and the Russian invasion of Ukraine.
Dou Zhao, disillusioned with love and family, moves to a remote village to protect her family. She helps Song Mo protect an orphaned descendant, and they form a trusting alliance.

When author Julian's offensive post goes viral, his career seems over until his neuro divergent son Austin suddenly arrives. Embracing Austin may be Julian's path to redemption if he and wife Ingrid can move past his mistakes.
Follow the Kilic brothers as they take different paths in life after moving from the tiny Ayvalik to the vibrant Istanbul.
Lucy, Anias and Marina, three girls from different schools are transported to the world of Zephyr as well as their mission to become Magical Warriors to rescue the captured Princess Esmeralda.
A family moves from Ohio to Los Angeles, where they realize they are unprepared for the city's fast pace and the overcrowded public school that the three teenagers will attend.

Love, brotherhood, and the unbreakable bond of twins. Banele and Sanele are twin brothers, walking two completely different paths, one in the light, the other in the shadows, but their fates are forever linked.

Kinn, the second son of a prominent mafia head, is ambushed by an enemy and meets Porsche, a college student who comes to his rescue, thus beginning their reluctant relationship as boss and bodyguard, which soon turns into something more.

Shocking tales of betrayal, violence, and deceit through testimonials, bodycam footage, and reenactments. Exposes the disturbing realities of monstrous past relationships, tapping into the universal fear of not truly knowing one's partner.
Determined detectives work to prove who was responsible for the death of Alexander Litvinenko, in one of the most complex and dangerous investigations in the history of the Metropolitan Police.
As the A-Troupe dancers prepare for the regional dance competition, relationships and loyalties are put to the test at the Next Step studio.
A naive romantic goes on a desperate quest for love when his longtime girlfriend dumps him.

movies.originalTitle: Ni wei xiao shi hen mei
movies.plot: After joining an all-male e-sports team, an amateur gamer tests her skills and leads her team to the world championships. Based on a novel.
A cardshark and his brother find adventure on the American frontier.
The Morales cousins scramble to save their grandfather's taco shop--and pursue their own dreams--as gentrification shakes up their LA neighborhood.

Lee Mack presents the game show where the questions aren't about general knowledge but logic, brainpower and common sense. 100 contestants begin each edition, who'll face the final question - which only 1% of the population can get right.
A group of humans wage war against the rising evil of unidentified parasitic life-forms that live off of human hosts and strive to grow their power

Zhou Zi Shu gets embroiled in a conspiracy in the martial arts world. He meets Wen Ke Xing who leaves the Ghost Valley to avenge his parents' deaths. They become fast friends and embark on an adventure to find a legendary treasure.

After a respected officer's death in early 2000s Bengal, IPS Arjun Maitra confronts powerful gangsters and corrupt politicians in his mission to bring law and order to a region gripped by crime and chaos.
A journalist seeks a fresh start in Alaska working for a newspaper in Anchorage.
As events unfold in her life, Clarissa explains to the viewer the motivations behind people's actions.
The school lives of Yano the unlucky schoolboy.
Follows detective Matthew Venn as he returns to an evangelical community in which he grew up to attend his father's funeral.
Veteran district attorney "Fatman" McCabe solves cases with the help of his easygoing private investigator partner Jake Styles.
The Goodman family lives with their lovable pet dog, Mr. Pickles, a deviant border collie with a secret satanic streak.
Saïd leads a team of young elite cops and will have to find his place within his group while preventing a gang war from breaking out between Eric's family and that of the El Hassani brothers.
After being falsely convicted for the murder of his entire class, a young man must learn to survive in a mysterious prison with a perverted take on incarceration while also looking to clear his name.
Five teenagers become the last line of defense for the galaxy in an intergalactic battle against the evil alien force led by King Zarkon.
Comedy following incompetent Greek-Cypriot lettings-agent Stath, who works for the family business, Michael and Eagle.
A police detective in 2016 discovers that she is able to communicate with her father via a ham radio, despite the fact that he died in 1996.
Devran, a prodigious young mathematician, navigates the challenges and triumphs of nurturing his exceptional talent from childhood.
A fairy whose tribe was in war with Moon Demon Lord, Qingcang meets him and mutual incantation and mutual curse ties their lives.
Barbie has various misadventures with her friends and sisters in a doll-sized version of Malibu.
Spin-off of "The Loud House (2015)" featuring Ronnie Anne Santiago, who moves to the big city with her mother and older brother Bobby and meets her extended Hispanic family.
Two best friends go to a magic sleep-away camp where nothing is what it seems.

A semi-retired couple who work for a clandestine monster hunting agency discover dark family secrets and the truth about their employer after their magically inclined nigh adult kids reawaken a witch bent on revenge.
A serial killer takes advantage on the media interest over his murders, manipulating their victims, police and the media, turning the murders into a spectacle mediatic.
Yates Forsythe returns to his hometown in Mississippi with his psychiatrist wife Frances and their two children, only to uncover secrets that change the lives of everyone involved.
Follow officers from a South Carolina sheriff's department as they urgently search for individuals who've disappeared under troubling circumstances.
A therapist tries to save her marriage after a cycling accident causes them to reassess their relationship.

Prominent LA defense attorney Theodore Hoffman takes on the case of troubled actor Neil Avedon, charged with murder after a previous high-profile acquittal. The trial unfolds over a season, interspersed with the firm's other cases.
The surreal life of Salad Fingers, an unknown creature living in an apocalyptic wasteland.

After 17 years in captivity, Israeli soldiers Nimrode Klein, Uri Zach and Amiel Ben Horin return to the country that made them national icons. They work to overcome the trauma of torture and captivity.

Muhtesem Ikili is an adaption of the famous American movie, Tango and Cash. A story of two police officer Mert Barca and Mustafa Kerim Can / MKC. Barca and MKC, are forced to come together for a drug operation.
A miscellany of numerous classic fairy tales' adaptations.

movies.originalTitle: Wo zai xiang gang yu jian ta
movies.plot: A young man goes to Hong Kong to study psychiatry for a pressing reason. His family has a genetic disease that caused his mother and brother to be diagnosed with schizophrenia at age 24 and he is desperate to escape the same fate.

movies.primaryTitle: The Real Housewives of New York City
movies.originalTitle: The Real Housewives of New York City
movies.plot: A fast-paced reality show that follows several incredibly busy and ambitious Manhattan women. Watch as they balance enviable social calendars, challenging careers, and motherhood, with the hustle and bustle of the big city all around.

movies.primaryTitle: The Saint's Magic Power Is Omnipotent
movies.originalTitle: Seijo no Maryoku wa Bannou Desu
movies.plot: Sei is living her dream life in a magical kingdom. She's popular for making potions, but will this obsession hurt her chances with Albert?
An eccentric genius profiler works with a detective with photographic memory and a police chief to go after a serial killer who was thought to be dead.
A clueless yet clever loner bungles his way through life in London.
An anthology series centered on a mysterious agency called Plan B that allows people to travel back in time to change their lives.

High-profile anchor Yan Xu and urban elite Haoming Shen's marriage struggles due to social differences. After a fallout, he realizes his love and pursues Yan Xu. They shed pretenses, reconnect, and discover their true selves together.
The adventures of Hercules as a boy, during his time at a training academy for warriors.

Disadvantaged students earn scholarships to matriculate at a privileged kids' high school to investigate an accident that left their best friend paralyzed. They confront prejudice and intrigue, unsure of who is friend, foe, or culprit.

movies.originalTitle: Sa rang eul Cheo bang hae Deu rim ni da
movies.plot: Two families with conflicts in the past, work through reconciliation, healing together.
A mother, her daughter, and their respective "hunks of spunk" negotiate life in suburban Australia.
A mother finds herself trapped in a terrifying kidnapping chain.

Renegade Immortal follows the captivating story of Wang Lin, a young man born with a crippled soul. Undeterred by his limitations, Wang Lin embarks on a determined path to cultivate immortality and achieve unimaginable power.
A bumbling superhero battles crime with the help of his daughter and pilot sidekick.

A delightful story ensues when the five illegitimate daughters of Don Calixto Salgero - all from different mothers and all named Juana - arrive in the town of Corosal to be near their father and their brother, the gorgeous but shy Ruben Salgero. Juana Valentina is the oldest, impulsive, passionate and the prettiest of them all. Juana Caridad, the "nun," is sweet, quiet and very religious. Juana Bautista has a gypsy bent and is very spiritual and wise. Juana Manny is a born fighter, athletic and aggressive. Juana Matilde, the youngest, is charming, scatterbrained and loves to sing. Dona Salgero, the mortified wife of Calixto, does not know what to do to get these "bastards" out of Corosal. But with the help of her nephew, the buffoonish Manuel F., she schemes to make their lives impossible. And things only get worse when she begins to suspect that her son, Ruben, has fallen in love with one of his sisters.
After losing his dream job, a burned-out artist falls between two men, a charming IT guy, and a reclusive tycoon who hires him to be his public face.
A human wields a magic book that can cure vampires of their bloodlust, and sets out to find vampires to cure with the book.
Follows the story of a simple maid that rises high in the royal harem as a consort and, ultimately, mother of the Korean king.
A young girl embarks on a series of misadventures, causing her friends and teachers to be worrisome.

Rebellion is a five part serial drama about the birth of modern Ireland. The story is told from the perspectives of a group of fictional characters who live through the political events of the 1916 Easter Rising.
Ken Boon and Harry Crawford are two middle-aged ex-firemen. Harry retires and opens a hotel (The Grand Hotel), with Ken as a temporary odd-job man.

It follows Erik as he gets expelled from his school in due to his violent behavior, and is transferred to a boarding school. He engages in a forbidden love relationship with a kitchen staff member, Marja.

In his profession, experienced captain Seyfi and rookie policeman Nuri Pamir face a child murder in the city. This murder leads them to the city's populated business man Abbas and his daughter Dilara.
Teen genius Hiro Hamada, Baymax the robot, and their friends defend the city of San Fransokyo as superheroes.

Maksim "Max" Lavrov wants to become a great chef. But he finds out that the kitchen isn't the place for an easy career. And in restaurant "Claude Monet" this job looks even harder and much more complicated than just cooking.
The story of Catherine the Great from the time she came to Russia as the bride of the heir to the Russian throne.

movies.primaryTitle: The Sleuth of the Ming Dynasty
movies.plot: In 15th-century China, a quick-witted government official named Tang Fan takes a break from his routine activities in order to investigate a murder, teaming up with martial arts specialist guardsman Sui Zhou in a bid to solve the case.
After losing their mother to a demon, two brothers grow up fighting supernatural beings.
Homicide detectives investigate crimes of passion among the affluent and glamorous in Palm Beach, Florida.
The classic long-running prime time TV investigative news magazine.
Letters bridge 35 years through a mysterious blackboard, connecting lovers across time. Weather patterns unlock communication between eras as a small-town youth unravels his love's disappearance.

The journey of a girl who disguises herself as her brother to attend a military school, set in the backdrop of 1910s China and the geopolitical turmoil the country experiences. The protagonist finds friendship, love and courage.
Two young single ad men must disguise themselves as women to live in the one apartment they can afford.

movies.primaryTitle: The Second Best Hospital in the Galaxy
movies.originalTitle: The Second Best Hospital in the Galaxy
movies.plot: Sleech and Klak, two brilliant female alien doctors who specialize in rare sci-fi illnesses.

When a police officer with a tablet addiction sees a dead boy, she questions her sanity, but she realizes that she is facing victims of unsolved crimes and that her past can help to catch a killer on the loose.
Stories about people who use the Virgin Mary's help when they get into difficulties; where a rose appears, their problems are solved.
In feudal Japan, a shinobi warrior embarks on a quest through the restless land to rescue his kidnapped lord.
The weekly adventures of tough-as-nails veteran police officer Sgt. T.J. Hooker, who rides the beat with his rookie partner Vince Romano.
Follows the adventures of best friends Kiff and Barry, an optimistic squirrel and a mellow bunny.

Yoon Gyeo Rye lived at an orphanage and spent time in prison. He struggles to have a normal life. He volunteers at a hospice. There, he works with volunteer team leader Kang Tae Sik and nurse Seo Yeon Joo.
A story where ten people get the chance to go back in time by one year, but unexpectedly mysterious situations start to arise when their fates are changed and twisted in the process.
A young singer dies and becomes a zombie. She is put in a musical group with other zombie singer girls as part of a campaign to save the world.
A series of violent videos from an unknown user named 'monkeyman' target a group of high school students whose pasts are connected.
The Baresi family experiences tragic loss from an Italian mafia's use of witchcraft. Michael Baresi attempts to break the generational curse inflicted on his family.
A drama series centred on the lives of the nurses at All Saints Western General Hospital.

movies.primaryTitle: The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
movies.originalTitle: The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
movies.plot: Framed for a corporate crime, an adult Ted Templeton turns back into the Boss Baby to live undercover with his brother, Tim, posing as one of his kids.
A forbidden affair at a wedding spirals into murder and distrust. Katie and Stefan, once lovers, are pitted against each other in uncovering the truth behind a deadly wedding tragedy.
A seemingly-confident comedy writer, wife and mom comically exposes her inner immaturity and neuroses through unexpected life situations.
The entire saga of Markiplier playing Five Night at Freddy's games, including fan games, fan animations, revisits and more.
The series brings together different guests with encounters that are considered "impossible" in daily life.

Suffocating in her marriage, Nicola's life changes when her husband's twin Lee returns, reigniting a past romance. A fateful accident leads to a week of secrecy and passion as they struggle with their feelings.

Milena, a young girl who experienced deep suffering and seeks help and consolation from God. She can't even ask for happiness. God agrees to help her by giving her the name Varvara so nobody could ever recognize or hurt her again.

movies.primaryTitle: Kubo Won't Let Me Be Invisible
movies.plot: A forgettable high school student yearns to make the most of his youth. His classmate, a playful girl, is the only one who notices him, and her teasing antics might just transform his dull daily life.
The adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO years before serving the Rebel Alliance. The series features several story arcs and one hour-long special.

In nineteenth century Spanish California, heroic masked swordsman Zorro, who's actually a local nobleman, must protect his friends and small town (or pueblo) of Los Angeles from its corrupt magistrate (or alcalde) and other menaces.
The crew of a research vessel are on a quest to find a missing TV explorer in the Amazon.
Cuckoo is every parent's worst nightmare - a slacker full of outlandish, New Age ideas.
Raw, brooding drama in which police detective Tom Noack returns home to Norskov, an industrial port in northern Denmark, after 20 years away to clean up the town's all-consuming drug problem.
An examination of despair and hope in individuals aware of an asteroid hurtling towards Earth, signifying the end of the world.

An iconic fashion house is thrown into scandal leaving the family's legendary fashion couture house hanging by a thread. Perle Foster and Paloma Castel team up to reinvent LEDU and claim their place in the Ledu clan and the fashion world.

A small village gets raided by bandits every harvest season. The villagers can't take it anymore, and decide to recruit samurais to defend them in exchange for rice. Will the villagers find who would defend them from the bandits?
The first manned mission from Earth to Mars in 2033 attempts to colonize the red planet.

A renowned detective who solves every case faces his toughest challenge when untraceable murders rock Hua'ao City. The killer vanishes without a trace, turning the city's shadows into potential threats.
Police procedural following Deputy Inspector Regina Haywood and her diverse team in East New York's 74th Precinct.
The lives and trials of the staff of a major hospital in Chicago.

movies.primaryTitle: The Greatest Event in Television History
movies.originalTitle: The Greatest Event in Television History
movies.plot: Adam Scott is determined to make the greatest event in television history by remaking the opening sequences of TV shows.
A Chinese-American teen living in a small Texas town finds out a demon king is hunting her for the supernatural powers she's been working her whole life to repress.
Raised in a wealthy but unloving Pasazade household, Seniha faces her past while striving for self-determination. Jealousy weaves through all relationships.
A story in which ominous things continue and the secrets of the family are revealed as they suddenly inherit the family mountain from their uncle, whom they had forgotten.
Sonic in a high-octane adventure where the fate of a strange new multiverse rests in his gloved hands.
A cyclical competition in which women from all over the U.S. compete for the honor of being America's next "it girl" in the modeling world.
Nadeshiko, a high school student who has moved from Shizuoka to Yamanashi, decides to see the famous Mount Fuji.
A single, 20-something mom struggles to find a happy work/life balance.

Chef's Table goes inside the lives and kitchens of six of the world's most renowned international chefs. Each episode focuses on a single chef and their unique look at their lives, talents and passion from their piece of culinary heaven.

Ippo the Japanese Featherweight champion will defend his title against amazing challengers. Takamura fights for the second WBC title in the middleweight class, and Aoki fights for the Lightweight title.
A rising attorney finds his perfectly crafted life threatened when his long-lost childhood friends threaten to expose a dark secret from their past from Kuyudibi district in Istanbul.
Comedy centered around a couple and their insufferable neighbors.

movies.primaryTitle: Our Dating Story: The Experienced You and the Inexperienced Me
movies.originalTitle: Keikenzumi na Kimi to, Keiken Zero na Ore ga, Otsukiai suru Hanashi.
movies.plot: Ryûto Kashima is a gloomy high school student. As part of a punishment game, he is forced to confess to Runa Shirakawa, a girl from the top of the school caste who's admired by everyone.
Set during the golden age of piracy in the 1700s and centering on legendary pirate Blackbeard.
Commander Shepard, a human soldier, battles the Reapers, a hostile alien race threatening humanity's existence in the 22nd century.

Sassy sitcom centering on radio and television personality Martin Payne, focusing on his relationship with his girlfriend Gina, interactions with Gina's best friend Pam, and escapades with his best friends Tommy and Cole.
Bee, an unemployed woman, is living a normal life until a grumpy companion named PuppyCat arrives. Follow Bee and and PuppyCat as they travel between reality and "Fishbowl Space."
Five underprivileged students from inner-city London win scholarships to an elite boarding school and find themselves in an unfamiliar world.
A Haredi family living in an ultra-Orthodox neighborhood of Jerusalem reckons with love, loss and the doldrums of daily life.
"Dangerous" Davies always gets the cases no one else wants, and no one notices when he eventually succeeds. But his old-fashioned decency and dogged determination have won him legions of loyal fans.

Former detective Alex Donovan leads a team of volunteers known as The Forgotten Network, a dedicated group of amateur sleuths that takes on murder cases after the police have reached a dead end and even unable to identify the deceased.
Geum Jan Di gets a scholarship to the elite Shin Hwa High School. She is picked on by Gu Jun Pyo, one of the richest and most popular students, but soon Jun Pyo finds himself attracted to her.
Blue is a puppy who puts her paw prints on three clues. Steve or Joe has to deduce the clues (with the help of off-screen children) to figure out what Blue wants to do.
The story of Jake Cahill.
A show about the fictional everyday adventures of real-life comedian Bastian Pastewka. He experiences funny, strange, and embarrassing moments that he often causes by his lies.

An epic crime saga of power, money, violence and corruption. the mafia controls everything through local and international networks like an octopus, anyone who tries to bring them down pays the ultimate price.

Kim Min Gyu has wealth and success, but lives an isolated life due to his allergy of people. He then meets and falls in love with a girl who is pretending to be a robot for her ex-boyfriend, a genius robots professor.

Louise and Tom who meet in a pub immediately before their weekly marital therapy session. Each episode pieces together how their lives were, what drew them together, and what has started to pull them apart.
Levar Burton introduces young viewers to illustrated readings of children's literature and explores their related subjects.

The same folks gather at the sales of storage units that have been abandoned by their renters. Having no clue what's inside, there are just enough instances where the buyers hit pay dirt to keep them, as well as the TV audience, addicted.
Entering the mythical world of the Monkey King, where a young monk and his group of disciples are on a journey to collect scrolls of Buddhist wisdom.
Follows the investigation into the mysterious disappearance of fictional metropolis Ultra City's most famous magnate by two intrepid detectives.
Ramin plans a robbery on his childhood classmate Noori who has become a mysterious rich man and that's just a beginning of a brutal journey.
The missions of agent April Dancer of the United Network Command for Law and Enforcement.
On his birthday, Thom Payne receives the gift of insignificance and also a new boss. He suspects his erectile dysfunction pills are interfering with his antidepressants, leaving him hapless.
Bounty hunter Josh Randall prowls the Old West.
Third-rate superhero Harvey Birdman gets a new lease on life when he becomes a lawyer.
One player starts with $1 million, while 11 others engage in a countrywide pursuit to track and capture them, hoping to claim the cash prize for themselves.
After disaster strikes Earth, a marine biologist on a submarine research mission must fight to survive with the crew as a conspiracy comes to light.
Set during the 2008 Mumbai attacks, it follows the staff of Bombay General Hospital and their travails during the fateful night of November 26, 2008.
A loose musical adaptation of Homer's The Odyssey.
The adventures of a movie director who gets involved in a murder case.
A tournament takes place to determine the best fighter among all high school students in Korea.
A high-tech intelligence operative, enhanced with a super-computer microchip in his brain, aids an elite government cyber-security agency in special missions.
A young vampire trying to fit in as a normal boy in a normal society.
A reclusive ex-cop reenters the game as an insurance investigator, searching for clues in crime scenes perfectly staged by a serial killer in her midst.
Follows the love story of two women who have a sixteen year age gap. Family and societal norms keep their romance from flourishing.
A prickly judge who despises juvenile criminals arrives at a juvenile court, where she takes on a complex role examining punishment for young offenders.
The misadventures of the staff of a retail floor of a major department store.
A veterinarian with psychic powers, and a hot-blooded detective who fall in love with each other while solving minor crime cases in a small town in Mujin, Chungcheong-do.

Hunter is an action thriller web series that follows Suniel Shetty as ACP Vikram in his journey to the dark alleys of Mumbai's crime world. A mission to find a missing woman leads him juggling between his past and future.
Chip and Dale are chipmunks that start a detective agency, Rescue Rangers, with their friends. The gang deals with crimes that are 'too small' for the police to manage.
When a software developer creates a dating app that a serial killer uses to find his next targets, she's drawn into a dark world of romance and murder.
The two brothers have a plumbing company and are trying to invent something that would make the world a better place.
A gifted writer who's the youngest editor-in-chief ever at his publishing company gets enmeshed in the life of a former copywriter desperate for a job.

The story follows Joseph's journey from being sold by his brothers to Egypt, his trials in Potiphar's house, imprisonment, rise to power interpreting dreams, reunion with his family after proving his brothers' remorse.

Three old men from Yorkshire who have never grown up face the trials of their fellow town citizens and everyday life and stay young by reminiscing about the days of their youth and attempting feats not common to the elderly.

An office melodrama that depicts work life and love life of the people working in Korea Meteorological Administration which is hotter than tropical nights and more indispensable than local heavy rains.
A group of small-town young men run a lucrative phishing operation, until a corrupt politician wants in on their scheme -- and a cop wants to fight it.
After 20 years, Ana María returns to Mexico and vies for control of her family's tequila empire as it threatens to crumble under corruption and secrets.
An in-depth look at the history and pop cultural significance of horror films.

movies.originalTitle: Watashi no Otto to Kekkon Shite
movies.plot: After dying from betrayal, a selfless woman travels back ten years to seek revenge. Her plans derail when she meets a mysterious executive who makes her question her vengeful path.
Rocky, a plucky flying squirrel and Bullwinkle, a bumbling but lovable moose, have a series of ongoing adventures.
Shocking twists revealed. The true stories behind gripping crimes that transcended headlines are uncovered in this true crime investigation series.
800-year-old vampire Nick Knight quests for redemption as a cop in Toronto, trying to hide his vampiric nature from the rest of the world.

movies.primaryTitle: Ladies of London: The New Reign
movies.originalTitle: Ladies of London: The New Reign
movies.plot: Follows a new wave of British blue bloods, ambitious American expats, and glamorous international socialites who light up London's elite social scene.
Garrow's Law is the true tale of William Garrow, who acted as counsel for the accused, introducing the concept of 'innocent until proved guilty' at London's Old Bailey.
A girl arrives at an old mystical house to live there. Inside the house she quickly discovers that the habitants, 6 brothers, that are vampires and that she is meant to be their bridal slave.

Tetsuo discovers that Matori, his daughter's boyfriend, has been physically abusive towards her. Tetsuo uncovers that Matori belongs to a criminal gang and that he plans to extort money from Reika's wealthy grandparents.

Set in an Irish neighborhood in Providence, Rhode Island, the series revolves around two brothers on opposite sides of the law: one a gangster (Jason Isaacs) and the other a state politician (Jason Clarke).
Vallery Irons heads a Beverly Hills bodyguard agency.
An Impotent Husband, a Turned-on Wife and a Perverted Sasurji, when Desires arise, will the sanctity of relations prevail, or will they give in to their lust remains to be seen.
Two siblings become roommates, one a 28-year-old media employee, as they navigate an increasingly bizarre world teetering on the brink of disaster.
A wealthy businessman becomes the mayor of Los Angeles.
Cory Baxter moves to the White House in Washington, DC when his father Victor, is named the new personal White House chef of the President.

Colleagues Alex and Helen unexpectedly become intimate after recent losses. Though they attempt to keep things platonic, they can't resist their desires and growing affection as friends meddle in their complicated relationship.

BTS: Bon Voyage is a reality show about members of South Korean boy band BTS (Bangtan Sonyeondan) travelling. It shows them in everyday situations that every traveller encounters and offers an unique insight in members' lives.
Sousuke Sagara, a member of a covert anti-terrorist private military organization known as Mithril, tasked with protecting Kaname Chidori, a spirited Japanese high school girl.
Everything about the town of Beacon Heights seems perfect, but in the aftermath of the town's first murder, behind every Perfectionist hides secrets, lies and much needed alibies.
A group of teenagers live together as patients at a hospital's pediatric ward and learn how to deal with their illnesses, the experiences that they have, and the people that they meet.

"The Hunger" was a horror anthology series where the hosts Terence Stamp (in season 1) and David Bowie (in season 2) eccentrically introduce each of the steamy, erotic and often supernatural tales of power, sex, lust, and driving urges.
The humorous adventures of a family of pop musicians.
When a cautious teacher agrees to tutor a nightlife host who struggles to read and write, their growing connection sparks criticism and controversy.

Asagi Soramame grew up in a remote countryside of Kyushu, Japan. She is an energetic and bright person. She had a fateful and shocking encounter with a man named Umino Oto, but they assumed they would never meet again.
Mystery and suspense series based on Robert Parker's "Spenser" novels. Spenser, a private investigator living in Boston, gets involved in a new murder mystery each episode.
Baki, a corpse washer in his thirties, lives a life of isolation and loneliness. But when confronted with his own mortality, a haunting question arises: Who will wash his body when he dies?

As trust and loyalty are broken heartbreak happens. Things take a new turn and passion for power begins. The couples get broken away. Can things turn back normal?

Traces the experiences of various residents of a fictional small village just inside the occupation zone during WWII. Deals with issues including collaboration, the Resistance, the fate of French Jews, and war profiteering.

Trapped in a fictional realm, Xiaoyu finds herself forced into the narrative as a persecuted heroine, subject to the cruelty of the male protagonist Nanheng. She resists but is bound by the storyline's predetermined path.
A man and a woman participate in a 24-hour human freezing experiment. Due to a mysterious plan, the couple awakens 20 years later.
Four high school students: Haruka, Makoto, Nagisa and Rin, all took part in a swimming tournament shortly before the end of high school and then lost touch with each other. Years later, they reunite.
A prosecutor has lost his memory and discovers that he is convicted on death row. He is now left with no option but to find the truth behind his condition and prove his innocence.

A poor child is forced to live in the streets and fend for herself against the cold weather, dangerous monsters and hunger. When everything seems lost, she is saved by a taoist grandmaster and taken to his sect of immortals for training.
After being uprooted from New York to New Orleans, the Hathaways are ready to resume their normal lives in their new home. They just don't know that a family of ghosts have the same idea.
A parody of educational programs. Just don't believe anything in the show is true.

A quiet, seemingly-quaint small town is ruled over by its charming yet evil sheriff who uses his demonic powers to remove anyone who dares to stand in his way. The only one he fears is a young boy he fathered through rape.
Ye Xiu (Yang Yang) is a well known top tier player in an online game Glory. After forcefully expelled out of his professional team, he was employed in an Internet Cafe as an odd-job worker.

movies.originalTitle: Shao nian bai ma zui chun feng
movies.plot: Baili Dong Jun, the youngest son of the Hou Mansion in Zhenxi, was very stubborn even as a child.
A turtle, guinea pig, and duckling save the day by using teamwork.

A powerful demon, tired of existence, embarks on a journey of rejuvenation instead of death. Chance encounters bring together a group of youths tracing a bloody path through the world.
The life of the Shiunji family gets romantically complicated when the children, two brothers and five sisters, learn they are not blood siblings.

Arm, a new engineering student, manages an online fan page featuring campus heartthrobs. His feud with Ark, a senior in the elite 'Divine Peers' group, escalates when Arm posts Ark's photos without consent. Ark has feelings for him.
Four famous musicians search for the best voices in America and will mentor these singers to become artists. America will decide which singer will be worthy of the grand prize.
Serhat's world shatters when he learns his wife Berrak's long-hidden secret. Crossing paths with the bold Zeynep, he is drawn into a storm that will change everything.

When investigative journalist Edie Hansen's estranged brother is murdered in his home, she's drawn into the dark underbelly of Cape Town. With her brother's children as prime suspects, she clashes with veteran detective Forty Bell.
After meeting an untimely demise in separate incidents, Cha Min and Go Se-yeon discover they've come back to life in new bodies they don't recognize.
The adventures of a young Clark Kent, as Superman, during his time with a team of teenage superheroes in the far future.

In a gritty urban jungle, four women - Srima, Rani, Rinku, and Minoti - are drawn into chaos after Minoti's husband's freak accident. A cover-up spirals into deceit, murder, and revenge as ex-con Rana and the police hunt them.
Three women who were born into the deadliest and wealthiest of the Italian mafia clans work with a courageous female prosecutor to bring it down from the inside.
When Geraldine Bretherick and her five-year-old daughter Lucy are found dead in the bathroom of their luxury home, the case divides new DS Charlie Zailer and her DC Simon Waterhouse.
Combining science and entertainment, the series explores various aspects of human sexuality through insightful yet light-hearted analysis, each episode focusing on a new theme.
After she performs with her band for them, a humble young woman becomes part of the lives of five wealthy siblings, and falls for the eldest.

Sub-inspector Anjali Bhaati investigates a series of deaths where women are found in public bathrooms. The deaths first appear as suicides but as the investigation progresses, Bhaati realizes that there's a serial killer on the loose.
Love -- and lies -- spiral when a DNA researcher helps discover a way to find the perfect partner, and creates a bold new matchmaking service.
Bholi visits her uncle Rajesh for Chandni's baby shower, falls into his trap, suffers, but will karma punish him?

A merger and acquisitions specialist, Yoon Joo-No, is a legendary negotiator. His team of experts including Lawyer Oh Soon-Young and Choi Jin-Soo specialize in large corporation deals between companies.
Centers on a sexy, foul-mouthed divorcée who becomes a teacher to find her next husband.
An undercover assignment to expose a drug ring becomes a timid Mumbai constable's road to empowerment as she realizes her dormant sexuality's potential.
A wealthy and intelligent woman is captivated by her childhood friend, an innocent girl who had given her lice as a child, finding herself surrendering to her charm despite her usual poised demeanor.

movies.originalTitle: Danjo no Yûjô wa Seiritsu Suru? (Iya, Shinai!!)
movies.plot: Bound by friendship, a girl falls for her best friend who reunites with his first crush. Can she convey her newfound feelings?

Imagine being in jail. Now imagine living in a foreign country. Scary? Paul Connelly takes you inside these jails. He shows what living conditions are for the inmates, as well as the guards. You'll never look at prison the same.
While investigating a serial murder case, Han Tae Joo gets into an incident. When he wakes up, he finds himself back in 1987. To get back to his present world, he must solve the murder case.
The plot revolves around the life of two happy couple. Small issues bring them under stress. Their relationship gets affected due to the challenges. Can they find a solution to solve the issue?

Founder of Jun Heng Law Firm, Qian Heng, and rookie lawyer, Cheng Yao, go from boss/employee to landlord/tenant in a shared house. They began to rub off on each other in terms of work, life, habits and principles and began to fall in love.
A cursed girl and a mysterious man join forces to hunt down an evil witch.

When psychologists advise them not to make any big decisions, three friends do exactly that; taking on the mid-life challenge they never saw coming, and upending their lives in an effort to find happiness while there is still time.
Showcases stories that have been passed down over time and have become part of urban folklore.
The classic Disney character Goofy is a single father raising his son, Max, in Spoonerville. Pete, a frequent antagonist from the old cartoons, lives next door with his family.

Yaman,who lives in one of the Istanbul's suburbs,is arrested and put in jail along with his brother Kenan for his brother stole a car at a gas station.Yaman gets a chance for a brand new start when he meets a lawyer Selim who takes Yaman to his new home.
An impulsive and free-spirited aspiring illustrator whose questions over her daughter's future start keeping her up at night, and the socially anxious yet gifted journalist Danny.
Follows a writer and his wife who announce their divorce with a party, which ends up exposing other absurd relationships in their world.

Physics teacher Akif Erdem, the protagonist of the story, wants to give a lesson in humanity to his students. Only Akif Teacher uses a different teaching method than the teachers we know and are used to.
A psychic, a Catholic priest, and a detective team up to fight crimes caused by supernatural forces.
Sehar, a bold young woman, stands up to powerful businessman Kamran's controlling ways at work. Her unwavering integrity and refusal to submit spark his anger, leading to her fight for dignity.
The adventures of proud Polish-American freelance insurance investigator Thomas Banacek.

A husband begins to track his wife's extramarital affair with a male escort.

An unknowing Sudou Kaname is invited to try out a new mysterious mobile app game called Darwin's Game, but later realizes that he's in for more than he's bargained for when he finds out that there's no way to quit the game.
Perplexing phenomena are meticulously explored in this investigative docuseries, which uncovers the truth behind eerie encounters, bizarre disappearances, and haunting events.

movies.originalTitle: Ban shi mi tang ban shi shang
movies.plot: Jiang Jun is reunited with Ma Yuanshuai, his childhood friend, at his workplace, not as an ally but as a rival.

movies.primaryTitle: One Night in Idaho: The College Murders
movies.originalTitle: One Night in Idaho: The College Murders
movies.plot: Follow the 2022 University of Idaho murders, the investigation, and the upcoming trial of Bryan Kohberger. It will feature interviews with victims' families and provide an intimate portrayal of the victims' lives.
Two girls, from different backgrounds but sharing a love for music, meet and change history with their united musical talent.

Covert operative Tom Keen joins forces with Susan "Scottie" Hargrave, the brilliant and cunning chief of a covert mercenary organization that solves problems that are too dangerous for the government.

After bombing attack, which killed his friends from the Border Guard, Captain Wiktor Rebrow trying to unravel the mystery and figure out what happened and who is behind it all.

Stella Blómkvist is a young, cute, libertine, tough, confident, intelligent, Icelandic lawyer with a flexible moral compass. A friend at the police calls her when there's a criminal in need of a lawyer.

Located in the middle of the 19th century, during the colonial era of Dutch India, the series "Grisse" follows a group of unusual characters who launch a rebellion against a brutal governor and finally have a chance to decide their fate.
A groups of women in modern America going through life and the intense challenges that are part of every relationship. Despite being from different backgrounds

Arslan must embark on a journey to reclaim his fallen kingdom and fulfill his destiny as ruler of Pars.

A 9-year-old Abby and her friend Joshua meet Jesus in Capernaum, circa 30 CE. Abby is full of questions, seeking answers. Their encounter with Jesus could change everything.
A dedicated Naval Officer's life takes an unexpected turn when her connection to the Secretary of Defense leads her into a web of political intrigue and potential conspiracy.
Tachibana Mei has had no boyfriend and couldn't even make friends. One day she injures Kurosawa Yamato, the most popular boy in school, and for some reason Yamato takes interest in her.

A mother of two ends up falling in love with a man half her age and tries to make him part of the family.
Reality series following former prosecutor Kelly Siegler and crime scene investigator Yolanda McClary as they crack cold cases across the U.S.
A Hollywood production rolls into a small Irish town and throws the spotlight on a secret that's been kept hidden since the eve of the Millennium.

movies.primaryTitle: Who Do You Think You Are?
movies.originalTitle: Who Do You Think You Are?
movies.plot: Celebrities study their lineages and family trees, usually learning surprising secrets they never knew about their families.
The series will focus on the conflict between the two families and a great love that will flourish between this struggle.

movies.primaryTitle: 1971: The Year That Music Changed Everything
movies.originalTitle: 1971: The Year That Music Changed Everything

Duggee looks after the Squirrels, who earn different badges on their adventures.
The show will explore the facts behind the world's most fascinating, strange and inexplicable mysteries.

Former President Richard Graves has the epiphany, twenty years after leaving office, that his policies have damaged the country for decades. This, as his wife, the former First Lady, has political ambitions of her own.
Follows the lives of two volunteer nurses on opposing sides of the Civil War - New England abolitionist Mary Phinney and Confederate supporter Emma Green.

Tschugger, a dialect word for "policeman" in the Swiss canton of Wallis, tells the story of a local police precinct in the canton of Wallis. But instead of investigating missing sheep, an attempted murder keeps them on their toes.
A series of brand new, hand-crafted, half hours of theatrical catastrophe as The Cornley Polytechnic Drama Society undertake more (overly) ambitious endeavours.

movies.primaryTitle: A Star Brighter Than the Sun

Four best friends living in Harlem strive for world domination.
Aladdin, Alibaba, and Morgiana go their separate ways after spending time together in Sindria to develop their own strengths, make new friends and prepare for what is coming.
The various Hanna Barbera characters compete in their own version of the Olympic Games.

A scheming coyote, constantly at odds with a swift and clever roadrunner bird, uses various gadgets and devices to try and catch his longtime rival.
Follows Bachelor franchise alumni as they compete in renovation challenges to update the Bachelor Mansion's spaces before a new Bachelorette season begins.
An insight into the lives of three paramedics, who must deal with the stress and tribulations of the job as well as their personal lives.
Kevin, a down-on-his-luck man, is tasked by God with a mission to save the world.
Buddy Dobbs (Michael Rosenbaum), a slacker on the run from a loan shark, steals a man's identity and ends up posing as a small town's new gay pastor.

When Hero discovers that the Demon King is not what he expected, the two begin to strike a deal that could save the world.
Drew Ferran as he comes of age and discovers he's the last of a long line of Werewolves
After fully recovering from her nearly fatal bout of bionic rejection, Jaime Sommers, the first female cyborg, is assigned to spy missions of her own.
In a world where dragons rule sky, sea, and land, dragon hunter Ragna joins forces with the mysterious Crimson to fight the dragons at any cost and destroy the dragon monarchs.

When a hacker begins releasing students' secrets to the entire high school, the socially isolated but observant Sofía works to uncover his/her identity.
An aging American ninja master and his headstrong young apprentice search for the elder man's daughter.
Several different deaths based on true stories.
The lives of a group of teenagers through their final two years of high school.
Secrets from the "Stranger Things 2" universe are revealed as cast and guests discuss the latest episodes with host Jim Rash.

Red, Chuck, Bomb, Matilda, Terence, and The Blues need to keep the eggs safe from the pigs that will snatch them at any cost.
The life of a split personality man who secretly sings for death metal.

Follows the complex work of federal police officers in an unprecedented investigation that culminates in the beginning of a thread that unravels, like no other, the construction of crime in the country.
A drama about various people competing in an illegal cross-country road race.

Serhat, a successful surgeon, leaves his homeland to build a new life in Istanbul. He falls in love with Melek and secretly marries her, but destiny leads him back to Urfa, where he confronts his past under the shadow of two rival families
Struggling mum Sam discovers access to lucrative stock market information while working as an office cleaner at Canary Wharf.
A look beyond blueprints and computers into the art and science of design, showcasing great designers from every discipline whose work shapes our world.
In a luxury apartment tower, six different women in unhappy marriages end up crossing the line into infidelity.
Frank Martin is an ex special ops, who now spends his life as a transporter on the other side of the law. With three rules, he always completes his contracts. One way, or the other.

An intelligent and witty dog imagines himself in the role of characters from classic books and gets involved in similar real-life adventures.

A romantic sports drama depicting the passion and affection for badminton of a male and female protagonist who are a mixed doubles group with players from the commercial badminton team.
Park Young-Han (Lee Je-Hoon) is a young detective. He becomes furious at the reality of human dignity being violated and he struggles to deal with it. He teams up with his colleague detectives

Yusuf, an ordinary young man returning from the military, finds himself fighting evil in the world of the mafia after the events that develop.

movies.primaryTitle: I'm a Noble on the Brink of Ruin, So I Might as Well Try Mastering Magic

Wu Zhen, sister of the queen, daughter of Duke of Henan, grew up pampered. She inherited demon power after being rescued by her cat master. Mei Zhu Yu, also spirit-sighted, trained in Taoism from young, mastering spiritual powers.

Combat!, a one-hour World War II drama series, followed a front line American infantry squad as they battled their way across Europe
Investigations of multiple mysterious and violent cases.

"Chabos" is a series on ZDFneo.

A narrative around the discovery of child pornography tied to an international school in Karlstad, Sweden.
Using the very latest in drone and aerial photographic technology, tour across countries and their seasons, getting a unique view from above.

movies.primaryTitle: Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H.
movies.originalTitle: Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H.

Crotchety old lady Sally Fergus roams the Old West with young companion Cyrus.
Humorous way of life with three different families that have diversified lifestyle habits.

Ultra-right-wing Alan B'Stard, the most selfish, greedy, dishonest, sadistic, sociopathic Conservative MP of all, plots to achieve his megalomaniacal ambitions.

A team of policewomen with supernatural powers try to protect the Earth from an alien invasion known as the Lucifer Hawks.

While he is thickheaded, a bit angry, but kind, honest and generous; she is quick tempered but so sentimental and fragile also. They fell in love; to live their "Second Chance"s in life.
A 2 trillion won divorce case that shocked the country and a woman who seeks revenge on the richest people of Korea.

Tales of science fiction, fantasy and the occult.

Ethan sets out to vanquish the Dragon that took his heart, but with every demon he battles, he loses more of his humanity.

As SI Hemant Kumar explores a missing person's case in the jungle town of Chhattisgarh, he is determined to solve it. Trouble follows when that leads to a string of bodies and a likely serial killer.

The story takes place in Joseon period, when power struggles surrounding the throne had reached extreme levels. In order to escape those who plan to assassinate him, the King puts a clown, who looks exactly like him, on the throne.

movies.originalTitle: Zutaboro Reijou wa Ane no Moto Konyakusha ni Dekiai Sareru
movies.plot: Marie thinks that she is being used as a substitute fiancée for her lost sister Anastasia; due to her parents breaking her self-worth. In truth, she was the one the proposal was meant for; the sender had mixed up their names.
A young boy who aims to be a professional Beyblade player. He aims to get to X Tower, where professional Beyblade players gather.

It tells the story of a medical graduate turned housewife but decided to return to the medical field, and a doctor husband who maintains a perfect dual life. He is great at his job and he is also great at cheating on his wife.
Two women flatmates in the city, one fancied by a neighbor. A strict landlady and a newcomer from another culture lead to comedy.
A straight-laced architect falls in love with a furniture designer while pretending to be gay.

When a generations-long family curse turns Alex Vanderhouven to stone, it's up to his two kids, Pandora and Russ, and his wife Sky, to return artifacts stolen by their ancestors to their rightful homes to finally lift the curse for good.
Ryu Yamada is kissing his normal life goodbye after he ends up in a bizarre body swap with honor student Urara Shiraishi!

Frankie Gaines looks like a typical teenager, but she has a very big secret: she's actually a cutting-edge experimental android. She must hide her true identity to avoid being tracked down by the evil tech company EGG Labs.

After the coronation, the villain kids Mal (Dove Cameron), Evie (Sofia Carson), Jay (Booboo Stewart), and Carlos (Cameron Boyce) use their one shot at being good while their villainous parents roam the Isle Of The Lost.

In the night, an emergency call to the police: a car accident, the female passenger has been killed. The driver and husband Tom survived. What nobody knows: Tom himself faked the accident. Philippe is the only colleague who suspects.
A teen with a troubled past reconnects with his two female best friends from childhood. He becomes the prime suspect when a fellow student is surprisingly found dead in her home.
The daily satirical adventures of Looney Tunes star the Tazmanian Devil, along with his extended family, friends, and enemies on the island of Tasmania.
After witnessing a suicide, an unobtrusive police clerk decides to investigate two neglected cases on her own, both involving abused women.
Centers on Sgt. Pete Hill who, after a stint in Afghanistan, is stationed at a small military base in Florida to tackle the toughest job of all: leading his dysfunctional brothers' squad.
A collection of short films blends horror, comedy, sci-fi, and thriller elements while exploring contemporary issues.
The New York institution is making its way across the pond. Coming soon to Sky One and NOW.
Pip the penguin and Freddy the flamingo become the first non-stork employees for T.O.T.S (Tiny Ones Transport Service) who deliver babies to their parents.
The sickest, most twisted animated shorts ever put on television.
Anastasia a young Greek woman in Ahmed I's harem takes on the name 'Kosem' (leader, pioneer). In a world of men, she rules of the Ottoman Empire through her sons and grandson.
Mickey and his friends Minnie, Donald, Pluto, Daisy, Goofy, Pete, Clarabelle and more go on fun and educational adventures.
A senator's wife goes missing.

In public, Umaru is the perfect vision of a beautiful and smart high school girl. At home, she morphs into the ultimate slob with the ability to game all night and binge on junk food and cola. Can her big brother, Taihei, change her?
Fena Houtma, a young orphan working in a brothel as a servant meets a mysterious stranger who tells her the truth about her family and a secret she must unlock.
At a predominantly white Ivy League college, a group of black students navigate various forms of racial and other types of discrimination.
Dramedy series examining the life of a woman who breaks off with her long term girlfriend and tries having a relationship with a man for a change.
Animated web series providing background and depth to Dexter's character and relationships.

"Utha Patak: A book that brings your story to life. Immerse yourself in its pages and live out your deepest desires, as reality and fantasy merge. But pleasure is confined to the book's world-dare to read?"
A British newscaster moves to Los Angeles with his alcoholic manservant and the baggage of several failed marriages to host a sanctimonious talk show.
Follows an escaped convict who takes hostages at a truck stop in southern Illinois, leading to an intense standoff with an FBI Crisis Negotiator trained in tactical empathy. Genre: Drama, Crime

movies.primaryTitle: How to Make It in America
movies.originalTitle: How to Make It in America
movies.plot: A group of 20 somethings living in New York City. Ben and Cameron work on starting a fashion company, while enjoying their lives in the greatest city in the world.
A failed television presenter, now presenting a programme on local radio desperately tries to revive his broadcasting career.

Doctor Richard Kimble is wrongly convicted and sentenced to death for the murder of his wife, a murder he didn't commit. He manages to escape on route to be executed and must stay ahead of the police to find the real killer.
Several murders in the fictional English town of Middleford. The crimes are solved by two female police detectives, Inspector Kate Ashurst and Sergeant Emma Scribbins, aka "Ash and Scribbs."

Twenty-three years after the original "Sonic the Hedgehog" video game, fast, handsome, arrogant hero Sonic continues to fight his archnemesis, Dr. Eggman, aided by Tails, Knuckles, Amy, and new recruit Sticks.
A tight knit family begins to unravel when a sister starts communicating with a voice that no one else can hear.
The misadventures of Doraemon, a robot cat from the future, who with his gadgets, is sent back in time to help make Nobita Nobi, a boy without much talent, a better person.
Candela Obscura is an ongoing horror drama that follows an esoteric order of investigators as they use centuries of knowledge to fight back a mysterious source of corruption and bleed.

Scott Calvin is about to turn 65. Realizing that he can't be Santa forever, he sets out to find a suitable replacement Santa while preparing his family for a new life adventure south of the North Pole.

After his detective father's murder, Louis dismisses vampire rumors and seeks the killer. When mysterious detective Arne Neuntöte and assistant Lynn Reinweiß arrive, Louis's life takes an unexpected turn.
Jeremy Wade searches the world for legendary and flesh-eating freshwater fish.

In an elite California equestrian town, the nouveau-riche Parker family navigates dangerous waters as their daughters pursue competitive riding dreams, uncovering dark secrets and murder within the prestigious horse community.
A well-respected announcer suddenly loses his ability to self-censor on air, catching the attention of a TV writer who invites him on her variety show.
A drama series exploring the complexities of relationships in modern family life in Sweden.

Aladdin, the clever hero of Agrabah, continues his adventures with the help of his fiancee Princess Jasmine, his pet monkey Abu, Magic Carpet, Iago the greedy parrot, and of course his best friend the semi-cosmic Genie.
The adventures of Sam Wing in his youth and Gizmo the Mogwai in China.
Xzibit finds the owner of a ruined car and takes it to the West Coast Customs for a renovation.
In Camargue, four boys in dire straits find themselves selling their bodies for money. Unexperienced but helped by their mischievous little sister Charly, they start an Escort Boys business.

A gifted woman's intellect brings chance to lead covert European police force. But it backfires, costing her everything. Following murder at her home and kidnapped heiress, her ex-supervisor enlists a policeman's aid to reinstate her.

movies.primaryTitle: A Journey Through Another World: Raising Kids While Adventuring
movies.originalTitle: Isekai Yururi Kikô: Kosodate Shinagara Bôkensha Shimasu
movies.plot: Takumi's reborn in a new world and finds super-strong twins, Alan and Elena. As their guardian, he joins an adventurers' guild to provide for them.

A story about a woman who has decided to fall in love and meets two men with different charms on a blind date, and discovers the true meaning of love. Lee Ui Yeong is the representative of the hotel purchasing team.
BBC adaptations of all 37 plays wholly and authoritatively credited to William Shakespeare.
Story of a partnership between a Zoid Liger Zero and its pilot Bit Cloud as they battle to become the ultimate team.
A student discovers a love for the art of dancing after an encounter with a pretty girl.
Six strangers invited to a billionaire's home. A forced helicopter landing. A cottage in the middle of the forest. What could all these people have in common to find themselves trapped like this?
A teenage slacker is given the ability to turn into the American Dragon and defend all mythical creatures that secretly reside in the human world.

In San Francisco, a nurse switches two newborns. Years later, when the truth is revealed, the now-wealthy man loses everything while the other gains status. This ignites a bitter rivalry, affecting relationships and sparking new romances.

movies.originalTitle: Itazura na Kiss: Love in Tokyo
movies.plot: Kotoko Aihara, a high school girl who isn't that smart has to follow her father's decision after her father decides to live temporarily with his friend. She is surprised to learn that the boy who she falls in love with lives there as well.

Bullied high school student Kota discovers fighting can be profitable when his classmate brawl is accidentally streamed and goes viral. He starts his own streaming channel and begins transforming his life.
"Tales of Tomorrow" was a hosted science fiction anthology series running from 1951 until 1953.
Two beautiful female assassins travel the world accepting assignments to kill various culprits, and at the same time, having deadly traps set against them by their own employer.
The true stories of extraordinary young women who witness the brutality and heroism of war and rise to meet the challenge.
Victims of romance scams try to reclaim their lives with help from "The Tinder Swindler" target Cecilie Fjellhøy and private investigator Brianne Joseph.
A new team of superhuman power rangers must work together and use their new ninja powers to prevent evil from dominating the human race and from destroying the planet earth and the universe
Detectives in scenic Kitzbuhel, Austria solve intricate crimes as hidden threats emerge amid mountain backdrops.
An ex-Scotland Yard detective returns to Kingston to work in missing persons and finds herself on a quest to solve a case that will blow her world apart.
MInecraft: Story Mode is an interactive, animated TV series from Netflix and Telltale Games. Viewers input decisions that affect the course of the story, using a remote control or computer keyboard.

movies.primaryTitle: King of Jin in Tang Dynasty
movies.plot: A renowned 21st century assassin is inexplicably reborn as the useless Fourth Lady of the Su Mansion, harassed by everyone. However, her callous imperial highness of the Jin Empire refuses to let her see her value.
A Londoner escaping his shady past meets a feisty Yorkshire woman whose car breaks down. He helps her, and they embark on an unlikely journey together aboard her narrowboat business.

A Space Sheriff with the power to travel between parallel Earths across multiple dimensions takes on cases throughout the multiverse. As he navigates these identical yet different worlds, the mystery of his unique ability unfolds.

movies.primaryTitle: TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You
movies.plot: A Young Prodigy accepts a Sudden Proposal from a Mysterious Woman who he falls in love with after she saves him from a Near-Death Experience.
The plot tells about an alcohol-addicted former rock musician, Marcin Kania, who sets off on a crazy journey into the darkest corners of Warsaw and the human psyche to find his missing son.
A recently widowed workaholic clumsily navigates life with his kids, guided by his late wife's online tips. Can he ace this crash course in parenthood?

movies.originalTitle: Qu you feng de di fang
movies.plot: After the death of her best friend, Xu Hongdou decided to quit her job and have herself a vacation in Dali, Yunnan. There, she met wonderful people and did wonderful things.
Follows Suze, a woman who stops time when she has sex, who meets Jon with the same ability, and together they rob banks.
There exists a love in the human heart that cannot be erased forever. Because it was believed that this love exists only in heaven, people continue to search for a stairway to heaven.
Komichi Akebi is starting junior high at the prestigious Robai Academy in the countryside. It's been her dream to wear a sailor-style school uniform and tomorrow her dream will come true.

movies.primaryTitle: The Adventures of the Galaxy Rangers
movies.originalTitle: The Adventures of the Galaxy Rangers
movies.plot: Four elite Galaxy Rangers with unique abilities defend law & order among the space colonies and protect humanity from the evil Crown Empire.
A girl who falls in love with a girl she sees in her dreams. She then meets her in real life.
Nordin Kynani faces challenges teaching underprivileged students, confronting rebelliousness, corruption, and ego, seeking to make a meaningful impact.
Sketch comedy performed by Odd Future Wolf Gang Kill Them All, as well as reality-TV segments featuring the group.
