The personal and professional misadventures of an opinionated but beloved woman working as a television journalist.
Jonestown, the site of the infamous 1978 massacre of more than 900 members of the Peoples Temple led by Jim Jones.
Slanderous accusations force Ayse to marry Kerem, a well-known, rich, handsome playboy.
Misadventures of Dewey Finn, a rocker who poses as a substitute teacher at a prestigious prep school as he teaches his unconventional and overachieving students to play and love rock 'n' roll.
A lonely woman exchanges letters with her distant husband. A postman intercepts their correspondence and deceives her by impersonating her spouse through letters, exploiting her vulnerability.

Bio-anthropologist, Dr. Sloan Parker, her colleague, Dr. Ed Tate, their associate Tom Daniels, and their friends, discover and investigate a secret new dominant humanoid species which is looking for a way to replace humans.
A cosmetic surgeon returns to her hometown to look after her father and siblings.

movies.originalTitle: Ting shuo ni xi huan wo
movies.plot: A determined female neurosurgeon faces her past when her ex-husband becomes her mentor. Their medical journey from Bei Ya Hospital to Africa transforms their relationship.

A psychotherapist's private life comes apart at the seams when she discovers that her husband is cheating on her. Dr. Dani Santino throws herself fully into her work and soon becomes the most sought-after therapist for celebrity clients.
The misadventures of a misfit PT boat crew during World War II.

25 years after a tragedy that affected her and her friends, Bérénice is a restorative justice mediator. But is it possible to believe in rehabilitation? Especially now, with the culprit back in their lives.

Group of friends get together thirty years after one of the members died in an accident. A relaxing vacation changes into a nightmare, when some of the friends are blackmailed with footage from that terrible week three decades ago.
Vampire and werewolf boys clash when a girl with a secret enters their lives, sparking an urban fantasy romance amidst confrontation and friendship.
Follow the Behavioural Analysis Unit's emergency response team - a Red Cell - as they tackle the BAU's most dangerous cases.

Almost a year after their astronaut mother's tragic death, Alex and Hayley Woods start attending an elite boarding school for future leaders, but soon begin to realize that everything is not as it seems.
The young Wicket and his Ewok friends have fantastic adventures on the forest moon of Endor.
A young doctor realizes that working as an intern in a big hospital is very much the same as being in high school.
TV follow-up to the 2001 film 'Training Day' about a rookie cop partnered with a corrupt officer.
In Fermont, a small mining town in northeast Quebec, the body of a young dancer is found. Detective Céline Trudeau, one of the most experienced professionals, investigates the case.
The cases of a police unit specializing in revisiting old criminal files whose investigations have been inconclusive.
An MIT grad student and a tech superstar bring a low-level Pentagon official a staggering discovery--that an asteroid is just six months away from colliding with Earth.

movies.primaryTitle: Romcon: Who the F**k is Jason Porter?
movies.originalTitle: Romcon: Who the F**k is Jason Porter?
movies.plot: A real estate broker's whirlwind romance turns dark when she uncovers her new boyfriend's true identity and criminal past. Joining forces with other women he deceived, she launches a dangerous quest to expose the truth.
A high school student with massage skills becomes dorm manager at a sports-focused school, caring for athletes while pursuing a medical scholarship.

movies.primaryTitle: Lego Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy
movies.originalTitle: Lego Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy
movies.plot: A nerf-herder discovers an artifact that twists the Star Wars universe, swapping the roles of heroes and villains. He embarks on an adventure to restore order and emerge as the savior who reassembles the fractured galaxy.

Follow the adventures of a young girl born into a band of robbers in a medieval Scandinavian fortress. As Ronja grows up, she learns that the surrounding forest can be a magical and sometimes dangerous place filled with strange creatures.
It demonstrates techniques of a new Sex Crimes Investigation Unit (GICCS).

On Colonel Trautman's request, John Rambo leads special unit The Force of Freedom against paramilitary terrorist organization S.A.V.A.G.E. (Specialist-Administrators of Vengeance, Anarchy and Global Extortion) all over the globe.
After Colin Walcott drops dead at his birthday party, his wife Tess, and daughter Cathy, discover he had a long-term mistress, Marilyn, by whom he has daughter, Cat.

With more than 20,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old school, no-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine.

Kamina Ayato lives an ordinary life. He goes to school. He lives with his mother. He has schoolmates. But all of that changes one day when massive machines, known as the Dolem, attack the city of Tokyo with their destructive vocal powers. Caught up in the chaos, Ayato meets a mysterious girl named Mishima Reika. She leads him to the sanctuary, resting place of the RahXephon, a giant humanoid being with powers to counter those of the Dolem. Upon its awakening, Ayato finds himself synchronising with the machine and it takes him to the world beyond Tokyo. It seems that Tokyo, more precisely called Tokyo Jupiter, has been cut off from the rest of the world. Those living within the boundaries of Tokyo Jupiter believe that the rest of the world has been decimated, when in fact they live in a world controlled by the Mu. Now, facing the truth, Ayato must come to terms with his new reality, for he is a central element in the fate of mankind.
A high school is populated by the clones of well-known historical figures.
A look at the inner workings of the CIA.

movies.primaryTitle: The Ice Guy and His Cool Female Colleague
movies.originalTitle: Koori Zokusei Danshi to Cool na Douryou Joshi
movies.plot: Office worker Himuro's supernatural powers freeze his workplace when he concentrates. Despite his icy abilities, he's kindhearted. His growing feelings for coworker Fuyutsuki cause snowstorms that everyone but her notices.
A 13-year-old boy named Henry Bigg, who is going on vacation, finds some mouse-like creatures called diminutives in his suitcase.

movies.primaryTitle: Saving 80,000 Gold in Another World for my Retirement
movies.originalTitle: Rôgo ni sonaete Isekai de 8-man-mai no kinka wo tamemasu
movies.plot: Mitsuha transports between her modern world and a medieval one. After a wolf attack, she plans to retire by earning 80,000 gold coins across the two realms.

Detectives Orhan and Selim attempt to solve puzzling cases with the help and guidance of forensics. Professor Sevil Atasoy, a renowned forensic scientist, also joins us sometimes to share relevant anecdotes.
Story of an Indian boy's love of cricket in Mumbai, and his discovery that the game isn't as pure as he thought.
In swinging 60's Melbourne, gorgeously reckless Peregrine Fisher inherits a windfall when the famous aunt she never knew goes missing over the highlands of New Guinea.
A dangerous and affectionate romance between a man whose time stops after being killed by his beloved lover and a woman who loses her memory of her previous life and whose time passes away endlessly.

movies.primaryTitle: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated!
movies.plot: A middle-aged salaryman finds himself in a video game world, in the role of a villainess.
An old storyteller tells European folk tales to his sarcastic dog.
Dwight, a 21st century teen, falls into an ancient, underground chamber and lands lip-to-lip with Gretta, a gothic princess who has been magically sleeping for a thousand years.
Private eye Barnaby Jones works with his widowed daughter-in-law to solve cases.

Faith, a small-town Welsh lawyer, is forced to cut short her extended maternity leave when her husband and business partner, Evan, goes missing. As the truth of his actions surface, Faith must fight to protect her family and her sanity.
The everyday struggles of living in the secluded state of Alaska where one wrong decision could cost you your life.
Halis Aga, the pillar of one of Gaziantep's well-established families, decides to marry off his unruly grandson Ferit to bring him into line.
A fantasy thriller about a man who is in shock of losing his daughter and a woman who lives in the past, both struggling to save the ones they love.
The adventures of a logging work team and the marriageable single women sent to them in post-American Civil War Seattle in the Washington Territory.

Emma a successful woman fears of losing her mind after suffering from sleep deprivation two weeks before turning 40. Only by investigating the truth of her painful past, can she find the answers to her present.

movies.primaryTitle: The Many Loves of Dobie Gillis
movies.originalTitle: The Many Loves of Dobie Gillis
movies.plot: A young man schemes and strives for beautiful women, fancy cars, and money.

Spanning decades, the saga contrasts obsessive Soames, clinging to wife Irene, and Jolyon, leaving for his kids' governess. Their diverging paths intertwine, bringing highs and lows to the upper-class Forsyte clan.

This series follows the protagonist, Luo Feng, in a post-apocalyptic world full of intelligent Monsters, as he becomes a warrior (superhuman) and gradually improves by overcoming various difficulties.
DCI Harry Virdee must hunt down a killer targeting the Asian community in Bradford, whilst dealing with his chaotic personal life.

The #1 food writer and television host in the world, Anthony Bourdain reinvented the food travel genre. In his groundbreaking first series, Bourdain travels around the world indulging his taste for local cuisine and eccentric characters.
A dire prophecy hangs over the young witch Nico. Can her childhood friend Morihito keep her safe or will Nico's out-of-control magic get in the way?

6 orphaned siblings struggle to survive on Istanbul's streets while evading threats from authorities and criminals. Led by eldest sister Azize, their bond is all they have as they desperately seek a safe haven and new life together.

Royal Military Police Sergeant Davis arriving in Aberdeen as a new recruit with Police Scotland. After completing his last assignment with the Royal Military Police, Lindo dreams of becoming a detective at New Scotland Yard.
In the very near future, creatures from ancient mythology must live among humans and battle for survival in a world that wants to silence, exploit, and destroy them.

Abhay Pratap Singh, the gutsy cop who can outwit any criminal, is back. Only this time, he is up against some sharper and hardened evil masterminds. Join him as he sets out on the road to justice with a darker and edgier.
Nora and Simon's love is the greatest of all - but also manipulative and destructive - is it supposed to be?
Seasonal anthology series. Season 1: The lives of the participants in a trial with significant racial motives are forever changed during the legal process.
Artists around the UK come together to compete for who has the best original celebrity portrait.
Nick Cannon and a new A-list celebrity lead a team of improv comedians each week as they compete against one another.
The story of people who gather to occupy samples for different purposes after the last sample of the so-called 'Tyrant Program' disappears in a delivery accident.
It tells the story of a group of young women who carry out burglaries to liberate themselves from the expectations on women.

movies.originalTitle: Watari-kun no xx ga Hôkai Sunzen
movies.plot: After his parents' death, Naoto cares for his sister Suzu while living with their aunt. A new transfer student, Satsuki, arrives at his school, bringing dark memories and secrets that threaten their life.

movies.primaryTitle: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day
movies.originalTitle: Kimi ga shinu made koi o shitai

movies.plot: A man who seems to know everything but his own name helps police solve crimes as he searches for his identity.

From the dark corners of the world comes another fanatical terrorism group, this time it's the Government of Darkness, aka G.O.D. Keisuke Jin is transformed into the next generation cyborg, the Kai-Zorg with the help of his father. He was given the name Kamen Rider X. King Dark, leader of G.O.D, didn't count on Kamen Rider X coming to ruin his plans of pillaging, rape, and destruction of Earth. Armed with riddle stick, and ridel whip, Kamen Rider X kicked everyone's butt, who stood in his way. Every G.O.D. cyborg from Neptune to Chronos, fell before the might of X. But his toughest opponent was Apollogeist. Their battle lasted 13 episodes. Seeing how useless and unworthy his Cyborgs were against Kamen Rider X, King Dark began to create new soldiers,combining animals, like Starfish-Hitler, and Spider-Napolean. In the last episode, X finds out that King Dark was created by Dr. Jinau, a friend of his father's, but now his brain resides within King dark.
A family living in Central Park in New York City must save it from a greedy land developer.
U.S. Marshals team up with former fugitives to work together on tracking down prison escapees in exchange for getting time off their sentences.
After being kicked out of their houses by their wives, two friends try to share an apartment, but their ideas of housekeeping and lifestyles are as different as night and day.
Amid the onset of andropause, a 50-something family man becomes obsessed with change and decides to pursue happiness. Then he bungles it up completely.
Ian Fletcher, formerly the Head of the Olympic Deliverance Commission, has taken up the position of Head of Values at the BBC.

Crime drama following the fictional agents and cases of the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation (aka the FBI). Most episodes are based on actual FBI investigations with all names changed to protect the innocent.
Fun-loving pug puppies, brothers Bingo and Rolly, have thrill-seeking appetites that take them on exhilarating adventures in their neighborhood and around the globe.

A civilian businessman who has no choice but to cooperate with the secret operation of the National Intelligence Service to arrest the Korean drug lord who has taken control of Suriname in South America.
As the oddball cast of characters at Abby's will tell you, everyone needs a bar to call home.
Follows the lives and relationships of a group of five husbands and wives who live on the same street in the fictional community of Maxine.
Mickey and friends welcome everyone back to the clubhouse for all-new adventures filled with music, laughs and new surprises.
Amateur detectives Nick and Nora Charles investigate various crimes.
A woman finds a strange animal in the rain. It offers her an umbrella to show its charm. Impressed by its wit, she takes the dog-like being home, beginning their shared story.
A police inspector is sent to his hometown to investigate a kidnap case, but apart from solving the mystery, he has to face the demons of his past.

movies.primaryTitle: WWII in Color: Road to Victory
movies.originalTitle: WWII in Color: Road to Victory
movies.plot: Gripping historical footage and expert commentary give detailed insights into the leading figures and decisive turning points of WWII.
A premiere surgeon is blackmailed in a plot to assassinate the president after her family is taken hostage by a rogue federal agent.
A being calling itself "Hyper Agent Gridman" contacts high schooler Yuta through an old computer, recruiting him in the fight against impending terror.

The series follows the lives of star-crossed lovers Elisa Scalzi, an honest but poor woman, and Count Fabrizio Ristori. Their love is hindered by a conspiracy led by Lucrezia, a noblewoman who also fell in love with Fabrizio.
Centered around a life science class teacher, "Afet Hoca", the humorous and genuine story of high-school students in Ridvan Kanat High School.

movies.primaryTitle: Yatagarasu: The Raven Does Not Choose Its Master
movies.plot: In a world of shapeshifting ravens, Yukiya, a Northern leader's son, is summoned by the Imperial Prince as murder, mysteries and an invasion from an unknown enemy threaten the four noble regions.
Teenage girl Kyra accidentally discovers an extraordinary world and gains magical powers; when an unexpected threat emerges, she must unite fairies, elves and humans to save them all.
Four fierce and furry superhero kittens protect the pets and people of Kittydale.
Facing a series of complex murder cases, new police commander Hélène Bach must learn to work with the brilliant yet exasperating Raphaël, who can make the dead speak like no-one else.
The friendship between fairy princess Holly and Ben Elf in the magical Kingdom of elves and fairies.
A divorced woman with three children - one of them deaf - marries a divorced man with a son of his own, and they must find a way for everyone to get along.
A newly married young man from a poor background faces life's hardships when his wife becomes pregnant with quintuplets, pushing him to fight for a better future for his family.
The adventures of a small green character who creates tiny plant-based meals.
A dishonorable thief escorts a mysterious girl to a location she seeks. They're joined by a knight aiming to avenge his executed father, who imposes a condition that becomes his new goal.
Follows suspicious lovers as they catch their cheating partners in the act.

movies.primaryTitle: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
movies.originalTitle: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
movies.plot: The further adventures of Po the Dragon Warrior and his friends.
Viewers from around America send in home videos with comedic moments.
Four sisters-in-law struggle to deal with small-town life and their overbearing mother-in-law.
Every second of every day, millions of Americans are caught on security cameras. Most of them are honest citizens going about their daily lives. But a few are guilty of unspeakable crimes.

Confident and instinctive Deputy Superintendent Lolita Lobosco transfers back to her hometown, Bari. Heading up a team at the local police station, she takes on murder and other crimes in her own particular style.
Two children who got swapped at birth grow up to become engaged to each other. It's an arrangement neither of them like, at first.

Starting his new term at Tanenashi High School, an unmotivated freshman searches for a club that requires minimal participation to suit his needs. He then comes across the magic clubroom, and inside is a cute upperclassman practicing her magic tricks. Suffering from stage fright that causes her to slip up in her acts, she has a tendency to end up in the most embarrassing situations. Despite having little interest in a club run by an incapable magician, the freshman finds himself involved as a new member, experiencing all sorts of awkward moments with his eccentric mentor.
Carter Nash discovered a liquid that could turn him into Captain Nice, a very shy superhero dominated by his mother.

Set in future Japan, where declining birth rates give children higher social status than adults. Santa Claus has been sealed by a curse, leaving Christmas a legend. Sanda Kazushige realizes he has a connection to the mythical Santa.
Four guests from the worlds of politics and entertainment join host Bill Maher for a free-wheeling and humorous discussion of current events.
A sportscaster must take on the responsibility of being a full-time dad when his teenage daughter moves in with him.

movies.primaryTitle: My Friend's Little Sister Has It in for Me!
movies.originalTitle: Tomodachi no Imôto ga Ore ni Dake Uzai
movies.plot: A high school gamer, mocked by girls, shifts his focus from romance to his future, seeking jobs at his uncle's company for himself and his friends.
German police inspector Robert Anders is a family man who lives with his Swedish wife and investigates murders in the spectacular landscape of the Swedish island of Gotland.

Xu Hanxia's mother died in childbirth, and her father did not care about her since she was born. But this instead cultivated Xu Hanxia's proud and daring character. With China's economic takeoff, Xu Hanxia took her brothers Tong Xiaoqi and
Two lifelong friends explore the enduring question - what if your first love was destined to be your soulmate? A sweeping romantic tale about love's timeless possibilities.
Abu Ahmad and his family are forced to leave the city of Haifa to find a safe shelter during the 1948 Arab-Israeli war. However, they face tragic conditions and struggle with displacement.
A short lived horror play anthology that aired in the United Kingdom weekly in 1968 from 11 April 1968 until 16 May 1968 on the BBC. It comprised 6 x 30 minutes horror stories.

In the present day, hundreds of extraterrestrial species walk the Earth. Some are pacifistic, others violent. Some are here for research purposes, others are career criminals. However, humans don't know they are here. Now, one more alien has arrived on Earth. One of the universe's foremost geniuses with a personality that's bound to attract all sorts of trouble.
High schooler Yuri finds herself atop a skyscraper in a strange world, where she must survive against masked assailants bent on killing their prey.
Follow the adventures and misadventures of Penny Proud as she does her best to navigate through the early years of teend-dom.

Children's stop-motion series set in Antarctica and focusing around penguin families living and working in igloos. The main character, Pingu, belongs to one such family. He goes on various adventures with his little sister and his friends.
Keith is a taxi driver who records a monologue on his video camera, which relates the story of his failed marriage after his wife Marion left him for her work colleague, Geoff.
The adventures of the half human/vampire hunter.
Diverse personal stories from around the world reveal how lives, passions and goals are facilitated by the human body's various complex systems; narrator Jad Abumrad.

Sheng Yang is a newcomer just entering society, while Jian Bing is a well-known advertising director in the industry. These two strangers form a bond and embark on a wondrous and romantic journey of love and personal growth.

1900. A village, where crafty farmers discover oil and make unscrupulous deals at the expense of the villagers. The journey of Johanna takes center stage: after the violent death of her father, she stands up to the overpowering oil barons.
Thea is a tough, no-nonsense widow raising four children while holding various low-paying jobs.
In 2065, the Tracy family secretly run International Rescue, whose mission is to save people trapped in extraordinarily dangerous situations using their advanced Thunderbird machines.

Doctor Joseph O'Loughlin a man who appears to have the perfect life and a successful career as a clinical psychologist. But nothing can be taken for granted. Even the most flawless existence is only a loose thread away from unravelling.
Following Eva Longoria as she travels Mexico to explore food ranging from tequila to mole sauce.

The series accompanies a group of 16-year-olds on the journey of their life following day to day in real time. Dependence on social media, how they face sex, love and ruptures, religion, the search of their identity and the need to fit in.
A broke office worker moonlights as a product reviewer and gets assigned to test an XL condom. When her strict boss unexpectedly qualifies for the product, their relationship takes an intimate turn.

movies.originalTitle: The Expanding Universe of Ashley Garcia
movies.plot: 15-year-old scientist Ashley Garcia explores the great unknown of modern teendom after moving across the country to pursue a career in robotics.

A unique situation where to save money, two strangers share a flat on a schedule where they never meet each other. They communicate via post it note while they navigate their unusual agreement, their relationships, and lives.

movies.originalTitle: Bob Ross: The Joy of Painting
movies.plot: In this PBS instructional series, artist Bob Ross guides viewers through wet-on-wet oil techniques, calmly painting serene landscapes step by step and encouraging anyone to pick up a brush.

Abandoned by her stepmother after her father's remarriage, Leyla returns years later seeking revenge. However, her quest becomes an emotional journey filled with love and struggles against the woman who ruined her life.

After his wife's death, Max investigates a teen's disappearance. His daughter faces strange events hinting at supernatural forces tied to ancestral myths and her own powers. They must reunite to unravel the mystery.

Three rag doll puppets live together in a countryside cottage: Tilly, a French girl, with red hair, who speaks in basic French; Tom, a blue haired boy with glasses; and Tiny, the green-haired youngest Tot.
After discovering her fiancé Tim Truman kissing another woman, Meg Cummings leaves her home in Kansas on their wedding day to start a new life in Sunset Beach, California.

movies.primaryTitle: The BMF Documentary: Blowing Money Fast
movies.originalTitle: The BMF Documentary: Blowing Money Fast
movies.plot: Explores an inside look at different perspectives from the ones involved in the series BMF.
The series tells the story of Lord Vishnu, who fights against evil, and comes to earth time and again to maintain the balance between good and evil.
A satire comedy of a misfit high school with punks, robots, gorillas and much more.

Inspired by Banjo Paterson's famous poem, The Man from Snowy River, this series is about cattle rancher Matt McGregor, his family, and their neighbours in the township of Paterson's Ridge in Australia's Snowy Mountains.
Degrassi: Next Class follows the lives of the students from Degrassi Community School, a fictional high school in Toronto.

A 16-year-old girl discovers she possesses supernatural water abilities after moving to a village, connecting with a mysterious boy despite her family's objections, unraveling secrets about herself and her worldview as their bond deepens.

movies.primaryTitle: Berserk: The Golden Age Arc - Memorial Edition
movies.plot: A lone sellsword named Guts gets recruited into a mercenary band and attempts to help the Band's leader, Griffith, on his rise to power.

A story that reveals the whole story of a friendship that has been changed over 20 years based on the death of a friend of Jang Jae-kyeong, an ace detective in a drug squad who is forcibly addicted to drugs.
A young woman's life changes dramatically as she faces cybercrime challenges in a world where privacy is vulnerable and reputations can be instantly destroyed.
Lilysa joins a cosplay club, convincing Okumura to become her photographer. Her favorite manga character inspires her cosplay, including fetish-inspired outfits.

Series from Marvel set more to the environment of Anime than typical American fare. Plenty of lengthy dialog, emotion and angst to go around, as well as grossly-mutating monsters to please the most demanding anime fans.
Allied with a family of humans, a new generation of Transformers searches for purpose while defending Earth from threatening evil forces.

Storyline follows the development of a kpop group who got caught up in a scandal. With the help of their manager who can see brief glimpses of the future they have to face the war that the entertainment business is to not be forgotten.
A policeman teams up with an art expert to investigate crimes
Drama following the professional and personal lives of doctors and surgeons led by Dr. Konrad Styner. Pioneering in its unflinching depiction of medical procedures and operations.

Tomoro Tenma lives in a world where human thoughts and emotions, known as e-Pulse, power AI devices called Sapotama. But when Digimon begin materializing from Sapotama and feeding on e-Pulse, society begins to fracture.

Two men with opposing ideologies embark on a mission to unravel the mysteries of the spiritual world. Fighting demons, ghosts, and even other cultivators, the two end up forming a bond that neither of them had ever expected.
This British anthology series, which was produced by England's leading exporters of horror films, told tales of haunted houses, demons, ghosts, and other supernatural wonders.
Follows a man who gains the ability to transform into a gaseous state and uses his powers for bank robberies.
Madhav Mishra is back to fight his toughest case yet nothing is simple and straightforward. Will justice win?
The wacky misadventures of a forever-scheming woman, her reluctant best friend, and her cantankerous boss.

The story of some of the most remembered characters who transformed the world. Produced by the BBC, based in true facts, with the support of modern historians. This documentary tells how Napoleon, Spartacus, Richard Lionhearth, Atila, Shogun and Cortes printed their names in the books of history.
Follows the misadventures of humanoid alien Lezly "Big Lez" Mackerel and his mates in the humble town of Brown Town.
A love triangle between Dan Sommerdahl, his wife Marianne Sommerdahl and their best friend Flemming Torp occurs as they try to solves killings in Helsingør.
British comedy series in which Kayvan Novak takes on the guise of various eccentric characters as he prank calls unsuspecting business owners and members of the public.
Comedy drama that follows the exploits of school staff both inside and out of the classroom.
In 13th century Mongolia, Persian medical expert Fatima joins the Khan's harem, allying with Töregene, Ögedei Khan's sixth wife. Their partnership shapes palace politics and global events.

movies.originalTitle: On the Edge with Alex Honnold
movies.plot: Professional adventure rock climber Alex Honnold embarks on a lifelong dream - an epic climbing quest across the remotest and toughest walls and peaks of Greenland.

BBC Radio4 adaptation: A stranger confronts a family with evidence that their brother was wrongly convicted of a murder several years before. They realise they are in danger with the real killer still amongst them.
A disgraced former NYPD officer lives with his son, an earnest, obsessively honest NYPD detective.
They'll ride refurbished vintage bikes from McGregor's Scottish home to Boorman's in England, taking a circuitous route through Northern Europe and the continent before reaching their destination.

Michelle Paradise stars as Jennifer, a documentary filmmaker with an active imagination and a shaky career. Jen wants to find Ms. Right but first she must navigate the rules of lesbian life, most of which she learns along the way. Luckily, her girl friends are there to help: Sam, a sexy lesbian who goes through women faster than real estate; Chris and Kris, a lesbian couple trying to have a baby while expanding their pet business; and Crutch, a young musician who must still do some growing up before she can expect to be taken seriously.
Historical figures who have been cloned and placed back in high school, including Abraham Lincoln, Cleopatra, Joan of Arc, John F. Kennedy and more, as they face the trials of normal teenage life.

Seven well-known Swedish men travel to South Korea to train as Shaolin monks. Over twelve days they undergo intense physical training and inner-journey work at a temple - designed to challenge them mentally and physically and help them confront personal demons. There are no eliminations or staged "intrigues"; the goal is the internal transformation each participant goes through.

A man who detests his mother and cats is forced to take care of her feline. In addition, he must collaborate with an attractive debt collector, a cat lover, to settle his mother's outstanding accounts.
Childhood best friends Via and Arkin develop romantic feelings. Their love faces challenges as Arkin's rising fame threatens to pull them in separate directions.
Set in a giant shopping mall, this show follows the after-school lives of six 16-year-olds.

movies.primaryTitle: The Night Beyond the Tricornered Window
movies.originalTitle: Sankaku Mado no Sotogawa wa Yoru
movies.plot: Two psychics team up to solve a string of murders, and along their investigations develop a romantic connection.
About Love Bugs focus on humorous and universally recognized differences between men and women.

A thousand years after natural disasters have devastated the planet Zi humans have re-established civilization, salvaging the ancient Zoids. When his village is attacked a boy activates an ancient Zoid to defend it.
A young man wakes up from a 12-year coma to discover new abilities that come to propel him into the middle of a dangerous conspiracy.

This docuseries is dedicated to America's veterans-showing that recovery from PTSD is possible and that reintegration into everyday life can be achieved with the right support. Each episode follows veterans attending transformative retreats, where a team of skilled facilitators combine therapeutic practices, innovative methods, and lived experience to guide them on a path toward healing. Through their stories, viewers witness the raw realities of PTSD-but also the power of resilience, transformation, and the enduring hope that peace and purpose can be reclaimed.

Karamora, who lost his beloved, Alina, in a fight with representatives of a secret organization, decides to challenge the centuries-old rule of the nobility, avenge his lost love and try to change the world.
Polar opposite pals Guy and Sam learn to try new things.
Four friends and their daily lives of playing extreme sports, surfing, and getting into some crazy situations.
Five women with the same birthmark set out to unravel the truth about their pasts and discover a tragic web of lies spun by a powerful politician.

After a failed romance, detective Elma returns to coastal Akrane. When a woman's body is found by a lighthouse, dark secrets emerge. In this suffocating small Icelandic town, her colleague Saevar may offer hope.
20th century astronaut Buck Rogers emerges out of 500 years of suspended animation into the 25th century to become Earth's greatest hero and to explore the unknown reaches of deep space.
Peter Parker, a new student at the famous Horizon High, fights evil super-villains as the costumed superhero, Spider-Man.

Ranger Porter Ricks is responsible for the animal and human life in Coral Key Park, Florida. Stories center on his 15-year-old son Sandy and 10-year-old Bud and, especially, on their pet dolphin Flipper.
A newspaper publisher and his Asian valet/martial arts expert battle crime as the feared Green Hornet and Kato.
The spinoff series of Bad Boys films focuses on drug enforcement agent Sydney Burnett, now working for the Los Angeles Police Department.

A disgraced neurosurgeon performs illegal surgeries while confronting her dark past. When she meets her former mentor, a battle of power and revenge unfolds as she pushes ethical boundaries in pursuit of medical breakthroughs.
After her affair is captured by hidden cameras, Lina sets out to unmask an insidious voyeur who threatens to destroy her life.
Contestants compete in trivia rounds to win mystery prizes from giant boxes. Through multiple episodes, pairs face off using strategy and knowledge while dealing with twists and changing alliances.
Lightning McQueen embarks on new adventures in Radiator Springs with his best friend Mater, plus new pals Pipes the drag car and Miles the monster truck.

After his wife dies, search and rescue commander John West uproots his three children, moving from Boston to his rural hometown of Turtle Island Bay. The death affects each of their lives as John and his kids cope with their loss.
Drama focusing on an elite LAPD bicycle cop unit patrolling Santa Monica and Venice Beaches and boardwalks to fight crime in sunny Los Angeles, California.

The lives and fortunes of the Bellamy family and their below-stairs servant staff at 165 Eaton Place play out against the social, political and historical backdrop of Edwardian London from 1903 to 1930.
In the 1960s, a teenage girl investigates her past and discovers a connection to the Black Dahlia murder.

movies.primaryTitle: Peacock Presents: The At-Home Variety Show Featuring Seth MacFarlane
movies.originalTitle: The At-Home Variety Show featuring Seth MacFarlane
movies.plot: Seth MacFarlane and other celebrities entertain the viewers with short sketches and musical parodies as a way of offering support to essential workers and communities in need during the global health crisis.

movies.primaryTitle: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants in Space
movies.originalTitle: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants in Space
movies.plot: Fourth-grade friends George and Harold have a shared love of pranks and comic books -- and turning their principal into an undies-wearing superhero.
Twelve famous faces embark on one of the toughest tests of their lives, for Stand Up To Cancer. And Ant Middleton and his instructors are making no allowances for their celebrity status.
Follows Major Prickles and his overzealous team, as they try to save the citizens of Big Tree City.
Viking culture is seen from a first-hand experience through the perspective of Athelstan.
The Quest family and their bodyguard investigate strange phenomena and battle villains around the world.

Sofía and Alejandro get married in a dream wedding, but when Alejandro dies in a plane crash and Sofia travels to Cabo to meet his family, she realizes that Alejandro is alive and his real name is Eduardo.

A small-town boxer enters an elite Delhi college to fulfill his brother's dream. He faces bullying and class discrimination while falling for an ambitious senior student, forcing him to fight for love and dignity.

In 1970s L.A., struggling comics pursue success at famed comedy clubs, exploring the darker motivations of an industry where making audiences laugh is no laughing matter. Based on William Knoedelseder's book.

movies.primaryTitle: Dating Rules from My Future Self
movies.originalTitle: Dating Rules from My Future Self
movies.plot: A girl gets romantic advice from herself ten years in the future via text message.
Four brothers living in New Zealand are modern reincarnations of Norse gods.

Based on the book 'A Ticket To Syria', Avinash Kamath, an ex-cop turned mercenary, takes up the daunting task of rescuing Aliya, a newly married girl trapped in war-torn Syria against the backdrop of growing ISIS terrorism.
A mother working in IT who ends up fighting undercover against the Bucharest criminals who have changed her life.
A new show centered on a teenage girl who takes over her grandfather's lodge and befriends its teenage staff.
"Freddy's Nightmares" was a 1988 horror anthology series with "Freddy", the dream serial killer, hosting stories set in Springwood, USA.

Nora Sand is a journalist working as a foreign correspondent for a Danish newspaper. At the peak of her career she's accused of having had an affair with one of her sources in a big case. Nora gets suspended, travels home to Denmark.

Harry Dresden is a wizard, the only one listed in the Chicago phone book. He's got a handle on the crimes that can't be solved by anyone else. Paranormal? No problem. Dresden deals in all matters of supernatural threats.
Saito and Louise's relationship deepens, but the Queen tasks them with a mission to seek the Pope's blessing, leading to challenges that test their bond.

Spinoff from 'All American' follows a young tennis hopeful from Beverly Hills and an elite baseball player from Chicago as they contend with the high stakes of university sports at a Historically Black College in Atlanta.

Maddy becomes fixated on his mistress's sister-in-law Dimpi, pursuing her despite her reluctance. When her enraged brother discovers them together and Maddy kills him, Manisha attempts blackmail, but Dimpi exposes her scheme to the police.
A 2019 adaptation of Tove Jansson's loved body of work around the Moomin family.

movies.primaryTitle: RuPaul's Drag Race UK vs the World
movies.originalTitle: RuPaul's Drag Race UK vs the World
movies.plot: Renowned queens from different Drag Race franchises compete in an international arena showcasing their country's finest drag in their bid to become the ultimate Drag Race Superstar.

A horror anthology about a family of monsters watching a different horror story every week on their TV. Each tale is separate, often cautionary with occasional dark humor and irony and features various deadly creatures.

movies.primaryTitle: Untitled Netflix/21 Laps Hockey Drama Serie Project
movies.originalTitle: Untitled Netflix/21 Laps Hockey Drama Serie Project
movies.plot: A grieving widow steps up to lead her husband's high school hockey team after a devastating tragedy, helping the surviving players find healing and purpose through the sport they love.
A woman is found brutally murdered in a Reykjavik suburb. A rookie police detective is put under pressure to find the killer before he murders the only witness - the victim's 6-year-old daughter.

movies.primaryTitle: Let Life Come as It Knows
movies.plot: Leaving his dirty past behind, Sadi Payasli, who is appointed as a geography teacher at Karabayir High School, crosses the path with five young people from the reformatory.
A cop must work with his mother, the "Mantis" - a female serial killer who murdered 5 men decades ago - when copycat killings emerge. He's hated her his whole life.
A former troublemaker applies for a job at a convenience store owned by the same man who ran errands for her a few years ago.
Harry loses his cool with 3 swimmers that he's forced to rescue just seconds after warning them not to swim in a dangerous area. However, calling them "imbeciles" and "idiots" puts him in hot water.
An anthology series featuring short films handpicked from festivals.
The adventures of the Man of Steel in his teenage years.

Subbu, a young man with a streak of bad luck and his life changes when he secretly becomes an adult sex-ed teacher in a rural village of Makhipur, balancing his strict father's expectations while pursuing his dreams and romance.
The pragmatic, reserved and refined Maigret investigates murders in his singular unhurried manner and inevitably discovers the truth.

We follow three Dublin sisters, and their Irish/Egyptian dad who, after a tragic incident, has to raise his three daughters alone. His irresponsible brother moves in to 'help' and never leaves. Meet the Amin family the new fighting Irish.

Jade quits university, returns to hometown, works as lifeguard. Group of young lifeguards navigate relationships, identities. Jade's secret challenges them, they support each other through difficulties.
Spine-tingling standalone stories span horror subgenres, warping reality and fear like Beyond Belief.
The semester has started. At this private school you must pass at any cost.

After an explosion at the school, the X-Men went their separate ways. But they must unite once again under the leadership of Wolverine to prevent an inevitable war while also dealing with present problems.
A reimagining of the popular 1970s TV series about a female athlete who is given bionic strength.
Centers on Ingrid Yun, an idealistic young lawyer, struggles with her moral compass and her passions as she fights to climb the partner track at an elite New York City law firm.

Unlike Carol's other variety shows, this series was a comedy anthology. It featured one show-long sketches, with each member of the company playing different characters each week and no "running characters."

Talented Midwestern girl Sonny wins a nationwide talent search and is moving to Los Angeles to star in a popular TV series. Her home life and work life are documented along with her adjustment to life in the spotlight.
It follows Gala as her life is turned upside down when her husband implicates the family in financial improprieties, and she is forced to flee the city alongside her mother and daughter.
Young teenager Jack Sullivan and a group of friends live in a decked-out tree house, playing video games, eating candy, and fighting zombies in the aftermath of a monster apocalypse.
Experienced missionary Vedat and politically correct Evren are assigned to important errands for a wealthy businessman, leading to internal conflict.

After her death, Ruhsar returns as a ghost to be with his husband Mazhar, but she must use her magical abilities to protect their happiness from Mazhar's mother, who is unaware of Ruhsar's presence, makes her best to remarry his son with another woman.

The students of all the fairytale characters attend Ever After High, where they are either Royals (students who want to follow in their parent's footsteps) or Rebels (students who wish to write their own destiny).

After failing to make the cut to join the now powerhouse Mighty Ducks junior hockey team, 12-year-old Evan's mother encourages him to form a new team of underdogs with help from Gordon Bombay, the Ducks' original coach.
In 'LOL: Last One Laughing,' comedians are forbidden to laugh as Philippe Geubels and Jeroom Snelders challenge ten Dutch comics to keep a straight face while trying to make each other laugh.

Missouri's Lake of the Ozarks sees a population surge during summer, with millions of tourists flocking to the area. Local law enforcement faces challenges in maintaining order and ensuring safety in this vibrant vacation destination.
Four Australian soldiers sent on a mission to a war-torn country are captured by freedom fighters and produce a hostage video that goes viral.
Superintendent Dalziel and partner DI Pascoe investigate murder, and find a bond forming between them despite their blatantly different personalities.
A miraculous shape-shifting serpent has the power to become a human. She can be anybody she wants: a wife, a seductress, a mistress, a damsel in distress--all for the sake of revenge.

After discovering Hell University, a group of friends is forced into a lawless school where murder is allowed every night. As fear threatens to break them apart, Zein fights to keep her friends alive while uncovering a system designed to make no one leave.
The real-life pirates of the Caribbean violently plunder, stealing and form a surprisingly egalitarian republic in this documentary series.

A users guide to the cosmos from the big bang to galaxies, stars, planets and moons. Where did it all come from and how does it all fit together. A primer for anyone who has ever looked up at the night sky and wondered.

Dave and Fiona are the perfect couple - except for the fact that they're not actually a couple. This over-driven and under-sexed pair of type-A maniacs hire world-renowned marriage counselor Dr. Jay Meeks to help them create a successful romantic relationship... by any means necessary. Even if it drives Dr. Jay to the brink of madness.

Follows former best friends Brooke and Peyton two decades later as they navigate parenthood and confront relatable issues like relationships, self-doubt and loss, mirroring the themes they grappled with as teens in the original show.
Tinku pretends mental instability as he joins his newly married brother. Tinku's act raises
Follows a best-selling author of a self-help book series who hides her recent separation as she starts to navigate her life as a single woman in her 40s in Los Angeles.
A big Danish sustainable energy company has had an enormous, suspect growth. Problems start, when an employee's body is found and cop detective Justesen starts investigating Energreen.
This Showcase Original Series is an erotic anthology that explores the desires, passions and fantasies of women.
Close friends trade bottle service in West Hollywood for baby bottles in the Valley while navigating bustling businesses and rocky relationships.
The story of a couple whose marriage is reignited by their divorce.
A girl, a guy, and their friends are twenty-somethings living in Chicago.

Aspiring magicians from all over the world perform their best tricks to try and fool Penn and Teller, the world-famous magician duo. If the two can not guess how the trick was done, the "fooler" gets to be on their Las Vegas magic show.

Economics reporter Bea has promised herself not to mix jobs and private life, but fails to defend herself when she falls in love with the charming bank director Peder. Suddenly she gets a tip that his bank is hiding big problems.
A Korea-born warrior girl had to be a servant at the Mongol Yuan court but somehow overcame her low status to become an empress in another land.
A man finds a mystical mask that allows the wearer to make all sorts of unusual things happen.
A newlywed couple's plan to leave the big city for a quieter life in Nebraska doesn't go as expected.
The rambunctious human and alien duo must hunt down Dr. Jumba Jookiba's 625 other experimental creatures infesting Hawaii.
Perky head cheerleader Bella's life in Texas takes an unexpected turn when she becomes the new quarterback for her school's football team, the Bulldogs.
Love blooms between a beloved prince and a fearless princess as they venture through the war-ridden martial arts world in a fight for justice.

movies.primaryTitle: The Life and Times of Grizzly Adams
movies.originalTitle: The Life and Times of Grizzly Adams
movies.plot: An innocent fugitive from the law lives in the wilderness with a grizzly bear companion and helps passers-by in the forest.

movies.primaryTitle: Sword of the Demon Hunter: Kijin Gentosho
movies.plot: Kadono village's shrine maiden has a guardian every generation. During Edo period, guardian Jinta confronts a demon foretelling a future Demon God's rise tied to their era. His quest to prevent this spans centuries.

A duplicitous, aashram based, Indian Godman's good deeds serve activities criminal and unholy, such as rapes, murders, drugs, vote bank politics and forced male emasculation. The law and a few crusaders investigate to bring him to account.
A young woman gets drawn into a supernatural system with Bible characters working undercover to help people today.

movies.primaryTitle: The Great Celebrity Bake Off for SU2C
movies.originalTitle: The Great Celebrity Bake Off for SU2C
movies.plot: Celebrity contestants take part in a special version of the popular British baking competition in aid of the Stand-up to Cancer charity.
Follow two childhood best friends as they dive deep into bad dates, heartaches and humiliations.
Bullied for her looks, Mi-rae gets plastic surgery hoping for a better kind of life but faces new challenges in college. Based on a hit Korean webtoon.
Experts help couples to learn how to enhance their relationships through more pleasurable sex and deeper intimacy.

A man is kidnapped and one of his is eyes removed by a gang of organs hunters and transplanted into a serial killer. The unwilling donor now has terrible visions as he witnesses terrifying attacks on the residents of Seoul.

Kevin and Jamie are two roommates. While both are content to wallow in their immaturity, Kevin must contend with his girlfriend Sarah's attempt to "improve" him. Jamie is always ready to provide immoral support.

movies.primaryTitle: You and I are Polar Opposites
movies.plot: A bubbly high school student becomes unexpectedly timid around her crush, occasionally slipping into Russian when flustered. Her usually outgoing personality clashes with newfound awkwardness in this sweet winter romance.

Follows four varsity friends, whose strong bond has held them together even as their journeys in life have taken them in very different directions. As they try to find love and success in Johannesburg after university.
Johnny Vegas and Sian Gibson return to Gold's whodunit comedy caper for a new series from the minds behind "Murder on the Blackpool Express", "Death on the Tyne", and "Dial M for Middlesbrough".

Prisma explores the relationships and the identities of Andrea and Marco, two twins identical on the outside, but very different in their approach on life; and of their group of friends, united by the search for their place in the world.
The mother of all wars, the epitome of all rivalries, the cauldron of emotions, insecurities, jealousies, and power play - Mahabharat.
When her world suddenly turns upside down, will Aarya become the very thing she hated?How far will she go to survive and protect her family?

Legendary theatrical madman Geoffrey Tennant returns to New Burbage Theatre Festival after his mentor's death, encountering his spirit and attempting to stage a remarkable Hamlet production amidst chaos with a difficult cast and staff.

Jack is a by-the-book detective whose habit of undermining himself has resulted in a dead-end position with the Police Dept. His partner Dan, a drunken, lecherous veteran hangs onto his job only because of one heroic act years ago.
A lasagne-loving pussycat adventures and explores the differences between good and bad, and right and wrong.
Two lifelong friends, who are both architects, form a business partnership.
A grim discovery at a construction site back home reunites three middle-aged film-club friends, who revisit their school advisor's strange disappearance.
30,000 Japanese players trapped in MMORPG, unable to log out. Veteran gamer Shiroe leads exploration of this new reality, negotiating with NPCs to bring order to the virtual city of Akihabara.

Long story of the rivalry, intrigues and wars of the late Eastern Han Dynasty and the Three Kingdoms period. Based on the classical Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms and other related sources.
Park Hoon and his father were kidnapped by North Korea and he fell in love with Jae Hee, but lost contact.
NCR Days depicts the life of a small town guy studying in a city that is completely contrasting to his perspectives in life.
Physically imposing, jack-of-all-trades loner Cheyenne Brodie wanders the Old West, finding action and adventure at every turn.

Brothers Daggett and Norbert Beaver have left home to gain independence by living on their own. Their goal is to live a wild bachelor lifestyle but, as might be expected from young brothers, they get into some weird situations.

Seven British construction workers escape Britain's ever-growing dole queues and travel to Germany to work on a site in Düsseldorf. Follow their trials and tribulations of working away from home and away from the women they left behind.
A team of teenage street racers are hired to infiltrate a criminal gang.
Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, and other famous characters present simple, funny, and visually vibrant stories.

movies.originalTitle: Wo de ren jian yan huo
movies.plot: Fire chief Song Yan and emergency doctor Xu Qin meet again after ten years.
In a world where superheroes exist, a homicide detective whose powers were taken from him investigates crimes involving superhumans along with his partner.
A single dad has his hands full raising six rambunctious chipmunks in this animated comedy.
A human family adopts a Sasquatch as their pet.

They're sisters, but blood may be the only thing they have in common. When Faith, a soap opera diva, is killed off her show, "The Sacred and the Sinful," she flees the tabloids by moving to the suburbs with her sister, Hope's, family.
An outcast in a prominent fashion company, a sweet-hearted and unattractive assistant falls hopelessly in love with her boss.

In 13th century Anatolia, as the Mongol threat looms and internal turmoil rages, Rumi, a wise spiritual figure, emerges to assuage people's fears. His timeless words unite reason and compassion, inspiring change.

Frustrated with dating, Sam and Lizzie follow rules from "The Girl's Guide to Depravity" to navigate Chicago's singles scene, prioritizing self-protection over romance until unexpected love comes their way.
After ten years, a loyal employee is framed for embezzlement, then murdered by his employers, only to be reborn as their youngest son with a yearning for revenge guiding his hostile takeover.
Thrilling yet poetic tale woven around an ensemble of characters and the gambles they're willing to take, in pursuit of their dreams, passion, ambition and love
British sitcom about a father-and-son rag-and-bone business in London. The intergenerational divide between the miserly Steptoe and his ambitious son results in comedy, drama, and tragedy.
Charly's quiet life with family in Berlin disrupted when past associates threaten them, forcing him to steal coin. Charly and driver Joseph, fatefully collided, now flee with family to escape danger.

movies.primaryTitle: Cousins by Name Lovers in Secret
movies.originalTitle: Cousins by Name Lovers in Secret

movies.plot: A global cataclysm, caused by a fatal accident in Geneva (Switzerland) during the implementation of the particle accelerator will lead to crew of vessel-school Estrella Polar to live the adventure of their lives.
Based on the award-winning educational apps, the StoryBots are curious little creatures who live in the world beneath our screens and go on fun adventures to help answer kids' questions.
The adventures of four ninjas who battle the dark lord Garmadon to save Ninjago.
Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup use their superpowers and super cuteness to save the city of Townsville from evil villains and all things icky.
A small-town housewife struggles to cope with the increasingly bizarre and violent events unfolding around her.
A respected photojournalist loses everything and ends up taking a job at a sleazy celebrity tabloid.
A covert branch of British Intelligence is assigned to investigate the strange, the supernatural, the...'Omega Factor'.
An updated version of the 1990s animated series featuring a trio of wacky characters causing mayhem on the Warner Bros. studio lot.
An Irish gamer plays numerous different types of video and computer games, shouting and swearing all the while.

A new menacing and imminent danger now awaits a dysfunctional group of women friends while remembering the memory of a deceased friend of theirs. Will one of them struggle and fight for survival as a mysterious deadly threat hunts them?
Newly crowned Princess Tiana embarks on an adventure in Maldonia, but her New Orleans roots beckon her back.

16-year-old Mila returns from a psychiatric facility after a misunderstood incident. She finds herself caught in a love triangle between her crush Ali and troubled actor Jannis, spiraling into a dangerous world of drugs and violence.
A younger Paddington writes letters to Aunt Lucy celebrating the new things he has discovered through the day's exciting activities.
Conan O'Brien and his co-host Andy Richter discuss current news topics and interview celebrities and personalities.
New blood meets old money. With immense power at stake, the lines blur between family and business.

movies.primaryTitle: My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World!
movies.originalTitle: Tensei kenja no isekai Life ~Dai ni no shokugyô wo ete, sekai saikyô ni nari mashita~
movies.plot: It tells the story of Yuji Sano who inadvertently accepts a summon to another world. Now, he has to get back to the mountain of work he left behind.
A young man from Earth enlists in the army to attack rebels on the Moon, only to find that his former best friend has become his enemy.

In an old house, tenants with hidden traumas enter the orbit of owner Jahan Ara. The peaceful facade crumbles as relationships strain, revealing manipulation and power struggles beneath surface kindness.
The heirs of a wealthy Southern businessman hatch a plan to get a piece of his fortune.

"60 Days In" offers an unprecedented look at life behind bars at Indiana's Clark County Jail. Seven ordinary people volunteer to live among its general population for 60 days, without fellow inmates or staff knowing their secret.
Two sisters see their world turned upside down when they discover a horrifying and otherworldly secret involving their parents.

The story of Jimmy Savile's life from his working-class roots, to his rise to TV stardom as a BBC presenter, and his later years when he managed to keep his reign of sexual abuse concealed until after his death in 2011.
A raw young officer and a handful of desperate men. A thousand miles of enemy infested ocean: and a ship that would not die.

Biel, a resident at a public hospital, has spent months dedicating his life to becoming a doctor. A general strike protesting cuts to public health Biel and residents consider supporting the strike, which could have fatal consequences.
A 14-year-old takes ownership of a toy company and hires a group of his friends to help him create amazing new toys.

Updated remakes of classic stories from Alfred Hitchcock Presents (1955) and The Alfred Hitchcock Hour (1962), originally produced by the Master of Suspense. His original opening bits are colorized for re-use here.
The story of an elite marine force based in Pensacola, Florida.
Loving parents are forced to make a harrowing decision about their daughter's medical care.
A laidback teacher provides needed guidance about life for a special class of exceptional students.

Inside Edge is the story of the Mumbai Mavericks, a T20 cricket franchise playing in the Powerplay League. Set in a landscape of conflicting interests, where selfishness is almost a virtue, where sex, money, and power are mere means to an end, Inside Edge is a story that pulls no punches, minces no words, and takes no prisoners. Come witness the game behind the game.
A young man who has been secretly cloned by his godfather scientist falls in love with a Moroccan girl from a rigorous family.

A missing teenager and the father desperately begins his search on his own. The dramatic situation his family is in deepens the crisis of their mutual relations, misunderstanding, emotional distance and lack of ties.
They present the news and information source of the day's topics and journalism.

Justin returns from living abroad in the hope of reconnecting with the biological daughter that he gave up for adoption. His plans go awry when he finds out his father left the family cottage to his stepsister.

movies.primaryTitle: My Stepmom's Daughter Is My Ex
movies.originalTitle: Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta
movies.plot: Former couple Mizuto and Yume reunite as step-siblings when their parents announce a marriage on the day before high school. To prioritize their parents' relationship, they establish a rule to not engage in any sexual activities.

In turbulent Dongguo, reporter Song Ran meets demolition engineer Li Zan. Their shared ideals spark romance, cut short by an explosion. Back home, they face guilt until reuniting to plant olive seeds, symbolizing recovery.
Stories about the kind of love you've always dreamed of and toxic romance you need to avoid. Relationships are never easy.
The wild world of competitive college cheerleading.

A criminal gang fleeing a botched jewelry heist is forced to hide out in a beach side estate where two women live in seclusion. Their world turns into a tension filled hothouse of secrets, betrayal and desire.
A parody of reality dating shows in the vein of "The Bachelor" and "The Bachelorette".
Robin of Loxley, otherwise known as Robin Hood, and his band of Merry Men protect England from the evil machinations of Prince John while King Richard the Lionheart is away fighting in the Crusades.
Complex overtones surround the kidnapping of a wealthy New York family's 15-year-old son, leading a specialist and a retiring FBI agent to figure it out.
After losing her biggest client, talent agent Paquita starts a search for new stars.
Survivors share their stories and experience of survival abroad.

movies.primaryTitle: Inside Look: The Assassination of Gianni Versace - American Crime Story
movies.originalTitle: Inside Look: The Assassination of Gianni Versace - American Crime Story
movies.plot: An inside look at the making of American Crime Story: The Assassination of Gianni Versace.

The Best Years is a new Danish feel-good comedy series about how crazy life is for families with children. It explores how people often have young children while their career, job, and finances demand the most from them. And how it can sometimes feel impossible to keep up and have enough energy for life, all while it seems like everyone around you has figured life out much better than you.
Follows the famed queen Marie Antoinette, who was the last queen of France before the French Revolution.
Etta Tiger Jonze seeks to avenge her family's murder and become the most powerful crime queenpin in South Florida.
A ragtag civilian patrol squad created to improve the image of the police inadvertently put their lives at risk when confronting some strange criminals.
A carefree cow named Otis becomes the leader of all of the animals in the barnyard.

movies.primaryTitle: The Curious Case of Natalia Grace
movies.originalTitle: The Curious Case of Natalia Grace
movies.plot: Challenging expectations, Investigating whether Natalia Barnett is an exploited Ukrainian child with dwarfism or a dangerous adult pretending to be a child.
After 32 years of service, Border Patrol agent Ben Clemens finds himself helping people he has always tried to keep out of the United States.
The adventures of the masked Texas Ranger and his Native American partner.
A disgraced former rugby star returns as a coach to his high school's struggling team, where he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and helps the determined captain lead the team to redemption.
A story of a lawyer with unusual style who only charges 1,000 won (roughly 1 dollar) for his service to fight for clients that are up against the richest and most privileged.
When many deaths occur in the quiet village of Sotoba, Doctor Toshio Ozaki initially suspects an epidemic but soon becomes convinced that something else is causing them.
A dead cop, sentenced to Hell, is returned to Earth by the Devil to recover 113 escaped evil spirits.
Game thieves, diamond smugglers and big game hunters endanger the animals in the African bush. But Dr. Tracy and his daughter Paula defy the constant danger.
Best friends Paige and Frankie express their offbeat individuality through funny music videos on their vlog channel "Bizaardvark."
Mike Nelson is a scuba diver in the days when it was still very new. He works alone, it was mostly carried through his voice-over narrations. These gave the show a flavor of a radio program.
A darkly comic and unconventional drama about a crime family's inner life, told through the eyes of its daughter, who is searching for love.
Ku San Young works and studies at night to become a public officer. After receiving a relic from her dead father mysterious deaths take place around her, and she finds herself slowly changing.
Unscrupulous and arrogant murder detective Evert Bäckström finds himself with the hardest case he ever had when a skull pierced with bullet holes is found on an uninhabited island in the archipelago.
A series of stand-alone short stories that dive deeper into the key themes and characters from the expanding Star Trek universe.

It follows Vivian Cunningham, who winds up helping people who come too close to the edge as she endures her own comedic catastrophes like accidentally burning down her brother's vegan food truck with a vape.
Two best friends set their sights on becoming the world's greatest skateboarders.
Two men from different worlds - Sanwal and Aliyaar - cross paths with the enigmatic Piya. Against a backdrop of wealth and deception, their destinies become forever linked through love and betrayal.

The series follows Qian Hongchu of the Wuyue Kingdom, charting his youth and his accomplishment of "Na Tu Gui Song." Through a young monarch's eyes, it shows how the chaotic Five Dynasties shifted from fragmentation to unification.

Two rival politicians from different backgrounds rise through Andhra Pradesh's power structure in the 1970s-80s. KKN and MSR navigate caste politics and personal ambition during a pivotal era in Indian history.
A mystery melo who depicts the story of a dangerous woman who may be a serial killer, and a man who falls in love while tracking her.
The 3D animated remake of the popular series The Smurfs (1981).

After witnessing the sudden implosion of Earth from orbit, a group of five Odyssey astronauts is sent five years back in time by an alien force to find the cause and prevent the disaster. A vast conspiracy stands in their way.

When teenagers, Harry and June, run away from their repressive families to be together, they're derailed by an extraordinary discovery--June's ability to shape-shift. A scientist tries to capture her and discover the key to her power.
An adaptation of a Chinese folktale about a pilgrimage to the West undertaken by a monk and his divine guardians.
The Plaths are a blonde, blue-eyed family of 11 in southeastern Georgia who share a passion for music, religion, family life, and traditional roles.
Tsubasa, a Tokyo schoolboy, gets transferred to the town of Hokkaido in northern Japan, and meets beautiful girls there.

movies.primaryTitle: Saare Jahan Se Accha: The Silent Guardians
movies.plot: In the 1970's, a resilient Indian spy must defeat his counterpart across the border in a battle of wits and trade craft to sabotage a nuclear program.
A young girl with the ability to see ayakashi is sent to another realm to repay her grandfather's debt and marry an ogre.
A young girl who had her life ruined by an ambitious, unscrupulous woman returns to her as an adult, under a new identity and seeking revenge.
A fictionalised look into the human tragedy of riot police and police brutality in Spain.

In this spoof of review shows, Forrest MacNeil, a critic obsessed with his work, experiences whatever the viewers ask him to review--including divorce, anonymous sex, and all manner of criminal activity.

After numerous attempts to be popular, two best friends decide to come out as lesbians, which launches them into instant celebrity status. Seduced by their newfound fame, Karma and Amy decide to keep up their romantic ruse.
The Exodite follows the struggle of a T'au Empire expeditionary force to bring the Greater Good to a new planet.However,there are many opponents to this notion,willing to take a stand.
Set in a world populated by anthropomorphic food, Apple and Onion, a pair of childlike newcomers to the big city, attempt to fit in to their new surroundings.

4400 overlooked, undervalued, or otherwise marginalized people who vanished without a trace over the last hundred years are all returned in an instant, having not aged a day and with no memory of what happened to them.
Set in the 1960, the series follows the dramatic changes to the lives of the Akarsu family after the patriarch's extra marital affair.
About first responders involving the police and firefighters who work together in emergency situations to fight against crime and fire.
A dog named Honey who runs group therapy sessions to help neighborhood animals manage the neuroses brought on by their owners and each other.

Fictional drama about actors rebooting a global-hit TV show that they had starred in 29 years ago for 10 years. That show was real, the actors from it are now playing versions of themselves. The original show was called Beverly Hills, 90210 (1990)

Set in 1889, the story about the five remaining vampire clans in Europe who are training to survive. In their midst is Alisa (14) who has the power to choose between eternal life as a vampire or for all vampires to live as humans.
Three prosperous women, including a mother and her daughter, fall for a seductive man in Colombia's Coffee Triangle.
"Vampirina" tells the story of a young vampire girl who faces the joys and trials of being the new kid in town when her family moves from Transylvania to Pennsylvania.

"Jack" moves to New York, and inadvertently steals the boyfriend office mate's "Jill", who is thinking of taking the next step with her girlfriend. Jack and Jill, romantically involved, face major obstacles in their current relationships.

Fred Heckman, a beloved Indianapolis radio reporter, is thrust into the middle of a life-or-death crisis when hostage-taker, Tony Kiritsis, demands to be interviewed on his popular radio news program.
This long-running BBC comedy show consisted of sketches and humourous musical routines.
A group of high school students hide out from a monster rampaging the halls. One of their classmates knows more about it than they let on.
Piyali rejects dowry custom and weds coworker Rakesh despite his lower status in their shared company.
Three grown-up siblings find themselves living at vastly different levels of financial security from one another.

During Emperor Wude's reign, the Huben Guards controlled Chang'an until Lord Xiao took power. Official Xie Huai'an joins forces with allies to fight the Huben, seeking revenge against their leader who killed his father.
The humorous Friday through Sunday misadventures of four best friends.

The story of a man-turned-immortal, Bulgasal, who wants revenge from a woman with a mysterious past and present, who he deems responsible for his immortality and miseries from the past 600 years, hoping to free himself from his curse.
Drama set in 1932 during the final years of British colonial rule in India.
This series focuses on five lion robots and their pilots as they fight the evil forces of King Zarkon and Prince Lotor.
A young girl coming to a small town with her family. And through tragic events getting involved with a religious cult.
Shuichi Kagaya and Claire Aoki are navigating a bizarre, new world. With his monstrous superpowers and her thirst for revenge, this troubled pair forms a strong emotional bond.
Matt Houston is a wealthy Texan who moves to California to oversee his family's offshore drilling enterprises but spends most of his time dabbling in his private investigator hobby.
A group of kids solves local crimes, capers, and mysteries in their neighborhood, with help from a ghost who can only communicate through writing and words.

Sakura stumbled upon the book of Clow Cards in a library. Accidentally setting the magical cards loose, it's now up to Sakura to catch them all with her best friend Tomoyo, and Kerberos, the guardian of the cards.
Left-wing radicals crash land in Oslos posh west side, fighting capitalists, social democrats, cable TV and rising right-wing sentiments in 1985.

Hosted by Boris Karloff, this anthology series initially focused on ordinary crime and mystery tales but later delved into gothic horror stories adapted from works by Cornell Woolrich, Robert Bloch, Charlotte Armstrong, and others.
As enemies who hooked up one night, it led to an arrangement. I was sure I'd never fall for you - what starts from pure desire can't turn to love.

Fiona, a defiant high school student, finds herself repeating the same day over and over again. Luckily, Fiona realizes she has a lot to learn and set right in her life before she can escape the cycle. It's Groundhog Day in a high school.
This is the story of three women whose bond was all but destroyed by the traumatic events of one night 20 years ago.
EastSiders is a two-time Daytime-Emmy-nominated series created by Kit Williamson, starring Williamson and Van Hansis as a couple experiencing life and relationships in Silver Lake.
Two police inspectors and their team from a Bonn-Koeln precinct fight all sorts of criminals they encounter daily on major highways in Germany.
A pop star's fatal fall from a quarantined hotel sparks an investigation. Officer Revi Shem-Tov must solve Sarah Hacohen's death while isolated with suspects harboring deadly secrets.
The night before Christmas 1969, the gas flare at the Ocean Viking is lit. Phillips has found the largest sub sea oil basin in history. And everything is about to change.

Follow the path of the red-handled weapon used by Rick Grimes to kill Terminus leader Gareth; from its innocent beginnings on a hardware store shelf at the start of the apocalypse into the hands of various survivors, familiar and new.
The story follows Ozan, a young idealistic doctor, whose life takes a dramatic turn when his path unexpectedly crosses with Kenan, one of Turkey's most powerful crime lords.
A handsome secret agent and his team of LGBTQ superspies embark on extraordinary adventures.
Norm Henderson is a former hockey player who was banned for life for gambling and tax evasion. Now he must do five years of community service as a social worker, or go to prison.
The Rescue Bots are Transformers that work with a family of heroes to rescue humans from disasters. These non-violent Transformer stories were aimed at pre-school viewers.

Xavier is a faun-like wanderer who travels across the land to find about his mysterious origin. Facing rednecks, inflicting righteousness and preaching about the 'strong, silent types' and morality, this hero has his work cut out for him.
Ruby Red, a down-on-her-luck drag queen traveling across America, develops an unlikely sidekick named AJ.
Park Mi Jeong, became a translator because of her excellent English skills. Despite her beauty, she led a solitary life, earning the nickname "witch" as men fell in love with her mysterious charm.
Jacko is a house painter who "appreciates" women. He sees the best in each one of them and they in turn, like him. Will he find true love? Will he settle down as he gets older?
Joe, beloved choir teacher, discusses topics of interest. First up, iron!
Members of the public are pitted against superfit Gladiators in trials of strength, speed and stamina.
Four young Irish brothers are caught up in New York's underworld of organized crime.
After 18 years behind bars, Miri Matteson returns home and stumbles back into adult life in the claustrophobic coastal town she once knew in this half-hour comedy series.

Xiao Yao, a carefree girl who embarks on a fantastical journey in the Valley of Ten Thousand Demons. Hong Ye, the formidable King is reborn to safeguard the valley. Hong Ye appreciates Xiao Yao's pure heart, untainted by desires.

movies.originalTitle: Queer Eye for the Straight Guy
movies.plot: Five gay men try to improve the lives and confidence of straight men by giving them makeovers and advice.
McKeyla, Adrienne, Bryden, and Camryn are four super-smart and science-skilled girls recruited to join the spy organization NOV8.
An alien spaceship crash lands on Earth and the technology and secrets she bears lead Earth into three destructive interplanetary wars.
Applying the laws of life on Earth to rest of the galaxy, this series blends science facts and fiction to imagine alien life on other planets.
The further adventures of Buzz Lightyear as a Space Ranger of Star Command and his comrades.
Follows a San Antonio teenager balancing college aspirations, societal expectations and a hectic home life anchored by his single mom and five uncles. Based on Shea Serrano's life.

In Baja California, an elite six-member unit searches for and captures American fugitives fleeing U.S. law on warrants from Marshals, bringing to justice criminals from scammers to kidnappers and murderers who cross the border.
Amy Schumer switches from sketches to doing stand-up to interviewing people on the street and people of interest, usually following a certain theme.

A relationship-advice guru, upon learning that her fiancé is cheating on her, decides to stay in a small town in Alaska, the most recent stop on her book tour.
