It's in this remote town, where the ratio of men to women is ten to one, she realizes she can truly learn about the subject she thought she knew so well -- how to find, and keep, a good man.
A quirky murder mystery based in a housing society called Sunflower. Its simpleton resident Sonu dives headlong into a murder mystery and becomes the chief suspect. What happens next?

Two lone strangers trekking on the road - a retired Australian policeman with a dog as his only company and widowed English nurse - meet each other and embark on an epic odyssey in the outback of northern Australia.

Three bear siblings decide they need to start selling drugs to raise money to save their home, after the gas companies start fracking next to their cave. Recruiting other forest animals they will face whatever comes before them.
Panda, a former cop turned relaxed pacifist, is forced to return to the service, but in his own way. No weapons or violence and not too early in the morning. Zen, what.
The missions of an elite British Intelligence covert operations unit.
Two astronauts and a sympathetic chimp friend are fugitives in a future Earth dominated by a civilization of humanoid apes.
In 1928 Berlin, detective Bernie Gunther hunts a killer preying on society's marginalized, all while dealing with the city's dangerous political climate.
A television series broken down into 13 separate 60-minute films from premiere horror writers and directors.

A detective for a police agency is teamed with a naive new officer, who is secretly an android, and often conflicts with the Assessor's Office and the security forces of "the Consortium", a small number of extremely powerful companies.

When Rebeca returns from prison seeking her biological daughter Aura, her sister Mónica refuses to lose the girl she raised as her own daughter. Their rivalry fractures the family and tests the bonds of blood, trust, and true love.
Anthology series wherein each episode, Jacqueline Stone reads a letter sent in from women recounting their erotic experiences.

After avenging his brother's murder and escaping prison, Jabal returns to Al Hayba to uncover a terrorist plot to transform the water dam into an illegal border crossing, putting the town in grave danger.
When Sam, a former star of a successful television show, returns from rehab, her career is in ruins. However, she teams up with private investigator Eddie to prepare for her potential comeback role.

A sitcom following the ups and downs of life, friendship, and family for three women living in Hull: self-described actress Toni, her sister 'there's no place like Hull' Paula, and confident police officer Rana.
A cop is recently divorced, and to fill the void, he adopts a police dog who has also lost his companion. Together, they solve crimes occurring in and around the city of Vienna.
A local teen uncovers her family's secret past and navigates the complicated world of a South African high school.

movies.primaryTitle: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
movies.originalTitle: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
movies.plot: A paraplegic ex-jockey joins forces with an outlaw to compete in the first cross-continental horse race across North America in the 1800s.
An aspiring singer who spends fifteen years alone on a deserted island before setting out on a journey to become a diva.
After partying on a mountain, Jon vanishes. His friends' viral video from hours before is the only lead. With everyone having motives against him, was it a prank or real disappearance.
A frustrated doctor juggles his career, marriage, and family.
Sacha Baron Cohen provides an inimitable mix of global reportage and celebrity chat via his characters Ali G, Borat Sagdiyev and Brüno Gehard.
Ben 10 is the fifth iteration of the Ben 10 franchise. It serves as a reboot of the television series loosely based upon the original series.
From cold, rock-strewn moors to comfortable suburban estates, award-winning writer Ruth Rendell explores the dark fissures between friends and family members that motivate murder.
The team responsible for organizing the 2012 Olympics in London faces many challenges.

movies.primaryTitle: Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, So I'll Max Out My Defense
movies.originalTitle: Itai no wa Iya nano de Bougyoryoku ni Kyokufuri Shitai to Omoimasu
movies.plot: Maple doesn't want to experience pain in the VRMMO game she started playing, so she puts all her skill points into defense until she can't even move. Somehow it works better than anyone expected. Now she's got followers??

movies.primaryTitle: Peter Grill and the Philosopher's Time
movies.originalTitle: Peter Grill to Kenja no Jikan
movies.plot: Peter Grill is the strongest man in the world, but that means he's got a host of women who are after him and steal him away from the woman he loves.
A single mother's life after she accepts the offer to be a surrogate mother for a gay couple.

A wealthy family faces bankruptcy and must marry off one of their three daughters to Tolga, a seemingly rich heir. The eldest daughter resists despite mutual attraction, while her sister pursues him. Unknown to all, Tolga is also broke.
A New York city writer and his friends traverse the gay world, exploring their ever-evolving sexuality, relationships, and what it means to be a true friend.
Anthology series which ran on PBS throughout the 1980s.
Nick Slaughter, a former RCMP and DEA agent, who had left the company after being fired from his job, moves to the Florida town of Key Mariah to set up a detective service.
A shy schoolgirl meets a laid-back boy with lemon-yellow hair.

The spooky family - Gomez, Morticia, Wednesday, Pugsley, Uncle Fester, Granmama, Lurch, Thing, and Cousin Itt - have a lot of neighbors and other outsiders who show up and get freaked out by the family's macabre shenanigans.
The story of a woman who, after her husband disappears one day, tracks down the secret behind his disappearance and encounters a large truth that is too much to handle.
An anthology which traces the lives of five real women who break the shackles of a male chauvinistic taboo to explore their sexuality and desire.
Participate in the legendary long pilgrimage of Tang Dynasty Buddhist monk Tang Shen, who traveled to the western regions of Central Asia and India to obtain sacred Buddhist texts.
Young singles seek unconditional love through attraction alone, but societal differences threaten relationships when backgrounds clash. Can love overcome class barriers?
Wander is is eager to help anyone in the galaxy, together with his friend Sylvia. Wander's friendliness often angers Lord Hater, who is bent on galactic domination, and his army of Watchdogs.
A man who works for the tax authorities ends up becoming friends with a dangerous criminal after their daughters become best friends and he accidentally saves his life.
In the 1870s Wyoming Territory, Slim Sherman and his 14-year-old brother Andy try to hang on to their ranch after their father's death.
Follows police officer Francisco "Paco" Miranda and his men through funny cases.
Asra lived a loving life until falling for Sultan who overcame a hard childhood to succeed, despite their differences.

College student Vishal returns home to a shock-his widowed father has remarried, bringing a new wife and stepdaughter. When forbidden attraction ignites, family spirals into a dangerous web of love, lust, and betrayal. Is escape possible?
Brothers Jonathan and Drew Scott help diverse couples find, buy and transform second-hand homes into the home they've always dreamed of.
A former RCMP cop turned coroner investigates deaths in Vancouver for with the help of his friends.
Dr. Marcus Welby, a general practitioner, and Steven Kiley, Welby's young assistant. The two try to treat people as individuals in an age of specialized medicine and indifferent physicians.
The misadventures of a goofy family deformed by toxic waste.
The lives of the residents living in a city apartment block in Sydney.

Elijah Kane, an ex-special forces operative and martial arts expert, is part of an undercover police team that carry out an often brutal style of law enforcement on the streets, similar to what Casey Ryback does on a boat.

Richard returns home from work to spend time with his widowed father, finding his house in disarray. In an attempt to help, he inadvertently causes more chaos, leading to heartwarming and hilarious situations.
The Berenstain Bears, a family of bears, figure out life together, and with close friends and friendly neighbors, life is never boring. Inspired by the book series written by Stan and Jan Berenstain.
A brilliant attorney and former First Daughter is blackmailed to heading a unit that investigates cases of wrongful conviction.

Feli, Lucie, Klara, Ben and Nils join Stage School Hamburg, one of Germany's most prestigious art schools. These young talents are ready to make any sacrifice to realize their dream: to perform on stage.
Filthy Frank and his disease ridden friends talk about various topics and take part in multiple life-threatening shenanigans.

Filiz has been struggling to survive in one of the city's slums, she is the eldest daughter of the family and has been taking care of her five younger siblings since their mother left them and their father is addicted to alcohol.

movies.primaryTitle: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible
movies.originalTitle: Shinmai Ossan Bôkensha, Saikyô Party ni Shinu Hodo Kitaerarete Muteki ni Naru.
movies.plot: An adventurer who served with the strongest fighters finally sets out on his own, in middle age.
An American SPEC OPS infiltrates one of Mexico's toughest prisons in search of information on the whereabouts of an American politician's daughter.
When a serial killer stalks a Romani neighborhood, a hardboiled police captain teams up with a Gypsy crime boss to bring the killer to justice.
A remote village becomes the arena of a breathless battle when an undead East India Company officer and his battalion of zombie redcoats attack a squad of modern-day soldiers.

An intimate portrayal of the daily life of four police officers, where the line between private and professional life blurs out as tensions heighten in the animated and crime-ridden city of Malmö, Sweden.

Feriha is a poor doorman's daughter. She lies about her identity when she goes to college. A rich playboy also begins to fall in love with her. Feriha's mother, Zehra, tries to protect her daughter from ruining her life.

movies.primaryTitle: No Longer Allowed in Another World
movies.plot: A suicidal writer is summoned to another world. He has no interest in adventure and just wants to end his life, but he keeps getting dragged into mishaps.
Doing scary stuff to win prizes.
After an alien attack destroys the earth, what remains of humanity has the chance to start society over from scratch.
Story of the the foundation of the Joseon Dynasty in Korea and ambition, success and fall of several real and fictional characters.
Fed up with her father, a young woman moves in with her older half-sister and her fiancé.
Experience the exhilarating journey of couples exploring the world of swinging as they meet experienced swingers and discover if it's the right choice for their relationship.

Transformers crash land on present day Earth and inadvertently cause a technological revolution. They wake up 50 years later in a world where robots are used in everyday life. StarScream arrives looking for their AllSpark.
Teenager Gô Mifune aspires to be the world's best race-car champion with the help of his friends, family and his father's high-tech race-car, the Mach 5.

Bruce Wayne is murdered and his adopted son forges an alliance with the children of Batman's enemies. As the city becomes more dangerous, these mismatched fugitives will become its next generation of saviors, known as the Gotham Knights.
NYPD Det. Sara Pezzini has a supernatural weapon and abilities to help her fight evil.

When Beto Reyes helps a depressed old woman, he suddenly becomes the legal successor to her multimillionaire company and her mansion, much to the chagrin of vice-president and now neighbor Emilio Iriarte. A comical feud begins.

movies.primaryTitle: The Faithful: Women of the Bible
movies.originalTitle: The Faithful: Women of the Bible
movies.plot: Follows a faithful dramatization of the Book of Genesis as told through the eyes of courageous and passionate yet flawed women whose descendants would shape the future of faith.
Iskender escapes his troubled past and seeks a fresh start in the idyllic town of Arafköy, where he crosses paths with Cennet Ana, a mother desperately searching for her missing son.

A man is murdered. At his funeral, four women realize he had intimate relationships with each of them, making them potential suspects. The film follows their investigation into his life and death to uncover the truth.
Rapper Toni comes home for his mom's funeral and must balance his music ambitions with unexpectedly becoming father to a teenage son.
Three autistic roommates find a way to live together and strive for similar things in life.
Tracey Ullman hosts a variety show containing sketches, song-and-dance routines, and The Simpsons.
Present-day L.A. crimes explored from different viewpoints - cops, witnesses, media, firefighters, even criminals. Each episode focuses on one case.

The story takes place in the royal palace, where a conspiracy summons an evil spirit (Palcheokgwi) with a grudge against the royal family. A shaman fights against him initially to save her first love, alongside her spirit guardian.

The tumultuous life, fantastic career, and volatile relationships of the legendary Yugoslav singer Toma Zdravkovic. The series follows the highs and lows of the famous bohemian and 'king of sorrow' that inspired his unique, timeless music.
A recently deceased young man is sent to another world and is taught magic by master Merlin. He quickly masters everything he is taught. However he has one fatal weakness, common sense.
Two spies are recruited by an intelligence agency. They pose as a married couple Mr. and Mrs. Smith when they are on their missions.
The adventures of a mysterious vampire hunter known only as D, in a world dominated by monsters.
Marco Mejia, a young gender non-conforming queer person whose life seems to be stuck in place until he lands a job working for legendary makeup mogul Madolyn Addison.
An exciting contemporary retelling that transforms the classic Tarzan tale into an intriguing mystery and, above all, a fiery love story.

The disappearance of a bus triggers a chain of events revealing a network of secrets, hidden forces, and power that transcends reality. At the center is a young journalist, Mersiha, who must decide how far she is willing to go.
UK version of RuPaul's hit reality competition show where RuPaul searches for the country's next drag superstar.

movies.primaryTitle: Last Days of the Space Age
movies.originalTitle: Last Days of the Space Age
movies.plot: Set in 1979 Western Australia. A power strike threatens to plunge the region into darkness, while the city hosts the iconic Miss Universe pageant and the US space station, Skylab, crashes just beyond the city's suburbs.
When a new army of Decepticons appear, Bumblebee must lead a new team of Autobots to Earth against their eternal foes.

movies.originalTitle: Hija del fuego: La venganza de la bastarda
movies.plot: A woman returns to her town under a new identity to take revenge on those who tried to kill her.
A medic lives with his small, strange family in the mountains, and in every episode he comes across a situation with not only his patients but also his family and friends.
Dark medical drama series following a junior doctor as he unearths the negligent practice of a senior obstetrician.

movies.primaryTitle: The New Dick Van Dyke Show
movies.originalTitle: The New Dick Van Dyke Show
movies.plot: Modern married couple Dick and Jenny Preston have comic misadventures raising their teenage daughter.

movies.primaryTitle: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
movies.originalTitle: Mikadono San Shimai wa Angai, Choroi
movies.plot: An orphan taken in by a wealthy family with three beautiful daughters soon establishes romantic connections with all three girls.

Follows Timo Harjunpää, a popular detective known for his honesty and empathy for the victims, as well as the criminals. He and his partner Onerva Nykanen are investigating a wave of murders taking place in Helsinki.
That '80s Show is a half-hour ensemble comedy focusing on a group of twenty-somethings finding their way through the '80s in San Diego.
During the First World War, Kitty Trevelyan tries to put the past troubles behind her as she joins two other girls to volunteer at one of the busy war hospitals in northern France.
Dr. Nico Tatopoulos leads a team, known as H.E.A.T, to battle giant monsters with the help of Godzilla's only living offspring.
A young boy cut off from the world meets his friends and sets off on a hard, long journey to be reborn.

In the ambitious journey of need and greed, Abhay, the poet falls in love with Manjiri, a poetess who has a different philosophy about life. Will Abhay choose love and simplicity or money and complexity?
We meet two families in a small coastal community in Norway, who are sworn enemies in the global salmon industry.
A dating game pairs singles based on physical attraction, exploring modern love through multiple story lines and perspectives.
Xiao Yan is the genius boy of discipline. When he was 4 years old, he started to practice asceticism. And when he was 10 years old, he got Level9 of the practice asceticism.
Disgraced ex-cop Ted Conkaffey is falsely accused of a disturbing crime. He escapes to the wilds of Far North Queensland and becomes entangled with an eccentric private investigator.

Explores history's most astonishing killers - criminals, tyrants, natural disasters, deadly weapons, battles, and even islands - revealing the strange truths behind the world's most prolific and powerful forces of death.

After their father's untimely death, Nicholas and his two half-sisters are left to cope with not only a devastating loss, but also the realization that Nicholas is the one who must rise to the occasion and hold it all together.

EMT Yoon Soo-wan, who had been blind, and successful surgeon Park Dong-joo were each other's first loves, but were forced to separate due to painful family circumstances. They cross paths twelve years later, but Soo-wan engaged to another.
Paralyzed police veteran Robert T. Ironside becomes a special consultant to the force.
Three nurses deal with patients and personal issues at Mercy Hospital.
A college grad heads to a big city looking for work and discovers her older sister, who's been living there for years, is a model.

Set in the German capital Berlin, the series centers around a German woman and single mother of a teenage daughter, who starts a relationship and decides to live together with a widowed Turkish father and his two teenage children.
Program that bases the choice of the perfect partner on physical attraction to find love naked and live liberating moments that offer a space in which to show all types of bodies.
The always odd and often gross-out adventures of a young boy named Sanjay Patel and his talking pet snake Craig.
The Late Show with David Letterman is an hour-long weeknight comedy and talk-show broadcast by CBS from the Ed Sullivan Theater on Broadway in New York City.

At a talent agency in Istanbul, agents scramble to keep their star clients happy and their business afloat. The agents will juggle one situation to another in circumstances that blend their personal and professional lives.
After a billionaire's death, his family members and ex-partner vie for control of his assets, forming alliances and betrayals amid settling old scores and redistributing wealth.
A crash course in the turbulence of being a teen is always on the schedule for the students at Hartley High School in this 1990s series set in Sydney.
A moving and funny drama about an exuberant, closeted family man who wants to end his marriage and live with his best friend, with whom he has been having an affair for almost 60 years.
A story about a former criminal profiler who now works as a fraudster posing as a fortune teller and the female detective who gets involved with him.
A billionaire bio-engineer brings a dead police officer back to life.
A long-running Western series set in Death Valley showcases frontier tales and local folklore, sponsored by a mining company that once operated in the region.
A group of Scottish teens with superpowers must join forces to protect themselves from a powerful organization targeting them.

movies.primaryTitle: Honey, I Shrunk the Kids: The TV Show
movies.originalTitle: Honey, I Shrunk the Kids: The TV Show
movies.plot: Wayne Szalinski is a clumsy genius who comes up with new gadgets and experiments all the time. But something usually goes wrong and gets him and his family into trouble, danger and fantastical adventure.
Bruno, a widower and strict marine with 4 children, find love in a charismatic woman.
Follows the intertwined lives of two men connected by the discovery of a serial killer in their small town, delving into the cracks of small-town America.
A woman suffers from amnesia and is forced to find out who she really is.

Follows a group of former Tier One Special Forces operators who sell their elite skills to the criminal underworld behind the front of a private military contracting firm and the FBI agent who's hunting for them.

The series follows a girl named Coco, who dreams of being a witch, but in her world only those born with magical abilities are able to become witches. However, after meeting a witch named Qifrey, Coco's dream begins to come true.
Cassie is a shy and lonely student who is only really loved by her best friend Thelma.
This show is about a brilliant forensic doctor and a rookie prosecutor who works together to solve cases.
Four friends that are always getting involved in scams and schemes to make some quick money, while trying to stay on the right side of the local crime lord, usually find nothing ever goes to plan.
During an investigation into the murder of a high-ranking official at the Swedish Migration Agency, the main suspect is also found dead, and Jana immediately recognizes something on his scarred body.
Twelve ordinary people are called for jury duty for a murder case as traumatizing as it is controversial in which a woman stands trial for killing her own blood.

Go Mi-Nyu, a girl about to become a nun, is asked to cover for her indisposed twin brother, Mi-Nam, who's on the verge of becoming a k-idol. To do so, she disguises herself as a boy and joins A.N.Jell, a really popular boy band.
A police department led by an older, experienced detective solves crimes together.

After her mother's passing, Tohru lives with the Sohma cousins - Yuki, the prince; Kyo, the hot-headed outsider; and Shigure, the playful novelist. She learns their zodiac curse: hugs from the opposite sex transform them into animals.

A satirical drama that closely looks at the materialistic desires of upper-class parents in South Korea and how they ruthlessly secure the successes of their families at the cost of destroying others' lives.

Druck follows a group of friends in their teen life in Berlin and deals with daily and current events, like friendship, love and the search for their own identity. Every season centers on a new character.

movies.originalTitle: Kidô senshi Gandamu: Fukushû no Requiem
movies.plot: In the year 0079, the Principality of Zeon rebels against the Earth Federation, sparking a war. After 11 months, the Federation seizes a Zeon base in Eastern Europe as a mixed battalion moves to reclaim it.
Food will tell the unknown stories of innovation and rivalries behind food industry tycoons Milton Hershey, John and Will Kellogg, Henry Heinz, C.W. Post, the McDonald brothers and more.

movies.primaryTitle: Summoned to Another World for a Second Time
movies.plot: Slightly gloomy teen Setsu is summoned to alternative world Eclair again, where war looms five years after he previously saved it. However, a trap had sent him back to his original world as a baby with his memories and powers intact.
A sentimental journey to the colorful Poland of the seventies, showing independent women who live by their own rules and tackle social taboos head-on.
The stories behind interesting and unusual artifacts stored in museums are told.

movies.primaryTitle: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
movies.originalTitle: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
movies.plot: Hilarie Burton Morgan puts a spotlight on murder cases from small towns across America.
An English priest is transferred to a small Irish village.

In the near future, the Earth is threatened by beings called NOVA. The only way to defeat these creatures is to use the Pandoras, genetically modified daughters, alongside the Limiters, capable of nullifying the effect of the NOVAs.
The story of an idealistic 19-year-old who leaves the comforts of her city home to teach school in the impoverished Appalachian community of Cutter Gap, Tennessee in 1912.
Ben Harper, a misanthropic dentist, has little time for most people, including his wife Susan, and their children Nick, Janey, and Michael.
Junjo Romantica follows the relationships of 3 very different couples. Romantica, Egoist, and Terrorist are all full of romance, longing, and of course, drama. It's complicated, but so very worth it.
A young woman is thrust into a world of old money and deadly secrets.
Special effects make up artists compete in challenges.
A comedy inspired by the life of Michael J. Fox.
Cruise into the crazy adventures of Tow Mater as you watch him be a fire truck, daredevil, import drifter, and even an astronaut.
In a world of anthropomorphic felines, two demoted fighter pilots battle evil as high flying masked vigilantes.
Travis Porter aims to become a barber like his grandfather at Chicago's Calvin's barbershop, where the tradition of great cuts and community spirit lives on through lively debates and gatherings.
The sudden marriage of Doga, daughter of a secular family, and Fatih, son of a conservative family, makes two families with very different lifestyles become relatives but conflicts occur.

Two female bus attendants in 1980s Korea form a deep friendship while navigating love, dreams, and personal growth. One battles motion sickness to support her family, while the other seeks escape from her troubled past.
With one paramedic opening, Dani Miller must set aside her recent heartbreak and prove herself worthy of the job while competing against the fire chief's impulsive son and an over-qualified rookie.
A squadron of giant robot pilots of a beleaguered Earth colony bring the war to their oppressive home planet.
Follows the adventures of an older Rugrats gang.
A community is rattled when a politician's son who was presumed murdered years ago returns home.

Maria and Ralf are stuck. In their daily routines, their jobs, and their love lives. These two singles would be perfect for each other if it weren't for one small problem: Despite living in the same small town, they have never met.
Follow the story of a 30-year-old woman who, when feeling dissatisfied with her marriage and family life, finds herself sent back in time 10 years following a lunar eclipse.

Impressed by her no-nonsense style as she sells sandwiches outside his offices, fashion executive Max impulsively offers teenager True Jackson a dream job as vice president in charge of his youth apparel line.
This is a parody of shows about the inner workings of an airport.
Amid a war between two rival ninja clans, the wandering swordsman Jubei Kibagami must protect a fabled artifact known as the "Dragon Stone" and its young guardian.

The magical world of CHIMA - a land ruled by animals that walk, talk, drive vehicles, use machinery and live in castles - was once a pristine, natural paradise but has now become a battle ground where friends have become worst enemies.

movies.primaryTitle: A Good Day to Be a Dog
movies.plot: An unpredictable fantasy romance between a woman living under a curse that causes her to turn into a dog when kissed, and the only one who can help her overcome the curse is a man who is afraid of dogs.
A trio of reformed juvenile delinquents work as undercover cops.
The day-to-day happenings of Gokuldham Society and its members, who live, celebrate and often face problems together.
Two detectives try to unravel the mystery of the murders that followed the discovery of a body in the Bosphorus.
Top Cat is the leader of a group of alley cats, always trying to cheat someone.
Centers on an ultra-competitive surgeon whose life is changed forever when his ex-wife dies and begins teaching him what life is all about from the here-after.
Tommy, Chuckie, and the Rugrats crew return for all-new adventures.
Millionaire chief of detectives solves homicide crimes.
Petar Maras continues his expansion in criminal underworld while saving his family.
A young girl named Blythe Baxter moves to downtown city in an apartment above Littlest Pet Shop. She soon discovers she can understand animals. She goes on some crazy adventures with the pets.

A young Portuguese woman is murdered in a small Icelandic coastal town, shaking the community. An Icelandic detective, returning to her hometown, is sent to solve the case, but must also confront her own past.

Bruno, Max, Leo, and identical twins Emil and Oskar are five friends from Hamburg in their early twenties. In both their professional and personal lives, they are prone to making poor decisions that constantly lead to awkward situations.

A look at the professional and personal lives of some of the military's brightest legal minds in the courtroom, where each attorney is trained as a prosecutor, a defense lawyer, an investigator - and a Marine.
A Muslim-American family must learn how to code-switch as they navigate the early 2000s.
The investigators behind infamous serial killer cases reveal the harrowing, chilling details of their extraordinary efforts in this true crime series.
The adventures of a superpowered teen and his scientist friend.
A live magazine programme featuring topical stories and big name studio guests.
Bean Scout Lazlo, a fun-loving, free-spirited monkey, and his two bunkmates Raj and Clam, wreak havoc on a very structured summer camp.
Theo leaves home seeking independence but faces adulting challenges: fines, daddy issues, scams. With best friend Johnny, he learns through mishaps that family matters most.
An actor becomes a stay-at-home father so his wife can pursue her career.
A young girl searches for the truth about her older sister's death by becoming a seamstress in the Emperor's harem.
The story of a small group of believers who turned the world upside down.
A first year high school girl likes a second year boy in her drama club. She acts out various character archetypes that you would find in a typical manga harem as their friendship deepens.

Stressed psychologist Nisse moves to Gagnef to start working at the health center. Once there, he meets his colleague Marika, a Finnish-Swedish psychoanalyst, and the pessimistic Micke, who helps him get his life in order.

Gonzalo, a bar owner's son, keeps failing at nightlife ventures funded by his father. Given one last chance with a new space, he partners with a self-proclaimed guru to open a coworking space, supervised by his sister Julia.

Despite her quirky look and deerstalker cap, Captain Marleau is a skilled detective who becomes one with her cases. Her humor and unpredictable style set her apart as she methodically pursues suspects.
A woman overcomes childhood leukemia to achieve her dream of becoming an on-air host at a home-shopping network.
Follows a funny and hard examination of motherhood.
When high school student Youko Nakajima finds out she is the rightful heir of a mysterious kingdom, she sets off on a fantasy voyage of danger and magic.
Kuzgun's family life changes completely as a result of the caliper held against his father, who is a police. Kuzgun will fall into a bondage, pain, anger, and struggle that will last 20 years.
Woman's petty lie spins her life in an entirely unforeseen direction. She finds herself living someone else's life in this unpredictable tale.

In 1989, school is out for the summer. When Camp Stillwater's dark, ancient mythology awakens, what was supposed to be a summer of fun soon turns into one of unforgettable scares and evil at every turn.
A sneak into the post-independence Bombay and streets riddled with crime. An honest cop's journey as he tries to protect his family.

When Dolores Roach is released after an unjust prison sentence, she reunites with an old friend who lets her work as a masseuse. When the promise of her newfound stability is threatened, Dolores is driven to shocking extremes to survive.
Follows the trials and tribulations of a group of feral British cats from all walks of society, who seek companionship while ruminating on everyday life.
A middle-aged son moves in with his old-fashioned dad.

A group of cheerful friends who help Koko avoid trouble. However, charming life comes to an end when they discover that Koko is an arms dealer, and that her happy bodyguards are elite soldiers who are "the best of the best" at something.
Female anchors strip fully naked as they present the news.

For Lisa Giordano Navarro, midlife is messy. At 50, she crashes head-on into a moment when the years she's lived meet the years she has left - and it scares her. So she blows up her life for a chance at a do-over.

Sorata is a normal student living in an abnormal dorm and he wants desperately to escape. But his plans are put on hold when a new student moves in. Attentions stray and sanity frays as the housebreaking continues in Pet Girl of Sakurasou.
Rudra, a senior police inspector is set on a mission to catch a wanted criminal with his personal life on stake.
The series follows junior investigators Stefan and Rash, who are brought together by a link between two seemingly unrelated cases.
Follows two children as they discover that their father is the toughest bounty hunter in all the galaxy when they accidentally hitch a ride into space.
A woman thinks of revenge after her life halts at crossroads but instead starts empathizing with her mark. It's a melodrama of love, forgiveness, empathy and tragedies.
Depicts the events of the christian cult of Knutby in the early 2000's, taking place in a rural small town in Sweden.
A comedy sketch show featuring David Mitchell and Robert Webb.
Crime drama inspired by real-life events of the 1980s in Purvanchal, Uttar Pradesh, at the time when state development work was distributed through tenders and the corruption that ensued.
Five female cops in San Francisco struggle with their personal and professional lives.
Phoebe leaves her job at a law firm and begins work at a family violence centre and she must navigate a path that isn't always clear, and people and events that aren't always as they appear.
It follows Gabby Brixton. After being fired, she finds her way into the phone sex industry as an operator. She becomes close to her other co-workers and she learns how powerful her voice can be.
This anthology series of terror features diverse characters facing primal fears in spine-chilling situations that stretch past daily routine.
Kraft Lawrence goes from town to town to make profits as a travelling merchant, with the help of a wolf deity by the name of Holo.
The ups and down of the fictional British football club Harchester United.
An alien spaceship crash lands on Earth and her secrets lead to a desperate war against an alien enemy sent to retrieve the ship.
An adventuresome family of experts in the field of creatures known as cryptids attempts to protect their secrets and powers from the forces of evil.
Detectives look to untangle the case of the Ragdoll Killer, who has killed six people and sewn their bodies into the shape of one grotesque body nicknamed the Ragdoll.
Follows police detectives investigating crimes and district attorneys prosecuting offenders in the city of Los Angeles, California.
Annoyed by his spoiled students, teacher Mr. Wolff changes their luxury class trip to a farm stay. The private school teens find unexpected emotions during their time in Italy.
When Nikola takes a teaching position in an isolated mountain community, he becomes entangled in dark local mysteries that point to a thirty-year-old village secret.
Mickey Mouse and his pals Minnie, Pluto, Goofy, Daisy, and Donald take their unique transforming vehicles on humorous high-spirited races around the globe as well as hometown capers in Hot Dog Hills.
Collections of short cartoons hosted by Mickey and his Disney pals at his club, The House of Mouse.

The fan-favorite cat-unicorn hybrid from The Lego Movie (2014) has adventures with her four other pals -- brother Puppycorn, scientist Dr. Fox, bodyguard Hawkodile, and boring, grey 1x3 Lego brick Richard.

50 contestants will form bands without meeting face-to-face, having to rely solely on musical compatibility and chemistry. Once the bands are formed, they will meet and have to gel with looks, choreography, and style coming into play.
Ex-cocaine dealer Jackie Price lives luxuriously selling art through tax schemes. After 20 years of anonymity, her peaceful life ends when The Seven Demons, elite hitmen, are hired to kill her.
Set in the 1960s, this British medical drama follows the staff and patients of St Aidan's Royal Free Hospital.
When human remains are found in a dead wolf, police officer Hannah Wester is forced to deal with a brutal spiral of violence in the small border town of Haparanda.
Svengoolie spoofs a different horror or science fiction movie each week with sketches, humor and song parodies.

movies.primaryTitle: By the Grace of the Gods
movies.plot: Ryoma didn't have good luck in his former life. But three deities decide to give him a second chance in a fantasy world of magic.
Espionage thriller inspired by the real events surrounding the aftermath of the 1972 Munich Olympics.

movies.primaryTitle: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Season 8 Motion Comic
movies.originalTitle: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Season 8 Motion Comic
movies.plot: After the events of the TV series, Buffy Summers rises up as the leader of a thousand slayers around the world - which evil has now started to manipulate in conspiring against them.

Dante Balestra is a philosophy professor who, after many years of absence, returns to Rome to take care of his son Simone. He has a non-conformist teaching method and establishes a very special relationship with his students.

After quitting her job in finance under dubious circumstances, the affluent and self-interested Fiona Wallice tries her hand at therapy - offering clients 3-minute sessions over the Internet in hopes of weeding out any unnecessary emotion.
The time travelling adventures of Doc Brown, his family, and his friend, Marty McFly.
Four superpowered pups work as a pack to help their new kid pals and a furry alien friend in a cute, cuddly, cosmic adventure.

movies.primaryTitle: I Left My A-Rank Party to Help My Former Students Reach the Dungeon Depths!
movies.originalTitle: A-Ranku Pâtî wo Ridatsu Shita Ore wa, Moto Oshiego-tachi to Meikyû Shinbu wo Mezasu.
movies.plot: Yuke's out for redemption. Teaming up with his former students, he's ready to show the world what a red mage can do!.

movies.primaryTitle: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend
movies.plot: Aki, a highschool otaku work to support his game making. With remarkable luck, he bumps into Kato, the most beautiful girl he has ever seen. Naturally, the meeting twists his life into a complicated relationships.

Despite his charm and success, Lee Ji Hyeok pursues hobbies over marriage. After he rejects Eun Oh's confession, they stay friends. His best friend Seong Jae secretly loves Eun Oh, and when these feelings surface, their lives transform.
Ben Stiller and friends Andy Dick, Janeane Garofalo, and Bob Odenkirk spoof TV, movies, commercials, rock musicians, and celebrities in this sketch comedy show.
The early life of Bobby McCallister, a progressive President of the United States from 2041 to 2049, is explored.

Two low-level cops who have spent too much time in a car; two criminals who are kept in the dark; two dispatch workers who haven't really clicked; and two Mexican tunnelers who are in a small space considering they've only just met.

Tells the compelling stories of people who are battling obsessive behaviors on the verge of taking over their lives. Follow these addicts as they reveal their strange addictions and meet with psychological experts.
Originally is was the saga of a working mom raising her three sons alone while her pilot husband was away, but after star Valerie Harper left, Sandy Duncan stepped in as the boys' aunt.
Ben Donovan manages The Sunshine Centre, a second-rate sports arena in San Diego.
To secure the haveli, Tiwari fakes marriage with Anita and Vibhuti joins in with Angoori, but their charade unravels when Gayatri Devi recovers and Vidya Bhabhi's ghost traps them in Ghungatganj.
A man's invention of a brain implant that allows people to share thoughts and emotions gets into the wrong hands.
I Survived incorporates interviews with stylized recreations to tell the stories of people who overcame unbelievable circumstances that changed their lives forever.

Following the death of her son in a hit and run, all Frances Cairnes wants is to hunt down and kill the man she believes is responsible. When she finally tracks him down, she tricks her way into his house and plots his murder from within.

When corruption charges strip him of his job, his family and his pride, former cop Mike Olshansky forges a new identity as a Philadelphia cab driver, patrolling the city as a roving vigilante who works with local police.
Depicts the power struggle of chaebol families. An exciting confrontation between a dirt spoon and a gold spoon unfolds.

movies.primaryTitle: Gortimer Gibbon's Life on Normal Street
movies.originalTitle: Gortimer Gibbon's Life on Normal Street
movies.plot: Life is anything but normal for Gortimer and his two best friends, Ranger and Mel, as they navigate Normal Street - an ordinary suburb that has a hint of something magical just beneath the surface.
Iconoclastic Adam Conover from CollegeHumor turns life as we know it on its ear by showing us how unnecessary, and sometimes horrible, things we think we know to be real and true really are.
A successful defense lawyer at a boutique firm becomes romantically involved with a client who may or may not be guilty of a brutal crime.
A hardworking nurse who loses her job for whistle-blowing is forced to take drastic measures to provide for her daughter.
Johnny Bolt recruits a group of ragtag supervillains for one last heist. Their target: A ruthless super-powered crime boss. What can go wrong?
Parents struggle to raise their teens.
On the run accused of a terrible crime, Manchester Detective Marcus Farrow tries to prove his innocence while being hunted by his former friends and colleagues.
In a world with human-animal hybrids, businesses bet on their duels' outcomes. Student Yuuya gets roped into kidnapping a hybrid girl by unaware friends, sparking a dangerous situation.
The American Revolutionary War is seen through the eyes of an American teenaged lad, a young English lady, and a French boy, all three of whom work as reporters for Benjamin Franklin.
In 2015 Geneva, a Swiss diplomat mediates tense US-Iran nuclear talks while dealing with the arrival of Payam Sanjabi, an endangered Iranian engineer from her past, complicating her diplomatic role.
A coming-of-age comedy from BAFTA-nominated comedian Liam Williams, who explores the roots of modern-day masculinity by delving into the memories of his own misspent adolescence.

A remote mountain home-stay holds untold stories within its walls. Fernandes, the reclusive veteran who runs it, watches as each new guest unknowingly steps into a web of historical secrets and unexpected connections.
After six years in a coma, science teacher Johnny Smith awakens to find that he has psychic powers.

movies.originalTitle: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
movies.plot: Hazel, a ten-year-old girl who has just moved to the big city of Dimmadelphia for her father's new job, explores the city on her own after her brother Antony leaves for college.
The series is story of love and break ups in the romantic world. It illustrates the present scenario in the context of fashion industry

Five ordinary people wake up one morning to discover that they are implicated in a ruthless kidnapping operation following the disappearance of the Iranian Defence Minister while on a secret visit to Moscow.
The story of two brainwashed assassins, Ein and Zwei, who struggle to regain their memories as they work for the Inferno crime syndicate.
The war of the Great Seljuk Emperor, Meliksah and her loyalist, Sencer against Hasan Sabbah, who is sworn to destroy the Seljuks.
The Portland Police Bureau's Elite Special Crimes Unit is led by Det. Lt. Everett Backstrom, an alcoholic smoker whose health is failing, but he takes on cases in special circumstances.
A metropolitan police officer becomes chief of police in a gated suburban neighborhood where vampires, werewolves, witches, and other supernatural entities reside.
The adventures of a space superhero who can become invisible and his sidekicks.
A young boy joins a temple to save his mother and ascend to become the strongest knight and inherit the throne.

For a tiny cottage in a tiny town, this place sure sees lots of baggage. Each episode, new guests bring their own special brands of crazy to this new TBS comedy from "My Name Is Earl (2005)" creator Gregory Thomas Garcia.
A 30-something guy still lives with his parents, works as a paperboy, and tries to avoid growing up and being responsible at all costs.
