Jalebi Bai, was a mere house help when she met different people with different lifestyles. But soon, with her strange and seductive methods she became the string that tied them together.
A therapist begins to suspect his clients after the murder of his wife.
Based on the acclaimed novel by Pérez Galdós, a portrait of Spanish society at the end of the 19th century through the eyes of two women, Fortunata and Jacinta.
Teenage boys use their "vocation" as altar boys to be bad.

The members of the NYPD Intelligence Division live double lives as they work undercover most of the time, trying to catch the most dangerous criminals in the city. They share their time between home, criminal underworlds, and their secret headquarter on Prince Street.

Ra Bong Hee, sole survivor of a plane crash carrying entertainment stars, returns to Korea after 4 months. Public demands answers about the eight missing passengers, but her memory loss hinders recounting the fateful events.
A pitiful cat with a pronounced lisp spends his time trying to catch and eat a little yellow canary, who always seems to outsmart his wicked plans.

Transferring to a new school right before the national college entrance exams was not part of Xia Xiao Ju's (Hu Yi Xuan) plan. But when life demanded that she do exactly that, the only thing she could do was try to make the best of it. Feeling completely flustered in her new surroundings, settling in was difficult at best; but when a misunderstanding brings an unexpected group of classmates into her life, things for Xiao Ju finally start to look up. Now surrounded by a group of friends, including the compassionate Cheng Lang (Chen Bo Hao), the straightforward Lu Shi Yi (Wang Rui Chang), the frequently dazed Qiu Yue Tao (iang Zhuo Jun), and her new best friend Lin You (Qi Yan Di), Xiao Ju feels ready to take on whatever life throws at her next. Tackling the college entrance exams with her friends at her side, Xiao Ju is certain she can take on anything. But after starting university, Xiao Jun's confidence is put to the ultimate test when she realizes that the boy she loves only has eyes for Lin You.   Struggling to make sense of the complicated world of love and friendship, Xiao Ju relies heavily on the strength and support of Shi Yi. Little does she realize that Shi Yi has developed rather strong feelings for her. Will her longing for another keep her blind to the love before her or will Shi Yi's patience pay off in the end?
When Avishai is found dead in his bed his friends decide to hide is death for 5 days, to allow him to win the Nobel prize.
Serious news reports, analysis and no-holds-barred interviews with leading politicians and public figures.
Takaya, an ordinary high school boy, gets drawn into an ancient war of darkness and tragedy when he discovers that he is the reincarnation of a feudal lord from Japan's Warring States Period.

Two Han Solo wannabes, Morris and Ty, fly the winged starship Space Hoopty with sassy computer Loquatia. They go on adventures, facing brother-in-law Vashti's insults and competition from bounty hunter Amma.

In a light comedic setting, a young man inherits a local sports club and faces funny situations and daily challenges, from managing the team to dealing with competitions, media drama, and behind-the-scenes chaos.
Choe paints a portrait literally and figuratively of his guests. From the walls of his childhood home, Choe will talk to his guests as a motivational interviewer and compassionate listener.
After being released from prison, the couple finally meet their fiancé. Will their love survive after prison when the bars are gone? Is it true love or just a sham?
Felix is a software developer who works for the department of software at an important anti-virus company.

Jiang Shuo, an amnesiac, buys haunted houses to resell. He crosses paths with Qin Yi Heng, a psychologist searching for his father, and Yuan Mu Qing, the daughter of a general. Together, they investigate mysterious forces targeting them.
Donny, a responsible adult with a childlike innocence, seeks guidance and life advice from his friend Cory, a thirty something father who has been sleeping on his couch for a while.
Despite turning 40 years old, engineer Stefan Karwowski's life, both professional and personal, is still full of challenges and surprises.

SCANDAL MADE ME FAMOUS is a documentary series that shows the unforgettable stories that turned everyday people into household names - from Casey Anthony and Lorena Bobbitt to Amy Fisher and Tonya Harding. Each hour-long episode unfolds in the storytelling tradition of the fan favorite original series MURDER MADE ME FAMOUS but SCANDAL MADE ME FAMOUS proves you don't have to kill to become a notorious celebrity - you just have to be a part of a killer scandal.

Babur has the mission to kill the son of his father's murderer in his happiest day. However there is a problem that Can(the son of the murderer) is in love with his childhood friend (Zeynep) and he cannot open his heart to her. And due to this desperate love he is unhappy. So, Babur must firstly make Can happy and then kill him.
Activist film director Michael Moore hosts a show where he continues his crusade to expose wrongdoing by the high and mighty.

First announced under the working title "MY AMERICAN FRIEND", this series is about the bond between two girls, MAGGIE (an American fashion student) and BIANCA (the daughter of an industry mogul). Together they start a rock band in Milan.

The O'Keefe parents had home schooled their children for most of their lives and with the dramatic and comic interest arising in situations where the children were beginning to experience the outside world.

College Behind Bars is the inspiring, emotional, and deeply human story of men and women struggling to earn college degrees while in prison for serious crimes. In four years of study they become accomplished scholars, shatter stereotypes, reckon with their pasts, and prepare to return to society. This is a groundbreaking exploration of incarceration, injustice, race in America and the transformative power of education.
Bridging the gap between "Gotham" Season 2's first and second half, this web series unveils the latest challenge to Penguin's leadership, Mr. Freeze.

Five years ago, Wu Gang was killed by a drug trafficking organization named "K", and his son Wu Zhen Feng was expelled from the police force. Utterly dissipated, Wu Zhen Feng boards the bus to the borders while his best friend Chen Yu chases after him relentlessly. Along the journey, the two were almost kidnapped. While saving his best friend Chen Yu, Wu Zhen Feng was brought away by the drug traffickers, and there has been no news of him ever since. When the two meet again, Chen Yu becomes a narcotics policeman while Wu Zhen Feng is now a famed murder suspect known by the nickname "Addict Lord". Ignoring public dissension, Chen Yu sets out to find the truth and clear Wu Zhenfeng's name, but he gradually discovers that Wu Zhen Feng's return has another purpose. The two best friends begin a game of cat and mouse.

The post-apocalyptic story follows Kenshiro, a martial arts master, as he protects the weak from violent gangs while wandering the nuclear wasteland. He contends with rival martial artists including his brother, who rules the new world.
Against her mother's wishes, Emilia pursues her dream of becoming a singer. When she meets her idol Ángel, the two find their voices, fall in love, and confront the pros and cons of fame.
A group of teens in the 23rd century are stranded in an intergalactic spaceship and must make the journey home by themselves.
Tenth edition of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup, co-hosted by Board of Control for Cricket in India and Sri Lanka Cricket.
The life of 15-year-old Lux who was abandoned in foster care takes an unexpected turn when she applies for emancipation and the judge makes her stay with her biological parents.
Within a high school is hidden the gate to the netherworld. Its students and teachers must fight demons who want the gate opened.
A man dies in a car crash, but awakes with the spirit on another person. He becomes the head of two families and he agonizes over his two different wives.
A one-ring circus travels through the American West in the 1880's.

movies.primaryTitle: I Saw You in My Dream
movies.originalTitle: I Saw You in My Dream
movies.plot: Shortly before his 20th birthday Ai starts to have prophetic dreams about Yu, his neighbor skilled in driving him crazy. And not just that dreams seemingly come true, but also the more and more romantic nature of them leaves Ai confused.
Bugs Bunny and all his cartoon friends are stage performers entertaining audiences with 7 features per show, all of which are classic theatrical cartoons from the 1940s, 1950s, and 1960s.

Uso Ewin gets himself tangled in a battle between the Yellow Jacket and guerrilla resistance League Militaire. Following his heart, Uso pilots the resistance's mobile suit and goes against the Zanscare Empire of space.
The adventures of "Pantheos", a rich Greek family, in the first years of World War II.

Five teenagers are chosen from their small town of Angel Grove by an intergalactic being and a futuristic robot to become legendary heroes, the Power Rangers after an ancient evil is freed from a space dumpster, hidden on the moon.
Sebastian Maniscalco combines his love for food and comedy and explores the gastronomic world, also having a good time with some special guests during his culinary education.

movies.originalTitle: Dao Mu Bi Ji 2: Nu Hai Qian Sha
movies.plot: In this sequel to the hit drama, another tomb-raiding expedition leads the group of explorers beneath the sea. In an ancient Ming Dynasty ship, they encounter monstrous creatures and puzzling traps.
Dramatic re-creations of crimes culled from FBI files, including interviews with agents and witnesses, and clips from surveillance films and news coverage.
A documentary style behind-the-scenes look at the KHBX news team.

movies.primaryTitle: Not for Ourselves Alone: The Story of Elizabeth Cady Stanton & Susan B. Anthony
movies.originalTitle: Not for Ourselves Alone: The Story of Elizabeth Cady Stanton & Susan B. Anthony
movies.plot: The story of Elizabeth Stanton and Susan B. Anthony and their life long fight to bring equal rights to women.
A large group of survivors seek shelter while travelling on a train after their station was attacked by aggressive, undead creatures called Kabane.

In a wild reality show set in a luxurious villa, fierce women and dominant men navigate ruthless challenges, betrayal, and fragile alliances-where survival depends on loyalty, strategy, and fierce protection.
Yoshino and Shuichi are two friends, both starting at a new school, both starting puberty, and both transgender. This series follows them as they come out and find acceptance.

An upbeat family-oriented TV miniseries with a mishmash of different generations and different attitudes towards relationships. The difficulties that arise between mother and daughter mostly due to the men they are having a relationship with becomes the central plot that illustrates the challenges that single moms and divorcees face in today's society. Their lives and the lives of the people they are connected to are depicted in a way that viewers can relate to through a fuzzy warm feeling called love.
A group of fishermen from rival villages who inadvertently trespass into international waters and find themselves imprisoned in a foreign jail.
A fugitive geneticist and four of his creations search for others of their kind while attempting to stay a step ahead of a morally ambiguous government agent.

A broke ex-friend of the Prince of Wales schemes for money while his romantic son pursues wealthy heiresses. Their servant Grunge, secretly richer than his master, gets unwillingly dragged into their plots.

When her sister gets blackmailed by a ruthless sex club owner, Dakota James is desperate enough to offer a contract relationship to Jaxon Shaw, a mysterious billionaire who never touches his lovers. Until Dakota. From her first touch, Jaxon starts to feel. Their secret relationship ends brutally when Dakota discovers she's dying and breaks up with Jaxon to protect him. When Dakota gets in too deep with the club owner, she is saved by the masked man Hades-Jaxon in disguise. But time is running out for the fated lovers. Will Jaxon uncover Dakota's deadly secret in time to save her? Or will the forces against them destroy their love before it's too late.
A documentary series on combat ships through the ages, from the 16th century to the present day.

movies.primaryTitle: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons
movies.originalTitle: Zero no tsukaima: Futatsuki no kishi
movies.plot: In this continuation of the previous season, not long after the war, Louise and Saito seemingly getting along now since she knows that he had given up his only chance to return to Tokyo for her. The story continues as Louise begins to use Void Magic from a mysterious secret book she had received from her majesty Henrietta, while a new villain has appeared in town causing trouble.

Bert Gramus and Rufus Butterworth were childhood chums who decided to pool their savings and purchase a diner, which they called "Bert's Place". Originally bachelor Rufus worked as a cabdriver while Bert and his wife Claudia operated the diner, but Rufus eventually quit his cabbie gig. Some of their regular customers were Hal, Andy, and Big Tom.

Thup, with heightened senses, and Singha investigate mutilated bodies in the forest, uncovering unforeseen dangers beyond logic and the culprits themselves as they delve into the mysterious murder case.

Follows the Karen Read trial, a court case that gained national attention around the death of a Boston police officer found dead in the snow. His girlfriend, Karen Read, became the primary suspect and was charged with first-degree murder.

From college sweethearts to lifelong partners, Pafun and Aioon build a loving, devoted life together-dreaming of a family that seems just out of reach. When Pafun's longing for motherhood deepens, their hope grows around the promise of adopting a child someday. Everything changes when their best friend, Nubnueng, returns unexpectedly and brings a life-altering opportunity. As love, loss, and responsibility collide, the couple must navigate heartbreak, resilience, and the challenges of becoming new parents. Fulfill is a tender, emotional journey that celebrates chosen family and the power of love to complete what life leaves unfinished.

Kirisawa Shogo was a high school student, and a good boxer. After his wife died, his life has become a mess. One day, his friend asks him to coach a boxing team. He accepts the coaching position and he begins to feel alive again.
Showcases the backstory of the universe where humans fight monsters with massive mechanized warriors called Jaegers.
Judge Judy Sheindlin, a former judge from New York, tackles actual, small claims cases with her no-nonsense attitude in which damages of no more than $5,000 can be awarded.
Updated prequel to "The Archies" of the 1960's follows the gang in Jr. High.
People should live in such a way that they are ready to meet death at any moment.
Attorney Madhav Mishra represents Raj Nagpal, discovered with murdered nurse Roshni Saluja after his child's party. As the trial unfolds, hidden facts emerge, questioning identities.

movies.primaryTitle: The Familiar of Zero: Rondo of Princesses
movies.originalTitle: Zero no tsukaima: Purinsesse no rondo
movies.plot: Following Saito's heroic actions in the war with Albion in the second season, Saito and Louise return to Tristain, only to have the runes which bind Saito and Louise disappear. Saito and Louise struggle with a relationship no longer defined as Master and Familiar, as they search for an elf who has the power to restore the dead to life, and may hold the key to understanding Saito's loss of the Gandalfr's power.
Celebrity Apprentice Australia is about celebrities that take on challenges such as financial, retail and many more and then they go to the board room and face elimination or 'firing'

Sabrina's life crumbles when she finds out her husband, Chris, is cheating on her with her best friend, Brenda. Pregnant and heartbroken, Sabrina must decide her next move. Will she seek revenge or rise above the betrayal?
Nuri Kantar and his family migrate from Anatolia to Istanbul. While family members continue their traditional lives, they also try to keep up with the rules of the big city.
Gonca, a high spirited peasant girl, takes the roads to find her sister Yonca, who has a completely different lifestyle, years after their separation at birth.
The astonishing story of the unprecedented relationship between acclaimed author and journalist Jillian Lauren and the most prolific serial killer in American history, Sam Little.

A gripping exploration exposing the psychological machinations and immoral behavior that define the most nefarious criminal types. Every episode of the series delves into the ardent backgrounds of infamous criminals with commentary from world leading experts.
A slick, street-smart private eye and top disguise artist solves various crimes with a little help from his friends and also takes care of his dad, a bar owner.

In an alternate 1996, the US and USSR take the Cold War to Mars. A group of teenage cadets, the Cosmic Culture Club, are sent as a message of goodwill to both sides by being assigned to the neutral UN base on Mars. However, it's not long before their visit is interrupted by a group of unidentified giant mecha that battle around the base, leading to the deaths of many personnel and teenagers. After reaching shelter and failing to communicate with the US or USSR bases on Mars, the group is approached by a young man named Eiji, who informs them that he's from a planet called Grados and that the Earth is in danger.

After the founder's death, his widow defies expectations by taking over the funeral home against the right-hand man's plans, facing competition, internal conflicts and a #metoo case that threatens the company's legacy.
Follows a new generation of superhuman Gladiators as they compete in a test of speed and strength against brave everyday contenders.
Saadat and Sakina are a traditional couple. Saadat doesn't allow Sakina to leave the house. Their kid is Shuja
Murder mystery interwoven with the historical events of England's Gordon riots of 1780, based on the novel by Charles Dickens.

What kind of life would Ibrahim Büyükak have if he did not pursue his dreams and continued to stay with his family in Bursa? Abandoned by his fiancee and living with his family, 35-year-old Ibrahim will go his own way?

movies.primaryTitle: The Game: You Never Play Alone
movies.originalTitle: The Game: You Never Play Alone
movies.plot: A career-driven game developer fights back against misogynistic expectations after she becomes the target of brutal attacks online and in real life.
Unexpected, a new series following the journey of three pregnant teen couples and the parents who raised them.
A single dad balancing new fatherhood crosses paths with his long-lost ex, reigniting old feelings and uncovering the truth behind their broken past.
The story of the meeting of two people who never should have met. A passionate love story that twists the hands of fate and changes lives.

A young, single anthropology professor at a Montreal university teaches his students about the social and sexual behavior of other cultures while struggling to understand the rapidly changing rules of the local dating scene.

Here and Queer made its debut in September 2022 with the goal of celebrating and amplifying queer artists during a time when LGBTQ people are seeing a rise in intolerance and a decrease in safe spaces in Canada and around the world.

movies.originalTitle: Bao hu wo fang cheng zhu da ren
movies.plot: In ancient times, there were two cities, Mu-Xi and Xuan-Yue, which had been at odds for generations and attempted to annex each other. The old Castellan of Mu-Xi City has no son under his knee, only his daughter Ye Zhaonan. The old Castellan was worried that Zhaonan would inherit the position of Castellan as a woman, fearing the possibility of clan usurpation. Constipation secretly concealed the daughter's gender, and he ordered Zhaonan to dress up as a man from a young age. In an accident, Ye Zhaonan fell into trouble and became a palace maid in Xuan-Yue Palace, suffering from various forms of bullying that she had never experienced before. However, her innate temperament as a Castellan in the deep palace was particularly unique, which was why she, along with the Xuan-Yue Castellan Liu Xuanming, A legendary story has been staged, 'One mountain cannot accommodate two tigers unless they are Castellans'.
Anthology presenting plays adopted from Pulitzer Prize winning stories, plays, novels, etcetera.
A girl goes on to live difficult times when she chooses to step outside the path her parents had laid out for her.

In this documentary the origin of house music is being explained. It starts in Chicago in the "Warehouse" club. This later became the Genre called just "House" because people wanted to buy music which they heard in the Wearhous. The character "Jack" which is often mentioned in house songs is also explained. Early 90s it got to England. Here the genre House splits in many different ways. Drum and Bass and Techno is mentioned. Also the rave scene is explained.

movies.originalTitle: Wo jiu shi zhe ban nü zi
movies.plot: Blessed with prophetic dreams, Ban Hua uses her gift to shield her family. Meanwhile, Rong Xia unravels mysteries surrounding his imperial roots. Their intertwining journeys lead to an unexpected love story.
Based around RK Multispeciality Hospital and its doctors, who are resilient as they deal with medical and personal challenges.

Shen Buyan meets demon queens while trying to save Lu Yuan, leading to a millennium-spanning love story where their timelines run opposite - as she falls in love, he's already lived it, and vice versa.
The series follows the quirky Dr Qin as he uncovers a variety of bizarre cases along with his trusted associate, Detective Lin Tao, and eager assistant, Li Da Bao.
Jeremy Wells acts as Taskmaster in this New Zealand edition of Taskmaster (2015), with Paul Williams acting as his assistant.

The anime will follow the adventures of Baron, a man living on continent of Arad in the year 981 after "the cursed light of Kazan" has fallen across the land. Thanks to the curse, one of his arms has become possessed. After finding a sword that has been possessed by the spirit Roxy, he embarks on a quest to unravel the secret of the curse and meets various people who also join his party.

After fifteen years missing, police officer Conall Ó Súilleabháin's murdered mother, Sabine, is found buried in a bog. Forbidden from investigating the crime, he has to join forces with a citizen-journalist to get justice for his mother.
Reality TV show following eight young men and women as they spend a summer experiencing the highs and lows of Newcastle-upon-Tyne's party scene.
Kamber served as a police officer for many years. In this process, he infuriated his superiors with his incompetence, ignorance and stupidity.
The show focuses on the life and work of the officers at the police station of Balihe.

Ultimate Warfare takes an exciting new look at some of the greatest battlefield conflicts in modern history. Using cutting-edge CGI animation and on the ground interviews to bring a new perspective to each battle, every episode profiles the decisive missions, heroes, and weapons, all of which played critical roles in turning the tide within historic battles.

movies.primaryTitle: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
movies.originalTitle: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
movies.plot: Three genius superheroes, Iron Man, Ironheart, and Iron Hulk, work together in iron suits to solve problems and protect their city using unique abilities while working from their Iron Quarters base alongside Vision and Iron Pup.
The long running television series of the Grange Hill Comprehensive School, and the children's everyday lives.

Once upon a time, there was a war between the Imperial army and Ninku, an elite unit of 12 zodiac warriors led by their master. Just when the Ninku were about to win the war, their master asked them to hold back and disbanded the unit. The series follows the adventures of 3 of the 12 zodiac warriors, along with the sister of one of them and a penguin, and the repercussions of that fateful day. It is a journey of friendship, loss and adventure, as they run away from the Imperial army who are trying to eliminate them.
Two contestants battle it out to face Bobby Flay. The victor faces Bobby Flay with their own signature dish. Who can beat the Flayster?
On the colony planet of Deloyer, an unexpected coup by a corrupt governor results in a dictatorship. A group of rebels, the 'Sun of The Fang', rise up to end the tyranny on their planet.
Strong-willed Kausar defies societal barriers for her daughter Seher's big dreams, but will destiny stand by their side?
A series that ironically demonstrates the Turkish judicial system. The issues of bribery, corruption, favoritism, problems not being resolved in court and quarrels are also handled in each series.
Two celebrities meet for the first time to spend an evening in each others and the camera's company.

An Extended family and four young people are drawn into the world of ska and two-tone music, which exploded from the grass roots of Coventry and Birmingham in the late '70s and early '80s which united black, white and Asian youths.
A reality show that follows singles yearning for a life-long partnership as they agree to a provocative proposal: getting legally married to a stranger the moment they first meet.

"Against the backdrop of the Gaza war, the life of an Egyptian doctor intersects with that of a Palestinian man, beginning a harsh journey of survival and resilience where hope and humanity emerge amid destruction and death."
A series of adaptations of the short stories of W. Somerset Maugham.
Fun, female-driven police mysteries set on the breathtaking island of Martinique.
At a Scottish loch-side cabin park, multiple families deal with hidden tensions and personal struggles while experiencing brief moments of joy from their separate vacation homes.
Gideon Oliver is an anthropology professor at Columbia University who uses his knowledge of other cultures to solve crimes, aided by his daughter and assistant Zina.
Follows the lives of a group of friends in the Eastlands ghetto of Nairobi, focusing on questions of race, relationships, violence, and future prospects.

The story of a group of Arab students who move to the city of fog to study during the 1980s, bringing with them their different ideas, traditions and dreams, to begin stories of love, jealousy and conspiracies.

This dark medical examination of the meaning of human life, centering on a team of unidentified black-market doctors who undertake any kind of surgery with superhuman surgical skills and exorbitant medical expenses.
Drama about a fictional British royal family in modern-day London.
A famous tailor begins to sew a wedding dress for his best friend's fiance- but all three have dark secrets that will soon upend their lives.

This is a mystery-solving adventure story about an idol girl Xia Zao An (with a hidden personality named Ai Di Sheng) and genius detective Mi Ka Ka who experienced a series of revenge cases together and fight against a secret organization named Poker. While resolving the cases, Xia Zao An's another personality is also emerging gradually...

Otto Olsson has cracked the love code. At least he has managed to convince an investor that he did. Because who would say no to a dating app that finds your perfect match through artificial intelligence? Hack my heart is about some high school students who decided to conquer the world. The school becomes the lab and the students the guinea pigs. In the center stands the entrepreneur, the prankster and the problem child Otto. To show the school, his father and the whole world what he's up to, he enlists the help of the hacker Mira. His only friend Tor gets to do the grunt work and the YouTuber Julius is enlisted to sell the app among the credulous kids at school. It seems that Otto is onto something because the dating suddenly takes off. The algorithm seems to work. If there is any catch? In that case, it would be that everything is based on a scam. Hack my heart is a dramedy about dreams, code and broken hearts.

An architecture student in his final year accidentally becomes a famous fortune teller, pretending to be the childhood crush of the heir to a real estate fortune. Though their relationship begins with a lie, it develops into real love.

movies.primaryTitle: Will the Real Jerry Lewis Please Sit Down
movies.originalTitle: Will the Real Jerry Lewis Please Sit Down
movies.plot: Jerry works for Mr. Blunderbuss at the Oddjob Employment Agency. Each week Mr. Blunderbuss sends Jerry out on a new job, and each week Jerry finds a new way to screw up.
A game show spoof featuring a rotation of comedian contestants performing comedy challenges.
The series tells the life of Hizir Cakirbeyli. It has entered the realm of the mafia at a young age.
Anthology of new works by writers 19 and under.
Examining the use of propaganda in Hitler's Nazi regime, focusing on the Fuehrer's fascination with it as a potent tool of psychological warfare.

movies.primaryTitle: Have I Got News for You
movies.originalTitle: Have I Got News for You
movies.plot: Hosted by Roy Wood Jr. with acclaimed comedians Amber Ruffin and Michael Ian Black serving as team captains, "Have I Got News for You" is a comedy panel show which delivers comic observations from the satirical to the surreal.
Documentary series about secret wars and political influences to create conflict in war torn countries and areas sometimes funding terrorism to align political ends.
Comedian Kapil Sharma interacts with celebrity guests about their latest films while keeping the audience laughing with his wit, humour and assorted skits.
Analysing the life and feats of a selection of military leaders from the past century.

The daughter of the richest family in town, admired for intelligence and proper manners, finds love with Halil, who seeks to avenge his lost kin. Their unlikely bond faces obstacles from both families.

Follows Brian O'Connor as he seeks to avenge the death of his brother, Sonny. He must disguise himself as esteemed ship captain, Vinicio Gallo, to learn more about the powerful Obregón Martelli family, who are suspects, and find the truth.
Sunny creates a documentary series based on her experiences at Sacred Heart.
Explore the world of SNCTM, an exclusive club where members indulge their wildest sexual fantasies under the guidance of its enigmatic founder, Damon Lawner.
Cho Soran leads an ordinary college student's life until he becomes involved in a terrible incident in a small town. While walking through a cemetery, Cho Soran is assaulted by zombies.

In the town of Cocomelon, baby JJ and his siblings go on fun every-day adventures with nursery, play, exploration, and learning - situations that any preschooler could relate to. Fun, relatable stories set to toe-tapping songs.
Four creatures with televisions in their stomachs have fun in their magical world.
4 siblings have to struggle with life after their parents' death.

Miran is seeking revenge for his parents death so he plans to marry daughter Reyyan from the family who were responsible for that. Unexpectedly he falls in love with Reyyan. Will this change the plan?
Opposites attract with the love story between a bibliophile, topper and a sorted girl with a practical approach and a laid-back guy.
British version of the South Korean singing competition/guessing game hit. Celebrity performers wearing elaborate costumes to conceal their identity compete - can you guess who is beneath the mask?
Class, capitalism and one man's quest to achieve the American dream.
8 Out Of 10 Cats is a cheeky and articulate comedy panel show hosted by English comedian Jimmy Carr that uses statistics and a series of opinion polls as a basis for discussion.
In each episode, a Nude-Muse model is interviewed while completely nude.

Shiva is a young boy who lives with his grandparents in a fictional city named Vedas. He is a child superhero with supernatural powers, he faces a lot of villains who try to harm or try to damage any people and property of his city.
A monster truck and his human driver go on adventures together while learning about science, technology, engineering and math.
Contestants guess letters to solve word puzzles and earn prizes like cash, cars and vacations through spinning a wheel. The top scorer advances to a bonus round for potential bigger rewards.
When Sahsu goes to Adana for a lecture, it's the perfect chance to face her estranged grandfather. But soon, she finds herself in the midst of a legend.
Sub-Inspector Vetri uncovers a sinister plot by a medical team attempting to cover up the deaths of young participants in a clinical trial by disguising them as accidents.
When career criminal Wolfgang West gets put away for four years, his wife Cheryl decides it's time for her family to go straight. But can the Wests change the habits of a lifetime?
A scheming neighbor pursues his attraction to a new resident's beautiful wife, weaving deceptions and troubles that disrupt multiple lives.

Blippi is an energetic character that jumps off the screen with his goofy mannerisms but friendly demeanor. Children from the ages of 2 to 7 years old have quickly taken a liking to Blippi's fun personality and innovative teaching lessons.
The further misadventures of Archie Bunker, now the owner of a local pub, and his regulars.
Fraternal twins Phoebe and Jay Yarber encounter various texts in their daily lives, from labels and signs to posters, helping them develop early literacy skills to navigate the world around them.
Follows Sam Snow and Kit Casey, two brilliant agents, as they solve mysteries that mix real zoological facts with wild detective action.

A young and sexy wife deprived of love from her husband lands in a golden hole. She has various experience here. Initially she gets access to both money and pleasure, but very soon she faces a series of problems.
The Korean War M*A*S*H unit veteran operates as Chief Surgeon in a major city hospital with his colleagues.

Nell agrees to look after the Kanisky's home, as a special favor to her dying friend, and takes on the role of housekeeper to widowed police chief Carl and a parental figure to his three teenage daughters, and eventually a foster son.
Hosted by Suzanne Whang, the show takes viewers behind the scenes as individuals, couples and families learn what to look for and decide whether or not a home is meant for them.

Tom Howard is made redundant from his job as a senior aircraft designer and decides to invest his skill, time and redundancy money in a run-down local boat-building yard. The decision puts a great strain on his marriage.
Comedian Romesh Ranganathan takes charge of the back-stabbing, big money, game show. Can the contestants create a chain of answers and avoid being the weakest link?
Content creators compete in extreme challenges, plotting and spending money to win up to $1M.

A working-class family comedy about dysfunction, reconnection, and all the pain and joy in between.

movies.primaryTitle: You Can't Be in a Rom-Com with Your Childhood Friends!
movies.originalTitle: Osananajimi to wa LoveCom ni Naranai
movies.plot: High schooler Eiyuu struggles with new romantic feelings for childhood friends Shio and Akari, unaware they might feel the same way. He fears ruining their friendship if they discover his changed perspective.

Bar/nightclub consultant Jon Taffer and his team of experts offer their expertise, helping real bar owners "rescue" their failing establishments by overcoming challenges and possibly saving them from closing.

Three students from different backgrounds unite at an elite college, questioning their paths. With help from an unconventional teacher, they challenge the system's rigid expectations while discovering their true identities.
A respected family court judge and a principled woman dedicated to saving marriages and ensuring children's well-being find themselves on opposite sides of a case that tests their beliefs.
Shido meets Tohka, a spirit who destroyed the Earth 30 years ago. To prevent another catastrophe, he must romance her to seal her unstable powers.

Set in Cornwall, Detective Superintendent Charles Wycliffe, who works along with his colleagues DI Doug Kersey and DI Lucy Lane, investigates murder cases with his trademark determination and clinical accuracy.
An innocent wife and a manipulative spouse. Nobody is who they say they are. Nobody. In this world full of lies and betrayal, where it's each player for themselves. You either kill or be killed.
Follow Jared "Cappie" Capp, an unconventional designer and builder, and his daughter Alex as they alter standard, pre-existing structures into unique dream retreats.

Single mother Mary Harris is an ER doctor by day, but by night she and her partner, a former plastic surgeon, moonlight as underground angels of death who help terminally ill patients slip away on their own terms.
Hayat is a country girl with strict parents. She is in a love hate relationship with her boss Murat. Hayat is full of secrets that can ruin her career and relationship.
A modern take on the British royal drama, offering a window into the lives of history's deadliest, sexiest and most iconic monarchs.

The web series focuses on the travels of Dr. Vishesh Arora, a sex consultant from a small town. The latest creation by Imtiaz Ali focuses on the doctor and his variety of clients who all are connected to each other.

Laurence Fintch wants to be the planet's financial savior. His digital technology has been unleashed. His attempt to corner the world banks spirals out of control, bringing forth a global Financial Armageddon.

Amos McCoy moves his family from the hills of West Virginia to an inherited farm in California. Grandpa Amos is quick to give advice to his three grandchildren and wonders how his neighbors ever managed without him around.
Late night show with author, comedian and television host and producer Greg Gutfeld, offering up satirical political and social commentary with a weekly panel of guests.

Veer and Sameera, strangers with opposite personalities, are left heartbroken after losing loves they thought would last forever. When fate gives the damaged souls a second chance, a beautiful love story unfolds.
In a world of superhumans, a bounty hunter takes on a team of apprentices to get them through their lethal surroundings.
The story of a psychiatrist who, years after her disappearance, must learn to deal with the loss of his daughter.
Humko unse pyar hai. Magar kar nahi paa rahe izhaar hain Mauka diya kismat ne aisa.. Ishq ke iss khel ke liye ab hum taiyaar hain.
Real estate mogul Ryan Serhant leads one of the biggest firms in New York and pushes his agents to greatness while tackling the most expensive listings.
Anonymous cyber pirates are threatening to release a highly anticipated film featuring a massively popular star. It's up to the cop Rudra to find the lawbreakers and bring them to justice.
A woman loses her children, her lover and her freedom when she is framed for fraud committed by her husband before his death.
Exploring the depths of human psyche through diverse tales of murder, suspense, and the supernatural.
Jamie King is an aspiring actor from Terrell, Texas, who has come to Los Angeles to pursue a career in show business. To support himself, he works at his family's hotel.
In the 1960s, a family experiences life and the struggles of the era, accompanied by the well-known pop songs of the period.
A working-class mom sells fake designer goods in Chinatown, but her dreams of a better life for her family push her deeper into NYC's criminal underground.

When an army of powerful alien beings is unleashed on Earth threatening life as we know it, a brand-new team of Power Rangers, fueled by the prehistoric power of the dinosaurs, are recruited to deal with the threat.
A group of people in a suburb of Adana secures the justice in their district , notably by blocking drug use in an illegal way.
In 1783, Ross Poldark returns from the American wars to his native Cornwall to right wrongs and reunite with the love of his life.
An inside peek at what really goes on inside the Playboy Mansion, starring Hugh Hefner's then three main girlfriends Holly Madison, Bridget Marquardt and Kendra Wilkinson.
Hannah Shin a spirited Canadian/Korean teen with dreams of becoming a K-pop star and connecting with her Korean heritage.

Yavuz, a Turkish soldier, and Bahar, a civilian, are caught in a terrorist attack in Istanbul. After losing his fiance, Yavuz returns to his village while Bahar pursues him to return a personal belonging.
Through the lens of a 90s kid, we witness a family navigate through the ups and downs of life during this magical and nostalgic era.
Former soldier and policeman Jackson Brodie becomes a private investigator.
Heed the call of adventure and enter Dimension 20 where Game Master Brennan Lee Mulligan, joined by comedians and pro gamers, blends comedy with tabletop RPGs.
The mountains of North America hide dangers that few dare to face, but in spite of everything, some men have opted for this way of life in the wilderness.
A behind-the-scenes look at powerhouse female CEOs, from Serena Williams to Winnie Harlow, as they navigate their empires across sports, fashion, beauty, music, and business ventures.

movies.primaryTitle: An Adventurer's Daily Grind at Age 29
movies.plot: One day while questing, he entered a dungeon and discovered a young girl being partially devoured by the weakest monster type - a slime.
A man's moral compass wavers after falling for a psychiatrist targeted by his brother. Love and guilt collide as he navigates betrayal and power games that challenge his principles.

Saya is a seemingly normal girl living with her father in a shrine. During the day she goes to school and spends time with her friends at a local cafe. But when night falls Saya is called upon to protect her village from strange monsters.
An exoanthropologist from the planet Mars, stranded on Earth, is rescued by Tim O'Hara, a newspaper reporter who introduces the Martian to his friends and the authorities as his uncle Martin.
This comedy set in the last Blockbuster Video in America explores what, and who, makes a small business succeed.
After a mysterious disease kills every resident over 22 years old, survivors of a town must fend for themselves when the government quarantines them
Shahmeer, the son of a politician falls in love with a girl who is against the corrupt political system. In order to win her heart, he disguises himself as an ordinary man.

Secret agent Steed, working for an unnamed branch of British intelligence, is teamed up with two partners to fight evil plots for world domination, dealing with suspended animation, biological warfare, robotics, and other threats.
Retired national team female handball player has become a Banchan take-out store owner in order to look after her family while she grapples with her daughter's tutor's many quirks.
Bob the Tomato, Larry The Cucumber, and their friends teach Christian and Bible-based lessons in a fun way.
This anthology series showcases the delight in modern relationships that dare to explore their deepest and quirkiest desires.
An ambitious woman of humble background and stunning beauty is determined to change her poor situation, using her seductive skills on a millionaire doctor.
Series of daytime plays set in contemporary Britain, all sharing the theme of someone going through some kind of life change.
Set in a small town, revolves around Fakhar and Kashif, two best friends unknowingly in love with the same woman, Gulbano.

A WWII bomb group commander must fill the shoes of his predecessor and get the performance rating up to snuff. He struggles with his own men, until he is able to develop pride in the group and win the men over, but at a cost to him.
Comedians and long-time friends Rob Beckett and Romesh Ranganathan travel around the world taking on challenges.
Set against the backdrop of London, the series builds suspense with its enigmatic narrative, captivating audiences through the mysterious filming location.
A punk-ass bitch with a heart of gold goes out of his way to help everyone but himself.

movies.primaryTitle: Beheneko: The Elf-Girl's Cat is Secretly an S-Ranked Monster!
movies.originalTitle: S-ranku Monsutâ no "Behîmosu" Dakedo, Neko to Machigawarete Erufu Musume no Kishi (Petto) Toshite Kurashitemasu
movies.plot: A protagonist reincarnated as a powerful monster kitten befriends and becomes the protector of an adventurer named Aria in a dungeon-filled city, exploring the labyrinth with unique companions while enduring excessive cuddling.
Television series that documents how various everyday products are made.

Astrid was traumatized by the mysterious disappearance of a school class in 1999. Twenty years later, when she finds out that the only survivor from 1999 mysteriously died, Astrid sets off to discover what really happened.

Gifted hacker Tobias and his ambitious best friend Marco, intent on cracking into the tech billionaires club, are plunged headfirst into the chaos of organized crime when they cross paths with the Irish mob.
Dave Attell watches 70's and 80's porn along with other comedians with a hilarious twist down 'mammary' lane.
Six intertwined stories explore memories, love, dreams, and separation through antique items sold at a shop, revealing the bittersweet tales behind each object.
People married and divorced, loved and lost. Murder, illicit passion, insanity, and secrets were the staples of Peyton Place.
Televised comedy/variety show with a country bent.
Music-based comedy quiz show.
A young fan maneuvers her way into a seasoned anchor's newsroom but soon confronts the dark side of ambition, envy and the desire to be seen.
A magical, giant city that challenges centuries; Istanbul. And our brave police who challenges all kinds of bad and trouble to make every street of this city better, "livable" for everybody.
Voyeuristic documentary series about titillating sexual and erotic experiences.
Holistic detective Gently relies on the universe to unravel mysteries based on the 'interconnectedness of all things'.
A 46-year-old ex-drug addict returns to high school as a freshman.
Jack-the-lad bus driver and conductor Stan and Jack enjoy the female employees more than their work and Inspector Blake is relentless in his attempts to make their lives a misery.
After the death of their father,his three daughters have to confront the wealthiest man in their village(Doukas), who wants to buy their fields.
A divorced father and a soon-to-be divorced mother meet and begin a romantic courtship which is always complicated by their respective children and their own life problems.
Gym teacher Graham Lubbock and his wife Elizabeth live in Eureka, California with their eight children.
Follows a wealthy Louisiana family known for their successful duck-hunting business.

Zheng Shu Yi is a hard-working reporter for one of China's leading financial newspapers. Shi Yan, the businessman, is looking to make a series of investments. Could this blossoming working relationship also lead them on the path to love?
Indian edition of the iconic global reality TV phenomenon "The Traitors".
Hollywood celebrities express their deep gratitude to the people who have had a huge impact on their lives by surprising them with large and moving renovations to their homes that make everyone cry.
Join baby Finn and his family on fun-filled adventures while learning something new every time. Get ready to sing and dance.

Omar is a police officer. After the death of his fiancé he suffers great pain. Sibel, Omar's fiancée's body was found on the top of a cliff, in a car next to a fairly old, rich business man. After the shock of her sudden death and the accusations of his love cheating on him, Omar realizes that there is more behind her suspicious murder.

A distinguished surgical unit turns upside down when a strange new resident joins the team. Ali has Savant syndrome, making it hard for him to communicate with other people, even though he is a phenomenal doctor.
Kenan and Kel, best friends who live in Chicago, are always dragged down by Kenan's get-rich-quick schemes; orange-soda-loving buddy Kel is dragged along but tends to mess things up.
In a world where an app alerts people if someone in the vicinity likes them, Kim Jojo experiences young love while coping with personal adversities.
Our collective nightmare mythologies are rooted in real-life horror stories.
A dive into Paris's criminal underworld, where Lyna meets the enigmatic and brutal Furie, the boss of this hazardous environment.
A couple faces new challenges with their growing family five years into their relationship. Life together brings unexpected hurdles as they navigate parenthood and family dynamics.

Follow Red Guy, Yellow Guy, and Green Duck as they learn about family, electricity, and death. Beware the strange and dangerous twists that come their way as their seemingly-safe house reveals that they live in an actual nightmare.
A talented young goalkeeper tries to revive his school's lackluster team in this anime series based on the hit manga and video game.

Follows four women at an archaeological dig in Greece, each facing different life challenges. When they discover a buried secret that could change history, they become entangled in a dangerous international conspiracy.
One of Britain's top comedians, Michael McIntyre, presents Saturday night entertainment for the BBC from London's prestigious Theatre Royal, Drury Lane.
Children's series about a magic coin that can grant wishes.

A woman resurfaces years after a near-fatal attack to take back what's rightfully hers. Caught between two men and confronting her treacherous adoptive sister, she fights to reclaim her place in a world of deception and power.

The story of Han Li, a poor and ordinary boy from a village. In order to let his family lead a better life, he willingly heads to Qi Xuan Sect to take their entrance exam. He was accepted by Mo Da Fu, and begins his journey in jianghu.
Still living at home with his eccentric family, Patrick hosts a show based around his ever-changing whims.

movies.primaryTitle: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
movies.originalTitle: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
movies.plot: An anthology series that follows different chapters of the Midnight Society, a group of teenagers who gather at midnight to tell scary stories, such as the Carnival of Doom, Curse of the Shadows, and Ghost Island.

Tannie Maria sees food as "medicine for the body and heart". She envies romance as much as she enjoys cooking and eating. But it's death that shakes up Tannie Maria's life, when one of the correspondents to her column is brutally murdered.
An ambitious young law enforcement graduate is thrilled when her idol takes her on as a trainee. But his methods aren't anything like she imagined.
An unknown virus spreads throughout the city, transforming the population into zombies, a group of students take refuge in a school to protect themselves.
Step off the private jet and into a high-flying social circle in Dubai, where lavish parties, stunning skylines, and jaw-dropping fashion are the norm.
A group of single parents form their own support system as they raise their kids and struggle to start new relationships.
A Romanian sitcom with drama in a small village in Muntenia, Fierbinti, renamed Las Fierbinti.
The story revolves around a conservative family including a mother, father, a dedicated son and his wife. Soon story takes a drastic turn when the son decides to leave his home for some time.
In 1930s England, a man from an aristocratic family takes up the pseudonym Albert Campion and, with the help of his ex-burglar manservant, solves mysteries.

Teacher Pete Dixon tries to teach the students at Walt Whitman High to be tolerant. He's assisted by girlfriend and school counselor, Liz and student teacher (later teacher) Alice. The students love him.
An Indigenous woman in Australia is thrust into the political limelight.

Dreams, ambitions and love inhabit the heart surgery department of the Le Molinette hospital in Turin, at the end of the 1960s. The head physician Cesare Corvara creates a team capable of carrying out the first heart transplant in history.

Each week, tough-love Taskmaster, Tom Gleeson, and his trusty sidekick Tom Cashman, set a panel of contestants a series of challenges, each more mind-bending and head-scratching than the last. Who will master the tasks?

Rebecca Gibney and Charles Edwards star as two city slickers who inherit a failing vineyard in rural New Zealand.. the only problems are that neither of them has ever done a hard days' work- and they despise one another.

A mother moves to a small town and gets entangled with a group of mothers. She exploits a rumor of a child predator living nearby, fueling gossip and heightening tensions while trying to safeguard her son amidst rising mistrust.
A group of waitresses and a pianist work at a fancy restaurant at the top of a skyscraper.

A successful real estate agent wakes up one day to find out that her husband is gone, leaving her with millions in debt. In order to survive and maintain her lifestyle, Linda must become the queen of the criminal world.
The series follows a single bachelor who is given a list of romantic interests from which he must choose a fiancée.
Hilton Lucas was forced by his employer to retire. His wife has trouble with him always being at home and so does he.

The treacherous job of driving trucks over frozen lakes, also known as ice roads, in Canada's Northwest Territories and Alaska's improved but still remote Dalton Highway, which is mainly snow-covered solid ground.
Explores how a young woman's mysterious death creates a traumatic ripple effect that ultimately pulls her surviving sister into a dangerous pursuit of the truth.
Paridhi, an honest cop, must race against time to solve a mysterious crime case that has baffled the police department.

movies.primaryTitle: Winx Club: The Magic Is Back
movies.originalTitle: Winx Club: The Magic Is Back
movies.plot: Bloom leaves her human life behind moving to Alfea Collage for fairies after a dangerous encounter with a monster. She joins her new friends Stella, Flora, Aisha, Tecna and Musa to discover her true powers and defeat their enemies.
A family of raucous supervillains recently ran afoul of the League of Villains, so now they must somehow beat a path to normalcy in a small Texas town.

Carolina assumes the identity of her identical twin sister, Celeste, a devoted nun, to escape her dangerous husband. When the real Celeste accepts a charity mission, Carolina falls in love with Oscar while posing as Sister Celeste.
Two sisters in 1920s London work to achieve success in the dressmaking business.
Two top London law firms clash over a shocking divorce case that rocks the legal world, with elite attorneys from Cathcarts and Taylor and Byrne battling for supremacy.

Young boys and girls try to secure a place. Boys and girls compete tasks to stay in the show and mingle with others to find love. A couple is crowned as winner. There are a lot of fights, jealousy, friendship and love between contestants.
A group of officers who work for the Crime Investigation Department of the police force seek the help of a professional forensic expert and solve various criminal cases.
Along with his brother and his friends, mechanic Christopher Titus tries to deal with his father, a lewd, crude, drinking serial divorcé.
Pocoyo, the curious toddler dressed all in blue, joins Pato the yellow duck, Elly the pink elephant, Loula the dog, Sleepy Bird and many others in learning new things and having fun.

BBC anthology series featuring original plays, theatrical and literary adaptations. Over 300 episodes of varying lengths aired from 1970-1984, with some later developed into series, including Rumpole of the Bailey and Gangsters.

From backstage controversies to mysterious deaths and unsolved homicides, this series explores the darkest stories from the golden age of professional wrestling, and tries to find truth at the intersection of fantasy and reality.
When Maudie, a ten-year-old puzzle prodigy, forms a detective agency with her classmates Ezra, Ava and Kyle, no crime is left unsolved.
Shining a light on the industry's hottest unproduced scripts.

An intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. Led by a valiant polar bear and a daredevil kitten, these eight talented critters are always ready to embark on an exciting new mission.
The frightening spread of the Ebola virus (season 1) and Anthrax (season 2).

Womanizing Will lives a carefree bachelor life on a Christmas song's royalties - until 11-year-old Marcus and his cute mom Fiona move in next door. Will provides an escape for Marcus from his vegan, hippie, uncool, depressed mom.
Short stories of what a few primary school friends get up to at little lunch, and in the classroom.
A victim of violence, Nefes fights against Vedat, a psychopath, for her son and herself. Along the way, she experiences true love with Tahir in the Black Sea Region.

Disgraced DCI (Detective Chief Inspector) Jude Pendragon faces a year's dismissal from London's Scotland Yard. During this hiatus he covertly goes through cold case files and finds one that takes him into another realm of reality, one from which he may, or may not, escape as he entered.
A family from 2121 is stuck in 2004, trying desperately to fit in.
A salaryman reincarnates in a world of swords and magic and starts his isekai life with a set of new skills.
A reality show where four contestants (two male and two female) stay in a huge house together where they interact, build relationships and have hardcore sex.
An evil galactic armada has come to destroy the planet Earth and the newest team of Power Rangers must harness powers from Rangers of the past to stop them as the Power Rangers Megaforce.

Martin Bryce lives in a quiet suburban close with his wife Ann. He does his best to "organise" the leisure time of all of the other inhabitants of the close, running umpteen societies and doing "good works".
The series consists of hard-core police investigation stories dealing with investigation, detection and suspense.
Story of an innocent and sensitive man, Parizad deals with his day-to-day life and his love life.

movies.primaryTitle: Doc McStuffins: Pet Rescue/Baby/Ultimate Safari/Arctic Rescue/Toy Hospital
movies.plot: "Doc McStuffins" is an imaginative animated series about Doc McStuffins, a young girl who aspires to be a doctor like her mom and communicates with and heals broken toys and stuffed animals.

The Criminal Technology Section of the Yunxi Public Security Bureau is the gathering place for local important and strange cases. Led by section chief Chen Guo Xian, the investigation team, formed by Si Yuan Long, Ye Qian, Leng Qi Ming, Wan Jin, and intern Wu Dan Qing, is a young and professional elite team.
"G-A-Y: Mr. Gay Germany" is a casting show on Joyn (DE) and Zappn (CH, AT).
The evolution of a family from the last days of the Frankist dictatorship to the early 1980s.
Five teenagers are chosen by five Power Animals to become the Wild Force Rangers, to fight the evil Jinderax and Toxica and their evil Orgs.

movies.primaryTitle: A Court of Thorns and Roses
movies.originalTitle: A Court of Thorns and Roses

movies.plot: A multi-cam comedy centered around the shifting family dynamics following a good-natured divorce — and the surprisingly hilarious moments that come with co-parenting.
A group of reclusive humanoid bears and a few trusted humans explore their lost heritage and prevent their enemies from exploiting it.

movies.primaryTitle: Saved by the Bell: The College Years
movies.originalTitle: Saved by the Bell: The College Years
movies.plot: While the gang is no longer the 'it' crowd at Cal U, Slater balances 3 sports, Screech his extracurriculars, Kelly her crushes, and all manner of college parties, but most of the 2 years follow Zach growing up and winning Kelly's heart.

UK version of the Norwegian show about a surgeon who is determined to save his dying wife to the point of agreeing to treat criminals and others for cash in his highly illegal secret underground clinic.
Follows a doctor named Efsun, from Antep, as both her professional and love life are put to the test.
While investigating the mysterious death of a teacher, a grizzled detective gets caught up in the world of a high-stakes virtual reality game.
A woman seeks out ways to change her life without changing her body.
The Mystery Inc. gang investigate more supernatural sightings with various guest stars and characters.
A group of flirty singles mixes in paradise, but to win the cash prize, there's a catch: no sex. Will they resist temptation or let desire take over?
In a strange galaxy far, far away, the evil Scorpius attacks an innocent planet. Five brave teenagers rush to defend it and discover that they have been chosen to be protectors of the universe.
Tracy Beaker is a 10-year-old girl who has been placed in a children's home. Tracy makes new friends along the way and causes mischief wherever she goes.
Two homicide detectives - one from Austria, the other from Germany - join forces to investigate dark and mysterious cases amidst the picturesque backdrop of Lake Constance.
Get ready to Wiggle with the Wiggles' TV series. Wiggle fans can join in on the fun with the beloved quartet Anthony, Murray, Greg and Jeff.
A documentary television series which explores human sexuality.
A 10-year-old genius goes from elementary school to high school.
The sword and sorcery adventures of a wandering adventurer who has the ability to communicate with animals.
The five bachelors named Kabila, Arefin, Shuvo, Nehal and Habu coming from different states had absolutely no idea that staying together under a roof will change their life.

Jimena is trying to keep her life in order, raising her three children, competing for the presidency of the company and dealing with her (almost) ex-husband. Then she meets Gaby, who turns out to be the best nanny for her children.

movies.primaryTitle: Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus
movies.originalTitle: Seishun buta yarô wa Santa Kurôsu no yume wo minai
movies.plot: A first-year statistical science student at a university in Yokohama. He's an odd-ball who doesn't own a smartphone in this day and age.
Taj, Taryll, and TJ Jackson struggle to manage their lives, careers and families under the constant spotlight of their famous last name.
A dead man found with a "Super Note" pulls ex-NIS agent Ki-tae back to action. He joins forces with counterfeiter Soo-hyun to investigate, uncovering a vast conspiracy threatening national stability.

World War II is over and the boys from the town of River Run, Ohio, are coming home. It seems that life is slowly going back to normal, but war has changed everything and they will never be the same again.

Crime Patrol attempts to bring stories of crime happening all around the country. However the case presentation would be a story telling form that would have the interest of a fiction drama presentation.
After an unexpected incident, Beth starts having flashbacks to her teen self and learns how she became who she is and who she wants to become.
Two actors and a makeup artist fight to make their own way in a world that weighs the backgrounds they were born into more than their dreams.

The lives of grieving mother Rosalie and her daughter Maddie are changed forever when they meet Jed. A spark of hope for the future is rekindled within the household. But underneath, a deadly and morally corrupt triangle is taking shape.
Upin and Ipin the twin who live at kampung durian runtuh.watch their live with their friend and family in a happy village
The adventures of a community fireman, Sam.
The tumultuous, humorous events of the two years since an Indian family arrived in Pittsburgh.
Follows the employees and patrons of Jameson Public Library as they go about their lives in this unassuming and extraordinary place
A musically driven series about exploring one's world and trying new things while being smart, accepting and optimistic.
A rebellious young woman encounters a compassionate teacher whose impact motivates her to transform her life, aspiring to become a neurosurgeon.
Detective Hannah Laing becomes deeply conflicted when she discovers that her son is playing a crucial role as an undercover informant in the investigation of a brutal murder.

In a quirky rural village, seductive Bholi craves wild passion, but finds betrayal at every turn as naive pehelwan Angad falls hard for innocent Roli, igniting a scandalous web of lust, lies, and love.
This iconic Australian series follows eight people living in St Kilda, Melbourne who are all looking for the same things: love, sex, romance, success, and anything else that's worth pursuing.

A romantic professor cleverly calls two college girls, saying their physics marks are low. His real plan is to bring them home for private tuition. The professor believes no one will suspect him, but his maid Rozi notices strange behavior and hidden intentions. When the two students arrive at his house to study, Rozi quietly watch.
A group of strangers struggle for survival aboard a spaceship heading to a distant planet.
Yes even though the show was a global one on Facebook and Instagram it was all shot in English.
Thief-turned-fixer Cat Chambers uses her criminal instincts to solve high-stakes crimes for the governor of a Pacific Island paradise, becoming entangled in fast-paced adventures and island intrigue.
When evil forces threaten to resurrect Anthrasax, the God of Destruction, the Kingdom of Meta-llicana calls on a volatile dark wizard for help.
The drama series follows the story of a mother and her young daughter, Serra, as they try to get used to their new life in an ordinary neighborhood after falling from grace.

movies.originalTitle: Kun Tun Tianxia: Zhang Men Guilai
movies.plot: Reborn after a deadly betrayal, Fan Lingxiao fights to uncover the truth and restore his shattered sect.
Middle-class woman Bess Denyar discovers that she's adopted. She's shocked to find that her birth parents head up a drag-racing team in the outer suburbs.
Following the lives of sisters Tracey and Sharon who are left to fend for themselves after their husbands are arrested for armed robbery.
After high school graduation, "Laguna Beach" alumna Lauren sets out to live on her own in Los Angeles and work as an intern at Teen Vogue.

Mrs. Sidhu is a caterer with a taste for solving mysteries. Her sleuthing turns into an unofficial partnership with dour DCI Burton, who reluctantly accepts that together they make the perfect pairing to fight crime.
A group of kids and their two caregivers have built a cool clubhouse out of giant boxes. That's where they meet for music, play and special activities that kids can do at home.
A stranded urbanite and his three unlikely companions brave an eerie village with a sinister past to rescue his missing family in one night.
A skit based show with Benny Hill, often containing smutty humour.

Each game of Blue's Clues involves problem-solving, viewer interaction, and of course, a stop for "mailtime!" In this reboot, the animated ensemble cast is back with a new host: Josh, who's just learning how to play Blue's Clues.
Years after stuntman Bunny recruited struggling actress Honey for a side gig, their dangerous past catches up with them, forcing the estranged couple to reunite and protect their daughter.
The Powells are a typical American family living in Pacific Bay, California, whose members gain special powers after their plane crashes in the Amazon.
Karin, Magali and Luna are three call girls, who decide to apply some marketing knowledge on the world's oldest profession.

After years of conversations with listeners from across the world on his podcast Conan O'Brien Needs a Friend (2018), Conan O'Brien sets off on an epic journey to connect with some of his dedicated followers in person.
Recent lottery winners look for their perfect dream house in this "House Hunters"-inspired reality show.

Truth is never black or white. A high-profile case of serial killings takes an unexpected turn when forbidden love and deception come into play. In a world where love can kill, uncovering the truth is more dangerous than ever.
Detective Chief Inspector Stephan Derrick and his loyal assistant, Inspector Harry Klein, solve murder cases in Munich and surrounding areas.
Follows wiz entrepreneur Axel, who decides to recruit women from the neighboring farms for his production of electronic hair curlers.
Hoichoi Originals presents "Charitraheen", based on the novel by Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, with the twists and turns being much in sync with today's world.
Ordinary people encountering strange phenomenons that may be keys to the answer about the origin of our world and the imminent threat we will soon face.
Sex, lies and true love in modern Scotland. Following the lives and loves of a group of twenty-something lesbians living in Glasgow.

A mother and businessman discover their daughters were switched at birth. To save one child's life through stem cell donation, they agree to a marriage of convenience, but their arrangement leads to unexpected feelings.

In early 1980s a young child disappears. The lack of police support pushes the concerned parents to take justice into their own hands and launch a desperate manhunt that is seen from the perspective of the local children.

There are some places on earth where the land just seems different, and Blind Frog Ranch in eastern Utah is one of those places. Locals say the land is cursed. That it's trying to hold on to something.
Twenty aspiring pop stars undergo a K-pop training program in this docuseries about the creation of HYBE x Geffen's first global girl group, KATSEYE.

movies.primaryTitle: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy
movies.originalTitle: Loop 7-kaime no Akuyaku Reijô wa, Moto Tekikoku de Jiyû Kimama na Hanayome Seikatsu wo Mankitsu suru
movies.plot: Rishe is already on her seventh time around being reborn and has had all kinds of excitement in her previous lives. But to savor the high life, she first has to marry the handsome prince, the same one who happens to be her murderer.
The most evil forces in the universe, Rita and Zedd, Machine Empire and Divatox, have formed an alliance with the monarch of all evil, Dark Spectre.
Players start off isolated in an apartment, and with their online interactions as their only means of any communication. The players use a social media platform called "The Circle".

Solicitor Peter Kingdom runs a small Norfolk legal practice with apprentice Lyle and secretary Gloria, assisting eccentric locals. Peter lives with unstable sister Beatrice and recently lost half-brother Simon mysteriously.

A mother, freed from jail after charges are dropped, desperately fights to reunite with her son. She faces her ex, his wife, corrupt cops and the mob while staying under the radar with help from unexpected allies.
Grizzy and the Lemmings are in a protracted conflict over the possession and ownership of "Yummy" a chocolate-hazelnut spread that looks like Nutella. Many foibles ensue.

Xia Mo dreams of becoming a popular blogger. He decides to claim his parents' coastal house, currently occupied by Shen Jun Yao, CEO of a technology company that has installed scientific equipment there.
Three sisters run a café by day, and moonlight as notorious art thieves.

Tanggol rises to be one of the most notorious outlaws in the neighborhood while he navigates his way in life to survive in Quiapo. Hoping to earn the affection of his parents, his feat draws him closer to the truth about his identity.
Gary Wallace and Wyatt Donnelly create their dream woman, Lisa, on their computer. Lisa has extraordinary powers and can grant the boys their wishes for short periods of time.
Life in a fictional Tombstone in the 1880s.
A retired judge and his last defendant follow up on cases that were dismissed due to technicalities.
A seamstress and the heir to Galerías Velvet pursue a forbidden love, highlighting Latino generational challenges in America amid fashion and daily life.
Grace is a recovering alcoholic, now divorced from an abusive husband, struggling to bring up three children on her own.

movies.originalTitle: Untitled Tim Van Patten/Liev Schreiber Project
movies.plot: Ex-soldier Jonah Lynn leaves Philadelphia for a quiet life. When serial killer Jurek Walter threatens his new home and family, Jonah must protect them, even as he sends his FBI agent daughter Saga to track the killer's last victim.
A reboot of Hollywood Squares. A game show where celebrities face contestants, seated at desks arranged vertically. Contestants judge the celebrities' responses to questions to determine winners.
One month into college, a freshman dies. Was it Murder? Or Suicide?
7 different types of Shaolin fighters are collected to save the world from evil.
A couple, who were in a long distance relationship for 3 years, face the prospect of getting married.

Motu and Patlu, two friends living in Fufuri Nagar, always get themselves into hilarious situations and later rescued merely by luck, using the help from Ghasita Ram, Inspector Chingam and Dr. Jhatka.
An encounter between Incila, Naz's despised assistant and Mete begins to change the direction of Naz's future, where she plans everything with Mete with a toxic passion.
Adventures encountered by a group of refuse collectors.

movies.primaryTitle: Matori & Kyoken Men in the Back Alleys
movies.plot: A former child star turns double agent for competing drug enforcement groups following a fatal event at a Roppongi nightclub in Tokyo's underworld.
A loving wife and mother deals with situations and problems of a middle-class family in the late 1950s and early 1960s.
Follow a boy and his fire truck in a fantasy world where talking vehicles live, work and play with the humans who drive them as they team up with their friends and teamwork to help their community.
Swathi dreams of owning a restaurant. But when murder derails her plan, she and her lover take an outrageous step - to replace him with her husband.
American history through the lens of its most iconic residence, transforming its four walls into a volatile stage where ambition, betrayal, romance, and rivalry collide behind closed doors.
A live-action girl named Mia is plunged into an animated storybook world of elves and unicorns.
For over 100 years, one family has trained bears for movies. As times change and questions around animal work grow, they decide their latest project will be their last.
A motley crew of fighters are recruited one by one to take part in a deadly inter-dimensional martial arts tournament in which the future of the planet itself is at stake.
In 1958 Spain, Jesus shoots his new wife, Begoña, while fleeing through the woods with his daughter. What events led Jesus to turn against his own family?

movies.primaryTitle: Mujer, casos de la vida real
movies.originalTitle: Mujer, casos de la vida real
movies.plot: It is a Mexican series that shares real stories that have been sent to Silvia Pinal, the host of the show; the episodes deal with strong issues surrounding women that don't always end well.
After smoking a magical strain of marijuana and falling asleep for 50 years, this adult animated series follows the three Freak Brothers and their sardonic cat as they adjust to life in 2020.
A married ex police couple are asked by a police officer and their close friend to turn their remote Guest House into a Safe House.
Young women keep disappearing near Adavigutta forest. A gentle-natured constable finds her strength when her friend becomes the latest victim, leading her into a dangerous investigation.
An office-based comedy series following Chit, whose unusual behavior turns everyday workplace interactions into unexpected and humorous situations.
An NSA agent teams up with a computer analyst to form a new cyber crimes unit in the UK's Government Communications Headquarters.

Mona and Dee Dee are half-sisters with the same father who didn't really know each other when they were little and are complete opposites, but as adults they live in the same apartment building and at least try to bond.

movies.originalTitle: Kui Cheng Shoufu Cong Youxi Kaishi
movies.plot: Pei Qian chose the high-risk, money-burning game industry, and deliberately produced "alternative" games that went against the rules of the market. However, he unexpectedly became popular time and time again, earning a lot of money.
Pairs of professional bakers compete to create spellbinding edible showpieces on the sets where the Harry Potter films were made.
A hardened war horse transported away from battle finds herself in a land that's inhabited by silly, singing centaurs of all shapes and sizes.
Revolves around the wicked intentions of a daughter in law. Things change as new fantasies unfold.
It's the show with hot questions and even hotter wings.

After losing the world title, an African boxing champion becomes a bodyguard seeking redemption. His mission to protect Donia draws him into a dangerous hunt for a hidden fortune, where he rediscovers his strength and a chance at love.
The murder of a beautiful young girl, seen from the Rashomon-esque perspectives of an unrelenting obsessed cop, a novelist captivated by her grace and an opportunistic news editor.
Five Amish youths leave their restrictive communities for New York City. They experiment with alcohol, nightlife, relationships, facing new drama and heartache.
A teenager discovers that her birth father is an alien and that she has supernatural powers.

In a renowned school, a teacher becomes involved in a dispute between two students. What appears to be just another incident will change the protagonist's entire life in a story about ambition, power, and glory.
Jane Halifax is a freelance forensic psychiatrist (f.p.) a psychological super-sleuth immersed in a mire of crime and punishment: Jane is an expert of the human mind.
A new version of the long-running MTV reality show, which looks to unite people from different backgrounds and find a common ground.

Lala's little sister, Momo Belia Deviluke, has fallen in love with Rito. Momo plots to steal Rito away from her sister, Lala. She hopes that if Rito marries Lala, he can legally marry every girl who is in love of him.
Two girls obtain a book. Upon reading, they become unhinged and act according to the book's instructions.

When Suga (40), the president of a notorious motorcycle club, is unexpectedly released from prison he is confronted with the betrayal of his brothers and must now fight for his life and that of his family.
Everyone knows about Joan of Arc, Louis XIV and Napoleon. However the lives of their cousins was long lost. Until today.
