An animated comedy adventure series that follows 13-year-old Milo Murphy, the fictional great-great-great-great grandson of the Murphy's Law namesake. Additionally, Dakota and Cavendish come from the future to prevent pistachio extinction.

From Montmartre to the remote French countryside, Maigret encounters the dark side of the human psyche. Yet, he manages to maintain both compassion and a sense of humor as he explores the complex motives that lie behind every crime.

David and Amy are on holiday in Spain, where they meet Robert and Linda, who are also holidaymakers. David and Linda spend their holiday trying to find some time alone together away from their spouses.

Guinness World Records' most popular TV game show, Wheel of Fortune, debuts in India with host Akshay Kumar. Contestants decode phrases about Bollywood, pop culture, and daily life in a thrilling word game where every letter matters.
Simon Cowell's journey to create a hit boy band, showing behind-the-scenes footage from auditions to debut single release, continuing his legacy of discovering talent.
Join Scooby-Doo and the gang in their various adventures in this compilation series including episodes from the Scooby-Doo Where Are You.
The trials of a former television station manager, turned newspaper city editor, and his journalist staff.
Princess's beauty stolen by thieves, Purno, a man in a purple suit, embarks on a quest with eccentric companions to retrieve her beauty, encountering bizarre situations along the way.
When a prophecy claims the lemur king will be eaten by the foosa, the cowardly King Julien XII hands over his crown to his selfish, party-loving heir, Prince Julien XIII.

Five teen sorcerers are called to save the planet from darkness, guided by their mentor and an ancient book. They embark on magical adventures, befriend dragons, battle beasts, face evil, and transform into the Power Rangers Mystic Force.
Comedy sketches compiled and created by Shane Gillis and John McKeever, both comedians.

After the Halo event of 2552, there is a brief but violent period of civil war among the humans. Two armies on opposite sides of a canyon, the Reds and Blues, fight in the most worthless piece of real estate in the galaxy.

The eccentric but brilliant criminology professor Jasper Teerlinck is an advisor to the Belgian federal police in Antwerp. Although a valuable contributor, he drives everyone nuts because of his strange behavior.
High-flying lawyer Rebecka Martinsson leaves Stockholm for her hometown when a childhood friend dies.
The series centers on Ariel and her fun-filled, action-packed mermaid adventures with her friends in the mystical underwater country of Atlantica, which takes its cue from the Caribbean.
This spinoff of "The Oval" follows Ruth Truesdale as she is forced to play nice with a scandalous, religious cult of powerful, sex-crazed fanatics in the hope of freeing herself and her daughter.

The comedy series shows the end of a soccer team's championship season, where everyone has to prove that they are capable of what is expected of them, that they put the interests of the club before everything else, and that with soccer you really can get to heaven... i.e. to the top scorer. The battle of the people of Csember takes place on all fronts, with the opponents, with themselves, with the profiteers around the team, and with the sponsors, as well as with local important people.

Ackley Bridge College, formed by the merger of two schools in Yorkshire, faces challenges as British and Asian students navigate social divisions, segregation on sports teams and friendships strained by cultural differences.
Resourceful young Hugo Llor works to make a name for himself in 14th-century Barcelona while keeping a vow he made to the Estanyol family.

Born into a unique world where, the main character, Shi Hao, is a genius blessed by the heavens. His journey will bring him through unknown lands until he is able to become a person that can truly shake the world.
A hard-nosed, conservative Marine impulsively proposes to the liberal reporter doing a story on him and agrees to help her raise her three daughters.

Anna accidentally pockets a client's ring. The client, Simon, blackmails her for sex or he'll report the theft, jeopardizing her career. Anna schemes to evade Simon's demands while concealing her mistake.
Tony Scali is the police commissioner of a city where solutions often require creativity. Tony's calmness and intellect are far more useful to him than guns or brute force in his fight against crime.

The young, idealistic and brilliant Dr. Prabhat, takes charge of a neglected Primary Health Centre in a North India Village hoping to bring about much needed changes only to realize it is he who will have do change before anything else.

movies.primaryTitle: The Guardians of Justice (Will Save You!)
movies.plot: When their seemingly fearless leader self-destructs, a team of troubled superheroes must confront festering evil in the world - and in themselves.
A legendary story tells of a beautiful woman from a poor neighborhood and her love affairs with two best friends who come from wealthy families.
Mountain Monsters is a show with professional hillbilly hunters that search for mysterious creatures that people have claimed to have seen in West Virginia.
A kabaddi champion from rural Maharashtra rebels against family, pursues dreams in Mumbai, and promotes education to prevent child marriage while maintaining her cultural identity.
Colors presents an innovative blend of celebrity personalities, culinary skills, and comedy, all coming together for a delightful entertainment experience.

Rejected by the gorgeous Adagaki Aki for his weight, Makabe Masamune slims down, adopts a new persona, and reemerges as an attractive teenager. His goal is to make Aki fall for him, then reject her as harshly as she did him.
Two hilarious guys put on different sketch comedy performances for the masses to enjoy.

Sophia, a misfit, discovers a passion for fashion, becoming an unlikely businesswoman in the process. As her business grows, however, she has to learn to cope with life as her own boss. This show is loosely based on the true story of Nasty Gal Founder, Sophia Amoruso.

movies.primaryTitle: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman
movies.originalTitle: Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru
movies.plot: A modest country Dojo master is called by his legendary student to be special instructor for the Knights' order. This starts his reluctant journey, marked by choreographed duels, to win over his and others' doubts.
It's a Chopped All-Stars tournament event! Through four preliminary competitions, sixteen celebrities battle it out for a spot in the $50,000 finale!
Mark Kermode and other leading critics review the latest cinema releases.
The secrets Sapphire, Steel and their colleagues find include people trapped in photos, ghosts lost in time and a retro dinner party.

A mysterious jellyfish-shaped entity hovers over Stockholm, causing widespread panic. Civil Defense agent Elias and scientist Zandra team up to uncover the truth behind this baffling phenomenon and its impact on the city.
The cases of maverick undercover New York City detective Tony Baretta.
The Second World War experiences of brave women recruited as undercover agents behind enemy lines.

Through re-enactments, discussions with investigation teams, and interviews with victims' families and other involved persons, the show highlights Lt. Joe Kenda's successes with his 387 homicide case history and 92% solution rate.
The intrigues, love affairs, and unusual stories that take place inside the prison that houses Brazil's most famous criminals.
Reality show about swinger couples in a suburban community. Nine, one-hour episodes were filmed; however, AETV canceled the show after only two episodes aired.
Mickey Mouse takes on new adventures finding himself in silly situations in different settings.

A hotel manager with a troubled past is recruited to infiltrate a tycoon's criminal empire. As he gets closer to his target and the tycoon's girlfriend, past demons resurface, testing his limits and loyalty.
A legal drama that rips away the facade of suburbia to reveal that sometimes quiet streets can hide the darkest crimes.
City slickers get schooled by awesome hosts on their last chance to succeed off grid & survive off the land... among wildlife predators & natural disasters
Chefs compete for the chance of $20,000 as they are cooking inside a grocery store.
In a world where criminals evade justice, citizens vote via text for the death penalty, executed by "Dog Mask" if over 50% agree.
Tales from the world of sports never heard before.
Short anime about high school girls who love tights.

A failed entrepreneur has a lot going on in life when he finds himself involved in a case of mistaken identity and ends up getting a contract to kill a young girl. The target is the daughter of an influential politician.

Set in a small restaurant open only after midnight. This drama depicts the lives of the restaurant's patrons, who come for the amusing chatter and the proprietor's willingness to cook any dish they request.
Four normal girls could've moved to Oslo with ambitious #lifegoals and unstoppable career opportunities, but who prefer a comfortable existence back home.
Pawnbroker Les Gold and his two children, Seth and Ashley, operate Detroit's largest pawnshop.
Comedy about the workers in a factory canteen.
The series explores strange and unknown creatures that have been allegedly spotted by witnesses in various parts of the country and the world.
The story follows the escapades of Crusoe, who embarks on a high-seas adventure and gets shipwrecked on a remote tropical island.
American comedy with a larger-than-life teacher and his housemates.
Follows three Chicago families as they journey toward hope and healing after an unarmed African American doctor is shot by a white cop.

movies.primaryTitle: The Real Housewives of New Jersey
movies.originalTitle: The Real Housewives of New Jersey
movies.plot: Another installment of Bravo's "The Real Housewives" reality show. In this series, they focus on housewives living in New Jersey.

movies.primaryTitle: The Secret Life of Amy Bensen
movies.originalTitle: The Secret Life of Amy Bensen
movies.plot: After losing her entire family, Amy has spent several years on the run from unknown danger. When she meets Liam on a flight she has no idea her life is about to change, for his part Liam plans to help her whether she likes it or not.
A group of people conspires to fraudulently win the grand prize in the "Melate" lottery. Based on real events in Mexico in 2012.
A horror anthology series, based on the most viral and haunting stories from the r/NoSleep community.

A village prepares for its 25th anniversary of being crime-free when a prized motorbike vanishes. With a jubilee trophy, wedding, and town pride at risk, a frantic search to recover the bike before it's too late ensues.
Four friends go on missions with their ever changing rocket ship. Every mission includes a classic song and a painting.

movies.primaryTitle: Have I Got News for You
movies.originalTitle: Have I Got News for You
movies.plot: A news quiz show offering satirical and surreal comic observations on current events.
"BAT-FAM" follows Batman, Alfred, and young Damian Wayne as they live with an unlikely group of new housemates while protecting Gotham City.

Dean Gallagher and Chase are brothers. Competitive alpha males, they argue over everything, agree on nothing, but defend each other from outsiders no matter what. They're also members of the elite RESCUE Special Operations Unit.

movies.primaryTitle: Yandere Dark Elf: She Chased Me All the Way from Another World!
movies.originalTitle: Chotto Dake Ai ga Omoi Dark Elf ga Isekai Kara Oikakete Kita
movies.plot: A schoolboy completes a quest to defeat a demon king in another world, but when he returns he is pursued by a dark elf who has fallen in love with him.
Greatest indian story brought to life by artificial intelligence, delving deep into theme of dharma, fate and power
Sitcom featuring the zany hijinks of New York's finest.
Kung Lao has triumphed in the Mortal Kombat tournament, defeating Shang Tsung and saving Earth Realm. Now, he must train a new generation of warriors for the next tournament.
When notorious industrialist Vicky Rai gets killed at a party, the main suspects are the guests - both invited and uninvited.
One of the pioneering alternative news shows, primarily covering scandals, crimes, cults, along with consumer tips, health advice, and human interest stories.
Comedy soap opera re-imagining the lives of the British Royal Family as you have never seen them before.
Scientists explore how Earth would transform if humans vanished, from ecosystem recovery to surviving structures and fastest decay. Based on expert analysis of our industrial world without people.
An antisocial maverick doctor who specializes in diagnostic medicine does whatever it takes to solve puzzling cases that come his way using his crack team of doctors and his wits.

Brilliant, eccentric Mumbai lawyer Amar Vishwas defends the underprivileged while seeking hidden truths. When a powerful businessman is murdered, he navigates a deadly web of lies, suspects, and shocking twists to deliver justice.
A family's lives are turned upside-down when a street-smart young grifter shows up on their doorstep claiming to be a distant relative.
Astrid and James struggle to hold onto their identities while raising their young children in the city.

In the shadow of Mumbai's shimmering skyline, a sinister force hunts the living. In this visceral tale of urban horror, a fearless cop and a haunted medical student must take on this living darkness to avert impending doom.
Pressured by his boss to join a support group because he can't move forward after his wife's death, an irreverent sportscaster finds connection with the extremely varied members.
Yo Gabba Gabba! is a fun live-action program for young children. Join our host DJ Lance Rock as he introduces us to friendly toy monsters in a magical land full of music, dance, and color.

movies.primaryTitle: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
movies.originalTitle: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
movies.plot: Loosely based on historical fact, the series portrays the gunslinging Wyatt Earp and his successful determination for law and order.
The history of the hunt for the worst serial killer in the USSR
A group of kids at a summer camp, run by the heard-but-never-seen Dr. Kahn, form friendships as they spend time harassing buffoonish camp counselor Kevin "Ug" Lee.
When a dark force threatens to destroy Unicorn Island, a brave teen and her five schoolmates must rise up to protect their beloved magical academy.

Half-brothers Yura, Ruslan, and Pyotr form a close family with their mother Flora. In 1995 Russia, greed and violence threaten their bond as they navigate underground clubs, fights, and the collapse of their once-secure world.

movies.originalTitle: Hasta que la plata nos separe
movies.plot: Poor salesman Rafael and wealthy business executive Alejandra are two strangers who suffer a car accident that changes their lives and intertwines their futures.
This German remake of the comedy "Ghosts" follows restless spirits as they quarrel in an abandoned manor and become dismayed when a couple inherits it and wants to transform it into a lavish hotel.
The lives and loves of Beryl Hennessey and Sandra Hutchinson, two young, single women sharing a flat in Liverpool.
A cat burglar, a car thief, and a dirty cop get a chance to turn their lives around; fighting crime and working for the mysterious Charlie Townsend.
Harrowing experience and pioneering endeavor in an undisclosed, remote location in a 90,000-acre swath of land in central Oregon.

Dragons have now become a legend for the world. After the occurrence of a crack in the surface of the Earth, scientists go to study it. Soon a group of kids discover the dragons are hiding and they decide to hide them.
In a world of science vs. magic, Adonis has sworn revenge on the human race for taking away his beloved mentor. What lies at the end of his destructive path?
A drama about the lost years of young William Shakespeare after his arrival to London in 1589--when theatre was like rock'n'roll, and a young man with a dream changed the world with his words.

The Transformers' war continues in an older time, through a new generation. On pliocenic Earth, the heroic Maximals and the evil Predacons battle for survival against each other and against a violent planet.
The adventures of Pippi Longstocking, an eccentric, super-strong, redheaded moppet and her best friends Tommy and Annika.

Jurre and Saar live with their children in Rotterdam. Saar works as a prosecutor on an important case and Jurre is a history teacher. They are both fighting their own secret battle without knowing this about each other.
The Time Force Power Rangers travel to the past to stop Ransik and his band of criminal mutants.

Benny Zerletta, a Brooklyn based Italian-American, soldier in the Colezzo crime family. He follows the steps of his cousin, who behind closed doors was the leader of a criminal organization in Gravesend.
The further misadventures of the citizens of Mayberry.
Some of Britain's most opinionated and avid TV viewers comment freely on the best and worst television shows of the past week, from the comfort of their sofas.
Karsu, betrayed by her husband, returns to her estranged mother's house with her three children and try to improve their mother-daughter relationship while building a new life.

Follow happily-divorced talk-radio host Poppa as a new female co-host challenges him at work, and at home he's still parenting his adult son, who tries to pursue his passion while being a good father and husband.
The ups-and-downs of a young courting couple's relationship.
Singles live together for 9 days, getting makeovers and dating guidance while seeking real connections. They experience emotional moments as they pursue romance through flirtations and dates.
Byker Grove follows the lives and relationships of a group of young people who are members of a youth club.
Kermit, Piggy, Fozzie, Animal, Gonzo and Summer use their imagination for all kinds of playroom adventures.
Bhaduri Moshai, a renowned occultist, faces a haunting mystery as an Aghori tantric surfaces during the blood moon, posing sinister threats to his loved ones.
Age old rivalry between two head honchos of Puri, Babu Jena and Loka Nana that leads to the creation of a new Nana in town and ultimately ignites a deadly blood feud.
Follows the Serrano family, who live in Round Santa Justa No 133, located in the fictional neighborhood of Santa Justa, in the Ribera del Manzanares, in Madrid.

movies.primaryTitle: Tu Haan Kar Ya Naa Kar
movies.originalTitle: Tu Haan Kar Ya Naa Kar
movies.plot: In the mundane life of Bimal and Antara, new neighbors bring in a fresh breeze of excitement. But behind all the fun and games lies a secret game of dangerous proportion that will change their relationships forever. The question is, for better or for worse?

Three Memphis women find refuge in roller skating while facing life's challenges. A skating competition with major prize money offers hope as they deal with grief, love, and city dangers, leaning on sisterhood to survive.

movies.primaryTitle: Blood Aces: The Wild Ride of Benny Binion
movies.originalTitle: Blood Aces: The Wild Ride of Benny Binion
movies.plot: Follows Binion's rise from a Texas hustler to a mastermind who redefined Vegas and the worlds of rodeo and poker.
In a mysterious assassin organization, the patriarch is poisoned, sparking a rebellion. Su Muyu, their guard, seeks a healer while fighting off rival assassins aiming to seize power.

In each episode of this Flemish whodunit based on the books of Pieter Aspe, a serious crime - usually one or more murders in the author's home town Bruges - gets investigated by the grumpy but brilliant chief inspector Pieter Van In and his team.
A look at the experiences of the members of the NXIVM, an organization and sex cult that made headlines for being charged with sex trafficking, racketeering, and conspiracy.
A group of boarding school students embark on the search for a treasure when one of them discovers a long hidden secret in the attic.
Cases of a woman and her male assistant who work for the fictional CJRA (Criminal Justice Review Agency), an organization which seeks out miscarriages of justice.
John Drake is a special operative for M9, specializing in security assignments against any subversive element that threatens world peace.
The brutal murder of Hamdi Atilbay brings together the paths of young prosecutor Leyla, and a famous journalist Kenan. However, this murder is covered with facts that will also destroy their love.
Living double lives, Ordo Realitas agents spread around the world, secretly investigate and prevent the paranormal from being formed, fighting against those who only want to wreak havoc in the world.

movies.primaryTitle: Inside Look: The People v. O.J. Simpson - American Crime Story
movies.originalTitle: Inside Look: The People v. O.J. Simpson - American Crime Story
movies.plot: Inside the series of the same name.

Netflix reality stars battle in a remote camp where a spinning wheel determines elimination. Through physical trials, harsh punishments, and social gameplay, competitors fight to stay off the wheel and win $250,000.

Aussie Shore follows the wild antics of a group of young and rowdy housemates as they work hard, and party even harder whilst navigating the highs and lows of living together 24/7 in the non-stop party town of Cairns.
Aspiring artists will compete to become the next big music star while touring with a headlining superstar.

Dana is a 9-year old girl who loves dinosaurs. Her life changes forever when she's given a Dino Field Guide, which not only teaches her new things about dinosaurs, but gives her the power to imagine dinosaurs into real life.
The adventures of two little bunnies, three-year-old Max and seven-year-old Ruby, as they try to get along in day-to-day life.
A secret society is devoted to chasing immortality by seeking refuge in the bodies of others.

Takryu tells the story of a man who was a gangster who would become a legend in Joseon. He was known as a gangster at Han River's Mapo Port and eventually became a Joseon legend because of his body and skills.

Cesur returns to his father's village with an elaborate plan to avenge the death of his father. The only thing he hadn't planned for is Suhan, the daughter of the man he believes is responsible for his father's murder.
An anthology series scripted by famed science-fiction author Ray Bradbury.

Tommy, Billy, Adam, Rocky, Kat and Tanya are turned back to their teenage forms thanks to the Zeo Crystal. The Command Center is gone but the crystal leads them to the new Power Chamber and all but Billy take on new Zeo powers.

movies.primaryTitle: Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers
movies.originalTitle: Lv2 kara Cheat datta Motoyûsha Kôho no Mattari Isekai Life
movies.plot: Flio's no warrior, just a simple merchant with rock-bottom stats-until a twist of fate unlocks super cheat powers that could change everything.
Tsukune takes a bus to his new school on his first day. Unbeknownst to him, the school is for monsters who go berserk at the scent of humans.
Following a generations-long power struggle between two families and a peace secured by a major secret, the arrival of Prosecutor Nevin to the city will change all balances and outcomes.
Sanyogita and her mother Saroj's bond is tested when young Raju enters their lives. Will his presence bring them closer or tear their relationship apart forever?
Life in the garage swerves off track for a NASCAR crew chief and his tight-knit racing team when a new boss steps in and shakes things up.
Enigmatic police inspector Ricciardi has a curse upon him: he can see the ghosts of people who have died violently and listen to their last thoughts.
Breaking into the bad guy business, Wolf leads his crew on daring heists seeking notoriety, but being truly bad isn't their strong suit.
A silly Japanese game show on which contestants are painfully eliminated through barely possible stunts and events, most taking place above pools of mud.
Drama series telling stories of the secrets people keep and how far someone would go to protect those that they love.

Federico Seligman retires to recover from illness, but upon return finds his sons have changed the business direction he despises. He'll do the unimaginable to prevent them from destroying his legacy.
Chennan searches for his lover Yuxin from 10,000 years ago, uncovering secrets about gods and demons' destruction. His journey weaves a legend of heroism and explores human nature, society, and life.
A former pro football player moves back to his Arkansas hometown to coach the high-school football team.
In Dublin, the Casey family's year of holidays and celebrations takes a dark turn when a concussion at a birthday party exposes secrets of infidelity, discontent, and financial troubles.
The highs and lows of the Wandin Valley residents, from the patients and staff at the rural town's hospital, to the locals and their everyday lives.

Enter Dubai's most exclusive Desi circle where billionaires, Birkin bags, and egos reign. TV stars Karan Kundra and Tejasswi join wealthy Indian expats in a world where alliances shift, relationships fracture, and gossip rules.
Bahar, a loving mother who struggles to maintain a life with her two children, must deal with life's challenges and uncover the hidden truths of the past.
The daily troubles of everyone who works at the job centre.

movies.primaryTitle: Dusk Beyond the End of the World
movies.plot: Against the backdrop of a changing world, a tender romance between human and machine forces society to question the very essence of love, consciousness, and the bonds that make us human.
Follows behind the scenes of what it takes to compete and win at the highest levels in men's professional golf, following the PGA players through their wins and losses.
Asya is a successful doctor who has the perfect life with her husband and son. But after she finds a blonde hair on her husband's scarf, she discovers his extramarital affair and everything changes.
Chronicles the women of a brothel in Nevada.
A nostalgic journey through the best automotive adventures, with archive footage and test drives, guided by the legendary James May, Richard Hammond and Jeremy Clarkson.
Collectors with homes overrun by toys, dolls and collectibles must decide to sell items for renovations. Bobby helps them sort, appraise and let go of possessions to fund home makeovers.
In their 18 years of marriage, a middle-aged couple tries to move on with their lives after the husband confesses he's gay.
Judge Judy Sheindlin presides over a new array of cases, litigants and judgments.
The Kara family's life is turned upside down because of a wrongful accusation that results in the imprisonment of Nazif Kara for a murder he didn't commit.
A good-natured high school teacher working at his alma mater works with gifted but misfit and disinterested students.

The TRT production is a prequel story of Awakening: the Great Seljuk. It depicts the life and triumphs of Sultan Alparslan, the second sultan of the Seljuk dynasty, whose victories expanded the empire in the 11th century.
Two wives, from two very different families, swap lives for two weeks. One week in the life of the host family, the other week forcing the family to live her lifestyle.
A young turtle named Franklin learns social lessons as he grows up with his family and friends.
Tony Twist and his three children--14-year-old twins Pete and Linda and 7-year-old Bronson--move to an old lighthouse on the rugged Australian coast.
Teenage twins from Chicago discover that they are the heirs to the throne of an island nation.

movies.originalTitle: Nageki no Bôrei wa Intai Shitai
movies.plot: During treasure hunting's golden age, Krai and friends aspired to be great adventurers. As they pursued this dream, Krai, realizing it wasn't for him, wished to retire from the perilous life of a treasure hunter.
A refined billionaire's daughter who grew up in London marries an ordinary guy on the same day they meet in a Russian city. Their relationship navigates the clash of opposite backgrounds.

Preschoolers are provided with learning opportunities through music, crafts, stories, games and information. The aim is to encourage a child to wonder, think, feel and imagine, striving to reflect a modern, diverse Australian society.

Host Antje Utgaard finds out if she can make sparks fly between two very different OF creators in just one afternoon. With hand-picked challenges to help break the ice, will these perfect strangers be a miss, a match, or something more?
Kevser grew up in a humble and poor neighborhood and after she becomes the bride of the son of the wealthy Kirimli family, her father cuts all ties with her as he does not approve of this marriage.
The three detectives fight every kind of criminal all over New York City. The show featured many actual New York City locations, as well as episodes based on real New York City police cases.

A hard-hitting teen telenovela set at a boarding school in Johannesburg. When a teen flees from a family tragedy in rural KwaZulu Natal to a boarding school in Jozi, she finds herself entangled in a scandal of epic proportions.
A bittersweet romantic comedy about a woman who magically switches between her 20s and 50s lands an internship at the Prosecution Service, caught between two generations and a tough boss.
Follows a middle-class man who experiences hilarious misfortunes as he desperately attempts to marry the woman of his dreams.
Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. gang solve more mysteries together, each time with a different living, late or fictional celebrity guest.

Clawdeen finds Monster High using her mothers magical amulet, and finds out she is a wolf. There she meets, Draculaura, a secret vampire witch and Frankie an awkward lab made monster. Together they save Monster High from various dangers.

Kevin is a medium for hire, who attempts to solve various ghosts' unresolved problems, so that they can move on to a final resting place, occasionally with the help of his best friend and drug dealer, Roofie.

A team of inspectors investigates murders in and around the small Upper Bavarian town of Rosenheim, and they still have plenty of time to see idyllic landscapes and luxurious pre-alpine villas and enjoy sumptuous Bavarian fare with beer.
An alleged sexual assault among adolescents, which sheds light on the sexual taboos of the adults in charge of them.
The participants of an unusual car race compete around America.

Family drama unfolds after Malkin's murder. Initially suspected maid proven innocent. Malkin mistreated maid who had affair with younger sister. Sister arrested for murdering Malkin and maid, exposing class divides.

movies.primaryTitle: With You, Our Love Will Make It Through
movies.originalTitle: Kimi to Koete Koi ni Naru
movies.plot: A shy high school girl's life changes when she meets her school's new student - a beastfolk teen. Despite initial nervousness and social prejudices, she discovers a deep connection with him that grows into something more.
Chronicles the personal and professional journey of the creative genius behind El Chavo del 8, El Chapulín Colorado, and Dr. Chapatín, from childhood through his rise as a TV icon in the 70s and 80s.
Rohan, a doctor, falls for a patient connected to an underworld don. Blinded by passion, they decide to remove all obstacles, even Rohan's wife. But will Rohan let his wife die for fleeting love?
Re-enactments of real-life tales of human survival against the savage elements, dangerous climates and physical hazards.

The year is 1952. Denmark is experiencing a great shortage of nurses, and therefore the headmistress at Fredenslund Hospital has started a controversial trial. For the first time, the hospital will also be training men.
A detective solves crimes with the help of an oversized dog. TV adaptation of the 1989 film 'Turner and Hooch.'
A space station romantic comedy between space tourists and astronauts.
A single bachelorette dates multiple men over several weeks, narrowing them down to hopefully find her true love.
Vishal suspects Bhuvnesh's secrets, uncovers an affair, and tension peaks when Ronak arrives, risking exposure of hidden truths.
Sixteen strangers trek through the New Zealand Alps, facing challenges for a $1 million prize. Only survivors reaching the distant peak's summit win.
Alex Murphy is RoboCop, a cybernetic policeman. A creation of a vast corporation, he fights crime and occasional corporate conspiracy in the near-future of Old Detroit.

A princess visiting Thailand faces an assassination attempt. Her police protector becomes her only hope for survival. As they hide from threats, forbidden feelings develop between them, leading to a dangerous final confrontation.
Gaurav wanted the perfect bride. The doctor had a way to help. But desire has its own plans-and everyone has something to hide.

In 1984 Kenith Trodd joined BBC team responding to Channel 4 releases, leading to transition from BBC studio plays to Screen One/Two anthology series. Trodd oversaw first group of titles in these series in 1985.

A wealthy Mexican fugitive, falsely accused of crime, finds refuge and love with a Colombian mariachi singer. While hiding his true identity, he learns to survive as a performer and discovers his cultural roots.
Four women--a chef, a single mom, an heiress, and a job seeker--dig into love and work, with a generous side of midlife crises, in pre-pandemic LA.
In 1970s Riyadh, Aziza reflects on her youth alongside sister Awatif and Bedouin Wadha as they face love and change in a transforming society.
The lives and adventures of the pupils of class 5C from 'Please Sir', after they have left Fenn Street School.
Sobha's friend Meena visits her home, but things take a turn when Sobha's son Vidhaan falls for her. Will love bloom or will relationships get in the way?

Following the crew of the patrol boat HMAS Hammersley, as they patrol the northern sea border of Australia. They have to deal with foreign fishermen poaching fish, smugglers and with political unrest in a neighbouring island state.

Fatmagul, a simple happy village girl, is violated by 4 drunk rich young men, the extreme hardship she faces forced to marry a rapist and the great remorse felt by others for their inaction when innocence was violated forms the story.
Brides-to-be from all over America come to Kleinfeld in New York to finally say yes to their wedding dress.
After defeating the Demon King, our Hero saves the princess and rides off into the horizon to start a new life - In his dreams - Little did he know that unemployment and mediocrity awaited him.

The series takes place at an Egyptian university, following a group of Egyptian and Arab students as they navigate academic pressure, emotional struggles, and the search for identity amid the real challenges facing today's youth.
A look at the world of child beauty pageants.
An outspoken and self-destructive criminal defense lawyer takes on the most challenging cases.
An English teacher begins to hear a low humming sound that no one else around her can hear.
Follow Danish secret service agent Katrine Poulson and British spy Beatrice Ogilvy, who are pitched together in a desperate race against time. Caught in a web of lies, murder, and power struggles.
In a city where shadows hold deadly secrets, six individuals search for freedom and redemption but find themselves bound together by love, betrayal, and the haunting echoes of their past.
A chain of events is kickstarted when a young girl is gang-raped by four boys.

An improv-comedy spin on "Dungeons and Dragons." Each episode introduces a new party of intrepid first-level characters who must battle the most vicious D&D monsters--which they stand no chance of defeating.

Twins Shikha and Nikhil couldn't be more different. But when their all-boys and all-girls schools suddenly go co-ed, chaos hits them head-on. Now both must confront new feelings, friendships, and the messy business of growing up together.
A team of paranormal experts travel the UK looking into instances of paranormal activity in the homes of ordinary people.
English language adult parody based on the Japanese series Shinchan (1992). This entry is for the Funimation English dub which originally aired on CN's Adult Swim between 2006 and 2011.
Lifeguards train rookies while facing dangers on the beach and complicated personal relationships.
In a lonely wife's empty world, an injured young relative becomes her forbidden toy-silent, dependent, and tempting. But when another wife senses the game , the toy threatens to break everything.

At a hospital a nurse switches two baby girls at birth because their last names are similar. The rich family gets the poor girl; the poor family gets the rich girl. After 15 years the truth is revealed.
A story of two generations of two families colliding, connecting, sometimes at cross purposes as they navigate their way around the maze of love, sex, money and politics.
Seductive killer or innocent victim? A murder mystery like no other.
The story of young teenagers and pupils in a high school in Antwerp, and their troubles, scandals and everyday life. Each season is told from a different person's point of view.
The lives inside and outside video games of the members of online guild the Knights of Good.
In the inner computer world of Mainframe, a guardian program sprite and his friends defend the system from threats from viruses and the User.
The Trades is a single-cam sitcom about refinery employees that balance the conflicting personalities of a small town with the antics of a stressful workplace.

Set in Gallowshields on Tyneside between the 2 World Wars, this story follows the life of ex-sergeant Jack Ford and the Seaton family as they deal with the aftermath of the Great War, the Great 1920s Depression and trade union activists.

movies.primaryTitle: The Secret Life of My Secretary
movies.plot: After Do Min Ik, a competent director, loses his ability to recognise faces, he becomes dependent on Jung Gal Hee, his secretary, and eventually develops feelings for her.
New players offer a modern-day examination of Black culture through the prism of pro football, while trying to keep their souls as they play The Game.

In 1972, seven women were brutally murdered in Manvat, shaking the nation. As the case stumped local police, Special Crime Branch officer Ramakant Kulkarni, stepped in to uncover dark secrets and hidden motives.
Seth Meyers hosts a late-night talk show.

A documentary film crew follows a group of young adults and their current concerns, in their small town. The crew focus is the daily lives of cousins Kelly and Shrub Mallet and their idiosyncratic surroundings.
A honest young man is compelled to accept every girl who asks to be romantically involved with him.
An ambitious girl, Heer and a privileged boy, Nawab from different worlds fall in love, but their story becomes marked by betrayal.
The story of American Christopher Cobb and his foundation of Australia's first coach-line, which he established in the colony of New South Wales, Australia.

A physics professor who happens to be the illegitimate great-grandson of Albert Einstein partners with a Boston homicide detective not only to help solve crimes, but also to address the problems inside the institution itself.
A single bachelor dates multiple women over several weeks, narrowing them down to hopefully find his true love.
Meenakshi gets lost in the emotions of letters from her servant's wife, shaking her marriage. As passions rise, will the truth behind Kishor's letters be revealed?
A show about handyman Manny Garcia and his helpful talking tools, who make repairs and fix problems in the small town of Sheetrock Hills.

Nicky Shen, a young Chinese-American woman, leaves college and takes a life-changing journey to a Shaolin monastery in China. She returns to her hometown and uses her martial-arts skills to fight crime and corruption.
Television episodes built around the same sorts of incidents found in Hank Ketcham's long-running comic strip.
A family with a struggling father and disabled sister. However, when everyone can only have one major element, Mo Fan can do much more.

movies.primaryTitle: Cooking Academy Culinary Arts by Alexander Eichen
movies.originalTitle: Cooking Academy Culinary Arts by Alexander Eichen
movies.plot: "Cooking Academy Culinary Arts by Alexander Eichen" is a daily soap on Joyn (DE, AT, CH).
Seven rival high schools battle each other for victory and total supremacy. The students will do what ever it takes to come out on top and see their school leading the way.
Following his service in World War II, Dr. Finlay returns to the practice at Arden House, at a time when the National Health Service is about to be instituted.

Crime/ Mystery Drama series After a series of disappearances of young women, newspaper reporter Lisa Wallace (26), sets out to find the man responsible who she believes is the same man who murdered her mother almost twenty years earlier.
Greg The Garlic Farmer lives inside a video game and has to deal with the other mindless NPC's and the crazy player characters.
Set during the end of the Goryeo period to the early Joseon period. Two friends aim their swords against one another due to differences in opinion about "my country."

Blue-collar plumber Joe learns that his recently-deceased father lived a secret life and stole millions from dangerous people--who now think that Joe has the money. He must race against time to find the truth and the money.
Reality show features sci-fi inspired pranks on unsuspecting people who witness alien abductions, hauntings, and other paranormal events, capturing their reactions.
A pair of intelligence agents posing as a tennis pro and his coach go on secret missions around the world.
A cooperative drama between a fraudster who cannot empathize and an overly sympathetic lawyer, as well as a revenge play against absolute evil.
The adventures of a 1930's Pacific Islands bush pilot and his companions.
Anupamaa sacrificed a lot to become a loyal wife, a devoted daughter-in-law, and a loving mother, only to be disrespected in return. After the bitter realization, she sets out to live on .
Precious Ramotswe launches the first-ever female detective agency in Botswana. She embarks on various adventures while investigating cases and must also overcome several challenges in her quest.

An armed robbery takes place on the bus line that connects the airport with several cities near Barcelona. The result? The three dead robbers, a wanted person, and six witnesses can't identify the fugitive.
In her adventures to always experience more desires and fantasies, Emmanuelle reaches new spirits of love.
Everyone's "Count" is a number based on life choices, but avoid reaching 0 or you'll be sent to the Abyss!.
Raucous 90s sitcom starring Kathy Burke and James Dreyfus as awful flatmates. Tom is an out-of-work actor with a sharp tongue, and Linda La Hughes is his dysfunctional friend.

The Battlestar Galactica finally arrives at Earth in the year 1980, but find that the planet is not technologically advanced enough to defend itself from the Cylons. The Colonials send teams to begin to secretly advance Earth's technology.
A mother raising funds for her child's cancer treatment, with a life-changing offer from her boss.
Isha and Suraj' emerge as a perfect pair, having turned their imperfect beginning into a journey of love. As successful IAS officers they work together to bring positive change in their community.
Cynical Dutch Detective Commissaris and his colleagues investigate murders, kidnappings, and political corruption.
The recently divorced Dr. Sheinfeld becomes an emergency room doctor at a Chicago hospital, where he soon bonds with Dr. Eve Sheridan. Situational humor mixes with tense medical crises.
An amiable, inquisitive Chicago priest moonlights as a detective and is assisted by a rather worldly, lock-picking nun.
Bat Masterson roams The West and defends the innocent.
Dramatization of real-life situations and stories that are related to popular sayings, by Don Tomas.
Centers on the Bunnies and patrons of the original Playboy Club in 1960s Chicago.
An enthusiastic young boy earns a job at a hero supply store and trains to become the "Greatest Hero Ever."
Bumper moves to Germany to revive his music career after one of his songs becomes big in Berlin.

Lee Yoon Sung is a talented MIT-graduate who works on the international communications team in the Blue House. He plans revenge on five politicians who caused his father's death and eventually becomes a "City Hunter".
DCI Jack Cloth and DC Anne Oldman are paired to investigate a series of grisly murders done by a devious killer.

movies.primaryTitle: Flash Gordon: A Modern Space Opera
movies.plot: Steven "Flash" Gordon and his companions defend Earth against Ming the Merciless.

movies.originalTitle: Ore no imouto ga konna ni kawaii wake ga nai
movies.plot: Normal 17-year-old Kyosuke isn't close with his 14-year-old sister Kirino. But then her secret otaku hobby gives them a chance to reconnect.
A luxury lifestyle consultant hosts a show offering high-end advice to clients seeking guidance on various life aspects, while maintaining strict professional boundaries.

The Larkin family lives in rural idyll in 1950s England. Father Larkin never pays his bills, but the big, sprightly family is never short of money. Father Larkin is always working on a new plan to provide the family with cash.
When her rich husband leaves her penniless, a Warsaw socialite must rely solely on her wit to survive.
Two wealthy businessmen with car obsessions cross paths with an idealist pediatrician. Love enters the equation, and their lives change for good.
Feel-good laughs without being crass. A sketch comedy show for the entire family.

Rosa, a young woman who has devoted her life to the struggle for human rights, whose world is turned upside down during a Gaza protest she attends in London. As she grapples with a serious illness and an unexpected personal quest, Rosa finds herself in Istanbul. There, her path crosses once again with Ali, a man she met for the first time at the same protest. The two quickly fall in love, but their relationship will become the catalyst for a devastating chain of events that neither of them could foresee.
The daily misadventures of teenage misfit best friends Clay and Rob in a world of anthropomorphic animals.

When Cape Town housewife Christelle Smit discovers evidence her husband is having an affair with a stripper named Candy Floss, her investigation takes her to a world poles apart from the suburban utopia she knows.
Rule-breaking detective Raphaëlle Coste and autistic archivist Astrid Nielsen work together to investigate puzzling crimes.
The six archenemies of Earth are challenged by two kids and a five-toed dragon.

Cha Young Min is a genius doctor but arrogant and selfish. One day, he gets involved in an unexpected case; his spirit possesses another doctor's body. These two doctors are complete opposites, with personalities and medical abilities.
In an erotic context, eight couples in Mexico dare a sex experiment. Sex coach Lea Holzfurtner accompanies them.
Newly divorced dad Drew faces finding a kidney donor and is at the end of his rope and his hope when he runs into Gina, a rough-around-the edges woman from his past who volunteers her own.
Talk show in which Dr. Phil McGraw invites guests to confront their problems.
Follows four friends in 't Gooi, a Dutch region where rich people live.
The program focuses on the misadventures of two unlikely yet somehow biological siblings: Cow and Chicken.
Port Protection Alaska shows a real way to define expectations when Nature commands attention for essentials in a subsistence group of men and women numbering under 100.
Children's series about the adventures of Worzel Gummidge (Mackenzie Crook), a scarecrow who comes to life. Two orphans arrive at a farm who meet Worzel and join him in the adventures.

Mehmet, a lawyer, reconnects with estranged daughter Doga after his mother's death. Buried secrets surface, threatening their lives as Celal's affair shatters the family. His wife Handan fights to keep them together.
A Dutch web cartoon created by Studio Massa. It tells the story of three adopted sisters named Maya, Coco and Mymy going through their lives.

movies.primaryTitle: Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
movies.originalTitle: Shin no Nakama ja Nai to Yuusha no Party o Oidasareta node, Henkyou de Slow Life Suru Koto ni Shimashita
movies.plot: Red was once a member of the Hero's party, a powerful group destined to save the world from the evil forces of Taraxon, the Raging Demon Lord. That is, until one of his comrades kicked him out.
Tall, clumsy Aoife O'Neill joins a struggling school basketball team after moving to a new area. Through 3x3 basketball, she finds her place while trying to help transform the team's fortunes.
The nine episodes represent a different emotion or rasa such as anger, compassion, courage, disgust, fear, laughter, love, peace and wonder.

A group of characters is implicated in the murder of Angelica. They all walk on a razor's edge searching for the truth, waiting for a verdict, which will establish, in a way or another, a new course for their lives.
Daisy O'Brien must live a double life after she is bitten by her vampire parents to save her life.
A group of friends and family lives in a fictional Dutch town called Meerdijk.
A crusty barrister oversees difficult criminal cases while dealing with the demands of his family life.
Follows two amphibian friends striving to balance the great outdoors and home pleasure, as they are thrown from one optimistic adventure to another.
"A gripping social drama where manipulation, heartbreak, resilience, and tangled relationships ignite conflict and suspense."
Revolves around a moving tale that artfully intertwines coincidence and destiny, bringing together two souls who could not be more dissimilar in their essence.

An 11-year-old Tsubasa Oozora started playing football at a very young age. To pursue his dream to the best of his elementary school abilities, he moved to Nankatsu, which is well-known for its excellent elementary school soccer teams.
Two unlicensed Swedish private investigators try to make a living in Los Angeles.

Nilüfer pursues her dream of working at Lutesya Hotel, built by her late parents. When Kaan, a hotel heir, returns seeking revenge against his controlling stepsister Sevil, his encounter with Nilüfer changes everything.
Dini, a high-achieving student, is romantically involved with Rangga, a popular senior and aspiring national basketball player.

A foreign woman marries a village landlord but remains unfulfilled. To find solace, she reads stories of joy. Birju the servant, uncovers her secret, casting doubt on her as an outsider in the eyes of those who serve her husband
It follows Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po on wonder-filled adventures as they learn and grow.

What's more fun than a pup in a construction vehicle? LOTS of pups in LOTS of construction vehicles. Rubble and his family - Aunt, Grandpa, cousins and all - are working hard to make their town, Builder Cove, a ter-ruff-ic place to live.

Kaji's a narcissist with good looks and popular at his office. He meets Fukami and vows that he would never consider him worth a date. At least, until he saw Fukami coming out of the shower and realized his irresistibly cute side.
The Rabbids from Ubisoft's "Raving Rabbids" video game series star in their own television series.
A group of archaeologists have 3 days to discover historical artifacts in different sites around Britain.
Two ex-lovers, a married American woman and an aspiring British writer, activate a long-planned escape plan and disappear together for a week. They soon get into trouble and a cop goes after them.

movies.primaryTitle: Captain Jake and the Never Land Pirates
movies.originalTitle: Jake and the Never Land Pirates
movies.plot: Jake and his gang of young pirates, including Izzy, Cubby and their parrot Skully, must surpass the evil Captain Hook and Mr Smee to find the lost treasure in Neverland.
Teresa finds her husband and his two best friends dead in the lavish community where they live. As the truth comes to light, so will dark secrets.
Thermoman is a multiple-powered superhero who originates from the planet Ultron. In an attempt to do his best to fit in with life on earth, he creates the human alias of George Sunday.
The show takes us through the struggles of life as a child monster. Three monster friends are studying how to scare humans in school. Often, their attempts don't work out as planned.
Nearly 30 years after her mom's murder, a political strategist launches a calculated plan to ruin the Colombian presidential candidate who killed her.

When Haru gets called to visit his mother in Canada, he finds out that he has a new adoptive brother. The problem? He seems more wild puppy than human. As Haru works to gain his new brother Ren's trust, a powerful bond is formed.
Prankster teen Juin torments orderly Sorn with endless mischief. When an unexpected encounter brings them together, their antagonistic relationship shifts as Sorn's feelings begin to change.

Sevi is a basketball captain from a humble family. Elyse is a spoiled cheerleader. Though opposites, the two fall for each other. But can their young love survive the harsh realities that may come their way?
Teen witch apprentices band together to defend New Orleans against an approaching dark force.

movies.primaryTitle: Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen
movies.originalTitle: Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen
movies.plot: Host Andy Cohen discusses exciting and provocative pop culture events with celebrity guests, reality TV personalities and viewers.
Confidence-boosting kids' show with music, silliness, and lessons for limitless creativity. Danny Go encourages joining the imaginative journey.
16 chefs going head-to-head in a series of challenges using ingredients and special cooking tools and equipment while racing against the clock.
Two Detectives Jack and Georgina who share chemistry but have complicated personal lives.

movies.primaryTitle: Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi
movies.originalTitle: Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi
movies.plot: A mother-in-law's struggle to put up with her three bahu's. The three bahu's have grown up sons. The bahu's sons start to get involved with having girlfriends and the bahu's try and break their relationships up.

"A Haunting" was a USA paranormal anthology previewing stories told by the victims. Victims tell their terrifying encounters with the paranormal. This show contains narration, frightening re-enactments, and religious content.
An elite covert operations unit carries out highly sensitive missions subject to official denial in the event of failure, death or capture.

movies.primaryTitle: The Increasingly Poor Decisions of Todd Margaret
movies.originalTitle: The Increasingly Poor Decisions of Todd Margaret
movies.plot: Todd Margaret is an American who takes a job running the London sales team for an energy drink. He has no experience with British culture, knows nothing about sales and has only one employee, Dave.
When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a remote town, a fisherman must fight to protect his family, his community, and his way of life.
Two FBI agents - one guided by reason, and another by intuition - looking for missing people in Washington, D.C.
Siblings Eva and Mads put a strain on their familial bonds as they try to come to terms with personal demons.

Detective Pierre Niémans and his partner Camille Delauney investigate a series of brutal crimes in remote French regions, unveiling dark regional myths and forgotten customs beyond the scope of local authorities.
A biographical story of TV personality and transgender icon La Veneno and those who surrounded her.

Nine well-known Danes leave their comfort zones and step into the legendary world of the Shaolin Masters. Over the course of 12 intense days, they train under two Masters in Kung Fu, meditation, and ancient rituals - facing relentless physical challenges, emotional breakdowns, and moments of profound transformation. From bamboo-stick discipline to carrying rice sacks, from breaking boards to confronting their deepest fears, each participant is pushed beyond their limits. The journey is as much about inner strength as it is about physical endurance, revealing the powerful connection between body and mind. What begins as pain, frustration, and resistance slowly evolves into breakthroughs, healing, and self-discovery. Along the way, the Shaolin Masters offer both fierce discipline and unexpected warmth, guiding the group toward resilience, courage, and clarity. In the finale, the participants must present their Tao Lu - a martial arts performance symbolizing everything they've learned - and reflect on whether twelve days in Shaolin can truly change a life forever.

A group of characters who live at a library turn into superheroes and then go into books; using early reading skills to save the day. They later use a problem from the story one of them faced and apply it to their own lives.
The life of Sira, a dressmaker consumed by the love of a man, left the turmoil of Madrid prior to the Civil War at Tangier, where she inadvertently becomes part of an espionage scheme.
A steamy affair between Mrs. Poonam and her nephew (Vipin) begins to develop a gap when they both have different expectations from each other.
A deadly virus hits a small community living on an island in the North Sea.
In 1860s Japan, an idealistic young boy joins a group of revolutionaries to change his land for the better.
A police officer secretly recruits a criminal to join the force. Their illegal scheme hangs in the balance.
Twelve men and women are called for jury service in the retrial of a man accused of a triple murder after the High Court overturns the original verdict.
A Christmas vacation turns into a nightmare for a teenager and her family when they discover an ancient menace that stalks their island getaway.
A parody of "Baywatch" featuring Malibu Adjacent's world-famous lifeguard, Notch Johnson.
Inspired by the classic Chinese story Journey to the West, the series follows the adventures of a young teenager, MK, as he comes into terms of his mission to save the world.
Follows a tech billionaire who buys Canterville Chase, unaware that the contents include a malevolent family ghost, who has been haunting the premises for centuries.
Follows the lives of a group of medical professions working for the Flying Doctors Service in the remote Australian outback.

Dilek, a mother of two struggling to make ends meet as an unlicensed taxi driver, loses her car in a police raid. When a mysterious passenger offers her a driving job, she's drawn into a dangerous world that will change her life forever
The story of those who pursue passion, those who fly at the expense of burning and those who stand up against life in pain.

Chhota Bheem is an Indian animated series adventures about a boy named Bheem and his friends in fictional village of Dholakpur.Bheem and his friends are usually involved in protecting the village from various evil forces.
A newly blended family and two polar opposite stepsiblings named Erin and Aaron who come together through music.

Tang San is one of Tang Sect martial art clan's most prestigious disciples in the use of hidden weapons. The elders believe his future will be bright; yet Tang chooses to forsake this life at the cost of obtaining a forbidden lore.
A New York homicide detective is cursed with immortality.

A rookie filmmaker chronicles making his first movie while living with creative friends who help each other chase dreams in a crowded industry. The novice group takes odd jobs to survive and grow their brand.
From the original creators of EUPHORIA, this dynamic drama tells the story of a troubled teen who is sent away to a brutal juvenile detention facility, and how his humor and wit keep him alive.

Nurse Katja meets Tim, whose mom is hospitalized. She forgoes vacation to care for Tim and siblings upon their discomfort with the rural helper. Katja enjoys the role and stays, working with the priest to assist struggling families.
A fashion photographer and a veteran special forces soldier posing as her model go on intelligence missions around the world.
Follows former YouTuber and convicted felon Ruby Franke and her life in raising her six children; often in unsavory ways.
