Home hunters and their realtors check out all sorts of architectural styles and work through the idiosyncrasies of buying real estate in other countries.
When Lord Zedd returns more powerful than ever, Team Cosmic Fury takes to the cosmos to battle the emperor of evil, and save the universe as we know it.

movies.primaryTitle: You Can't Do That on Television
movies.originalTitle: You Can't Do That on Television
movies.plot: Sketch TV by young amateur actors in true classic Nick-style. But whatever you do, never admit that you don't know or ask for water.
The antics of the dysfunctional staff of Sutton branch of a mobile phone retailer.
"Die Landarztpraxis" is a series on SAT.1 (DE, AT, CH).
Generations clash when the award-winning C-suite at Atelier ad agency is canceled and pushed out and the Gen Z social media team is put in charge.
Drama following the life of the officers and men of the King's Own Fusiliers regiment, during their home lives, training exercises and battles.
The ladies of Atlanta's exclusive medical inner circle return with more patients, less patience and a few heart palpitations along the way.
The love story of two young Italian immigrants who first meet on their way to Brazil at the end of the 18th century, but are separated after their ship docks.
Three teen strangers awaken in a dangerous world and try to make sense of what connection they have to each other as they attempt to make it out alive.

It depicts the story of an ordinary housewife, Kang Eun Su, who turns to crime by selling drugs worth hundreds of billions of won that she accidentally finds while struggling to pay for her terminally ill husband's medical expenses.

About 20 years before Clanul, Bebe Udrea (George Mihaita), aka "Macelaru" (The Butcher), aimed to build his own clan and rise to the top of the mafia. The series reveals his dangerous journey and the origins of beloved Clanul characters.
Seher starts working at Agah Bey's house with her children. Curious love triangles form between the children of the two families, and the terrible secrets in the mansion begin to be revealed.
The adventures of suave cat burglar Alexander Mundy, who plies his trade for the U.S. Government.
Nev Schulman and Max Joseph help people who have fallen in love online test the authenticity of their lovers' identities.
A semi-spinoff of the popular Yu-Gi-Oh anime series, focusing on a boy named Jaden and his misadventures as a student at an esteemed Duel Monsters academy.
Following the misadventures of four buddies who work together at a magazine.

In an alternate universe, the Holy Grail War was won by the Yggdamillenia family. Now two factions with 7 Master-Servant pairs each and 1 extra Servant as the Ruler are fighting to win the Greater Holy Grail.
Jerry Seinfeld is joined by friends for a cup of coffee and a drive in a classic car, sharing stories all along the way.

movies.primaryTitle: The Irregular at Magic High School
movies.plot: Siblings Tatsuya and Miyuki are pitted against each other when they enroll at Magic High School.
Follows the heroic adventures of Spyro, Eruptor, Stealth Elf, Jet-Vac and Pop Fizz as they travel the vast Skylands universe, protecting it from evil-doers.
Explosive military drama about a crack SAS team. There's a life-or-death mission, reputations at stake, and stamina sorely tested at a combat survival weekend.

The computer virus Venjix wants to attack and destroy Corinth, the only city on Earth to survive its massacre. With the help of advanced biotechnology, RPM Power Rangers must save humanity and defeat Venjix.
This skit-filled Canadian comedy show pokes fun at the Canadian government and other national happenings.

Marasli is a retired soldier who became the owner of a bookstore. For Marasli, life changed dramatically after her daughter was killed. One day, the beautiful Mahur enters his bookstore and is involved in an accident shortly after.

Three women get caught in the world of human trafficking, prostitution and organized crime when one of their husbands disappears. The women, with completely different backgrounds, meet on similar turning points in their lives.

Sara Aapi is the story of a woman who sacrificed her dreams and the most precious years of her youth to give her three brothers the best upbringing. After the sudden death of her parents, Sara takes control of both the family and the business. She turns them into success stories, but at the cost of her own personal life. Her world revolves around her brothers, Burhan, Adnan, and Usman. Over time, Sara becomes strict and commanding. Her decisions become law inside the house. But her strongest test begins when her brothers' personal desires rise against her authority. Soon, tensions grow and loyalties are tested.

After testifying against a crime boss, an undercover agent's family is killed. Adopting a new identity as a trucker named Chance, he roams America helping people while evading hitmen and pursuing the crime boss.

movies.primaryTitle: In Another World with My Smartphone
movies.originalTitle: Isekai wa smartphone to tomo ni.
movies.plot: When a boy is accidentally killed by God, he is resurrected in another world as recompense with his magically enhanced smartphone being only the first of his gifts there.
Celebrating the noisy, joyful, messy reality of pre-school life.
A literature teacher suspects that a well-respected surgeon has drugged her and begins a legal case against him.
Follows four Dutch friends navigating crises of masculinity, relationships, and careers in a world of empowered women, using humorous methods to cope with their changing dynamics and struggles.
The show serves as a sequel to Dinotopia (2002) and adds a new threat to the world of Dinotopia in the form of outlaws knows as the Outsiders, as well as more dinos.
A trio of ninja trainees become Power Rangers to defend their school after it is attacked by aliens.
A show about two police officers from Wolfsrathausen who sometimes work a bit differently.
Actor and licensed barber Park Bo-gum opens a hair salon in the South Korean countryside together with friends and fellow actors Lee Sang-yi and Kwak Dong-yeon
Torn between love and ambition, Arjun must choose between Mira, the CEO who loves him, and Kavya, the Managing Director who promises success.
A poor woman loses her house and gets a job as a nanny taking care of 7 kids.

An anthology series featuring women from different walks of life who are driven to violence and murder because of circumstances varying from mental illness and domestic violence to humiliation and manipulation.
Three women face supernatural challenges weekly at haunted sites, alone without phones or crew. Host Rannvijay guides 13 episodes where the bravest contestant wins 5 lakhs.

A police inspector who wakes up from an eight year coma must adapt to the radical change that everyone living in France is naked. He soon learns that not everyone agrees with the government's mandatory nudity policy.

What happens when three kids from the other side of the track join a posh international Delhi school? CLASS follows the dramatic dynamics of this upmarket school and the tumultuous events that follow.
Budding entrepreneurs, inventors, and small businessmen pitch their ideas to five "dragons"--real-life business leaders and millionaires.
Ex-cop and recovering alcoholic Hank Dolworth partners with his best friend, former criminal Britt Pollack, in an unlicensed private investigation business.
A student at the Police Academy is tasked to study a cold case: the murder of a pregnant woman on a Swedish beach 25 years ago.
Three Norwegian women imprisoned in Bolivia for drug charges face lies, betrayal, and a risky jungle escape aided by an unlikely ally.
When clues to his brother's murder lead Poncho to a fire brigade, he joins it to investigate further and finds romance, family - and a serial killer.
A former cricket star becomes a coach and leads struggling students who unite to preserve a legacy while finding their own paths.
Jack Logan is a time traveler from 2007, who hunts down rogue travelers and brings them to justice before they can alter the past.

Following her husband's passing, Audrey fforbes-Hamilton is forced to sell her stately home. While she comes to terms with her downward mobility, she decides to show the new owner a thing or two about "nobility".
Detective Peter Wendel returns after a long sick leave to form a team to reopen cold cases; the team find clues that an innocent man has been convicted of murder.
"Call My Agent. - Berlin" is a dramedy series on Disney+. It's the german version of Call My Agent! (2015), Call My Agent - Italia (2023), Call My Agent Bollywood (2021) and "Call My Agent!" (????).

movies.originalTitle: Cook's Country from America's Test Kitchen
movies.plot: Discovers the best of American cuisine through extensive kitchen testing.
Mrs. Kate Columbo, wife of the famous lieutenant, solves crimes as a reporter, while raising her little daughter.
Martin Moone is a young boy who relies on the help of his imaginary friend, Sean, to deal with the quandaries of life in a wacky small-town Irish family circa 1990.
A woman sets out for revenge against the gang that tried to kill her.
Observational documentary series following life on a remote sheep farm in Yorkshire for Clive and Amanda Owen and their nine children.

movies.primaryTitle: Where in the World Is Carmen Sandiego?
movies.originalTitle: Where in the World Is Carmen Sandiego?
movies.plot: Contestants pursue the international thief as junior detectives who must answer questions about geography.
After a fateful domestic clash, a devoted mother Deniz Demir (Demet Evgar) finds herself in prison and fighting to survive in hopes of reuniting with her daughter.
A mix of celebrity interviews, musical performers, audience participation games, and segments spotlighting real people with extraordinary stories and talents.
After a family tragedy, a man discovers mythical creatures living among humans - and soon realizes they hold the key to his mysterious past.
Action drama following Aaron Bishop and Ronnie Pike; two NCA agents taking down hardened criminals in London.

A dancing competition with a monster twist that has never been seen before, giving a colorful global stage to people passionate about dance. Competitors transform into lovable and fantastical dance monsters in front of a panel of judges.
Two identical twin sisters separated at birth reunite and the rich, devious, cruel one offers to let her sweet-natured counterpart assume her place.
A small-town cheerleading squad is rocked by disturbing events when a new coach arrives.

movies.primaryTitle: Prince Caspian and the Voyage of the Dawn Treader
movies.originalTitle: Prince Caspian and the Voyage of the Dawn Treader
movies.plot: Young Prince Caspian of Narnia wonders and dreams of the old days of Narnia when animals talked, and there were mythical creatures and four rulers in Caer Paravel.
SML is an American live-action adult sitcom web series consisting of short films with puppet characters. The series often shows the life between Jeffy, Marvin, Junior and Friends, and Brooklyn Guy.
The fearless Baddies embark on a Midwest takeover, shaking up cities from Detroit to St. Louis with their bold style and unexpected alliances.
A twenty-three-year-old grade school teacher named Daisuke Aoki whose main problem is that one of his students named Rin Kokonoe has a crush on him.
Vindication is an episodic faith-based crime-drama series that follows the small-town investigative work of Detective Travis.
Savita's stale marriage takes a turn when her nephew-in-law Ravi returns from the city. His modern charm awakens her desires, leading to secret encounters that risk family bonds and social norms.

movies.primaryTitle: Polly Pocket: Adventures in Sparkle Cove
movies.originalTitle: Polly Pocket: Adventures in Sparkle Cove
movies.plot: Polly Pocket and friends take on the best adventures in Sparkle Cove. Join Polly, Lila, and Shani on the coolest island adventures, new powers, and fun challenges.

A big-city lawyer is prompted to undergo a "sea change" with her children and becomes the magistrate at the small coastal town of Pearl Bay, where the family comes to love its people and the quality time with one another.

Is the legend about the sea taking human offerings true? Are the two stones with the same sign carved in them to be blamed for all the events, or are the reasons hidden among people who are unaware of their mutual dark secret?
A group of five young dragons is prophesied to end a decades long war that has ravaged the fictional realm of Pyrrhia.
A divorced reporter, looking forward to the single life, finds his parents' marital problems derail his plans.
Property experts Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer show house hunters some properties for sale that fit their requirements.
A young couple who dreams of marriage conceal their identity to escape from the darned. They will introduce themselves as sibling and work in the farm in Adana.
Two bored friends discover a lifestyle magazine that promises excitement, but their attempt to follow its advice leads to a series of misadventures and unexpected consequences.
A single mother tries to find love again with her new boyfriend Diego, of whom her father disapproves. She gets help from her two brothers and two girlfriends at work (her father's bar).
Contestants face 26 sums of money, 26 suitcases, and one question: Deal or no deal?
A medical student who intervenes in an attack while wearing his father's police uniform, leading to complications. It will also parallel of a criminal barrister.
A young orphan and her new family unite in a quest for revenge against those responsible for their personal tragedies.

When a group of four boarding school students discover a supercomputer housed inside an abandoned factory, they find a virtual world called Lyoko and awaken a sentient multi-agent system virus that tries to take over the real world.
Twelve young people, united by an exaggerated personality and an eccentric lifestyle, who will live a vacation in a villa on the coast of Lazio.
A self-proclaimed intellectual is forced to move in with her carefree sister and her sister's lovably eccentric friends.
A member of a league of time travelers and a boy travel through time repairing errors in world history.
The fight of Abdulhamid II to keep Ottoman Empire and Caliphate alive.
It follows a woman as she sets off to solve a murder that she witnessed on a rough estate.
Behind the scenes of Stranger Things, shining the lights on the crew who makes the show possible.

An exotic dancer is frozen in 2001 and unfrozen in 2525 by two female warriors fighting against robots that have taken over the world. The three join forces and try to escape from the underground caves to which humanity has been banished.
A therapist struggles with problems of his patients, while dealing with the ones in his personal life.
The house where you were born even decides who you love and who you marry. First the mothers take the pen in his hand and start writing.
John Drake is a special operative for NATO, specializing in security assignments against any subversive element which threatened world peace.
A royal's idealistic journey to Mexico becomes a tale of love and betrayal as Carlota and Maximilian face political turmoil while trying to build their empire amid rising cultural tensions.
Pawel is a decent man - a devoted husband, father and skilled heart surgeon. One hasty decision alters the course of his perfect life forever.

Former professional snooker Lin Yi Yang met the popular nine-ball player Yin Guo on a rare snowstorm night. With the help of Yin Guo's cousin, they got to know each other. Yin Guo's appearance changed his life; he fell in love with her.

An aspiring actor built a Ponzi scheme to fund his Hollywood dreams, faking wealth through false CEO connections. He lured investors while living luxuriously, until his deception collapsed, leaving $200M missing.
Middle school students clash over social status when a new girl challenges the popular crowd's dominance, leading to a divided campus where rivals must ultimately learn to bridge their differences.

movies.primaryTitle: The New Leave It to Beaver
movies.plot: The continuing adventures of the "now adult" Beaver Cleaver, his family, and their friends.
A charismatic defense attorney and a powerhouse television producer work together to control the media following a high-profile incident.
True crime show about conflicts between neighbors that go terribly wrong.

In the jungles of Peru, the fight for survival heightened his senses. Now, Detective Jim Ellison is a sentinel in the fight for justice. Anthropologist Blair Sandburg works side by side with Jim, helping him develop these senses.

June and Oscar live a comfortable but very predictable suburban wedded life when suddenly they find themselves in a completely otherworldly situation, raising questions about love and marriage in the afterlife.
A group of rebellious women are put in a house together in an experiment intended to moderate their behavior.
The World War II North African missions of an Allied commando patrol squad of the Long Range Desert Group.
Mere Humsafar, is a story about a British national, Hala, who is left to his father's relatives when her father and mother decide to separate after her birth.
When the secrets overshadowed by the past come to light, friendships and loves intersect in the lives of Leman, Sahika, Mine, Suzi and Demir with brave confrontations.
Thundarr the Barbarian and his companions Ookla the Mok and Princess Ariel wander a devastated future Earth and fight evil wherever they find it.
Exploring hidden worlds, revealing objects and organisms concealed beneath surfaces through technological imagery and serendipitous incidents.
Two antiques experts compete against each other over five days, buying antiques and selling them in five auctions. The programme is done in a lighthearted fashion with all profits going to charity.

Colorful, charismatic characters run a restoration shop and use their impressive skills and experience to restore, trade, and sell classic cars--transforming piles of rust into collectible car treasures.
Two half-sisters, a New Zealand farmer and an Athens detective, team up to solve crimes while searching for their father. Shirley's rural wisdom complements Helen's investigative skills.
Tracey Ullman returns to British screens with this new sketch show, introducing us to a slew of new comic characters and impersonations of celebrities.
After losing his only wife, Faruk returns to his mansion in Istanbul with his children. Serap, who comes with them to take care of the children, has ambitious plans.
An unusual alliance develops between Diana Trent, a cynical retired photojournalist and Tom Ballard, a former accountant, while staying at the Bayview Retirement Home.

Shaman King follows the adventures of a 13-year-old shaman and his teammate a samurai warrior spirit, who traverse the world fighting evil spirits and misguided shamans on their journey to be the next Shaman King.
"A father's love can save a life... or take one," sets the tone for a dark and gritty series.

movies.originalTitle: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Tekketsu no Orphans
movies.plot: 300 years after the Calamity War, a ragtag group of freedom fighters and an ancient Mobile Suit rise to the call for justice, once and for all.

Leo, Mathias, Jens and Herman were kings of High School. 8 years later they are still living together, and haven't done anything with their lives, except party, drink, and repeat. Society has left them behind, without them knowing it. Yet.
Two former child prodigies, together since childhood, reach their 30s and wonder if their average lives-and their relationship-match the exceptional potential they once showed.
Cast, crew and experts detail the secret histories of the most iconic film and television series of all time.
Friendly dinosaurs climb aboard a train to visit different times throughout the prehistoric age, learning about dinosaurs and having fun adventures.
Phinny, an innovative young corgi, might be the smallest pup on the crew, but he proves that you don't need big paws to have big dreams or big ideas.
An upscale law firm specializing in family law undertakes clients with domestic conflicts.
Focus on finding affordable beachfront properties, aiming to show how to own affordable paradise houses.
A bone chilling history that unravels the twisted ties of fate, hidden secrets of a family and terrifying horrors an investigator has ever seen.
Troubled by an atypical medical condition that has a direct bearing on a young boy's sexual life, the world around him goes upside down wherein everyone tries to take advantage of his abilities.
Revolves around seven childhood friends who discover that life at 30 is definitely not what they had imagined while growing up.
The Power of Two features forty original Battle for BFDI contestants, two recommended character contestants, Bomby, Donut and Tear Drop (User Name)
The story of Zelda Sayre Fitzgerald, a brilliant and beautiful Southern belle who became the original flapper and icon of the wild, flamboyant Jazz Age.

Three sisters, Hitomi, Rui, and Ai, run a café but moonlight as the art thief trio "Cat's Eye". They steal paintings, leaving clues to find their missing artist father from the Nazi era. Hitomi's fiancé Toshi, a cop, vows to catch them.
A celebrated crime novelist suffering from Alzheimer's is found at a murder scene with no memory of what happened. Now, it is up to his daughter to save him.
An Australian dating reality show based on the British series Love Island.
A musically-talented teenager returns to her native Buenos Aires after living in Europe.
Fleur's life takes a turn when a low moment becomes a viral meme, forcing her to pack up her life with her daughter and move back in with her parents.
Taimoor, a powerful businessman, seems to have it all until secrets emerge. His marriage, family tensions, and a new woman's arrival unravel the façade, exposing the true nature of each relationship.
Malika leaves comfort and tradition behind for love. Her life with Raza brings unexpected constraints instead of the dream she sought. Through loss and change, she finds a new path to herself.

Police officer Darby Spencer and her mystery novelist mother Victoria Spencer have opposite personalities but still embark on the unlikeliest of ventures: becoming partners in a private detective agency.
Follows Victor, a police officer who dedicated his life to fight the narcotraffic war and to help his son Pedro, a drug addict who became one of the most wanted criminals in Brazil.

When three young girls turn up dead in Osijek, Croatian officials worry there's a serial killer on the loose; on the hunt for justice, detectives find help from the unlikeliest of allies, leading the group down a dangerous path.
A former heavyweight boxing champion struggles to find his identity after retiring from the ring.
Rotating panelists discuss the big news of the day and react to the top stories;
Set in the year 2199, a young woman who has lost everything finds a new life at Earth's Space Training Academy where she learns to defend the galaxy from intergalactic threats.

Follows the exploits of the infamous pickpocket, The Artful Dodger, and Fagin's gang as they find ingenious ways to survive the grim and exploitative conditions of early Victorian London in the 1830s.
An epic tale that explores the eternal battle between the good and evil, highlighting the quest for righteousness and spiritual awakening.

A master of disguise, a charmer, and a smooth talker - this is a story about genius conman Matsya Thada. Fate throws him a curveball when a cunning and ruthless cop wants to apprehend him at any cost.

At the 203 apartments Drake, NYC, residents are granted one wish - any wish. But beware of the price. There's something supernatural and evil about The Drake that only the owners, Gavin and Olivia. know about/control.
Suddenly one day, monsters called Neighbors emerge from a portal to a different world. Earth's weapons do not affect them, but a mysterious group of warriors begins to fight the Neighbors.
The lives of William (an undertaker) and Mary (a midwife) cross. They become romantically involved, but what happens for the rest of the series is far less predictable.
Gifted teen hacker Lux gets humiliated at engineering school. To get revenge, he cyberstalks and befriends the popular clique, manipulating them with their own secrets until his scheme backfires.
Four panelists must determine guests' occupations - and, in the case of famous guests, while blindfolded, their identity - by asking only "yes" or "no" questions.
A T.V. show that is filmed on location in a particular strip club. It follows the strippers/dancers and the drama from the inside point of view.
After selling their Swedish supermarket for millions, Tom and Petra move to Mallorca for a luxury retirement. Events at Tom's 50th birthday lead his brother's family to follow, triggering chaos.

movies.primaryTitle: Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story
movies.originalTitle: Magia Rekôdo: Mahô Shôjo Madoka Magika Gaiden
movies.plot: A magical girl, Iroha Tamaki, searches for her missing sister in the mysterious city of Kamihama, where it is rumored that magical girls can achieve salvation.

movies.primaryTitle: A Minha Familia É Uma Animação
movies.originalTitle: A Minha Familia É Uma Animação
movies.plot: The many adventures of a family that tries to protect a very special member by hiding him: Neco, a cartoon kid.
A group of kids sing songs at a club for kids. They solve problems in-between performances.

The misadventures of three twenty-something flatmates, bound together by circumstance. Mandy is sexually active, Martin is sexually inactive, and their troubled landlord Matthew never leaves the flat.
The continuing adventures of Agents K and J as they deal with problems with extraterrestrials in New York City.
A group of seemingly unrelated strangers all receive a mysterious note stating "I know what you did", which sends their lives into a downward spiral.
A white former NBA professional retires from the pro game and gets a job as a basketball coach in a predominantly Black inner-city high school.
A religious former police officer plans a bold robbery with a sinister ally to fund her daughter's crucial operation.

A young Xiaolin monk named Omi with a giant yellow head leads a trio of other students to collect powerful items known as Shen Gong Wu while battling the evil Jack Spicer who is also after the artifacts
Teen best friends Debbie and Sue grow up and find love and freedom on the beaches of Sydney's Sutherland Shire during the tumultuous 1970s.
Fictional characters from movies, comics, manga, television programs, literature and video games are created in a simulated battle to the death.
A once happy family suddenly begins to fall apart following a seemingly minor incident in which a man slaps another couple's misbehaving child.
A jazz musician gains super powers after getting struck by lightning.

In 2029 Japan, under GHQ control after the Lost Christmas virus, teenager Shu discovers his power to extract weapons from others. His peaceful life changes when he meets Inori, a member of the resistance group Funeral Parlor.

Kevin Hart and other celebrities play comic fictionalized versions of themselves in this parody of similarly-named reality shows. Episodes often feature Kevin Hart's attempts to gain celebrity, and his jealousy of his friends.
Following the death of his son, Gus Witherspoon takes in his daughter-in-law and his three grandchildren to live with him. Adjustment to the new arrangement is not easy on any of them.
Bluey, an energetic Blue Heeler pup, brings her family into imaginative games unfolding in hilarious ways, weaving her neighborhood into her delightful world.
Host and designer Vern Yip travels across the country to mentor brave renovators who have taken on the task of converting unusual commercial and industrial spaces into one-of-a-kind family homes.

There is a couple who has a love marriage, but after some time, there is a lot of distance between them and both are in lot of tension, then his friend tells him that wife swiping game is the best solution for them.
The wealthy Sanders family deals with the loss of their matriarch while uncovering and facing a variety of secrets and scandals.
UK comedy sketch show depicting most forms of stereotypical British society.
Cases and complicated lives of a public prosecutor and a police unit, a member of whom is the prosecutor's son, who work in Wiesbaden.

Follows Álvaro, a 17-year-old from a wealthy family, whose life takes a downward turn after an accident lands him in a juvenile detention center. It portrays his experiences and struggles within the correctional facility.

movies.originalTitle: Sakir Pasa Ailesi: Mucizeler ve Skandallar
movies.plot: Delving into the lives of the Sakir Pasa family from 1912, the story follows Ottoman artists like painter Fahrelnisa Zeid, engraver Aliye Berger, and ceramist Füreya Koral, exploring their relationships and contributions.

Sitara is an orphan who finds joy in life despite her struggles. At a wedding, she mistakenly believes Salar, a wealthy young man, is the photographer. Their growing connection faces family objections and conspiracy.

The Dakota Boys assemble a team of divers, mountaineers, and mechanics to explore uncharted plunge pools in white water rapids, using suction dredges in treacherous conditions where a mistake could prove fatal.
The estranged wife of a television reporter returns to invade his new life.
Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest is a sequel to Hiro Mashima's Fairy Tail series, focusing on Natsu Dragneel and his team from the wizard guild as they aim to complete an unfinished, century-old mission.
Victoria Winters comes to Collinwood, an isolated mansion in Maine, to work as a governess, but soon finds herself drawn into a strange world of vampires, ghosts and curses.
It follows a crew of fierce female convicts who break free and go on the run.
It follows the disappearance of a young woman which triggers a devastating chain of events which lays bare the dark, hidden heart of paradise.
A thief and conman is given the means to become invisible, and ends up working for a government agency.
Sid and Jean Abbott struggle to understand their teenage children's progressive ways. The couple live in London with protest-loving son Mike and trendy daughter Sally.
A tomboy, mistaken for a lad, maintains the deception for the sake of employment. The situation becomes complicated when her male boss begins to develop feelings for this "boy."
Katerina Verbitskaya grew up as a noble lady with her godmother Anna Chervinskaya. But everyone thinks that she was only Peter Chervinsky's property.
A college professor copes with contemporary fatherhood.
Three teams of gold prospectors take a gamble to strike it big, deep in the wild west of outback Australia.

A dark dramedy about a progressive Portlandian family made up of husband, wife, three adopted children from Liberia, Vietnam and Colombia, and one biological daughter, who find their sanity tested and values challenged in 2018 America.
Our ragtag group of misfits serves the best weed and the biggest laughs in an LA medical marijuana dispensary called, The Dharma Collective.
Startup founder Tara and investor Matthew clash over their rival dating apps - hers based on compatibility, his on chemistry. They challenge each other to prove which approach works better.
Three friends attend a school for fish submerged in a pet shop.
Fanny falls deeply in love with a hip-hop producer. This dangerous love turns out to be the beginning of a bigger human trafficking network.
Moz is a drug dealer and has very strange clientele who come and go from his flat.
Ex-couples who broke up for various reasons gather to look back on their past love and to find new love.
A manager is sent to India to oversee a staff of customer service representatives.
A debt collector is kidnapped and made to take over a rich businessman's identity, facing deadly threats, a forced marriage, and powerful enemies while living his dangerous double life.
Charo Santos-Concio brings to light the extraordinary real life stories and anecdotes of ordinary people as well as celebrities.
Chip Chilla is a comedic, pre-school series celebrating the day to day lessons of Chip and his homeschooling family of energetic Chinchillas.

Alexis wants to learn everything about her mother's past. She finds out that her family is connected with the isolated island of Spinaloga - the former settlement of lepers. Adaption of the novel, "The Island", by Victoria Hislop.
Centers on a rookie Secret Service agent embroiled in an international crisis on his first day. Navigating power and corruption, he crosses moral lines to uncover the truth.
Tales of crime and passion in Auckland, New Zealand, spanning from 1974 through to 1990.
The StoryBots are back, answering tough questions and delivering so many laughs that kids won't even realize they're learning.
The Chihuahua and Cat duo return for more adventures, but this time they are more adult-oriented.
A globe-trekking reality show that follows Josh Gates around the world as he explores different sites of supernatural import.
Three intertwined timelines follow the planning and execution of a daring heist in Zurich and its aftermath as an FBI agent pursues a master criminal across Europe.
A group of kids and a robot learn lessons from the Bible with the help of a time-traveling book.
It is about life that intersects with the collision of four cars.
The Masire brothers rule Johannesburg's criminal underworld but a supernatural family curse and a tangled web of betrayal threaten to destroy them.

A devoted son balances work with caring for his ill parent alongside his two obsessive sisters. His structured life takes an unexpected turn when he encounters Inci and discovers feelings he's never experienced before.
Mona, an orphan, works at an online newspaper reporting on arson cases in Istanbul. One day, while covering a house fire, she encounters photojournalist Yakup, there on the same assignment.

movies.primaryTitle: The New Adventures of Robin Hood
movies.originalTitle: The New Adventures of Robin Hood
movies.plot: The legendary outlaw and his Merry Men battle evil around Nottingham and Sherwood Forest.
Tetraplegic artist Freya and straight-laced lawyer Abe's whirlwind romance tackles the realities of dating with a disability, with personal assistants ever-present during intimate moments.
In peaceful, snowy Porvoo, secrets held by the icy river are surfacing. Uncompromising Chief Inspector Hautalehto must hunt a well-concealed killer.
Ex-cop Armaan Mistry brilliantly cracks the hardest cases, but struggles with severe OCD.
Set against the backdrop of a horrible murder at Mahim station, follows Peter's involvement in this diabolical inquiry. The stakes rise when his own son, Sunil, becomes a suspect in the case.

Kumar Mahajan's life takes an unexpected turn when Sudarshan Chakrapani, a man mirroring his fate, crosses paths with him. Can this meeting empower Kumar to take control of his present and alter his destiny?
A comedy sketch show centered around All That (1994) alum Amanda Bynes.

A diverse group of tourists on an organized trip to Lisbon find themselves investigating a murder after one of them is killed on the first morning. Set out to find the killer among the group as they visit beautiful Lisbon sites.

Marianna, Shira, and JJ struggle to overcome their pasts and draw on their personal strength and one another to navigate the storm of relationships, intrigue, and romantic tension, as well as danger and violence, to find happiness.
French remake of Ghosts (2019
The adventures of a professional lumber salvager and his friends in Gibsons, British Columbia.

The adventures of a rhyming canine superhero.
Participants called Roadies are selected via auditions from all over India, visit different locations and compete in challenging tasks to win a prize.
Three students and their adventures adult life with their guru's while studying.
A group of teens with psychic and other paranormal abilities use their special gifts to battle evil.
Violetta is bored with her life in Mexico and runs away to New York with a bag full of money.

"Rederiet" is one of the most successful soap opera in the history of the Swedish television. The story is about the passenger company (Freja), who operates on the Baltic sea between Stockholm -Åbo. And it takes place both in Stockholm (mostly in the office of the company) and on board m/s Freja. Well. The company (Dahlénrederiet) has for decades been run by the Dahlén family. But when the story begins so are there many people who are trying to gain control over the company, which leads to a constant struggle for the power. As well is it also a constant struggle for higher positions between the personal on the ship and some people use their position to make some extra money. And in the middle of all this problem are the of course many troubles with the passengers or with the ship which have to be solved. So there is (as always in a soap opera), terrible accidents, deaths, murders, smuggling, theft, infidelity, arson, rape, drugs and many other terrible things. But there will also be a lot of love and friendship and maybe some unknown relatives will show up.

Magistrate Claire Lewis Jones faces dilemmas as her daughter's friend faces charges and a criminal kingpin from her past resurfaces, entangling her family in a web of deceit that blurs the lines between justice and personal loyalties.
Olie, his sister Zowie, and his best friend Billy live as robots and discover the values of friendship, family, and growing up to be a great kid.

A fallen Taekwondo champion protects an autistic boy after his family is attacked, fleeing to her estranged mother's village, where buried secrets and a mysterious disappearance challenge their search for safety.

A chance meeting after a cancelled flight leads to an unlikely night of drunken airport-hotel sex between two strangers in their late twenties, Fola and Josh. Both are already in relationships and unknowingly soon to be neighbours.

Mockumentary focusing on real-life comedy couple John Richardson and Lucy Beaumont, who play fictionalized versions of themselves, their home and work lives, and relationships with their Hebden Bridge neighbors and celebrity friends.

SuperMarioLogan revolves around puppets/plush versions of Mario characters, other characters from other media, and even original characters, and it follows their bizarre life and adventures at home and at school.
A clerical error sends 12-year-old Adam Lyon to a middle school for zoo animals, but his best friend, Jake the Monkey, is standing by him every step of the way to help him adjust.
A team of negotiators and special forces respond to a hostage situation in a small bank, with the events unfolding through the eyes of the criminals and their victims.
Sophie Haas, an aspiring criminal investigator from Cologne, is relegated to a very small police outpost in the Eifel mountains.
The adventures of young H.G. Wells and his time machine.
A young gay couple must overcome dark, mystical forces conspiring against them, starting with a vengeful 19th century witch and her cheating warlock fiance.
An immersive, action-packed and discovery-led series following International teams of archaeologists during the excavation season in Egypt's Valley of the Kings.

Tumble Leaf is a series aimed at preschoolers, set in a whimsical land where a small blue fox plays and discovers adventure and friendship around every bend in the path. Children will be enriched by understanding the world around them.
Follows two best friends from the U.S. who go backpacking in Australia and are soon drawn into a seemingly perfect community of surfers led by a charismatic but mysterious figure, Brando.
A revenge saga that unfolds against the backdrop of the ancient tradition of Khaie.

A remote Alaskan town that has been overrun by paranormal forces. Local outcast Roman Mercer must overcome the town's prejudices and his own personal demons if he's to harness his repressed psychic powers and save everyone.
Girls from rural areas attend a finishing school in a bold social experiment. As their lives spiral downward, they work to transform themselves. A reality show about self-improvement begins.
To escape her sister's shadow, a top student bets her future on tutoring the school's worst class, only to betray their fragile trust and risk their future.
Timothy West and Prunella Scales travel across canals in both Britain and Europe.

A young girl and her blended family move to the small cottage town of Evermoor. All is well until sinister things start to happen, magic tapestries, an enchanted typewriter. Only a few of the strange things found in the town of Evermoor.
Showcases sites of unusual activity to discover if the activity documented on Skinwalker Ranch is real and pervasive.
Demir and Selin stubbornly claim the same house and are forced to live together. The company will become inevitable when someone comes to the company he works for and the other as manager.

Señora Acero 3: La Coyote--Bastard daughter of Vicente Acero, Vicenta Rigores Acero (La Coyote) must come face-to-face with her destiny to become the New Señora Acero, as she is the heiress of the Acero family dynasty.
It tells the story of James. His observations on life fuel his comedic rants at everyday inconveniences and elevates them to absurd heights.

Having fun at school, doing homework together, cooking and eating, playing video games, watching anime. All these little things make up the daily life of anime and chocolate lover Izumi Konata and her friends.

A recovering alcoholic who becomes the manager of a big city bus station.
A vast, panoramic tale charting the fortunes of four large families and exploring India and its rich and varied culture at a crucial point in its history.
A teenage Tony Stark battles evil with his revolutionary power armor technology.
A reformed party girl finds herself an insta-family after falling in love with a man with three manipulative children and two judgmental ex-wives.

The oddball family life of Miranda Sings, an incredibly confident, totally untalented star on the rise who continues to fail upward by the power of her belief that she was born famous--but nobody knows yet.

movies.primaryTitle: Who Do You Think You Are?

Nisan goes after her friend who disappeared after attending a healing session together. The adventure begins for Nisan, who reaches a cult while following her friend's footsteps.
Join Wubbzy and all of his Wuzzleburg friends! Widget is the busiest builder and fix-it whiz, Walden knows all about science and art, Daizy is the sweet girly-girl next door.
Follows the journey of a married vampire couple struggling to accept their daughter's human boyfriend, after being together for 500 years.
A country bumpkin goes to live with her upperclass relatives and learns to adapt amongst her peers, without changing who she is.
Set right after the events of Babylon 5: A Call to Arms (1999), a team of soldiers and scientists led by Capt. Matthew Gideon have five years to find a cure for an alien plague decimating Earth.

A group of poltergeist experts locate, retrieve, confiscate, or otherwise do what it takes to fix haunting situations.
Mickey Mouse hosts a youth-oriented variety show featuring 'The Mouseketeers'.
John Ritter and Markie Post star in this comedy about two politicos that fall in love.
A story of two popular college students who fell in love through an online game.

Humanity must resume its war against the Martians when they revive after decades of hibernation following their defeat in the 1950s.
Contestants run, jump, crawl, climb, hang, and swing through crazy obstacles as they compete to become the next American Ninja champion.
They call him the Sniffer. He's the proud owner of an acute sense of smell, he knows things about you even you don't and would rather keep to yourself.

Anuradha Chandra stabs her perfect lawyer husband one fateful night and confesses to her crime. However, it is anything but an open and shut case.

A single mom tries to raise her daughter in London while wondering if she should have another kid.
A covert team of skilled operatives undertakes high-risk missions to rescue hostages from perilous locations worldwide, inspired by a real-life intelligence officer.
Dr. Matt Powers is chief of Hope Memorial Hospital in the city of Madison, and he cares about the lives of staff and patients.
Scientist/comedian Bill Nye explores various aspects of science for young viewers.
This London-set series centers on a young woman pursued by shadowy paranormal adversaries while grappling with extraordinary abilities of her own.

Chulbul the cable guy is having an affair with married woman Seema. He sees schoolgirl Soni while with Seema and resolves to connect cable for Soni. Chulbul schemes to obtain a new subscription.
Jerrica Benton is secretly the leader of the glamorous and exciting music group, Jem and the Holograms.
Ash and his Pikachu travel to the Kalos Region where he explores and battle Pokémon with new friends along the way.

Comic goings-on at a holiday camp: Ted's the camp comic but is always on the lookout for a way to make money; Gladys has her eye on the boss; Peggy wants to swap her mop and cleaner's outfit for a "yellow coat".
A jet plane named Jett travels the world delivering packages to children and solving problems with his friends the Super Wings.
Facing his own past, an investigator unravels the mystery behind three cruel, ritualistic murders.

Two hosts blend witty banter and sharp humor with sports analysis, creating a fresh take on athletic discussion and game breakdowns.

The story of students of a specialized high school seeking their ambitions, rather than going off to college. It will delve into how these students learn about love, friendship, true passions, and growing up in an intense environment.
Two individuals' lives intersect on a desolate highway as they embark on a journey of love, redemption, and self-discovery, unraveling their pasts and embracing their true selves along the way.
Ferit, who is about to marry Hande, the daughter of the Varoglu family, is confronted with the facts before the wedding and his world is turned upside down.
Four fashionable teenage girls scoop stories for their popular magazine.

movies.primaryTitle: Marry Me, Let's Have a Baby!

The cases of Hawaiian Eye Private Investigations and the two handsome, slick, tough-guy detectives who ran the firm, Thomas Jefferson Lopaka, or Tom for short, and Tracy Steele, a Korean War veteran and former city police detective.

movies.primaryTitle: El Dragón: Return of a Warrior

Addie is a teenage middle school student. She has two BFFs and an annoying big brother.

A Welsh community devastated by tragedy is forced to confront difficult truths amid the search for justice.

Bai Shuo, a general's daughter aspiring for immortality to repay kindness. Despite difficulties, love breaks through restrictions, embracing each other's truest stories.
Diego, a boy who loves nature, helps save animals in trouble with his friend jaguar.

A group of misfit cops rise up from decades of helplessness to save their corrupt city from catastrophe.
About a man who lives in a boat in the middle of the ocean and faces challenges from the sea animals.

-STAT shares with us the daily life of the staff of St-Vincent Hospital in Montreal (Canada).

A reality series explores non-monogamous, committed relationships involving more than two people.

A queer, fast-paced narrative follows a newly single man roams the streets of Brussels in search of fleeting, comforting encounters.
Twin teenagers Riley and Chloe are subject to the trials and tribulations of school, family, friends, and boys.
The personal journey of an atheist writer and a dysfunctional family as they embark on a pilgrimage to visit all 18 Maha Shakti Peethas.
A bunch of kids are to make a newspaper for the young, named "Junior Gazette". The series follows these kids both on job and in private.

Chef Alton Brown whips up quick recipes and explores the science behind what makes them so tasty.

The successful head chef, Michael, must suddenly defend his position with the arrival of a new sous-chef, Naja. She serves up new initiatives aiming to modernize the work environment, hierarchy and gender equality in the restaurant, Værk.

To revive the Queen, the symbol of happiness called Cure Decor, "the Queen's scattered power of light of happiness", is required. To collect the Cure Decor, a fairy named Candy searches for the Pretty Cures on Earth. There, Candy meets a girl, who decides to collect the Cure Decor. Now, will the world earn a "happy ending"?

Widower Tom Corbett raises his young son Eddie.

Follows DCI Joe Mottram, a star detective with the Metropolitan police who, after a personal tragedy, retreats to Capri in Italy with his daughter to stay with his Italian in-laws for the summer.

The story of Moses from his birth to his death, following the well known story of the Plagues and Commandments and weaving in many other stories of the Hebrews and Egyptians who touched his life.

As more crimes and criminals cross borders, the Danish police creates an international criminal investigation team. The half Icelandic "Ørnen" leads the diverse team of 6. The latest technology (2004-6) is used.
Sketch comedy series featuring a range of different humor styles.
Ritu and Anuj as they navigate through their newly budding romance.
Satirical yet educational animated series about a young girl who is secretly the superhero Wordgirl, armed with superhuman strength, abilities, and a skilled vocabulary.

Ten contestants, seven days, ONE MILLION prize fund. Sidemen Reality Show.

Baywatch veteran Mitch Buchannon moonlights as a P.I. with his two friends Garner and Ryan. In season 2, Diamont replaces Garner, and Mitch's cases suddenly take a hard turn towards supernatural horror.
A corrupt officer falls for a businessman's wife, but their manipulation backfires as greed and betrayal reshape their lives.

Woo So Jeong is a doctor. Even though it is illegal, she helps terminally ill patients, who are suffering from pain, with euthanasia. She does this with Dr. Choi Dae Hyeon. Detective Cho Hyeon U works to track them down.

An animated parody of popular science fiction movies and TV shows.
Yuki Cross, a student at the Cross Academy, acts as guardian to the school's vampire population.
Drama focusing on the players at Earls Park Football Club as well as the lives of their wives and girlfriends.

The continued story of Betty and Armando. The couple is now married and raise their daughter Camila. Betty is also the president of her own fashion company called Ecomoda. Armando is the vice president.

Ren, an emotionally unstable Chihuahua, and Stimpy, a good-natured yet dimwitted cat.
Two neighbors with contrasting attitudes towards drying undergarments garner assumptions from local men about their perceived promiscuity.
Online news series covering the dangerous Spider-Man.
