An affluent divorced woman named Caroline Weatley, raising her son Tom with help from her mother Laura West, seeks a housekeeper, and a man named Charlie Burrows applies for the job.
A boy who is able to read the secrets of those whose skin comes in contact with him, and a girl who does her best to hide her pain.
Set free on Earth, fairies with magical powers begin influencing people's emotions. Now, it's up to a princess from a faraway kingdom to stop them.
Spin-off of Total Drama (2007), with the characters we love, plus Jude from 6Teen (2004), as kids.

movies.primaryTitle: The LXD: The Legion of Extraordinary Dancers
movies.originalTitle: The LXD: The Legion of Extraordinary Dancers
movies.plot: Chronicles the journey of seemingly ordinary people who discover they have extraordinary powers and must choose their place in an epic war between good and evil.
An anthology series featuring various predominately British mystery stories.

After a nude photo leaks online, three teenage friends face the consequences and struggle to regain control of their lives while navigating through social media, relationships, and personal boundaries.

movies.primaryTitle: The Hard Times of RJ Berger
movies.originalTitle: The Hard Times of RJ Berger
movies.plot: The daily life of an unpopular high school student.
Ria, a happily married suburban housewife, reaches the age when she feels like life is passing her by.

Peter and Eva, expecting their first child, buy a house in a suburb. Before moving into their new home, they lose the child. Eva finds it difficult to assimilate the loss. Peter has mixed feelings. For one thing, the baby was not his.

movies.originalTitle: Odayaka Kizoku no Kyuka no Susume
movies.plot: A brilliant chancellor gets transported to another world but stays cool-headed. He teams up with Gil, a top independent adventurer, treating it like a vacation as they begin their easygoing fantasy journey.

movies.primaryTitle: If My Wife Becomes an Elementary School Student.
movies.plot: It begins when a husband and his daughter, who lost his wife 10 years ago and lost the meaning of life, unexpectedly reunited with their wife (mother). As his wife is reborn as a 10-year-old elementary schooler, the family is reborn.
A continuation of the movie of the same name where Frances "Baby" Houseman falls in love with camp dance instructor Johnny Castle.
An erotic anthology series exploring different aspects of love, lust and romance.

Zeynep, a single mother, meeting Fatih, a wealthy man who also returns to Türkiye with disappointments. To get out of the difficult situation they are in, they both tell everyone that Fatih is the father of the baby.
A philandering billionaire playboy who moonlights as the superhero, Awesome X, faces against his greatest adversary, Killface, but finds balancing his business and superhero lives difficult.

A hot-blooded prosecutor is murdered when he gets entangled in an investigation around a corrupt politician. He gets sent back in time to when he was 18 years old, and he prepares to take down his enemy.
A reporter's world turns upside down when a criminologist claims to be his forgotten first love. As he investigates his own memories, he must confront whether his past is truly what he remembers.
SOKO Köln is a German crime series that is broadcast on ZDF.
Follows the magical adventures of fraternal twin genies Shimmer and Shine, who unintentionally create chaos while attempting to grant wishes for their human best friend Leah.
The travails of a tightly knit family that moves to Istanbul.
Teams compete to navigate rooms flooded with lava by leaping from chairs, hanging from curtains and swinging from chandeliers.
Host Adam Richman (and subsequently Casey Webb) travels around the U.S., taking on a variety of local eating challenges involving meal size, spiciness and other daunting factors.

Adam was the first human God made, followed by Eve. God made them a garden with fresh fruits, but warned them to not eat from the one tree. That tree was beautiful, but if Adam ate the fruit from it, it would be a huge sin.
A reality dating series where singletons across the country meet, date, and get engaged before seeing each other.
A new police task force disrupts crime in Redburn, causing tensions and a ceasefire. The task force challenges criminal elite, locals shape youth, and Chloe navigates power dynamics.

Reyhan was born in the countryside; is a modest, young and beautiful girl who grew up in traditional style. Reyhan remains an orphan after her mother's death, and her life changes at an unexpected point.
Teen thieves learn to use their skills for good at a secret school run by Caspian Lockett. Young pickpocket Gabriel Avery joins The Crooked Network to fight 'The Nameless' and discovers his destiny.

This series takes place at a cutting-edge city hospital. The first season follows Ella (played by Kim van Kooten), a skilled obstetrician who leads a team of fellow medical professionals. Together, they must perform under immense pressure. The healthcare providers and their patients represent all walks of life and amidst their many triumphs and struggles, laughter and tears occur in equal measure. The thin line between one's personal life and one's professional life becomes increasingly blurred when working such long hours, making conflict unavoidable. But in the end, there is one thing that unites everyone on this parallel hospital-universe: the universal human experience of new life, fragile yet filled with hope and potential.
Aboard the narrowboat Naughty Lass, an explorer navigates the intricate network of canals, revealing the beauty of England's landscapes, towns, and villages from a unique perspective.
Five young adults are recruited by the Lightspeed Rescue organization to protect the city of Marnier Bay from the forces of evil.
Three girls in high school made a prank on the fourth girl and caused her to be expelled from the high school with her teacher. After 20 years they got together in a high society environment.
An 8th grader with preteenage problems on her mind and magical braces in her mouth tries to survive 8th grade and later, high school.
A supernatural thriller set in an elite boarding school with a secret so dark, it will shake up the lives of everyone connected to it.
The elegant hotel Fürstenhof in the little village Bichlheim becomes a place for two young people to find the love of her/his life. But things get complicated.
Two teenage slackers find a mecha from the future that had been lying in a New Jersey junkyard for nearly 60 years and make modifications much to the dismay of the robot's attractive creator.

Defne is hired as an IT expert at Yalin's tech company. First they dislike each other. Things change when Defne's brother starts dating Yalin's sister, but will other members of Defne's traditional and Yalin's modern family also get along?

Battling with limited resources, a wonderful invention made by Taner, who dreams of one day reuniting with his childhood love Dilek, and his two cousins pave the way for an unforgettable turn of events.
Series of one-off dramas, each focusing on a different house within the same street.
Adaptations of mystery stories written by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's contemporary rivals in the genre.
This is a story about Yugoslavian national football team and their journey to the first world championship in Montevideo.

In 1990s Mumbai, a struggling young man joins a film production company but turns to video piracy after facing workplace humiliation. As his illegal empire grows, a determined cop closes in on the operation.
A successful corporate executive finds himself torn between his urban life and rural roots, as past family bonds and a new connection with a District Collector reshape his path.

movies.primaryTitle: Karenjit Kaur - The Untold Story of Sunny Leone
movies.originalTitle: Karenjit Kaur - The Untold Story of Sunny Leone
movies.plot: The life story of Indian-Canadian actress and former adult film star, Sunny Leone.

Wrongfully imprisoned former farmer Constance Mayer, 50, earns law degree. As clerk to demanding Marseille judge Filiponi, her nontraditional methods challenge colleagues and her mentor's perspective.

Celebrities are unexpectedly confronted with a Big Red Book containing details about their lives. They recount their life stories, with family, friends, and colleagues making guest appearances, in a studio setting.
Located in northern Mexico, it shows the region's fight against organized crime and the problems between Mexico and the United States.
SOKO Wismar is a German crime series.
The story of the executive chef at a country house hotel.

An assassin and a prince forge an unexpected bond amid war and chaos. Years later, they meet again-one as emperor, one as king-forcing them to confront their past feelings and choose between love and duty.
Based off the webtoon of the same name, it's the story of a police officer whose attempt to bring down a nationwide criminal organization ends up with him losing everything he holds dear.
A luxury nightclub stages a war for power on the Lisbon nightlife scene. This series examines the capital's night, where sensuality ans sex mix with politics, security, business, and glamour.
A group of students attend high school on a cruise ship.
A grasshopper-like, motorcycle-riding cyborg (joined by another one later in the show) fights the evil organization that transformed him for their evil deeds.
Baal Veer is a SuperKid who fights for good and honest children.
Meet the people flying between LA and Vegas on weekends.

Tracy Beaker returns to The Dumping Ground only this time she's not a resident but a care worker offering her advice and experiences to a new generation of 'dumped' kids, often with calamitous results.

Tarzan (Lord Greystoke), already well educated and fed up with civilization, returns to the jungle and, more or less assisted by chimpanzee Cheetah and orphan boy Jai, wages war against poachers and other bad guys.

A mysterious ailment affects women in a remote village. When a traveling doctor arrives with traditional remedies, his unconventional treatments raise suspicions among the villagers, leading to tensions in the community.

Five pairs of travellers embark on an epic race that will take them through many countries. However there is a catch, no planes allowed, no smartphones and only a small budget given to conduct their journey.
Widower Ned Logan struggles to raise his family alone while upholding the legacy of running a prestigious Kentucky horse farm.

movies.primaryTitle: The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess
movies.plot: A former teen fanfic writer wakes up as the villain in her own story. While dodging deadly scenarios she once wrote, a mysterious character appears - one she never created. Now she must decide if this stranger is friend or foe.
A semi-famous actress who returns to her hometown to work with a regional theater troupe.
Vince Faraday is a cop who has been framed for murder, leading him to fall off the grid and become the super hero known only as "The Cape."
A teenage girl and her three best friends, accompanied by a poodle, embark on dangerous adventures to save the world while dealing with family life and the fleeting nature of youth.

movies.primaryTitle: The Girl of the Green Valley
movies.plot: Melissa Çelik is left without a mother and father when she was a baby. No one knows the truth about what happened to her family. Green Valley tells her story of becoming a young girl and then a woman.
Just Kidding is a hidden camera comedy sketch show similar to shows like Candid Camera. A unique feature of the show however is that all the pranks are carried out by kids.
The story of a young woman from a small Polish town who escapes to West Germany and finds herself drawn into the world of adult entertainment.

An intelligence agent is sent to El Principe, on the border with Morocco, to investigate a possible police collaboration with a terrorist cell, but finds unexpected love with the least suitable person: a drug baron's sister.
A suave and elegant university professor, who can shape-shift into any animal, fights crime along with a female New York detective and his right-hand man.
The Refornment Movement of 1898 resulted in the "Six Heroes" dying. Huo Yuan Jia, who was filled with patriotic enthusiasm, had been eager to participate.
Diarra Brickland (Kilpatrick), a schoolteacher going through a divorce, refuses to believe that she's been rejected by her Tinder date.
Follows groom-to-be Stu and his friends on his stag do in South America.
Dempsey, a tough NYPD cop, is sent to a London undercover police unit teamed up with the sophisticated, sexy, blonde Makepeace. They hunt down the top of London's underworld - when not quarreling.
Throughout the series follows the stories, lives and adventures of a group of military cadets after their reception at a military academy where starting with education for military pilots.

It follows Oriana Fallaci, a correspondent who is intelligent, controversial and intolerant of the dynamics of an editorial team composed only of men who get to focus on politics while she's relegated to the role of "film girl".
A pre-teen version of Scooby Doo, with a pint-sized version of the title character.
Dating series that explores the romantic interactions of successful black men and women in their 30s and 40s looking for lasting, authentic relationships.
Cubicle denizen Dilbert toils away at Path-E-Tech which makes undefined products. The focus is on his survival amongst a moronic boss, hostile co-workers and his malevolent pet, Dogbert.
In 1997, four kids vanish in Silverpoint Woods. 23 years later, one boy tries to find out what happened.
Explores a world of gangs made up of those sworn to protect and shed light on corrupt and secret societies. And what if the Policemen use the criminals to arrest others.
Two best friends narrate the ups and downs of middle school while comparing it to moments from when they were little.
Two players compete against each other in a race against the clock to test their knowledge of songs performed by a live band.

Madrid 1920s, Marquise Elena de Valmonte explores her passion for cooking, as a means for evading her authoritarian husband. An incident makes her and maid Cecilia fugitives. They reopen an abandoned restaurant as 'La Favorita Bistro'.
A poor, widowed woman, desperate to support her 7-year-old daughter, and a wealthy business executive with a sick mother enter into a contract marriage together.
The residents of the rural Scottish village of Glendarroch deal with issues ranging from crop failures and parish pump politics to infidelity, alcoholism and drug abuse.
Successful prosecutor Firat, who does not remember anything, is accused of murdering his wife and daughter. He has to escape from prison to reveal the truth.
SpongeBob and his friends spend the summer at the craziest camp in the Kelp Forest, Kamp Koral.
Contestants attempt to match the answers of celebrities in the game of fill in the missing blank.

A mockumentary about comedian Thomas Giertsen, who has everything: Great girlfriend, big house, lots of cash and funny friends. A perfect life? Still he tends to get in trouble. After all; he's always right.
Valentina's life is turned upside-down after her fiancé Alonso leaves her at the altar.
It tells the story of Enric, who is heavily impacted by a viral video of a Christian pop band made up of five sisters.
Live late-night comedy sketch show similar to "Saturday Night Live."
When an alien disguised as a cat lands on Earth, Coop Burtonburger's little sister, Millie finds him and brings him home where bedlam ensues.
Fate leads two best friends to marry the same man ensuing a complicated love triangle.

Zig, a famished hyena comes up with the craziest plans to make a meal out of Marina, the carefree mermaid. But that's forgetting all about Sharko, the muscly shark who will do anything to protect her.
Jim and his put upon friends try to learn what it means to be a good person.

movies.primaryTitle: Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister
movies.plot: Uryuu Kamihate aims to enter medical school but finds his new foster home is a shrine where he must marry one of the three Amagami sisters and take over the temple.
MacKenzie Allen becomes the first woman American president after she ascends to the job following the death of president Teddy Bridges.
Through visions of the past, Rin Okumura finally discovers the truth about the mysterious Blue night and of his parents history with Satan.
Set at a small Chinese restaurant, "Wok of Love" follows Seo Poong's attempt at survival, food and love.

A devoted mother agrees to a painful bargain with a guarded businessman to finance her son's medical treatment, only for their forced encounter to ignite an intense and unexpected love that challenges both of their deepest wounds.

The story of Maggie Beare, an elderly woman suffering from dementia (or so she says) and her faithful, long-suffering son Arthur. Despite all of Maggie's manipulative ways, he is her carer, even if they don't always get along.

A 20-something girl rebuilding her life in Los Angeles and an established artist cross paths changing each of their lives forever. Secrets from their pasts threaten to ruin their budding romance unless their love can survive the truth.

movies.primaryTitle: The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On
movies.originalTitle: The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On
movies.plot: Get hitched or call it quits? Couples put their love to the test--while shacking up with other potential matches--in a provocative reality series.

movies.primaryTitle: My Wife Is the Student Council President
movies.plot: Izumi Hayato running to be student council president. But when a beautiful girl swings in promising the liberalization of love while flinging condoms into the audience, he ends up losing to her and becoming the vice president.
A guy transforms his life by taking control over his addictions and using his story to help others.

The plot revolves around the life of Mohini. People around the village are falling for her. Things take a new turn as she involves in something new. The new experiments improve her love life. Can unexpected events affect her happy life?

movies.primaryTitle: The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson
movies.originalTitle: The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson
movies.plot: Making a satire out of the entire Late Night Show concept Scotsman Craig Ferguson hosts his show with a robot skeleton and a "horse" as his sidekicks. The show features the stereotypical parts of a Late Show, but all in their own, raw way.
The series is about three very different families living in the same neighborhood of Granli in Oslo: the family of Jonas Kvåle and Maria Lerke, the family Pedersen, and the family Kopperud.
In the heart of Middlesbrough, a quirky bunch of LGBTQ+ pals embrace their identities, finding solace and joy within their community's small but vibrant pocket.

President Gilcrest and his trophy wife are living in the White House, with their overachieving daughter sidetracked by pregnancy, a couch potato hopeless son, a genius young son, and an odd middle school girl.
A disabled man develops feelings for his maid while his wife plots his murder with her lover. The maid must choose between betraying him or protecting him from the conspiracy involving her aunt.
Through an exclusive matchmaking agency, women strive to marry a desirable bachelor and into the highest echelon of society.
Encaged in a gold-clad life of secrets and lies, two women in a conglomerate family seek to topple all that stands in their way of finding true joy.
Batman, Superman and Wonder Woman will lead the DC Super Heroes against their most infamous foes.

Danger Mouse, the greatest secret agent in the world, must follow Colonel K's orders (and try not to break Professor Squawkencluck's inventions) to foil Baron Greenback's and his henchman Stiletto's plans.

Documentary series focusing on history's largest financial crimes ranging from Ponzi schemes, murder, card counting, generating fake currency and goods, extortion, online dating, identity theft, drug distribution, and insider trading.
This investigative docuseries explores the greed, fraud and corruption that built up - and ultimately brought down - India's most infamous tycoons.
An African American remake of the television series inspired by the Neil Simon play about two friends living together despite their completely disparate attitudes to life.
An enthusiastic singing lady and her puppet animal friends go on a variety of adventures.
Intelligence operatives from MI6 to the CIA share insider stories of spy craft, Cold War campaigns, and coups carried out by covert agents.
Saturday Night's Main Event is a series of American professional wrestling television specials produced by WWE (originally the World Wrestling Federation or WWF).
A young man gets a lucrative job offer. But this opportunity comes with a dark consequence. Will his life change overnight?

Follows eight characters and what they do in everyday life such as being a painter, a police officer, a teacher, an inventor, and a fitness fanatic. One character is disabled in a wheelchair, working in a shop.

Sitcom about a Flemish amateur soccer team, focusing on a few of its members and their loved ones. They are often plagued by the clubhouse's hostile neighbor, the chairman's inappropriate behavior, and their own personality traits.
A kung-fu-fighting pup and his snickering cat sidekick battle crime.

A painter's daughter and her stockbroker husband face strain in their marriage when his losses and debts mount. His focus on recovering leads to distance between them, amid valuable inherited artworks.

The story of Lee Everett - a convicted murderer - when the zombie apocalypse comes crashing down on the world. He finds an 8 year old girl called Clementine and the story follows their fight for survival.
Girls struggle with relationships, friendships and teachers at school.

The series follows his humorous escapades as he manages to save the day with his quick thinking and a wide array of robotic abilities, along with his closest friends - Chulbul, the pet donkey, 8-year-old Imli and Gintu, his magical jinn.
The hijinks of a street-smart savior living in modern-day Compton, on a mission to spread love and kindness throughout the crime-ridden L.A. neighborhood with his small group of followers.
Real FBI cases are recounted through reenactments and interviews with law enforcement and forensic scientists.
Welcome to Camp Crush. The most epic summer camp ever. Your favorite Monster Trucks will compete in all kinds of challenges to be the best. So pack your bags and get ready for Camp Crush.
After declassified FBI files about Hitler have been released, a group of specialists work together to try and find the truth of Hitler's supposed death. Did he really die in the bunker?
Peter, Fredrik and Gottfrid, ended up creating one of the world's largest BitTorrent indexes in 2003 as a reaction to big business trying to take control file sharing over the Internet.

Matthias is a mouse who lives at Redwall Abbey, a fortress under constant siege from evil rats. When the image of a great mouse-warrior begins to speak to him, he realizes that his destiny is to be the successor to a great warrior.

Chefs from all over the world come to fight a culinary battle against one of President Kaga's "Iron Chefs". They have one hour to prepare a meal where each dish must prominently feature the special ingredient of the day.

movies.primaryTitle: The Wonderful World of Mickey Mouse
movies.originalTitle: The Wonderful World of Mickey Mouse
movies.plot: Mickey and his best pals - Minnie, Donald, Daisy, Goofy and Pluto - embark on their greatest adventures yet, navigating the curve-balls of a wild and zany world where the magic of Disney makes the impossible possible.
Follows two guys and their adventures in Kingdom Of Saudi Arabia.
Erotic series in which Dalia teaches and demonstrate ancient sexual techniques to her students.
Gritty realistic hospital drama featuring manly Dr. Casey against the medical establishment, at first, under the watchful eye of Dr. Zorba, and later under the thumb of Chief of Surgery Dr. Freeland.

Jeff Cooper has to reinvent himself after being fired from his position in the space start-up Mars.Iy. With no chance to return to Earth, he has to find meaning again in a dangerous, alien, but familiar corporate landscape.
A love story between a young poor student pianist and his older married piano teacher. Could their pure love for each other win, despite disapproval from the society and the "moral standard"?

movies.primaryTitle: Soul Land 2: The Peerless Tang Clan
movies.plot: Storyline about the daughter of Tang San and Xiao Wu. 10,000 years after Soul Land 1, a world where magic and machinery co-exist Huo Yuhao and Tang Wutong meet at Shrek Academy.

movies.originalTitle: We Best Love: No.1 for You
movies.plot: Zhou Shu Yi has always ranked second to Gao Shi De - grades, popularity, girls - you name it. For this reason, he was excited about college and parting ways forever. But will Gao Shi De really let him get away so easily?

Investigating magistrate Candela is transferred to El Hierro, the most remote of the Canary Islands. There, she discovers a suspicious community and is confronted by the death of a young local boy, murdered the day before his wedding.
Lone mage Siluca wanders the land of Atlatan, disgusted by its greedy nobility. When she meets knight errant Theo, she sees a chance to create peace.
A computer-generated superhero and his human creator fight crime in the city.
A Latina reporter looks back on her childhood as a chubby, willful, reluctant Dominican immigrant growing up with her eccentric family in 1980s Miami.
Two teenage friends come of age while going through life's struggles together.
After the end of the Civil War, a former Confederate Army private roams the Wild West, and, as a rogue drifter, gets involved in helping out various settlers threatened by various bad guys.

A Brazilian telenovela based on the Books of Samuel, Chronicles, and Kings. It portrays the nation of Israel from the judge Samuel, to the transfer to monarchy, to the division of the kingdom, and in the end to the conquest by Babylon.

Correspondence-course Eastern law school graduate Tom Brewster travels out West to seek his fortune. Unfortunately, his cowboy fighting skills leave much to be desired and earn him the nickname "Sugarfoot", one step below "Tenderfoot".
Forensic psychiatrist Jane Halifax after 20 years returns to her old job helping the police. This time to help find a sniper that's on the loose before it's too late.
Scottish comedy shadowing a typical family and their chaotic life. They say blood is thicker than water- and no-one is thicker than The Scotts.
Centers on the adventures of "Chibi" versions of Disney characters as they live in their own universe.
From servant's quarters to business empire, Emma Harte's indomitable spirit propels her rise from poverty to riches, yearning for one unattainable love.
Cihan discovers her father's body; the case, assigned to her colleague Metin, tests their love as suspects emerge in this unconventional murder mystery.

movies.primaryTitle: So You Think You Can Dance
movies.originalTitle: So You Think You Can Dance
movies.plot: Qualified dancers from ballroom and ballet to salsa, jive and hip-hop all compete to be named the best.

Öykü, a young fashion designer grapples with a love dilemma with her childhood love Mete, and Ayaz, Mete's business partner, heightened by Seyma's secret games and the risk of falling in love. Love will catch everyone in cherry season.

Competitive game show based around traveling (and its hardships) where contestants complete challenges to use different modes of transportation. With the world as the "board," each season is a unique take on classic household games.

Chidiya Udd is a story of a 20 year old Seher from Rajasthan and is an intersection between the Mumbai underworld and the red light district. This story depicts her struggle but also her determination to play by her own rules.

House of Lies tells the gripping story of two women determined to secure their dream life and protect their families. But ambition, deceit, and betrayal weave a dangerous web, ultimately building a house of lies.
The Spanish "Conquistador" Hernán Cortés arrives on the shores of what today is México and faces both local demons and those who've sailed with him.
A girl named Strawberry and her friends go on thrilling adventures.
The further adventures of Littlefoot and his friends learning about the world of dinosaurs.
"The Black Widow" is based on the life of Griselda Blanco. This Colombian novela walks you through the life of the infamous Griselda Blanco, a Cocain Kingpin in the early 1980's.
Köinzell, a young swordsman wielding the deadly black sword, faces rumors of bloodshed. Pursued by the Traitorous Lances, he battles to uncover the truth behind his quest amidst enemies' corpses.
Funny and extraordinary life of taxi drivers working in a taxi station named Akasya Duragi.
Three female comics perform sketches dealing with a wide variety of topics, from irritating flatmates to workplace issues to people who pretend to be ill to get free things or special treatment.
A Twilight Zone-esque look at the life and people living in a futuristic city where the haves and the have nots are strictly separated by a wall.
Chip and Joanna Gaines take on clients in the Waco Texas area, turning their fixer uppers into the homes of their dreams.

Rani, a young, adventurous girl gets married to Sudhir, who has a conventional, routine life. Tension arises among the couple, when Sudhir discovers that Rani has a bucket list of sexual activities that she is set to fulfill.
The Castles, while investigating the case of the Mischievous Elf, are involved in a viral nightmare that pits them against a boy with powers willing to destroy Christmas.
A dramatized take on war in Iraq.
Love is as tough as it is sweet for a lovestruck teenager, whose relationship with her next-door neighbor transforms as they grow into adulthood.

movies.primaryTitle: The Echoes of Survivors: Inside Korea's Tragedies
movies.originalTitle: The Echoes of Survivors: Inside Korea's Tragedies
movies.plot: Showcases the tales of those who survived Korea's darkest chapters, shining a light on hidden truths.

Teams of contestants answer questions against the clock to build up their prize pot, then compete against the Chasers - quiz champions from across the country, who get closer to them with every wrong answer, to keep the money they earnt.
A deceased street musician returns to life, and must restore the balance between good and evil to be reunited with his dead girlfriend.
A dance competition where celebrities compete to be crowned the winner.

movies.primaryTitle: The Smile Has Left Your Eyes
movies.plot: A detective probes a death case, his sister gets involved with a suspect. He tries keeping them apart, suspecting danger, but she sympathizes with the man, straining the case's progression.

Two high school boys, Mao and Hisashi, set rules to maintain boundaries while sharing a dorm room. But navigating friendship, sexuality and privacy proves complicated as they learn some things can't be easily promised.
The world famous and notoriously erotic novel is sumptuously produced for the first time for video audiences adhering closely to the book that shocked the world.

Stinky the garbage truck and Dirty the backhoe loader are best friends who have lots of adventures together. They find themselves in some strange situations, and try to find resourceful solutions to problems.
Set in the future, twenty-four teenagers are chosen from the last living colony, to take part in a competition known as The Exemplar. That's the chance to write their names into history.
Tom and Jerry return with vengeance in this new show.

CGI sci-fi comedy series set in universe divided between Confederation and Dark Clown Empire. Follows outlaw group led by Chode aboard Spaceship Bob evading both powers while pursuing schemes in lawless "Rift" border region.
A Mexican telecom tycoon Leon Carvahal is murdered on his wedding day, at the exact moment when hitman El Chino Valdes faces execution by electric chair in the US.
Covering the entertainment industry with interviews and reviews from studios to festivals on the hot topics of the day.

movies.primaryTitle: Strange Days at Blake Holsey High
movies.originalTitle: Strange Days at Blake Holsey High
movies.plot: When Josie Trent is sent to the private prep school, she comes face-to-face with paranormal things that cannot be explained. But with the help of her friends and one science teacher, maybe surviving school won't be that hard.

This is a survival thriller, based on true events. Three women with different connections to one man need to find a way to get out of the monsters grip. Will they be believed, or can he manipulate the surroundings once again.
A bittersweet sitcom about a couple who meet again five years after he jilted her at the altar.
The party keeps on going for Poppy, Branch and the others from DreamWorks Animation's hit Trolls (2016).
Follows 8 couples as they meet face-to-face for the first time in the UK and have 90 days to get married or return to their respective homes.

Kifissia, 1925. Petros Aslanoglou arrives at the Grand Hotel to visit his sister, who works there. Discovering she's been missing for over a month, he goes undercover as a waiter to investigate, soon finding himself in grave danger.
The Care Bears live in a faraway place up in the clouds called Care-a-Lot. They travel around the world on Missions in Caring, whilst evil villains such as Lord No Heart, try to thwart their plans.

movies.primaryTitle: Hello Neighbor: Welcome to Raven Brooks
movies.originalTitle: Hello Neighbor: Welcome to Raven Brooks
movies.plot: New girl Trinity, moves across the street from creepy neighbor, Mr. Peterson. She joins Nicky & their less courageous friends on terrifying stealth missions to find out what horrific secrets are hiding in Peterson's horror house basement.
A young, ambitious Serbian Secret Service agent negotiates the dangerous rules of the modern century international spy game.

movies.primaryTitle: Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks?
movies.originalTitle: Tsuujou Kougeki ga Zentai Kougeki de Ni-kai Kougeki no Okaasan wa Suki Desuka?
movies.plot: Masato is transported into a video game world for the adventure of a lifetime. The only catch? His mom's joining his party.
A love letter to the diverse musicality of New York, it explores the universal journey of finding your authentic voice in your early twenties.
Momo, a young soccer player who ends up innocently behind bars. In Berlin jail he now has to assert himself and is put under pressure by his uncle, the clan leader Amar.
Assistant manager John Redmond and promotions rep Kayleigh Kitson are forced to commute together every day. But will they get along?
