The completely-bonkers Ace Ventura continues to tackle cases involving stolen or missing animals, usually arriving at the solutions by pure fluke as he blunders his way through the facts in his inimitable way.

When her father inherits an overgrown orchard, Ruby O'Reilly discovers a magic well. She's been designated its new "keeper," and now it's up to her and her friends Mina and Sam to turn unfulfilled wishes into reality.
A bizarre escape begins with two people-a hostage and a kidnapper. The only daughter of a major corporation is kidnapped, but the plan fails.
Three teams spend 28 days in some of the most haunted locations in the United States for an experiment based on the theories of paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren.
A weekday gabfest offering a female perspective on the day's headlines.
A look at the daily misadventures of the troupe filming the low-quality TV series "Gli Occhi del Cuore 2".
Three energetic wombat siblings solve problems and explore the Treeborhood.

A loving but immature father with a larger-than-life personality is committed to co-parenting his two kids with his very-together ex-wife. For Marlon, family always comes first--even if he's the biggest kid of all.

Iris paints dolls for a living, alongside her twin sister. When she meets Silas, and then Louis, she is offered an opportunity to escape and start a new life - but to do so, she must abandon her sister.

Pro athletes have it all: extreme wealth, adoring fans, lavish lifestyles. Fame and fortune can come at the price of true love. 5 international soccer stars are going undercover in the US to find love for who they are, not what they have.
Gong Shim rents out her rooftop room to a pro-bono lawyer in order to fund her art study abroad, consequently turning her life upside down.
After finding Hawke, they decide to continue the deal that Stringfellow Hawke had with the agency: they keep Airwolf location a secret and will go on missions for the agency.

When an attempt on Dr. Alec Holland's life leaves him consumed by deadly chemicals and fire, the swamps of Louisiana transform him into a superhuman creature hell-bent on ridding the swamp--and the world--of the evil that men do.

The series follows the comical adventures of a mischievous yet artistic Wolf , trying to catch - and presumably eat Hare. It features additional characters that usually either help the hare or interfere with the Wolf's plans.
Two orphaned sisters navigate a town full of people torn straight from fantasy and fairy tales, confronting heroes and villains alike, while investigating the mystery of their missing parents.
An absurd merger at a university brings computer science and model students together. Charismatic fashion student Kang Min Hak became a social media star through a dating show.

A dentist and father of two decides to take his family across country after their house burns down. With their old beat up Winnebago, the Martin family will encounter the best that America has to offer.
The SOKO Stuttgart team investigates analytically and with sensitivity in the likeable state capital. The exciting cases of the series lead them to bizarre crime scenes and to different milieus.
Sonic and his royal siblings seek to find their mother and defeat the tyrant, Robotnik.
Texas Ranger Hoby Gilman travels the Old West tracking down assorted killers, bank robbers, horse thieves, and other evil-doers.

movies.primaryTitle: I'm Kishi Knight: Your Private Tutor
movies.plot: A heartwarming comedy about "sparkling prince" private tutor Naito Kishi and the hot-headed delinquent, Tôru Takasugi. Tôru's mother, worried about her son's constant fighting and terrible test scores, hires Kishi as his tutor. Though Tôru is bewildered by Kishi's gentle and sweet teaching style, he soon finds himself drawn into Kishi's pace, setting the stage for a dramatic transformation in his life.
Comedian Guy Montgomery hosts a spelling competition with a mixture of simple and unconventional rounds.
A series of shorts illustrating various songs that teach multiplication tables, grammar, science, American history, computers, economics, and environmentalism.
The adventures of Ray and Henry continue as they fight old and new criminals in this animated spinoff.
A series of stand-alone episodes whose only common link is the coastal setting. In each episode, attractive young men and women end up in bed together due to unusual circumstances.

After nuclear war, a pandemic, and natural disasters, only a third of humanity remains. Two opposing armies recruit survivors for an ultimate clash between good and evil forces, forcing everyone to pick a side.
Explores a group of interconnected individuals who are collectively haunted by a murder of one of their own, serving as the catalyst to unravel secrets, suspicions, and betrayals between friends.
A horror anthology series revolving around different ghost stories.
Three friends at a retirement center have their comfortable existence rattled by a newcomer to the community.
A fisherman as he discovers a treasure lost for generations at the bottom of the ocean. Taking a small part of it home for himself.

Cursed YouTuber Joey Graceffa finds himself guiding a number of invited social-media personalities into solving puzzles and voting one another off to survive the night, and not be slain by various monsters and evils.
Samantha Vera, a kind and empathetic Ateneo student, faces devastation when her parents announce she'll marry UP med student Cy Ramirez after graduation.
A man named Montu arrives at a village bearing a gift for his friend's spouse, Renu. As time passes, he finds himself attracted to her, caught between loyalty and temptation.
Two CA Aspirants from two different ends of the spectrum of the course, Archie and Niraj embark on the journey of one of the toughest courses and face the obstacles it has to offer.
During Terra's siege, Loyalist Titans hunt Warmaster Horus. Princeps Gemnon and Aurora Ferrum pursue glory but face unexpected opposition.
No food, no shelter, no fresh water - one man alone in the wild for seven days with only his wits and stamina to sustain him.
A girl named Strawberry Shortcake, along with her cat Custard and dog Pupcake, has adventures in friendship in Strawberryland.
A massive traffic jam on the outskirts of Madrid disrupts the plans of thousands, leading to unexpected, humorous, and emotional stories.
As the Medellin Cartel crumbles, Pablo Escobar's No.1 hit man struggles to stay alive and gain respect in the prison hierarchy.
Two strangers are prime suspects in a murder.
A British sketch comedy series featuring a wide range of characters, each with unique and humorous quirks, created and performed by Catherine Tate.
San Franciscans during the goldrush of the 1850s attempt to maintain law and order in their wild city. Newly arrived Matthew Wayne becomes sheriff, then marshal, and organizes the city police force.

After leading London 2012 and serving as BBC Head of Values, Ian Fletcher joins the 2026 World Cup team as Director of Integrity, facing challenges in the largest tournament ever across North America.
Steven Wilde always had everything he wanted, due to his improbably rich father. Except the girl, Emmy Kadubic, who is an environmentalist. Emmy and her daughter, Puddle come to live with him.
After attempting an attack on the Home Minister, Baali is on the run. What happens when he chooses the path of violence?
An anthology of human relationship stories connected by the only open in the wee hours diner the characters frequent. Resolutions are often facilitated by the owner/chef.

Wolfie Smith is an unemployed dreamer from Tooting. He leads a small group called the Tooting Popular Front with aspirations to create a communist Britain. However, as a result of being disorganised, his chances range from slim to none.
Based on Tyra Banks' concept "America's Next Top Model (2003)", this series hosted by German super model Heidi Klum and a variety of guest judges tries to find Germany's next top model.

The story of two warring coaching institutes, and the consequences of their rivalry on the students who come there to study. A journey of friendship, first love, heartbreak, peer pressure and the loss of innocence of youth.
A single mom risks it all and moves her family to a vineyard with hopes of taking her natural-hair-care line to the next level by infiltrating the African American elite in Oak Bluffs.
A young and inexperienced crew venture into space to face mysterious clouds, folds in time and the occasional alien attack, as well as more household challenges.

President is assassinated. The Minister of Police declares a state of emergency and issues a warrant for the arrest for all the Clan members. There is a leak of information, Shok and Pasha have to deal with it. It is a cat and mouse game.

movies.primaryTitle: Show Me the Money 12: The World of Yaksha
movies.originalTitle: Show Me the Money 12: The World of Yaksha
movies.plot: Show Me the Money 12: The World of the Yaksha is a parallel hip-hop survival spin-off. Rappers must survive extreme, lawless rap battles in an underground world where fates are decided by fan evaluations and skills, with no set rules.

After being struck down by a trolley (golly) in 1925, Ethel MacDoogan, a flapper, waits in heaven for a chance to help a family and earn her wings. That chance arrives in the form of the Preston family.

Upon being demobbed, RAF serviceman Harvey Moon returns home and finds his family involved in various troubles. His wife is not interested in resuming their relationship, and works in a seedy nightclub frequented by American servicemen.
Four musicians named Twist, Kiki, Shout and Marina perform pop songs while attending music school.

Sympathetic old-school doughnut-shop owner Arthur, his spunky young employee and aspiring artist Franco, and their friends and patrons keep the shop going in a changing culturally-mixed inner-city Chicago neighborhood.

Now it's all up to Max. Can he infiltrate the Pantheon, find a cure that will restore Alex's humanity, free Rayne and Cytro, defeat the army of Terror Energy powered minions, and stop Terrorax once and for all?
British singing competition in which contestants sing cover songs to try and impress judges and voting viewers.

In a rural Tahsildar's office, a computer engineer named Paari is mistakenly welcomed as the new collector, leading to a series of comedic misunderstandings and romantic tensions with his ex-colleague Indu.

Two rival teams are given the task of building some kind of machine, in one day, using only the items found in an unusually well-stocked scrapyard. Machines constructed to date have included trebuchets, hovercraft, rockets, and more.
The adventures of the master thief Lupin III and his cohorts as they dive into various escapades, all the while in pursuit by the tenacious Inspector Zenigata.
Elsa, a Parisian, cannot forget her ex. Her best friend secretly hires an escort boy to help her move on but the plan works a little too well.
Pia and two Israelis are kidnapped by terrorists in the Sinai desert and threatened with death if 12 prisoners are not released.
A young and curious boy constantly wonders the fields of science.

movies.primaryTitle: Las hijas de la Señora García
movies.originalTitle: Las hijas de la Señora García
movies.plot: Mrs. Garcia strives to give daughters Valeria and Mar a better future, shielding them from poverty. She'll stop at nothing to see her dreams reflected in them and enforce high standards even if the cost is her daughters' happiness.
A young man spends a week in a psychiatric ward, where he meets five other patients and must contend with research-happy doctors and cynical nurses.
Family drama revolving around Naghi Ma'mouli, his wife Homa, children Sara and Nika, Alzheimer's-afflicted father Panjali, relatives and friend Rahmat, facing various issues across different seasons.
Various original cartoons by some of today's top animators.
Guests unwind at a Cabo resort enjoying intimacy amidst scenic beauty, where the sea's rhythm dissolves troubles and sensuality reigns.
A whodunit based on the murder of popular children's book author and illustrator Olivia Lake.

This chat is very different from what you know. Every person has a different story, every story has a different side. Hasan Can Kaya first chooses the speakers and then the fun increases with interesting questions.

Centered around a Haryanvi female police officer named Chandramukhi Chautala and her funny subordinates. The show depicts their lives as they try to solve every case which comes to Imaan Chowki in a comical and unusual way.
Behind-the-scenes look at Toronto Pearson Airport shows how Canada's busiest hub manages millions of passengers and aircraft through snowstorms, tech problems, emergencies, and security issues.
Drama and supernatural chills in this series centered around a haunted insane asylum-turned-apartment building.
A mysterious chef operates in a remote location, preparing magical dishes that fulfill customers' greatest wishes, but if they're willing to pay the price.
The lives of occupants of an inner-city housing project.

After following some advice from a mysterious NewTube channel, Hobin is soon knocking out guys stronger than him and raking in more money than he could have ever dreamed of. Will Hobin be able to keep this up?

In 1956, 14-year-old Alan Silver's life revolves around family, the synagogue, and the Dodgers. Grandparents Jules and Sophie live in the same brownstone as Alan, his brother Nate, and their parents, Phyllis and George.
The cases of the Munich police's major-crimes unit.

movies.primaryTitle: Our Last Crusade or The Rise of a New World
movies.originalTitle: Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjou, Arui wa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen
movies.plot: As a war rages on between a machine-based empire and a magic-focused empire, a witch and a soldier meet and fall in love. Will their romance bring an end to their nations' conflict?
A spin-off of True Blood that follows Jessica Hamby (Deborah Ann Woll) as she discovers what it's like to be a "Baby Vamp" in the small town of Bon Temps.

Never Say Die focuses on an IT university student and a investigative vlogger as they are caught and trapped in a cruel and deadly spider's web of corruption, deceit, greed, injustice, and power. Can there be a way out to fight for truth?

movies.primaryTitle: An Unsuitable Job for a Woman
movies.originalTitle: An Unsuitable Job for a Woman
movies.plot: Cordelia Gray inherits a struggling detective agency after her boss's suicide. Her assistant Edith Sparshott aids her as she navigates the dark underbelly of crime, uncovering clues in complex cases.

movies.primaryTitle: Nadia: The Secret of Blue Water
movies.plot: A teen acrobat of mysterious origins and a young inventor find themselves entangled in a sinister plot that involves the fate of the world.
Diverse young Canadians embark on building new lives in the rugged wilderness across four seasons, facing challenges of off-the-grid living while striving to thrive in remote landscapes.
The day-to-day lives of three orphaned children who are adopted by aliens that have trouble adjusting to the local culture.
Dutch program featuring four young comedians performing short hilarious sketches.

In the town of Margate, Eldest sister Trish is pregnant and expecting a girl baby. Her sisters Clare and Leila rally around her with their mum. But other sister Mel makes an unexpected return threatens to destabilize the entire family.
Love story between a poor harvest girl and a handsome man from a rich family.
This grisly new documentary series delves into the shocking case of a body discovered after 28 years hiding in plain sight.
A detective searches for his missing son, tracking a supernatural bar where people play Russian roulette for a chance to speak with their dead loved ones.
An imaginative 11-year-old boy turns everyday life into an adventure, finding creative and quirky solutions to navigate his daily challenges.
A 41-year-old man is unable to leave home because of his domineering mother.

God created humans to worship Him, yet some lose their way, letting ego and desires lead them toward darkness. Iblees tells the story of Anabiya, a young woman whose relentless pursuit of her desires and unchecked pride slowly transform her into a figure consumed by evil-human in appearance, but devilish in actions. Anabiya is the daughter of Shakeel, a well-known businessman. Maryam, a simple and devout girl, was raised by Shakeel after her father sacrificed his life to save him. Treated as his own daughter and placed on equal footing with Anabiya, Maryam's quiet goodness sparks jealousy and resentment in Anabiya. What follows is a series of manipulative schemes, deceit, and ruthless actions by Anabiya, threatening the lives of everyone around her-including her own family.
Two guys and their pet gorilla hunt spooks.

Years later, Kuzey is forced to move to his hometown, the Black Sea Region, with his daughters. As neighbors with Yildiz, whom he had abandoned in his past. Yildiz intends to send them back to Istanbul at all costs.
Movie director Choi Seung-hee catches sight of a young lady that mysteriously looks like his dead girlfriend. Struck by the resemblance, he cannot help but to follow her.

The general's son runs away, meeting a poor classmate he pretends to be underprivileged to befriend. But the friend is revealed as his soon-to-be stepbrother. They face obstacles due to class differences but find a way with love.
The stories of police officers and doctors working near the Port of Hamburg.
Interconnected dramas about the lives of a group of workers at a Manchester textile factory, with each episode focusing on the home life of a different character.

Gorou is a gynecologist and idol fan who's in shock after his favorite star, Ai, announces an impromptu hiatus. Little does Gorou realize that he's about to forge a bond with her that defies all common sense.
Collection of three of Skinemax episodes: Tamara; Elena; Celeste.
The story revolves around the life of the protagonist, a young man who works as a call boy.
Living in a house full of females, young Wyatt hangs out with his friend Pesto but deeply yearns for a brother to bring some much-needed male energy into his life.
Unlock the mysteries behind Room No. 911's enigmatic door. Embark on a journey where every shadow holds a secret, and each clue leads to the unexpected.
The adventures in the Florida Everglades of game warden Tom Wedloe, his wife Ellen, their son Mark, and Mark's tame bear Ben.

Three kids, Max, Neil and Nikki, spent the summer vacation at a dysfunctional campsite called 'Camp Campbell' which is currently in the hands the camp counselors, the overly cheerful David and the less optimistic Gwen.
Five modern women live together under one roof as they deal with their families, career, and men; and explore their colorful sex lives.

The short episodes capture the lives and challenges of a vibrant cast of characters, who have grown up from the BabyRiki series to develop unique personalities and make new friends in different environments and settings.

movies.originalTitle: Wai Mao Zhi Shang Zhu Yi
movies.plot: A Chinese drama about an ugly boy who is suddenly able to switch between his original body and a handsome body.
Follows John, Tommy and their coworkers as they find themselves in the midst of chaos while working at a Delco lumberyard.
Retired teacher Carol Kenney begins a second career as a doctor.
Princess Merlinda, Sasha, and Nerissa emerge from the sea, embarking on an adventure to stop Pirate Barbarossa's nefarious plan of draining the ocean's magic
Explores and reveals newly available evidence about declassified government activities throughout history.
After her husband's death, Ebru has to go to her husband's hometown due to financial problems. Will Ebru find out that she is living in a big lie about her son, whom she thought was dead?
International news, interviews and in-depth analysis covering everything from sports, climate and technology to race, health, parenting and personal finance.
As the war between the Imperial Army and Hellhorde rages on, the Princess, despite being armed with her mythical sword Excalibur, is captured and imprisoned.
Embark on the ultimate winter getaway with some of Bravo's beloved Summer House (2017) and Southern Charm (2013) cast members and their friends during a two-week vacation in Stowe, Vermont.
A tale of power, corruption and redemption set against the rich backdrop of the French port city of Marseille.
Gun-toting Grandma Hattie from Tyler Perry's plays gets her own sitcom. Managing the Love Train Diner with her brother-in-law Floyd, she dishes out justice in the best way: with love.

Two spies from neighbouring warring states get entangled in court politics, war and dangerous plots despite wanting to retire from their paths to live up to their principles and shifting bottom lines to achieve peace.

If you'd never seen him with a ball, you wouldn't look twice at 11-year-old Jamie Johnson, but blessed with incredible talent, he has the skills to live every school boy's dream - to be a professional footballer.
This is a sketch comedy show centering around four women and their life observations.
The life story of R&B musician Bobby Brown.
Enter a cradle of mysteries where a man with a dark past manipulates multiple lives through a series of cryptic letters and deadly games.
Rab C. Nesbitt is lowlife scum (and proud of it) in Glasgow, Scotland who spends his time drinking in his local and speaking to the camera about the state of society as he sees it.
A rude, crude, and scruffy curmudgeon named Dan tries to get revenge on anyone and anything that angers him.
A mother and daughter blur the lines between family and close friendship.

Stacey Solomon and her team of experts help makeover Britain's cluttered homes. All of the homeowners possessions are taken to a warehouse where they will choose what to let go and what will return to their reorganised home.

movies.primaryTitle: From Me to You: Kimi ni Todoke
movies.originalTitle: From Me to You: Kimi ni Todoke
movies.plot: Put off by her gloomy demeanor, Sawako has a hard time fitting in but when an outgoing classmate approaches her, life takes a turn for the better.
In an alternative present, companion robots are commonplace. When humans make copies of themselves so lifelike that they form emotional bonds, questions and ethical dilemmas arise.
Lolita is a single woman whose husband has left her and she has to start a PG to pay off bank EMIs and loans. However, he soon has to face many problems.

movies.primaryTitle: It's Okay to Not Be Okay
movies.originalTitle: It's Okay to Not Be Okay
movies.plot: It follows Mia, a woman diagnosed with an antisocial personality disorder, who gets romantically involved with Patpat, a psych ward caretaker, who has dedicated his life to taking care of his autistic older brother Matmat.
A detective investigates brutal murders where body parts are left at a police station. He learns the tiffin supplier is married to his ex-colleague, with whom he once stopped another serial killer.
Sitcom based around widower Simon, his daughter Samantha and life at his advertising agency - Eyecatchers.
When Alexandra discovers that her late husband led a double life, she secretly befriends the other woman, Veronica, to uncover what really happened at the pier the night that he died.
All You Need is a dramedy series produced by ARD, about four gay men in Berlin, searching for love and security in the age of Grindr. The show is created and directed by Benjamin Gutsche.

The Nashes of Ridgemont, New York are an unusual suburban family. Jim Nash, a college English professor, and his wife Joan, a newspaper columnist, live with their four sons, a tolerant family maid, and a huge sheep dog.
Mahboobeh, a noble's daughter in old Tehran, loves a carpenter's apprentice. She defies family and rejects suitors, fighting for their approval to marry Rahim, not knowing fate may have other plans.
Hong Ji Hyo's boyfriend disappears with an unidentified light. Since then, Hong Ji Hyo traces her boyfriend's whereabouts. With the help of a UFO club members, she approaches a mysterious secret.
Detective Maria Kallio is a drama series about a thirtysomething cop, who dreams of becoming a lawyer but ends up heading the murder squad.

Two strangers enter a fake marriage: he gains his inheritance, she gains business credibility. Their six-month agreement seems simple until real feelings develop, forcing them to reconsider their planned split.
A drama series about food, love and infidelity in Cornwall.

Zeynep who lives with her twin children, is divorced from Oktay whom she married with great love during her university years, because she was cheated on. Zeynep loses her faith in men and closes her heart to love. Until he met Kenan Yelda.

Claudia Winkleman hosts the search for the UK's best amateur piano performers. The pianists will play on the pianos that have been set up in four of the UK's railway stations. The winner will play at the Royal Festival Hall.
The adventures of two unlikely friends, an emotional pickle and a freewheeling peanut, utilizing a mix of animation and live action.
An Amsterdam student joins a secret society that has been around since the Dutch Golden Age, but must decide how far she is willing to go to rise up the ranks.
Two police officers, both burdened by personal losses, team up to solve a high-profile murder case that involves people close to them.

Based on the Spike Milligan children's book "Badjelly the Witch" the animated series will bring to life Milligan's original tale about two siblings who go searching for a lost cow - and stumble upon a cast of magical creatures.

Meet Isobel. Struggling to make rent, she turns her extra bedroom into extra cash--while trying to figure out exactly who she is. Spoiler alert: It's complicated. "Strangers" is a coming-out-of-age story about finding yourself.

Prince Fichael and his crew as they venture out of their domed human city to fight the evil aliens that want to kill them. As they begin their journey, Fichael quickly discovers that all is not what it seems and he may be living a lie.
Oprah Winfrey hosts a live audience talk-show with celebrity guests and discusses daily stories.
The story is based on horrifying true incidents that happened between 1985 - 1995 in Chennai.

81 contestants compete in a high-tension battle of knowledge, nerve and strategy. Standing on a vast floor made up of 81 squares, each of which represents a unique category, players go head-to-head in quick-fire duels.

In 'The Oldenheim 12' we follow the lives of the residents of the extremely traditional Dutch village of Oldenheim. The locals are shaken to the core when they suddenly face a series of mysterious disappearances.
A powerful vampire causes chaos in Japan. Yukina, an apprentice Sword Shaman, encounters Akatsuki Kojou, the Fourth Primeval.
Follows Charlotte and Asher's untold story from the Rock Squad vampire universe, set in the 1990s.
After finding out their babies were switched at birth, two women develop a plan to adjust to their new lives creating a single and very peculiar family.
Sarah, a polite and curious 7-year-old English girl, embarks on lots of little adventures with her best friend - a lovable duck named Duck.

This Yu-Gi-Oh spinoff explores more serious themes. The story takes place in a dystopian future where Domino City has been divided into Neo Domino and the Satellite sector after a tragic incident. Satellite residents are looked down upon.
Live matches from the all-women's professional wrestling league.

After a thousand years of exile, Talpa, ruler of the Netherworld, returns to claim the Earth as his own. The only thing that can stop him and his minions are five young men and their mystical suits of armor.
Mockumentary comedy series following the life of Scottish police officers from different areas of the force. In a fly on the wall style.
British sketch comedy starring the likes of Rowan Atkinson and Mel Smith.
A police officer must deal with society's and his mother's pressure to marry, as well as frequent bullying and pressure from his superiors.
Celebrities guess hidden phrases by guessing letters one at a time and win money or prizes, as determined by a spin of the wheel, for each correct consonant they guess.

A senator's aide unravels a complex web of lies, crimes and conspiracies when she returns to her corrupt hometown -- San Bonifacio, Texas, near the Mexican border--to investigate the death of her sister, a local cop killed by a car bomb.

Psychologist Artyom uses provocative therapy but faces chaos when accused of causing a patient's suicide. Released from prison, he reopens his practice, aiming to prove his innocence while helping clients and navigating personal struggles.
A live situation-comedy that revolves around a family that wins a national lottery and examines how they handle the changes after winning a huge amount of money.
A diamond dealer navigates the culturally diverse and otherwise treacherous world of the diamond business.
The Crown takes Tempest's stronghold. The ex-pirate wins a pardon and becomes a privateer. He and Deputy Gov. Beamish fight Spanish raiders despite their unease. They defend the Caribbean.
In an America quarantined by the rest of the world, humans and vampires co-exist on opposite coasts thanks to a peace treaty, while each side plots to destroy the other.
An African-American editorial assistant works at a white NYC publishing firm. When a black co-worker arrives she gets excited, but is the new girl a friend or a foe?

Three boxers from Chelyabinsk, before flying to the World Championship, decide to earn extra money at the Moscow Ultimate Fighting Tournament. Having learned about the violation of the sports regime, the head coach excludes them from the national team. The boys eat sadly in a restaurant, discussing their inglorious homecoming. In the same establishment, a business dinner of a famous Moscow lawyer is being held, with the protection of which, through no fault of the guys, a conflict begins. Boxers demonstrate their skills and naturally end up in the police. They face jail time. However, the lawyer offers a deal: become his bodyguards or go to jail. The brave trinity decides to change their tracksuits to classic ones.
A detective from Wicklow in the east of Ireland is looking for a murderer, not suspecting that someone close to him may be the culprit.
After spending most of her life in big cities, widow Doris Martin decides to move back to the family ranch.

In ancient Qin Dynasty, Emperor Qin Shi Huang dispatched a secret army, the "Tangled Army," to uncover the secret of immortality. Over time, the army's expedition and findings vanished, leaving their mission and fate shrouded in mystery.
Follows the evolution and power of gangs across the United States and abroad.
An insight, to the many lives of the women and men that enter jail.

"THE NEW GATE" online game becomes deadly, trapping many. Shin, defeats final boss but gets transported 500 years into game world instead of escaping. He finds himself in unfamiliar territory, facing challenges in virtual realm.
Crown Prince Lee Gak transports 300 years into the future following the death of his wife; in 21st century Seoul, he meets Joo Se-Na, a woman with an uncanny resemblance to the deceased princess.

movies.originalTitle: Todas las veces que nos enamoramos
movies.plot: Year 2003, Irene a young film student who is preparing a short film. To star in it, she meets Julio, with whom she quickly falls in love. But time and life take them down other paths, extending to the present.
Horrible plastic surgeries gone wrong are looked at by two of California's best plastic surgeons.

Ranma transforms into a girl when splashed with cold water. An Amazon warrior Shampoo, cursed to become a cat, pursues him. Ranma's friend Mousse fights him over fiance Akane amid a panty thief's antics.
The colorful crew at Gotham Garage overhauls an eclectic collection of cars and trucks, trading up to a showstopper they can sell for big bucks.
A mystery drama series about trials and tribulations of Aboriginal people in the fictional town of Lynx River, Northwest Territories.
Former Florida prosecutor and judge Marilyn Milian decides actual small-claims court cases. Participants and onlookers are interviewed, and viewers are polled on the cases via a Web site.
A man receives a death message that leads him on a quest to prevent his future murder and protect those closest to him from the same fate.

Mother hen Nettie monitors Mellie, whose recent behavior as a single gypsy woman is improper. Mellie seeks love while working. Kayla's home is chaotic housing Laura's family. When the four meet for fun or business, chaos ensues.

Following the death of Ashish, the promised heir to the Gaikwad political legacy, it is Ameya Rao Gaikwad's rebel daughter Poornima who's at the helm of affairs as the interim chief minister of Maharashtra.
This charming group of West Virginia craftsmen honor their ancestors as they reclaim and restore some of America's oldest and most beautiful barns and cabins.

movies.primaryTitle: How to Build a Sex Room
movies.originalTitle: How to Build a Sex Room
movies.plot: Couples looking for more spice in the bedroom hire luxury interior designer Melanie Rose to create stylish spaces where they can carry out any fantasy they wish.
A reality series that follows couples working to preserve their relationships while one of the partners is incarcerated.
Doménica, a wealthy orphan raised by her aunt, faces betrayal when her fiancé Max flees before their wedding. She retreats to her ranch, becoming cold-hearted, until meeting neighbor José María.
Lin Dong wants to take revenge on a man who embarrassed his father in front of everyone. Now we have to see if it will be successful.
An edgy satire centered on liberal activist Will Stancil that features animation largely created with AI. It was released on X by controversial cartoonist Emily Youcis.
The 1978 kidnapping and assassination of former Italian Prime Minister Aldo Moro by Red Brigades terrorists

"Mohrey" is a crime thriller at the essence tangled in suspense, mystery, revenge and a hint of romance. It has a "Rashomon" kind of a narrative that keeps the audience on toes seeking for the real version of truth.
Follow Inspector Cetin Ikmen, his partner Mehmet Suleyman, and Detective Ayse Farsakoglu as they solve crimes in the modern world of Turkey.
An Italian version of the acclaimed, innovative Norwegian youth series Skam, which follows a group of teenagers in their everyday life of school, love, and leisure time.
Lives intertwine as hidden truths surface, revealing a web of romance, treachery, and battles for control.
Hitman Steven Matrix is shot, experiences afterlife, gets second chance by helping others. Wakes up, meets guides assigning cases where he aids people using unorthodox methods from past profession.
Children's series about the adventures of Worzel Gummidge (Jon Pertwee), a scarecrow who comes to life.

The second season of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck's movie making reality series goes a different route when it's two professionals realizing their vision on screen instead of just one: writer and director.
When a rookie detective Yoo Ryung's autistic twin sister goes missing, Yoo Ryung joins the subway police team to try and find her.

A woman struggles to fulfill her dreams in the face of a tyrannical family determined to control every step of her, battling alone to win the hearts of her children who have turned against her and achieve the life she desires.

This intoxicating cocktail of crime thriller and family saga in the early '80s follows the Lords - a family of South London gangsters - who recognise a golden opportunity to re-capture their former glory on the Costa Del Sol.
An extraordinary series with an electric, oppressive atmosphere. A spiral of violence, unhealthy manipulations and tortured characters, Durham County excels in the detective series genre.
Four farmers and 32 women meet and mutually decide if any connections, love, or futures can be found, all while in their farm settings.

Cameras ride along with Troopers as they keep the streets safe and hunters honest while at the same time taking advantage of the breathtaking landscape that Alaska State Troopers are lucky enough to call "their office."

Dicte is a dedicated reporter and refuses to give up before she has her story. Her stubborness gives her problems immediately with the policeman John Wagner, and they often get into clashes with each other.
New York City accountant Bruce moves to Sweden in Northern Europe, after falling in love with a Swedish woman.
It's Christmas in the 1980s, Adolf Hitler is alive and has two Yuletide wishes: Danger 5 dead and the world under his Christmas tree.
The show follows the Jonas Brothers through fun and unusual situations as they try to live ordinary lives.
From critical emergencies to the operating room, this documentary series follows London's trauma centres as they treat the most severely injured.
#Bhagar is based on 2018 "Bhagar" scandal. Anirban is on a mission to expose Iqbal and his fake baby food business. Paresh realizes how painful death can be and decides to live.
Retired naval commander Jim Kennedy is divorced and has a teenage son. He takes over the famous cruise ship, where he and his crew tackle different scenarios with different passengers every week.

A six-year-old girl named Kai-lan, who invites friends at her home to share in the colorful interplay of Chinese and American cultures, as well as the Mandarin language, through interactive exercises and magical stories.

The Clan is an adaptation that will center on an engaging story about the classic struggle between the Police and the Mafia. Tensions will rise as love stories spice up the eternal battle between good and evil.
A man with severe conflict-avoidance issues is forced to change for his son's sake.

A police officer becomes a ray of hope in the darkness of injustice and crime. While investigating, she unfolds various mysteries which challenge the longstanding societal beliefs and rituals. A story about fighting for good against evil.
A charming young businessman dates a spoiled woman. They plan a memorable night, but an unexpected event leaves the loud, chatty woman astonished.
A team of little-known Canadian superheroes are called in to save the world when other superheroes are destroyed.
The series is about a company president who gets trapped in a smartphone due to a suspicious incident, and an unemployed young man whose life changes after picking up the strange smartphone.

Se-hyun, a genius forensic scientist who discovers traces of her father's killings while doing an autopsy, and goes on a hunt in order to hide the past that she wants to erase, before the police get to the truth first.
An epic, generation-spanning drama about two Latino families vying for wealth and power in California's Sonoma Valley.
A team of experts from auction houses tours towns throughout the UK to value treasures brought in by members of the public.

The lives of Istanbul's richest and most powerful families. Their maids, who are exposed to the secrets, mysteries and crimes hidden behind the closed doors of these houses, often become a part of them.

Our world is dying; a pair of scientists attempting to create the world first teleporter manage to create something even more powerful: time machines. But their actions have unintended consequences, with the butterfly effect taking hold.
Three powerful families of Mani are involved in a cycle of blood, hatred, and revenge. In the rugged land of olives, a revenge trap sets to love.
Intelligent and endearing, Dexter Morgan is America's favorite serial killer - a crime solver by day who becomes a murderer by night.

Ten of Mexico's best comedians compete against each other in a celebrity showdown. As the clock ticks in this six-hour competition, the goal is to eliminate your opponents from the house by making them laugh.
An elf working in Santa's Workshop in the North Pole dreams of becoming Santa Claus someday.
The Octonauts expand their exploration beyond the sea - and onto land. With new rides and new friends, they'll protect any habitats and animals at risk.
A married couple gives up their high-powered careers to run a daycare center in their home.
In 1914, on the eve of war, a fugitive prince and a girl in disguise meet aboard a bioengineered airship, the HMS Leviathan, and change the course of history.
In her sixth year of law school, Cristela is finally on the brink of landing her first big (unpaid) internship at a prestigious law firm.

A cat - Tom - and a mouse - Jerry - are a frenemy duo whose small conflicts lead to traps, slamming, crashing, and a lot of cartoonish shenanigans. Sometimes, they end up teaming against other enemies or Jerry/Tom teaming up with the enemy.
Crime series kick-started by the finding of a young man's body.
The story of college students and their realization of first love as they make new friends.

Babe, the number 1 driver, is Charlie's idol. Charlie wants to be like Babe, but he does not have a race car. He plucks up courage and approaches Babe to ask to borrow one. Babe agrees and the two make an interesting deal.
Follows Atlanta-based self-made multimillionaire Todd Chrisley, his devoted wife Julie and their five children who live a seemingly picture-perfect Southern life with everything money can buy.

TRT's historical drama, based on the life of "Barbaros" Hayreddin Pasha and his brothers. The series tells the adventures of Ishak, Oruc, Hizir, and Ilyas fighting high tides and the secrets of the seas in pursuit of the holy secret.
A charming young priest arrives in a small town, hiding secrets. His true purpose remains unknown until the powerful local leader's daughter unexpectedly becomes his greatest challenge.
Tari and Bian sign a wedding agreement ending their marriage after one year.

movies.originalTitle: Sono bisuku dôru wa koi wo suru
movies.plot: The story centers on a high school student who dreams of becoming a hina doll craftsman and his popular classmate who asks him to make a cosplay costume for her.
The daily challenges facing the first Woman Police Constable to join a West Midlands force in the 1950s, where sexism, chauvinism and petty grudges are rife.
Based on Lily Koppel's best-selling titular novel, which tells the real story of the women who stood beside some of the biggest heroes in American history during the height of the space race.
Contestants competing against a professional quizzer, known as the Chaser, whose aim is to prevent the contestants from winning a cash prize.

In Nafplio 2025, abandoned twins confront their mother - now married into a powerful family - forcing long-hidden secrets, forbidden loves, and a vengeful past to collide in a tale of betrayal and redemption.
Follow "relationship fixer" Dr. Draya Logan, a renowned marriage and sex therapist who finds herself entangled in a series of lies, sex, and murder that could cost her everything.
A gripping tale of love, injustice and revenge, where past mistakes block the path to happiness.
A culinary school becomes the backdrop for a heartwarming comedy that stirs up redemption, social inclusion, and fresh starts into a flavorful mix of life lessons.

movies.primaryTitle: Spice and Wolf: Merchant Meets the Wise Wolf
movies.originalTitle: Ookami to Koushinryou: Merchant Meets the Wise Wolf
movies.plot: Merchant Kraft Lawrence discovers a wolf deity named Holo sleeping in his cart. She offers to lend her wisdom to boost his profits if he takes her on his travels. Their unlikely partnership begins.

Ash Blake is nothing but a joke to his fellow students at Ansullivan Dragonar Academy. Sure, he's got a sacred star brand that marks him as a future master of dragons, but he's having more than a little trouble playing the part of a hero.
Zombie House Flipping explores the recent trend of house flippers scooping up foreclosed and often abandoned zombie houses and renovating them to return neighborhoods to their former glory.

An English language version of Ultraman: A Special Effects Fantasy Series (1966) following a man named Hayata who transforms into a giant superhero named Ultraman to fight alien invaders and giant monsters that threatened earth.
Follows Ren Amamiya and a rebellious group of teenagers in Tokyo who form the Phantom Thieves of Hearts to rebel against the corruption and slavery in society.

Now Pepe Cadena finishes telling the story in which the most powerful drug traffickers in Colombia are strengthened but later fall while he and others dedicate themselves to the dangerous task of exposing them to collaborate with justice.
K-pop sensation SUPER JUNIOR stars in a dynamic variety show featuring multiple segments, from quiz competitions and talk shows to cooking segments and talent showcases.
Comedy duo Dawn French and Jennifer Saunders satirically present aspects of British life, films such as Batman Forever and Pulp Fiction.
Two friends in bar narrate American urban legends with an additional strong sexual tone.
Best remembered by its posterior title, Your Show of Shows, this live variety show included comedy sketches with TV pioneers Sid Caesar and Imogene Coca.

movies.primaryTitle: A Little Late with Lilly Singh
movies.originalTitle: A Little Late with Lilly Singh
movies.plot: Late-night talk show hosted by Canadian comedian and YouTuber Lilly Singh.
Comedian Red Skelton hosts a variety show of comedic sketches, and a range of stars, to speak to an entire generation.
A group of Scottish school children travel to Australia in search of UFOs. The exciting journey is just the beginning of their adventures as the young explorers record their experiences on camera.

movies.primaryTitle: The All New Mickey Mouse Club
movies.plot: Reboot of the 1950's Mickey Mouse Club featuring comedy sketches, commercial parodies, music videos, celebrity guests and a cast of talented young performers.
Industrialist Tony Stark leads his private team of superheros as Iron Man against the forces of evil.
Several children investigate cases in their city together.
The life and events happening in 3 different families. Plot twists, secrets and love all build up in this show.

movies.primaryTitle: My Little Pony: Make Your Mark
movies.originalTitle: My Little Pony: Make Your Mark
movies.plot: Sunny Starscout, Zipp Storm and their friends now live together on the coast of Maretime Bay, where they uncover magical adventures and must be ready to fight Opaline Arcana, an exiled alicorn from the days of Twilight Sparkle.

Punn, the owner of a vintage shop, is enlisted by a gallery-owning friend to restore a painting vandalized under mysterious circumstances. During the process, Punn injures himself, inadvertently staining the artwork with his blood.

Falsely accused of violence in high school, adult Kang Bok Soo returns as a student to get revenge on his first love and classmate who caused his expulsion. He gets caught up in the changed school's dynamics.
The missions of a Mobile Infantry squad as they participate in a war of survival against a ferocious alien insectoid invader.
A psychologist and body image expert work with groups of people with different body types to help them love their bodies.

After their home-care team leader's death, two assistants-new hire Sille and veteran Rie-uncover dangerous secrets and power dynamics that could destroy their careers and expose the system's dark side.
Paris and Nicole accept various internships along the East Coast. Hilarity ensues as the girls leave their limos behind and travel by Greyhound bus.
Hosted by Brian Malarkey, Cutthroat Kitchen: Knives Out hands four chefs each $25,000 and the opportunity to spend that money on helping themselves or sabotaging their competitors.
The 11th century and the emergence of the leader of the El Hashaashun group, Hassan Al Sabah

movies.originalTitle: Xian ru re lian de wo men
movies.plot: Zhi Xu, a top student, meets Luzhou Chen, a troublemaker with a violent past, during the summer after her college entrance exam. Despite their contrasting reputations, an unexpected connection forms between them.

Kusum excitedly awaits wedding night with husband Ravi. But soldier Ravi suddenly called to duty, leaving Kusum frustrated. Mysterious intimate gifts appear on her window, intriguing Kusum. She wonders who this secret gift giver could be.

In a peaceful region, a horrific crime occurs: business owners are brutally murdered. Detective Melchor Marín investigates the case while balancing family life. The story explores justice, vengeance, and one man's quest for purpose.
A series of hardboiled crime fiction set in contemporary Naples by the author of the internationally bestselling Commissario Ricciardi series.
Young and attractive, they explore the underground swinging scene, breaking stereotypes about who embraces non-monogamous lifestyles.
People in England are worried about the coming millennium. The year is A.D. 999.

Wildcards is Saving Throw's live play Savage Worlds Deadlands Reloaded RPG show on Twitch and Youtube. It follows a posse in alternate history 1879 as they make their trek through the dangerous Deadlands of the wild west. James Bogue, the stoic gunslinger; Rosaleen S. Byrne the charismatic high class escort/Huckster who deals with demons; her just as charismatic partner in crime, Gabriel Prior, a con artist posing as preacher; Torte Law, the playful Native American scout; and Howell Melton, the consummate frontier's gentlemen looking for a simple life. These 5 find themselves chosen as unlikely heroes to save the world from Hell on earth, but will they be able to defeat their own demons to help everyone else?

1557, The Wars of Religion threaten France. Behind the ramparts of the castle of Mespech, surrounded by a dangerous, hostile and intolerant world, the Siorac family fights for its survival and its convictions.
Napoleon's tumultuous relations with Russia including his disastrous 1812 invasion serve as the backdrop for the tangled personal lives of five aristocratic Russian families.

Dakota, Chelsea, Tanner, and Alex rule out the option of ending their terrifying road trips and continue their paranormal investigations by uncovering some of the most haunted places in all of America and the world.
Follows the showdown that results from the love that blossoms between two kids of lovers who parted ways years ago because of a letter.
After an accident, no one can see the once-popular Koichi - except for loner Mitsuru, whose fondness for his classmate blooms into a haunting romance.
When a science experiment goes wrong, teenagers Shelby and Cyd start leaping backwards and forwards through time. Teenage genius Barry helps them master their new power.

Inspired by a 2016 event, the series follows a child abduction that triggers a complex tale of power and class struggles. A house cleaner, makes a secret deal to protect her child, highlighting parents' fight for survival.

movies.primaryTitle: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee
movies.originalTitle: The Life and Times of Juniper Lee
movies.plot: Juniper Lee is an 11 year old girl who can fight the force of chaos and curses. One day she skipped one of her friends' birthdays and fights the chaos again.

"Undefeated lawyer" Tang Yingying faces off against her boss Kang Jun in a series of cases, navigating the conflict between social connections and legal principles, ultimately leading to personal growth.
-We dive into the world of the Lapointe-Macdonald firm and its criminal defense team.
Quentin, Tiff, Vicki and others look at all things car-related.
Threesome is a comedy about three inseparable friends in their 30s. Alice lives with her boyfriend Mitch and her gay best friend Richie. Together they form three points of an unlikely triangle.
Follows a young woman and her hero's journey.
Teams of celebrities and their families face off to name the top responses to questions posed to 100 people.
Scottish mining engineer and adventurer Richard Hannay upholds his own moral code while navigating thrilling escapades in early 20th century Britain.
This is a horror story of the pure trembling love of a girl named Satou Matsuzaka.
True stories of female killers.
The life of four lifelong friends changes drastically after an accidental homicide at a bachelor party.
The story of a Michelin-starred chef whose world implodes when he discovers shocking secrets about his pregnant wife.

Widowed shopkeeper Ah Wing raises his son while managing grief. Meeting insurance consultant Zi Meng leads to friendship and possible romance, as he helps others and she reconsiders her views on marriage.
A village family story who try build an relation with their Maalik for job and therefore the twist began in their life.
Follows the catastrophic single life of Cat as she strives to survive in a world where everything else is still going on but hers has abruptly come to an end.
A group of doctors from the U.S. travel to work at a remote clinic in the South American tropics in an attempt to discover the true reasons they became doctors.

movies.primaryTitle: Teen Wolf: Search for a Cure
movies.originalTitle: Teen Wolf: Search for a Cure
movies.plot: The story revolves around Stiles tracking down a werewolf expert named Dr. Conrad Fenris in the belief that he may be able to cure recently bitten werewolf Scott McCall.
Jeff Randall and Marty Hopkirk are private detectives, running their own agency. When Hopkirk gets killed, he reappears as a ghost - pretty handy to have around in this line of work.

Revisiting the twisted lives of some of the most frightening, diabolical characters in recent history. The stories trace the heinous, criminal acts of these elusive miscreants and the eventual road to justice.
Moviebox is a TV Show that brings the latest news of the movie industry. Backstage interviews, junkets,festival coverage,latest theaters releases,red carpets and premieres.

movies.primaryTitle: The Fall and Rise of Reginald Perrin
movies.originalTitle: The Fall and Rise of Reginald Perrin
movies.plot: This story concerns a middle-aged middle manager, Reginald "Reggie" Perrin, who is driven to bizarre behaviour by the pointlessness of his job at Sunshine Desserts.

After getting abandoned by both his family and his allies at the Agency for reporting his encounter with a UFO, an ambitious CIA field agent is asked to join a task force investigating government knowledge of UFOs, and possibly much more.
A doctor who knows more than she lets on about what happens after you die.
This Cartoon Network series centers around Lion-O and his wacky misadventures, as he tries to defeat the evil Mumm-Ra.

Age is thrown out the window when singles search for their soulmates, but will the years come between them? Hosted by Nick Viall and Natalie Joy, a group of daters will discover if love is truly ageless.

Abandoned in the countryside, Hanyan returns to her family, catching ill deputy minister Yunxi's eye. As they fall in love, she rebuilds family bonds and helps expose her corrupt father's hidden misdeeds.
